tshotsho 5cicitrī rngarigatsā gyi citsho chici — mi cho ṇ+ḍi hūṃ/tsho ཿ tsho dzo tsho nyaḥ9ram̐ 7 snamo.oṃcitsho jidze thocho ‘ chi‘ṭ+wāṃ rid she te 'aspyo/khyi (3 (zhu pre 5ba ro 3( —

rī stochi ca ‘zici 4rī ricici/byu rnyowacichirnyi ju ṭ+wāṃhūṃ ‘rngo —hūm̐ rīñca sgru ‘ ri me7ri — 3ci tsho ne smiṭ+wāṃ tsho ri tsho snatsho4dzi citsho lhayo da rte ོ nispyo sri (3 (zhu me 5ba ro ja( —

dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/dgeslong blo bzang bstan 'dzin ni 1916lor bod ljongs dbus stod mal gro gung dkar rdzong khongs phag mo lha sding nas 'khrungs shingakadagung lo 8da 13bar lha sa grong khyer khongs go ba khang ser nang sger gyi slob grwa zhig tu bodalgig sbyangs/ dgung lo 20(1933)lo nas de snga'i bodas gnas srid gzhung gi bla phyag las khungs kyi 'khu li'i go gnas thob/1958lo b.rasnga rjes su phebasakhyams pa dngaka bla phyag jo lags/ lha sa slob 'bring gi dge rgan/ mtsho sna 'bras sgrub pa sogs gnangaka1959lor rgya gar duyal gyar phebs te sngarjes suyāl gyar zlos gar 'go 'dzinadang / shes rig drung che/ rgya gar ldi li rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi lasabyed sogs gnangaka 1980lo'i zla 6par bal yul brgyud bod du phyir phebs gtan bzhugs kyis 1982lo nas lha sa grong khyer srid gros kyi uyon gnang ba dang 1984lor lha sa grong khyer srid gros kyi rgyun las u yon gnang ba bcas so/ /

7 skru5skospu kotsādzi lha spulha45rithu tsho/ma5dzonadzi /sbyi'i 'don thengadro slo/ zhethos byiṭā ༵sna rdo/nga k+ṣiṃ~X ༵sna tram̐ ༵ ༵ snaṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃpy-i py-i r+sha~X k+ṇi~X sbya / py-i~X/ phran dge smong blo bzang bstan 'dzin rang nyid kyi ༷༷/ /bye//khros /spyi)'o rgyus dang 'a' ba'i gas gidon da'os 'ga' gablo bzaX waXwa ༷/༷ /wa / brtsams/

dkar chagagacig rang lo bcu bdun bar gyi gnas tshul/ (1)gnyis/ rang lo bco brgyad lo go mag tu ster ba dang /zha'u li bskos pa/ (7)gsum/ lo gcig gi nang du bla phyag las khungs kyis bsgrub dgos pa'i las ka'i skor/ (13)bzhi/ 1939lo nas 1940lo bar bla phyag gi zha'u li sogs byed ring gi 'brel yod gnas tshul/ (53)lnga/ gting skyes 'bras sgrub pa'i las 'gan 'khur ba'i skor sogs/ (71)drug mes rgyal nang sar tā la bcu bzhi pa'i chibs zhabs su bskyod skor sogs/ (86)bdun/ lha sa slob 'bring du dge rgan gyi las 'gan 'khur ba'i skor sogs/ (100)brgyad/ mtsho sna 'bras khang gzhung 'dzin byed par bskyod skor sogs/ (107)dgu/ rgya gar du bros byol phyin pa'i skor/ (120)bcu/ bal yul nas bod du bskyod 'byor skor/ (237)bcu gcig dus rabs 'di'i nang yul gyi nyo thang ji byas skor gyi gnas tshul mdor bsdus shig (348)1

gcig rang lo bcu bdun bar gyi gnas tshul/phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin (thog ma'i ming lha dbang tshe ring )gyi skyes yul ni grong khyer lha sa'i shar ngos su gnas pa'i dbus stod mal gro gung dkar rdzong khongs phag mo lha sdings zhes pa'i khul du yin pa dang / khyim tshang ni sger lha sdings pa'i mi ser grogs ra gsar zhes pa'i zhing pa zhig yin/pha dbang 'dus tshe ring (mal gung rdzong gi las drung byed myong ba )dang / ma sgrol 'dzoms gnyis la rigs myug ming sring lnga byung ba'i nang nas phran ni rgan shos de yin zhing / rab byung bcu drug pa'i me 'brug zla 4tshes 15(spyi lo 1916lo'i zla 6tshes 26)nyin skyes/ ming la lha dbang tshe ring zhes btags 'dugarang lo drug tsam la slebs dus phas nang du yi ge 'bri klog bslab pa dang / lo brgyad la slebs skabs lha sar sger gyi slob grwa go bo khang ser zhes par pha mas slob sbyong la btang byung / rang lo bcu bzhi la slebs dus rang dpon sger lha sdings pa'i mdun g.yog la yong dgos zhes bka' phab don bzhin slob sbyong byed 'phro bzhag ste lha sdings pa'i g.yog por 'gro dgos byung /nga'i dpon po lha sdings sras bsod nams tshe ring gi las ka bya yul ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i gam bcar zhabs zhu spyan bsal thub bstan kun 'phel gyis 'go khrid byed pa'i grwa bzhi ‘‘glog 'phrul ngo mtshar gter mdzod khang ’’zhes pa'i las khungs de'i nang las ka gnang gi 'dug sa sbrul 1929lor rgya gar dbyin gzhung nas dmag mkho'i yo chas me smyogs dang /1

sbag sbag mi srin ghan/ de rnams kyi mde'u bcas 'bor chen zhig de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung la spus tshong byas pa rnams rtsis len du grwa bzhi glog 'phrul las khungs nas lha sdings sras bsod nams tshe ring mngag gtong byas don ltar rgya gar du skyod skabs phran lha dbang tshe ring yang g.yog por 'gro dgos byung zhing / lha sa nas mnyes thang dang / chu shur/ gam pa bar tshigs/sna dkar rtse/ ra lung / sgo bzhi/ rgyal rtse/ sab sgang / khang dmar/ sa ma mda'/ ka la/ dud sne/ phag ri/ gro mo bcas rdzong gzhis so sor 'byor dus rdzong dpon phal che ba dang gtso drag rnams kha btags khyer te rang rang gi rdzong sa gnas de nas mal le gnyis gsum mtshams su phebs bsur yong mi 'dug phar lam dud sner ma slebs tsam la chu mig gshongs ko zhes par de snga shing 'brug lo dbyin dmag gis bod du btsan 'dzul byed skabs lha sdings mda' dpon (de ni bsod nams tshe ring gi yab red )zhes skad grags can de dbyin dmag gis zhi chings byed rgyu yin khul gyis mgo skor btang ste bkrong yul gyi sa cha de red zer gyi 'dug de snga'i zhabs gras rnying pa de dus kyang mnyam yod gnyer pa khra khog tshe ring zer ba de sa gnas der slebs dus sngar gyi lo rgyus dran nas mig chu gtong gi 'dug rgyal rtse nas 'bras ljongs kyi sgang thog bar dbyin jis sbrag zam btsugs pa'i khang pa (sbrag sbang lar )khag la tsha zhag sgrig cha byas 'dug cing / gro mor 'byor 'phral me mda' dang mde'u sogs dbor 'dren bya rgyu'i thad rta drel dang / mi hreng gis nang 'dren byed dgos stabs gro mo ba rta drel yod rigs dang brdal gla sprod len byed phyogs skor gro mo spyi khyab pa dang mi dmangs kyi 'go khrid gong 'thus rnams dang gros mol bya rgyu sogs la bdun phrag gnyis tsam yun 'gor byung song / de nas gro mo bye ma dang / chu 'bi thang / sna thod la brgal te mtsho 'go dang spon rdor mal le bcas brgyud sgang thog tu 'byor/ 'bras spyi blon chen lbil lim sab 2

ces pa bha ra ko ṭi zer bar 'dug pa kho rang sdod yul gyi gzim chung khag gcig tu sku ngo gnyis dang / nga tsho g.yog po tsho sdod khang gcig rta drel bzhag sa bcas gang legs gra sgrig byas 'dug sku ngo bsod nams tshe ring dang khong gi lcam chung gi gcung po sde dge sras skal bzang dbang 'dus lags mnyam 'khrid gnang yod pa khong gnyis kyi gsol tshigs nyin ltar 'bras spyi blon chen dang lhan du gnang gi yod pa red/ nga tsho g.yog po tshor yang nyin re zhogs ja dang / nyin dgung / dgong dro bcas nyin ltar lto thengs gsum re gang legs chu tshod dus thog tu gtong gi 'dug 'bras ljongs rgyal po lha sdings dang gnyen nyer brten nga tsho dpon g.yog tshang ma gsol ston la mgron 'bod thengs gsum tsam byas byung ba ltar phyin/ de nas sku ngo bsod nams tshe ring dang sde dge sras skal dbang lags/ zhabs gras rgan pa gnyis bcas ka blon sbug tu phebs nas dza sag ra ye bha dur dang thug 'phrad mol bsdur gyis rgyagar ldi lir ngo bskyod ma dgos par me mdel sogs tshang ma dbyin gzhung rang nas 'bras ljongs sgang thog tu rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu'i thag gcod byung 'dugade rjes zla ba gcig tsam song ba dang / me mdel sogs tshang ma sgang thog tu mjug 'gril 'byor bas gro mo ba'i 'go gtso gong 'thus rnams 'bras ljongs su 'gugs 'bod kyis sgam de rnams rtsis sprod dang 'brel brdal gla 'dod blo khengs pa sprad nas khong tshos phag ri bar gtsang skyel zhu rgyu'i khas len zhus pa sogs kyi skor lha sar bka' shag tu snyan zhu btang ste lha sding sras ngo g.yog gro mor thon zhing / gro mo dung dkar dgon dge bshes rin po che'i bzhugs shag tu phebs sgrig gra rgyas zhus 'dug dung dkar dgon par zla ba gnyis lhag tsam bzhugs ring dung dkar dgon gyi dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya lhag tsam gyi 'dus tshogs la bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed dang / rten mchog spyan sngar sna lnga'i mchod sprin brgya tshar 'bul bshams dang 'brel dge bshes rin po che 3

tshogs mgon du gdan zhus kyis brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan yang 'bul gnang mdzad song / nyin gcig gro mo spyi khyab pa dza sag mi rgyab pa zer ba de dung dkar dgon du dge bshes rin po che'i mjal khar bcar song bar khong la dgon pa'i dge 'dun rnam pas ser sbreng dung rgya dang bcas te phebs bsu zhus song / khong gis dgon pa'i srung ma'i gtso bo rgyal chen rdo rje shugs ldan rten gzhir khog brlams spyan 'dren gyis sngar dgon pa'i rtsod gzhi zhig bka' dpyad gtong phyogs la phran bu'i nor 'khrul byung bar gro spyi mi rgyab pas 'gyod bshags phul te dge bshes rin po cher brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan dang / rten mchog la mchod sprin/ dge 'dun 'dus tshogs la mang 'gyed/chos skyong la bshags tshogs bcas bstar 'bul yang zhus song / dung dkar dgon pa'i bla brang dang grwa tshang gnyis ka stobs 'byor mnga' thang chen po 'dug cing / rgya gar du phar tshur 'gro mi tshong pa dang / gnas skor ba sogs dge bshes rin po che'i mjal khar yong mkhan sprang po yan chod dbyer med tshang mar dgon pas za 'thung gnas mal sogs sne len gang gzab byed kyi 'dug nged tsho dpon 'khor gro mo nas phag rir phebs/ phag ri rdzong sbrel la me mdel sogs skyel 'dren 'phral du zhu dgos sogs kyi bka' mngags gnang / rdzong ya gcig lha sdings sku mched shod drung spo shod pa nas dpon g.yog tshang ma gsol ston la gdan zhus ltar phebs/ de nas phag ri rdzong sbrel dang gtso drag bcas kyis phebs skyel zhus/ dud sne brgyud rgyal rtser phebs/rgyal rtse rdzong mdun skyo lho zhes pa yab gzhis phun khang gi phyag mdzod kyi nang der phebs sgrigs gzab rgyas zhus 'dug rgyal rtser zla ba gcig tsam bzhugs ring rgyal rtse tshong spyi mkhan chung lo tsa ba ser byes blo bzang 'byung gnas zhes pas gsol mgron du yang yang gdan zhus ltar phebs/ rgyal rtse rdzong shar shod drung spel bzhi ba lha sdings dang gnyen nyer song bas/ dpon 4

g.yog tshang mar gsol ston thengs kha shas bshams/ bzhugs yul skyo lho phyag mdzod nas kyang nyin ltar gsol tshigs dang ja chang zhal tog sogs gzab rgyas btang / de'i skabs rgya gar dbyin ji'i tshong don ngo las rgyal rtser gtan sdod byed mkhan nas kyang gsol ston thengs gnyis bshams pa dang 'brel rta rgyugs dang / rta mchongs/ drel rgyugs/ bong rgyug glang rgyugs/ rkang rtsed spo lo/ rta bzhon spo lo bcas 'gran bsdur dang gzhan yang rgya gar gyi rkang bro glu gzhas glog brnyan sogs kyi ltad mo sna tshogs gzigs 'bul zhus song /nyin gcig rgyal rtse khul gyi bod rigs slob phrug tshang mas lo ltar byed srol red ces grong rdal gyi ri la bskor ba bskor te phyogs bzhi so sor mchongs rwa re re bzos 'dug pa der mchongs rgyag 'gran bsdur yang byas pa mthong byung /slob phrug kha shas kyis gdan sa se 'bras kyi grwa pa rdob rdob mchong rgyag mkhan dang 'dra ba yang mchongs thub kyi 'dug rgyal rtse dpal 'khor chos sde'i grwa tshang bla khag bcu drug dang / ri khrod dga' ldan sogs g.yas g.yon gyi dgon sde/ gnas rnying dgon pa sogs la gnas mjal mchod 'bul yang zhib lhod gnang song / rgyal rtse nas sgo bzhi/ ra lung / rdza ra/ sna dkar rtse/ dpal di/ gam pa bar tshigs/ chu shur/ ljang / mnyes thang bcas so sor zhag sa byas te lha sar 'byor/ grwa bzhi glog 'phrul las khungs la ma phyin gong rtse shod gzim chung 'gag so sor 'byor phyag zhus/ de nas grwa bzhi las khungs la bskyod de me mdel sogs re re bzhin rtsis 'bul la nyin grangs mang po 'gor/me mda'i spor tog ang grangs sogs lhu sgrig byas/ gus pa lo na chung stabs me mda' la ha cang dga' po yod/ spor tog ang grangs sgrig skabs rgan pa tsho las ngas mang ba sgrig thub kyi 'dug byas tsang sku bcar kun 'phel lags kyis nga la dga' po zhe drag gnang gi yod/ lcags rta 1930lo rang lo bco lngar (bod lo'i rtsi srol gsham la rigs 'gre yin )ngas pha ma'i gnyen 'phrad 5

la dgongs pa zhus te phyin pa yin/ de dus de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis grong drag dmag mi gsar 'dzugs bya rtsis kyis yul lung so so'i nang 'khos 'byor drag pa'i bu rang lo bcu drug yan nas lo sum cu so lnga man dmag bskul rgyag pa'i skabs 'khel zhing / mal gro gung dkar khul gyi dmag bskul byed po gtso bo rtse drung thub bstan theg mchog dang / sa gnas rdzong dpon/ las drung / mi ser gyi 'thus mi 'bri rgya phag gsum ('bri gung / rgya ma/ phag mo lha sdings )so so nas yi ge legs shes kyi gtso drag re bcas nas 'khur mnyam len gyis byed sgo 'thus tshang dgos rgyu'i skor bka' shag gi bka' rgya'i dgongs don ltar phag mo lha sdings pa'i gtso drag mi 'gror nga rang 'gro dgos zhes lha sa nas rang dpon gyis yi ge btang 'byor byung don bzhin nga rang 'gro dgos byung ste zla ba kha shas 'gor song / de rjes lha sar phyir log gis lha sdings pa'i g.yog po mu mthud rang 'jags bsdad/

gnyis/ rang lo bco brgyad lo go mag tu ster ba dang / zha'u li bskos pa/phran rang rang lo bco brgyad chu bya (1933)lo/ bod kyi rdo shing spyi khyab pa shing bzo las tshan karma bsod nams kyi bu mo bsod nams dbyangs can gyi mag par rang dpon nas ster 'dug pa dang / pha ma gnyis nas mal gung grong smad khang gsar la ster rgyu'i khas len gtsang ma zin yang / dpon khungs lha sdings pas ‘‘khyod tsho'i bu lha dbang tshe ring shing bzo las tshan karma bsod nams kyi bu mo'i mag par ster dgos zhes sku bcar kun 'phel lags nas bka' phebs pa ltar rtsa 'khrol phul zin pas 'phral du lha 'byor thub pa dgos rgyu ’’zhes pa'i yi ge tsha nan 'byor don ltar mi 'gro mthu med la brten/ pha ma gnyis nas nga tsho lha sa'i smon lam mjal bar 'gro zhes brel tshubs kyis lha sar thon/ chu bya lo zla dang po'i tshes gsum nyin chang sa'i rten 'brel byas/ lha ldan smon lam chen mo grol rjes sman rtsis khang du sum rtags sogs rig gnas slob sbyong du phyin/ lo de'i bod zla brgyad pa'i nang bla phyag las khungs kyi las byed zha'u li mi bzhi gsar 'jug bya dgos khongs su yig tshad phul te mi bab spyan khur bcar bas zha'u li bsko gzhag byas don ltar tshes cha stabs bstun gyis gsar mjal zhus/ las khungs bla brang phyag mdzod du gzhon gral byed sgo spyi dang / mdzod khang khag mang gi lde mig rnams khungs so so blo nges byas te 'gor 'gyangs med par sgo dbye bya rgyu dang / mar ltang dang / ja sgam/ pang 7

leb/ 'bras ltang sogs dngos zog sne mang rdzong gzhis khag nas 'byor ba rnams skad gsang mthon pos grangs rgyag dang / 'dom 'jal/ 'bo bshar sogs rtsis len bya rgyu/ rtsis len zin mtshams khang par sgo lcags brgyab thog sgo zam 'then nas la cha'i the'u mi 'dra ba khag gsum re trem rgyag rgyu/ rnam kun res gza' spen pa phud/ de min nyin ltar zhogs pa nas sgo phye ste gtong sgo 'gro khungs lha ldan gtsug lag khang steng shod bar gsum dang / ra mo che/rtse pho brang po ta la'i mchod khang khag gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum/ rgyud grwa stod smad/ rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang / gnas chung / dga' gdong / rme tu/bzhi sde/ tshe smon gling / kun bde gling / tshe mchog gling / ri skya bsam gtan gling / lcags po ri bde thabs lha khang brag lha klu sgug bha ma ri/ nye 'khor ri khrod khag sogs dang phyogs mtha'i dgon khag bsam yas dang / rwa sgreng / dwags po bshad sgrub gling / 'on mnga' ris grwa tshang / chos 'khor rgyal/ khra 'brug rtsed thang dga' chos dang / lnga mchod grwa tshang / gra phyi smin grol gling sogs lho kha khul dgon khag mang po/ gzhan yang phyogs mtha'i dgon khag mang po'i mchod rgyun gtong sgo ja mar/ 'bras phyur/ spos/ me tog sman phye/ dri bzang / mchod 'bru/ mchod mar/ dngul dang dngos rigs sna tshogs nyin ltar rgyun chad med pa sprod dgos pa/ de min dbyar dgun nyi ldog zhabs rim dang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim pa'i dgongs rdzogs gshegs tshes la sku mched mchod 'bul dang / sku 'gyed/ mang ja/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang du zla re bzhin nyatshostong brgyad gsum zhes tshes brgyad/ bco lnga/sum cu so sor sna lnga'i stong mchod rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum chag med 'bul rgyu'i mchod mar/ rgyan mar/ rdor mar/ mchod rtsam/ mchod 'bru/ spos/me tog sman phye/ dri bzang sogs stong mchod gnyer par sprod dgos pa/mchod 'bul ba dge 'dun rgyud grwa stod smad gnyis dang / gdan sa gsum/8

gling phan tshun sogs phebs res su yin la bsnyen bkur mang ja dang / bzhes 'bras sku 'gyed bcas nar 'bul/ gsang phu dbyar chos dang / ljang dgun chos zhes par lo ltar se 'bras dga' gsum gyi dge bshes dang / rig lam slob gnyer dpe cha ba stong phrag kha shas 'du 'dzoms kyis nang rig pa'i gzhung lugs sde snod gsum gyi gzhung chen pod lnga'i rtsod gleng brdar sha gcod sa lha bu yin gshis/ der 'dus mkhas mang 'dus pa'i tshogs la dga' ldan shar rtse gnyer tshang sogs rang khungs so sos bsnyen bkur zhu lam thog bla phyag nas bsnyen bkur mang thug dang sku 'gyed bcas kyi gtong sgo gtong dgos pa sogs kyi 'brel yod las don sgrub dgos/ de lnga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gnas yul lha sa nas sa thag ring ba'i mdo smad khul dang / mdo stod/gtsang phyogs/ stod byang sogs phyogs bzhi'i dgon khag shin tu mang po la mchod rgyun gtong dmigs khungs so sor gna' snga mo zhig nas sa rten sogs sprad yod pa red/ lhag par mdo khams khul la sa thag ha cang ring ba'i sar lung pa de ga'i sa zhing dang / phyugs zog sems can rnams dgon pa dang /mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi sde so sor bgos 'grems kyis gzhung khral 'bul ma dgos par mchod rgyun khag nyams chag med pa dgos rgyu dang / mi ser dbul phongs su mi 'gyur ched dgon pa'i tshad ldan gyi bla ma dang / mi ser sde khongs nas spyi mos yod pa'i shes ldan la mi mus rgyud bcas kyi 'go dpon bsko gzhag gis ser skya bla dpon gnyis nas 'go khrid gugyis te bstan pa rgyas pa dang /'gro ba bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba'i byed sgo rgyun 'khyongs zhu rgyu'i mna' gan 'bul bzhes byas pa'ang khag mang po yod pa red/ bla phyag las khungs nas gang sar rtag par gtong sgo gtong dgos kyi yod par brten nga tsho'i las khungs de'i las ka las khungs gzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar skabs 'gar res gza' spen pa'i gung seng yang med pa dang / rnam 9

kun las khungs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhogs par tshugs snga la dgong dro grol phyi bas rtag par dgong dro nyi ma bzhud bzhud 'gor ba bcas las ka ha cang mang po yod pa red/ gang lags zer na rdzong gzhis khag mang po nas yong 'bab rtsis len zhu rgyu dang / dgon sde khag dang / gzhung khag ar las gtan 'jags kyi rdo shing / dmangs 'ul/ bzo las lag shes khag la rgyun du phogs thob sprod khungs mang ba'i rkyen gyis tshar dus med pa'i las ka byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ lhag par las brel che shos kyi dus tshod ni bod zla bcu pa nas bzung zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i zla mjug bar yin zhing / dus skabs de'i nang thebs sbyar (thebaha rtsar sbyar ba'i )ma dngul khag nas bun btang gi bskyed kha bsdu rgyu dang / rdzong gzhis khag gi yong 'bab 'byor pa rtsis len bya rgyu/ lo gsar 'char nye dang smon lam tshugs rgyu'i gra sgrig bcas kyis brel zing che ba'i las ka mang po yod pa red/rab byung bcu drug pa chu bya (1933)lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes sum cu nyin gyi dgongs dro tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa dgongs pa chos dbyings su 'thims tshul bstan la nye ba ste/ tshes sum cu nyin gyi snga dro sku phyi zhabs brtan ched gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum dang / rgyud grwa rnam gnyis sogs dgon khag la bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed dang mchod 'bul zhu bar bla phyag ngo las dang /rtse yig tshang ngo las phyogs bgos kyis btang bas gus rang 'bras spungs la 'gro mkhan gyi gras la yod cing / de nyin 'bras spungs tshogs chen 'du khang gi rten mchog rnams la sna lnga'i mchod sprin stong tshar dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur gsol ja dang / bzhes thug ming rtags/ dge 'dun rer sku 'gyed dngul srang gsum sgor mo gsar pa re 'bul gnang mdzad par dge 'dun rnam pas mnyes tshor mi mdzad par bzhin mdangs mog por gyur 'dug pa phal che bas dgongs pa gzhan don du phebs rgyur thag chod pa lta bu'i 10

mya ngan gyi smre ngag 'don gyi 'dug de'i sang nyin srang gsum sgor mo gsar pa 'di kha ma gro mya ngan gi sgor mo zhes ming btags 'dug de'i sngon tsam ste tshes nyer bdun nyin tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa nas chibs g.yog btang gnang ste phran lha tshe'i bza' zla bsod nams dbyangs can gyi pha shing bzo las tshan karma bsod nams lags nor bu gling khar ched 'bod gnang ba ltar bcar song bas/ khong bcar skabs rnam kun dang mi 'dra ba'i bzhin mdangs 'gyur zhing gsung skad 'dzer ba bcas kyi gnas babs mthong bas sems sdug gi ngu thag ma chod par lus stabs tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum pas cung mi dgyes pa lta bu'i tshul mdzad pa dang sbrags gzim chung gi shel khra'i a shing dam du btang nas shel khra'i bar seng nas lhag rlung 'ong 'dug pas ser bkag rgyobs shig ces bka' phebs don ltar khong gis a shing dam du btang /ser bkag brgyab zin mtshams zhabs zhu ba spyan bsal bkra shis don grub lags la sngon nas bka' mngags gnang yod tshod ltar gsol thab nas rmug thung dang / nya shag kon chen/ kam bkrag sogs bzhes zas ras dkar bsgril 'thum gcig 'khyer yong ba der yang bskyar kha bsnon mdzad de shing bzo las tshan karma bsod nams la gsol ras bstsal zhing phru gu tshor ster ang zhes gsungs 'dugakarma bsod nams ni chung ngu'i dus nas shing bzo slob par snye mo nas lha sar 'byor te dge rgan gyi ngag bkod dang len gyis slob sbyong la 'bad brtson byas pa'i 'bras bu lag rtsal brkos dang / bris cha legs pa/ mchod rten dang / gtsug lag khang sogs gsar bzhengs kyi cha thig blo thog tu nges shing lag rtsal phun sum tshogs pa mkhas pa'i yang rtser son pa zhig yin gshis/khongagis sa bkra bkod pa dang bzo skrun rnam grangs shin tu mang ba'i khongs gus rang gi shes gsal la pho brang po ta la'i shar rgyud nyams gso gsar rgyag 11

dang / nor gling spyan bsal pho brang gi gzim chung ngo mtshar dpal 'khyil dang / skal bzang bde 'khyil/ 'chi med mchog 'khyil/ mtsho dkyil pho brang / gru 'dzin pho brang sogs dang / grwa bzhi glog 'phrul khang las khungs dang / dngul dpar khang / lor dpar khang / me mda' dang / mde'u bzo grwa sogs bzo grwa khang khag grwa bzhi grong drag dmag sgar sogs kyi sa bkra 'god rgyu dang / ar rgyag gi las 'gan yongs rdzogs dang lhag par rtse pho brang po ta lar sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i gser sdong chen mo dge legs 'dod 'jo rten dang brten par bcas pa'i gsar bzhengs zhu sgo mtha' dag 'gan 'khur gtsang len zhus te phun sum tshogs po'i sgo nas legs grub byung bar skabs de'i sa gnas srid gzhung nas gser sdong rin po che legs grub mdzad sgo'i sar legs skyes mjal dar a she dang / gos chen nang gos ru su gser ma rgyu rnying kha gsar gyi gyon pa dang / 'ja' lham/ zhwa 'bog rgya gri phor shub/gru tse dkar po'i 'og 'jug gru rtse mtshal ka'i sked rag sogs gyon chas cha tshang mdzad sgo tshogs 'du'i dbus su sprad thog byas rjes gzengs bstod kyi dril bsgrags bsngags brjod dang 'brel sngar yod pha gzhis stod lung rgya stag gzhis le lag dang bcas pa chu byi dmag don byas rjes su pha de'i sku tshe'i ring sprad yod pa de dag mi mus rgyud bcas la ji srid nam gnas bar kha 'dzin gtan 'jags su gsol ras kyi gtan tshigs 'byed khra zhal gsal gyi zol sgo bdag rkyen thob yod pa red/ 12

gsum/ lo gcig gi nang du bla phyag las khungs kyis bsgrub dgos pa'i las ka'i skor/lo ltar bod zla 12tshes 30nyin rtse po ta la'i bde yangs shar du bla phyag ngo las tshang ma dang / las byed gad pa khag 'khrid de rtse rnam sras gan mdzod nas smon lam tshogs mchod kyi gsol ja dang / gnad sa se 'bras dga' gsum gyi rgyun ja/ rnam kun gtong sgo'i gtong ja bcas ja sgam stong phrag kha shas rtsis len zhu rgyu dang / tā la'i bla ma'i dgung gsar gsol bskang shing 'bras rtse gsol thab pas bzhes 'bul byed la ma las/ de min rgyal tshab dang /srid blon/ yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis/ rgyal yab/ rgyal yum/ sku 'khor/bka' blon/ sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po/ dza sag dar tā/ tha'i ji/gdan sa'i mkhan po/ mkhan sde che chung / phogs dpon/ rtsis dpon/rim bzhi/ sras rnam pa/ las tshan pa/ drung gtogs/ lto zan khag bcas la dgyes ston nyin gnyis kyi gsol ston shing 'bras sngar lam bzhin bde yangs shar du gtsang 'bul zhu dgoyoshing / lo gsar gong gtsug lag khang gi yang steng gzim chung khag dang bcas gzhung khang le lag yongs kyi gsham bu gsar brje dang / gzim chung khag gi sa yol gnam yol/ zhal gsang /shel yol/ khra ras sogs tshes 20tsam nas gsar brjes byed dgos/ smon lam chen mos gtsos mdzad sgo khag gi 'char can mtshan grangs dang / kha btags/ dngos po sogs dbyar dus nas gra sgrig sngon zin gyis do dam jo 13

lags so so'i ming byang ras 'dzar bkod pa skabs so sor zhu sprod bya rgyu dang /smon lam chen mo'i mang 'gyed tho sgrig gzhung khra rtse yig tshang las khungs brgyud snyan zhur phul ba de tshes 30nyin phyir zhu bya rgyu/ tho sgrig snyan zhu'i nang smon lam nyin nyi shu rtsa gcig la snga zhogs/ nyin dgung dgong ja bcas tshogs thengs gsum la nyin re gsol ja drug dang / bzhes thug gsum/ tsha gra zhes rtsam pa dang / khur ra/ bzhes zas/ gzhung 'gyed dang sger 'gyed lag 'don dod 'bul/ thebs sbyar mang 'gyed khag bcas gsal po bkod dgos yod pa red/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang / ra mo che bcas pa'i rten mchog rnams la lo gsar tshes gcig nyin 'bul rgyu'i thugs smon snyan shal nang mdzod dang /a she/ zub phyi bcas brgya phrag kha shas phul chog gra sgrig zhus te thugs smon snyan zhur nye char phul ba de yang rtse yig tshang las khungs brgyud phyir zhu byed dgos/ po ta la'i gzim chung khag dang / gser sdong lha khang khag lha ldan gtsug lag khang / rwa che gtsug lag khang bcas la 'bul rgyu'i dgung gsar rten 'brel ched sngar srol mtsho sna 'bras sgrub pas g.yur za ba'i shing 'bras tsha lum ma sos pa yal ga lo ma 'bras bu rang 'grigs gru ma nyams pa 'bul lam zhu bar 'bras sgrub pa phyag nang ngo ma rtse gzim chung du bcar dgos/ lo gsar dang smon tshogs sogs zla re'i byed sgo dper na/ shing khyi (1934)lo gsar la mtshon na/ tshes gcig snga dro bla phyag ngo las tshang ma gyon pa gzab mchor gyis lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang / rwa mo che gtsug lag khang / tshe dpag lha khang bcas la thugs smon snyan shal 'bul ba dang chabs cig mchod mjal du skyod skabs khyams rwa'i khang gnyer dang / jo khang dkon gnyer khagadakon gnyer dpon bcas nas bkra shis bde legs kyi gro bso phye mar btegs bzhes dang / thog mar bla phyag ngo las rnams khyams rwa'i rnam thar sgo gsum du 'dzoms dus byas te dus 'byor gyis phan tshun gus 'dud dang 14

bcas bkra shis bde legs zhu res byed pa dang / gzhan yang gzhung zhabs sku drag dang / lcam chung / sras sros/ zhabs gras sa bzhu 'khyer ba/ mi dmangs pho mo mang po bcas tshang mas rgyan gos gzab mchor gang legs spras te spos dang / mchod me/ snyan dar bcas khyer nas 'tshang ga shig shig gis mchod mjal zhu bar yong srol 'dug rnam thar sgo gsum du bla phyag sku ngo ser skya bzhi dang / phyag drung / bla brang khang gnyer/ bzo khang do dam/ jo lags phyag nang / zha'u li/ rtse mo gnyer pa zhes smre ru ba grwa gcig bcas bla phyag las khungs kyi ngo las tshang 'dzoms byung 'phral rim bzhin gnas gzigs thugs smon snyan shal phul te mchod mjal khag grub rjes rang so so'i shag tu log skya rengs dang po shar ba dang po ta lar lo gsar mdzad sgor phebs dgos/ rtse gzim chung du snga dro 'dod khams dbang mo'i tshes gtor grub pa dang / tshoms chen du mdzad sgo ma gnang gong mdzad zhabs ser skya thams cad tshoms chen du tshang 'dzoms thog stag brag nas tā la'i bla mar phyag dang bcas maṇ+ḍal rten gsum btegs te mjal kha zhus zin rjes rim bzhin srid blon dang / yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis/ yab gzhis 'khor bcas bka' blon rnams sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po/ dza sag tha'i ji/ dar tā/ mkhan sde che chung / gdan sa'i mkhan po rnam pa dang bla sprul dge 'dun/ phogs mda' rtsis sras/ las tshan che chung / drung drag 'bring dkyus gsum/ dmag sgar khag gi ru brgya/ drung gtogs/ rtse slob grwa ba/ lto bzan che chung bcas nas rim bzhin rang rang go babs mjal dar 'bul skabs dza tha'i man mgron gnyer chen mo brgyud 'bulasrol 'dug de nas rnam grwa gsung zhabs pā rnams kyis cho ga'i tshig 'gros dang mthun pa'i bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / rdzas brgyad khag rin rgyan khri pas rim bzhin btegs 'bul grub mtshams tshogs langs dge bshes gnyis nas bzhugs khri'i mdun phyogs shar nub kha sprod kyis rig lam mtshan 15

nyid rtsod/ gar mkhan rol cha ba rnams nas rol cha 'bud dkrol dang bcas gar phyeg pa bu bcu gsum lag na rdo rje'i gri gug thogs te gar dang po 'khrab 'bul zhus pa dang / gsol ja gnyis pa dang bzhes 'bras 'dren gtong byed/ston chen gsol bskangs dang / shing 'bras rgya lcog rnams dang dkar spro bcas bsgrigs 'bul zhus/ gsol tshigs grub mtshams su mi dmangs khrod nas sder mchongs pa zhes pho gzhon mang pos tshoms chen gzim sgo phye 'phral 'ur sgra dang bcas thon nas dkar spro mtho brtsegs kyi steng du'ang 'dzegs te phyu pa'i am phrag chen por kha zas dang / shing 'bras sogs rgyangs pa dang /'ga' zhig gis sbra snam gyi tshugs sgye chen po'i nang blugs pa/ rtse'i gad pa khag dang / zhol chibs rwa'i lag do sogs lto bzan chung khag kha shas nas kyang dkar spro hab thob rgyag pa/ de nas gzim 'gag tshos rta lcag thogs te skad gsang mthon pos sder mchongs pa rnams la mar rgyugs shig ces brjod pa dang rim bzhin phyir log zin mtshams gad pa tshos gad snyigs phyag nas gatreng ma bzo ba/ rig lam tshogs langs dge bshes gnyis nas mu mthud rig lam rtsod/ gsol ja gsum pa gtong ba dang / gar gnyis pa 'khrab zin rjes phebs ras bting nas gar rol bas phebs brda gtong ba dang /mdzad zhabs ser skya tshang ma yar langs nas tā la'i bla mar gus 'dud zhus te de nyin gyi mdzad sgo grub/ dgyes ston nyin dang po bla ma lo gsar zhes gtso che ba chos phyogs kyi mdzad sgor brtsi srol ngag rgyun du yod pa dang / dgyes ston nyin gnyis par rgyal po lo gsar zhes zer ba der mdzad sgo byings nyin dang po dang 'dra mtshungs thog dmigs bsal 'phar ma ni 'bras bu gling pa zhes sngar tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i gzigs snang du byung ba zhes pa'i lha dang / klu/gnod sbyin/ dri za/ mi'am ci la sogs pa'i 'dra brnyan mchod sprin gyi gar 'khrab srol 'dug cing / gar mkhan gzhon nu bzhi nas lag gnyis kar gri 16

ring re thogs te gri gar 'khrab pa bcas mdzad sgo yun ring tsam 'gor ba/de nyin rtse pho brang gi mdun zhabs rdo ring nang mar sngar byang gar thag shur ba zhes rtse pho brang gi shar rgyud sge'u khung zhig nas rdo ring nang ma bar thag pa 'breng thag sbom po btang ste byang gar thag rtsed pa pho gzhon zhig gis lag g.yas mda' dar thogs te thag 'khyud kyis mthur rgyugs byed srol yod kyang /bar skabs shig la thag rtsed pa'i mi zhig thag shur lam lhongs ma byung bar 'chi 'das gyur pa nas bzung pho brang shar rgyud nas thag shur gtong ma dgos par rdo ring nang mar shing ring btsugs nas de'i g.yas g.yon phyogs bzhir 'breng thag btang ba der thag rtsed 'khyud nas shing rtser slebs pa dang ker langs kyis 'gro kun chos 'byor bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba'i smon tshig skad gsang mthon por bsgrags thog am phrag nas phye mar bton te nam mkhar gtor zhing ki sro'i lha rgyal 'then srol yod pa la skye bo pho mo mang po ltad mor yong srol 'dug bod zla dang po'i tshes gsum nyin gnas chung chos skyong rten gzhir spyan 'dren zhu srol ltar gnas chung lcog tu tā la'i bla ma dang / bka' blon/gdan sa'i mkhan po/ gzhung zhabs ser skya bcas zhogs pa nyi shar snga char gzab gsol mdzad sgo tshugs shing / gam bcar gnas chung sgra dbyangs gling grwa tshang 'dus tshogs nas bskang 'phrin dang / bshags bstod 'bul gnang la bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed dang mchod sprin dgos mkho rnams bla phyag las khungs nas sngar lam ji yod gtong dgos pa/ gnas chung du gzab gsol mdzad sgo grub 'phral gus tsho bla phyag ngo las phyed bgos kyis khag gcig rdzong rgyab spro khang du tshes gsum thog mda' zhes pa'i bka' blon rnam pas dbus gzhung zhabs shod skor rnams glu gar rol rtsed kyi dga' ston mdzad sgor 'gro dgos pa dang / khag gcig de'i sang nyin smon lam chen mo'i gral 'dzin sta gon la song ste smon lam chen mo'i gsol ja dang / gsol mar/ bzhes thug 17

rgyu 'bras dang / nas bcags/ sha phyur sogs dang / zangs rkyan/ dngul rkyan rtsis sprod byed sgor bla brang steng las khungs su bskyod dgos/ de nyin 'bras spungs tshogs chen zhal ngo gnyis dang / zhang po shing gnyer/ chab dam pa gnyis/ dge g.yog bcu dgu/ 'bras spungs bkra shis khang gsar ba'i sde pa ngo las/ bkras khang gnyer pa/ tshogs chen thab g.yog khag bcas lha sar 'byor zhing / tshogs chen zhal ngos lha sa mi dpon zhes grong khyer spyi khyab khang snang rtse shag las khungs su bskyod nas sngar srol smon lam nyin nyi shu rtsa gcig ring grong khyer nang gi chab srid dbang cha khrims rgyugs dang bcas pa rtsis len dang / smon lam chab chu len yul khron pa khag dang / gsol thab rung khang khag gi sa bdag klu gnyan rnams la smon lam ring chab chu legs 'bab dang /zhugs me legs 'bar gyi sri zhu bsgrub dgos pa'i tshogs gtam gtong dgos pa dang / sa khungs so so'i khang gnyer rnams zhal ngo khang du 'gugs 'bod kyisasmon lam ring gi spang blang byed sgo rnams bkod 'doms byed pa/ smon lam spyi khyab khang du sku tshab dza tha'i rim bzhi gang rung gcig dang / lha sa gnyer tshang pa ser skya gnyis/ gnyer tshang drung yig shod gnyer nang nyi shu skor/ gzhan yang las bya sgo rwa ba shod drung brgyad dang / brgya the'u shod drung bdun/ (sku 'gyed rgyag skabs dge 'dun grangs rtsis kyis brgya re'i mtshams thel tse re rgyag dgos pa de'i do dam pa shod drung bsko srol yang dngos su ngo tshab re gtong ba/) grangs rgyag pa dog bde ba zhwa 'bog gyon pa'i pho gzhon bcu bzhi/ dge 'dun gyi gsol ja bzhes thug 'dren 'bul zhabs zhu zangs rkyan pa o lo zhes snam dkar phyu pa dang ras dkar kha ras bcings pa pho gzhon mi grangs sum brgya tham pa bcas yod pa red/ cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i skabs dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed sogs gang ci'i 'gan 'khur ba bla brang phyag mdzod pa mkhan chung gnyis dang / shod skor rim bzhi 18

gnyis/ phyag drung las tshan pa gcig bla brang khang gnyer rtse drung gcigabazo khang do dam pa zhes bzo rigs khag gi 'go khrid pa rtse drung gcig jo lags phyag nang ngo ma 'phar bcas mi grangs nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ jo lags zha'u li mi bco lnga/ rtse mo gnyer pa zhes dpal lha mo'i sku tshab lta bu (bshad srol )me ru ba grwa gcig gar dgos mi gcig ja zhu gcig gtan sdod gad khro mi bcu bcas yod cing / 'bras spungs bkra shis khang gsar zhes par smon lam chen mo'i gsol ja gsol mar sogs sprod thengs dang por ja sgam brgya tsam dang / mar ltang lnga brgya tsam/ 'bras ru'i khal sum brgya tsam dang / nas bcags ru'i khal sum brgya/ phyur ba ru'i khal lnga bcu/ tshag sha khog sum cu/lug sha khog brgya bcas lag 'dzin tham 'byar du rtsis sprod byed pa dang / da dung rim sprod bya dgos pa/ bla steng gzim chung dga' ldan yang rtse'i zhal khra'i 'og smon lam dngul rtsis khang du 'gan 'khur ba bla phyag phyag drung dang /las bya drung yig rtsis pa jo lags bzhi/ dngul gnyer jo lags gnyis/dmigs bsal gyi rtse'i sku tshab rtse mgron gcig rtse yig tshang las bya dngul rtsis pa rtse drung gcig 'gyed gtong pa rtse drung bdun dang / bla phyag jo lags bcu bzhi/ gzhan yang 'brel yod bka' shag khang gnyer drung gtogs gcig 'khyams rwa khang gnyer dang / lho rgyud khang gnyer/ ltag sgo khang gnyer/ bka' shag gsol thab pa bcas gnyer nang rgan pa bzhi/ gad khungs khag lnga bsdoms gad pa mi grangs lnga bcu tham pa/ dkon gnyer dpon zhes gtsug lag khang gi dkon gnyer chen mo 'bras spungs dge slong gcig dang / jo bo rin po cher dus rgyun du khrus gsol 'bul mi gser khri dge slong gcig lha khang khag gi dkon gnyer rme ru bzhi sde sogs kyi dge 'dun lnga bcu tham pa/ bar khang ma ṇi 'khor chen bskor mi mtshams khung dang / ne byung ri/ga ru dgon pa bcas res mos kyis btsun ma brgyad/ gtsug lag khang gi dbu 19

rtse dpal lha lcog tu dpal lha'i rgyun bskang pa rme grwa dge slong gcig dang /chog grwa sum cu tham pa/ gad pa gnyis/ me gtong chu len mi gnyis/ dus chen khag la dpal gsol ma zhes snga dus gzhung zhabs bka' blon rnams kyi lha lcam dang / sger pa khag gi lcam/ jo lags phyag nang tsho'i lcam chung bcas dang bas kun blangs kyi 'gro srol yang bar skabs nyams chag gis phyis gla cha sprad de btang ba'i bud med mu tig spa phrug dang / g.yu byur spel ma'i spa phrugamu tig thug khog gser gyi ske ga'u dang a sgor/ skra lan skra sbrel/ 'ba' khug khab shub/ sdig rwa glo phreng / gos chen phu yod phu med/ gru tse tshos sna'i 'og 'jug 'ja' phrug sna lnga'i gos gzan/ lham rta zon bcas rin thang che ba'i rgyan chas spras pa bzhi bcu skor nas gtso che ba dpal lta'i ri rab dang /gzhung gi dbyar gsol/ dgun gsol/ gzab gsol khag bcas la 'don bzang dpal gsol dbu mdzad mas dbu skul gyis dpal lha'i gsol mchod gnad smin sgrub dgos pa red/ gtsug lag khang steng shod bar gsum dang /phyogs bzhi khor yug dang bcas par rnam kun me dang rkun ma'i bskor srung 'gan len lha sa gnyer tshang las khungs nas byed dgos pa ltar dgong re bzhin sa srib mtshams phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi gzim sgo khag la bskor g.yeng lta rtog zhib bsher byed pa dang / de'i thog smon lam ring smon lam spyi khyab khang nas kyang dgong ltar me rkun mi 'byung ba'i zhib bsher bskor g.yeng byed srol yod/lo gsar tshes bzhi nyin/ smon lam chen mo'i gral 'dzin zhes se 'bras dga' gsum dang / nye 'khor gzhis dgon sogs kyi dge 'dun rnams sngar lam bzhugs gnas so sor gral 'khod thog gsol ja bzhes thug dang / bla phyag nas 'dzugs ston bkra shis kha btags re 'bul srol yod la smon lam tshugs pa nas bzung nyin ltar snga tshogs dang / dgung tshigs/ dgong ja 20

bcas tshogs dus gsum yod par/ tshogs dus rer gsol ja thengs gnyis dang / bzhes thug thengs re/ gzhung sger thebs sbyar bcas kyi sku 'gyed dang / thog mtha' bar gsum du khu ra zhes bzhes spro re 'bul srol yod/phyis su dngul bsgyur gyis khur dod dngul zho gang re bla phyag las khungs nas 'bul srol 'dug tshwa gra zhes dge 'dun rer gsol zhib rtsam pa bcu 'bo re rtsam khang las khungs nas thengs kha shas ngo 'bul byed dgos kyang / phyis su tshwa gra chen mo zhes ngo 'bul thengs gcig las de byings dngul dod 'bul ba sogs la 'gyur 'dug smon lam gyi tshogs shing la smon lam shing gnyer zhes rtse drung gnyis sngon tshud nas bsko gzhag byas yod pa khong gnyis nas le thogs med par gtong dgos pa dang / tshwa bul zhol pa las khungs nas gtong dgos/smon lam chen mo'i rung khang gnyis kyi chab chu sngar mang tshogs gzhon nu ma rnams kyis rang rang bsod nams gsog ched chu ban 'khur te khron pa khag nas chu 'tshang kha shig shig gis blangs te dad 'bul zhu ba dang / skabs 'gar chab chu ldeng min gyur skabs snang shag las khungs kyi skor bya bas chu len mkhan yod tshad chu jag rgyag srol yang yod/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku bcar spyan bsal thub bstan kun 'phel lags nas rgyu gron btang ste lha sa grong khyer gyi shar phyogs me tog ldum rwa zhes pa nas lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi rung khang chen mo'i bar sa 'og lcags mdong nang chab chu drangs te zangs kyi chu mdzod chen po phyur por bkang cing / chab chu gtsang la 'dzad med byung yod/ nyin ltar smon lam gung tshigs gsol tshogs grol rjes dga' ldan khri rin po che dbu bzhugs kyis gdan sa'i mkhan po rnam pa dang / bla sprul/ dge bshes lha rams pa/ tshogs chen dbu mdzad rnam pa/ gzhan yang gsung bzang dge 'dun gyis gtsos tshogs dmangs dge 'dun bcas skam tshogs zhes chu tshod bzhi tsam ring gsol ja bzhes thug gang yang med par spyan 21

'dran khrus gsol sogs kyi zhal 'don rim pa gsung gsang rta dbyangs dal ring smin rgyas mdzad srol dang / dgong ja'i gsol tshogs grol rjes dge bshes lha rams pa gsar pa res mos kyis dam bca' 'jog cing / rtsod grwa tshugs par ‘‘bla ma gzhung las pa mi’zhes gdan sa'i mkhan po gnyis kyis rtags gsal rtsod lan legs nyes zhib brtag ched lha rams de'i g.yas phyogs nas zhal shar gzigs kyis bzhugs/ rtsod par phebs mkhan dge bshes bla sprul dang / gzhan yang mtshan nyid pa yongs rdzogs las sngar gdan sa'i mkhan po las zur rnam pa phebs srol mi 'dug kyang / phyis tā la bcu bzhi pa'i dus gdan sa'i mkhan po las zur dang / rgyud gra stod smad kyi mkhan po las zur dang bla ma dbu mdzad bcas pa tshang ma rtsod par phebs srol bzos shing /rig lam mtshan nyid mkhas pa stong phrag kha shas nas 'tshang ga shig shig gi sgo nas nam phyed yol yol bar mtshan nyid rtsod pa byed/ lhag par tshes bcu gsum bcu bzhi gnyis ni lha rams pa gsar pa'i nang nas phyag dpe skad grags che ba'i gras dam bca' 'jog pa'i dus yin gshis/ nyin de gnyis la rtsod par phebs mkhan shin tu mang bas khyams rwa chen mo gang ste lho sgo dang /sgrol ma lha khang sgo 'gram la yang 'tshang ga shig shig gis rtsod pa'i dus skabs ma thob pa'i dngangs 'tshabs gnang zhing / tshogs mjal zhu mkhan mang tshogs rnams kyang khyams rwa'i g.yab 'khor steng gi khor yug nas 'tshang ga ha cang chen pos tshogs mjal zhus te gsol ba smon lam 'debs kyi yod pa red/lo ltar smon lam 'dus tshogs dge 'dun stong phrag sum cu la nye bar dad sbyin lag nas mang 'gyed chag med 'bul rgyu'i thebs rtsa (bla phyag tu )sbyor 'bul zhu mkhan yang mang po yod cing / sbyin bdag kha shas nas gsol ja bzhes thug sku 'gyed bcas dngos mdog lag 'don 'bul ba dang mang che bas bla phyag las khungs nas gtong rgyur dod 'bul zhus te rang nyid kyi mang 'gyed 22

tshes cha gar 'khel nyin tshogs dbus su spos skor du bcar ba dang 'brel bsnyen bkur zhu mkhan gyi sbyin bdag rnams la khyams rwa'i g.yab 'khor nas tshogs mjal bzhugs yul bka' shag gdan gnyer nas gdan lcog dang /bka' shag gsol thab pas ja 'bras/ bla phyag las khungs nas legs skyes shing 'bras sne 'dzoms ras 'thum/ kha btags bcas sprod srol 'dugatshes bcu nyin snga dro rme rnying dpe har lcog tu tā la'i bla ma dang / gzhung zhabs shod skor yongs rdzogs mdzad bcar gyis gnas chung chos rgyal rten gzhir khog brlams spyan 'dren gzab gsol dang / gnas chung sgra dbyangs gling gi dge 'dun rnams la mang 'gyed/ gnas chung sku rten tā bla mar gnang cha dang gzab gsol 'bel bshad pa gzim chung dmag dang / ru 'dren/ 'cham pa/spyan gzigs rta g.yag dmag spyi khang gi dmag drung shod drung gnyis bcas so sor bla phyag nas legs dar kha btags re sprod srol yod/ smon lam ring nyin ltar zhogs tshogs grol rjes dga' ldan khri rin po ches gsung chos rwa ba'i bzhugs khri chen mo'i steng nas gsung chos stsal bar chos zhu ba gdan sa'i mkhan po rnam pa dang / bla sprul dge bshes/ tshogs chen dbu mdzad khag bcas gsung rwa'i bang rim steng 'og nas zhal yar gzigs dang / rdo gcal du dge 'dun 'dus tshogs de'i rgyab mtha' 'khor du dad ldan skye bo pho mo stong phrag mang po bcas chos zhur phebs kyi yod/tshes bco lnga nyin gyi zhogs tshogs rnam kun las snga ba 'tshogs nas grol mtshams su gsung chos rwa bar tā la'i bla mas ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khrungs rabs gsung chos gnang skabs bka' blon gyis gtsos gzhung zhabs ser skya yongs rdzogs kyang chos zhur bcar srol dang / de nyin dgong tshogs snga tsam 'tshogs te grol 'phral bco lnga mchod pa'i mchod pa khag dang / stegs sgrom khag dbor 'dren gyis bar skor khor mo yug tu mar tshon las bzhengs 23

pa'i mchod pa gtso 'khor lnga'am/ gsum sna tshogs mtho tshad rgyug 'dom bdun brgyad tsam nas/ dma' tshad rgyug 'dom lnga tsam yod pa de dag la mar tshon gyi rgyan spros khang bzang pho brang rgya phibs nang thub dbang gtso 'khor ram/rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ rje yab sras gsum/ mchod pa'i lha mo/ sbyin bdag ha shangs/ tshe ring drug skor/ mthun pa spun bzhi/ gser 'brug dang / me tog sna tshogs sogs lag rtsal bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pas brgyan yod pa red/ tshes bco lnga'i dgong mo sa srib tsam la bar skor khor mo yug tu mchod pa khag bsgrigs tshar ba'i spyan sngar dkar spro dang / gro bso phye mar/ yon chab sogs sgrig gshom dang / mchod me spar te gra sgrig ang bsar byed dgos/thag rgya bkrams zin pa dang / grong khyer lha sar bca' sdod dmag sgar khag ru sgrig gis bar skor khor yug tu sdod dgos pa dang / thag rgya'i phyi nas mi dmangs mang tshogs rnams 'tshang ga shig shig gis mchod pa'i zhal mjal du yong gi yod pa/ tā la'i bla ma mchod gzigs skabs shing ra chen mo nas thab g.yog dang dge g.yog chab dam pa gnyis/ zhang po shing gnyer bcas sngon du thon nas mang tshogs rnams la ‘‘phar rgyugs shig ’’ces skad 'bod byed/sngar srol hor gsang gi lgang bzhu 'khyer mi rtse drung brgyad dang / shod drung brgyad/ sa bzhu 'khyer mi bla phyag las bya jo lags brgyad bcas nas lam g.yas g.yon du 'gro ba dang / dbus su tshogs chen zhal ngo gnyis dang /smon lam spyi khyab pa/ bla phyag ser skya dang / lha sa gnyer tshang pa ser skya'i spos sne dang bcas chibs zhabs su srid blon/ bka' blon/ sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po/ gsol gzim mchod gsum/ rtse yig tshang gi drung yig chen mo bzhi/yig tshang gnyer las dang / rtse slob grwa ba/ bka' shag mgron drung bcas yod pa red/snangasrid gzim chung gi mdun ngos su bla phyag gi mchod pa gtso 'khor 24

bsgrigs yod pa dang khungs so so'i mchod pa rnams la drung yig chen mo gcig gis mchod tho skad gsang mthon pos snyan sgron byed pa/ bka' blon rnams go bsdur gyis mchod pa legs nyes kyi ang rim 'god dgos pa/ mchod pa'i 'khri khungs ngo ma so so mchod pa'i mdun nas zhwa phud gus 'dud kyi mjal dar phul ba rang slog g.yogs srol dang / mchod pa khag so sor gsang thag gi gzigs mo 'dra min sna tshogs gzigs 'bul byed cing / de'i nang nas rgyud grwa stod smad gnyis kyi mchod pa'i gsang thag gi gzigs mo ni gzhan dag las 'phrul khyad ldan pa yod/bod kyi gna' srol gyi rta dmag rnams lo ltar smon lam chen mo'i mdzad sgor bcar dgos pas rta dmag spyi khyab pa yā sor khri pa gnyis ni shod skor rim bzhi sras rnam pa'i gzhon khral yin gshis rim bzhi sras rnam pa gnyis kyis 'gro gron btang ste sngon tshud nas gang ci'i gra sgrig tshags tshud byed dgos/rta dmag gi sgar sa sngar srol po ta la'i bdun gyi klu sbug na thang la bod zla dang po'i tshes bcu drug tsam nas gur sgar phab nas/ dkyil sgar zhes mdzad sgo 'tshog yul gyi gur chen lding gur 'go snam gyi rgyan spros can yol 'khor lcags ri dang bcas pa dang / yā sor khri pa skra sger so so'i gur/ yā sor byings kyi gur/ mgron gnyer zhabs gras/ rta dmag byings kyi sdod gur bcas tshes nyer gcig gong gra sgrig 'thus tshang byed thub pa dgos/ dkyil sgar spyi khyab khang du 'gan 'dzin phyag mdzod pa gnyis dang / las bya mi brgyad/ gnyer pa gnyis/ khrung zhu rgyan bzang ma gtso bo gnyis/ rgyan bzang ma gzhon pa gnyis/ chang ma gnyis/ ja ma gnyis/ rgya zas ma byan chen mo bzhi/ ma byan byings drug spyi'i zhabs zhu lag g.yog mi grangs brgya tsam bcas kyis nyin mang sta gon byas pa rnams spyi khyab khang nas zhib bsher gyis 'thus tshang bzo ba/yā sor khri pa gnyis dang / mgron gnyer gnyis/ g.yog po bcu gnyis/25

chibs 'khrid pa bzhi/ zhabs stegs 'khyer mkhan gnyis/ mgron zhabs rnams kyi rta 'khrid pa bcu bzhi/ yā g.yog ces shod drung bcu gnyis dang /g.yog po nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ rta 'khrid pa bcu gnyis/ 'dam brgya shog brgyad kyi yā sor gnyis dang / mgron gnyer gnyis/ g.yog po brgyad/ chibs 'khrid pa gnyis/ zhabs stegs pa gnyis/ rta 'khrid pa drug srung ma dmar nag gi rten mdung gdan zhu ba lcags khrab gyon pa mi rta rang 'grigs gnyis/ rta 'khrid nga gnyis bcas yod pa dang / bod mda' dang / gri mdung / mda' gzhu sag thag rdzas snod khug ma bcas thogs te khrab rmog dang / lcags khrab/sha dor sogs chas gos cha tshang ba'i mi rta go thang gi rta dmag khyon nyis stong tham pa yod pa red/ tshes nyer gcig nyin yā g.yog phyogs bgos kyis g.yas ru g.yon ru'i mi rta chas gos sogs tshang bsher byed/ tshes nyer gnyis nyin/klu sbug sgar sgrig gi mdzad sgo yin gshis yā sor khri pa gnyis gyon gos gos chen stag shun rnying ma dang / gru tse tshos sna'i 'og 'jug zhwa mo wa kir gser gyi 'phru tog tshe bum gzugs la rin po che'i khra rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rna rgyan bod g.yu dang / gser gyi sog byil mu tig g.yu khra can/ gos chen gser sked/ lham 'ja' chen mtshal kha/ mda' mdong gzhu mdong / gos rgya se the'u rgya smug steng si shan 'ja' bsgrigs byas pa'i mda' gzhu sag thag la dar tshon sna lnga'i rgyan bcings/ sked 'dogs gri dpa' dam dngul shub tsha gser la g.yu byur gyi khra rgyan 'byar ba/ byu ru'i 'phreng ba sogs rgyan gos rin thang che ba'i gzab mchor dang / yā sor byings rnams gyon pa rgyan bzhi dang /'og 'jug tshos sna/ gser gyi mu sog 'ja' lham rgya smug zhwa mo wa kir la gser gyi 'phru tog mda' gzhu sag thag rgyan bcings/ mgron gnyer gnyis dang zhabs gras rnams kyi gyon pa gos tshos man ser po dang / 'og 'jug tshos sna/ —gser gyi mu sog zhwa sbu kru/ rgya gri phor shub/ skra lcang lo'i 26

steng gser gyi skra ga'u/ byu ru'i phreng ba/ mgron gnyer gnyis kyi lham 'ja' chen rgya smug dang / g.yog po dang chibs 'khrid pa sogs kyi lham spu ma nag po'i shol rtse/ rta 'khrid pa bzhi dang / rkub stegs 'khyer mi gnyis bcas kyi phyu pa gos chen ser po'i zur bzhi rgyag brdzes dang / gru tse dkar ljang gi shan rtse nyis brtsegs/ zhwa mo sog zhwa/ gser gyi mu sog gser gyi skra ga'u/ byu ru'i phreng ba/ 'dam brgya shog brgyad kyi yā sor dang / mgron zhabs rnams kyang chas gos gong dang 'dra mtshungs lta bu/ yā sor khri pa gnyis dang / brgya shog pa'i yā sor gnyis bcas kyi rta 'khrid pa ma gtogs/ rta 'khrid pa gzhan dag rnams kyi gyon chas rang rang gi rgyun chas kha gsar gzab mchor gyon srol yod/rgyan bzang ma'i chas gos ni/ gos chen gser ma'i phyu pa phu yod phu med nyis brtsegs dang / gru tse tshos sna'i 'og 'jug gos rgya se'i steng brtsegs/gos chen mtshal kha 'jam sangs kyi pang khebs/ si shan 'ja' sgrig gi 'dzar ldan/ dngul tsha gser ma'i sdig rwa glo phreng dang / 'ba' khug khab shub dngul gyi g.yer kha can/ gser gyi ske ga'u ske thag gzi byur spel ma'i 'dzoms bkag mu tig phrul phrul/ gser gyi sbab rgyan la g.yu khra dang /gzi byur/ rin po che'i khra sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ rdzul ljang gi ske phreng mu tig 'then thag gser gyi sbab lho khra ldan/ gser gyi a sgor/ mu tig gi skra sbrel 'dzoms bkag g.yu byur spel ma/ mu tig gi spa phrug g.yu byur gyi 'dzoms bkag rgyan can/ mu tig lhas pa'i spyi g.yu thag pa/ zhwa ser/ mu tig thod khebs/ gos 'ja' sgrig ma'i dpung gzan/ lham rta zon gos chen rgya se'i bol ldan sogs rin thang che ba'i rgyan gos gyon spros byed/yā sor khri pa'i rta sga gser sga dang / yā sor byings dbang sga rta chas gos rgya se'i steng si shan 'ja' sgrig gi gzar/ si shan tshos sna'i 'ja' 'dzar 27

ldan/ mgron zhabs rnams kyi rta sga rgya sga dang / grum ze'i smag khran smag shog gzhi mtshungs/ bzhon rta rnams la rgod sgro'i mgo rgyan dang rma bya'i sgro mdongs la dar tshon sna lnga'i me tog rgyan can/ mjug rgyan dar tshon sna lnga'i rgyan bcings/ yā sor khri pa gnyis kyi rta sga'i sga khebs gos rgya se si shan tshos sna'i 'ja' 'dzar can de chibs rta bzhon khar ltebs brtsegs kyis rta 'khrid pa'i phrag steng 'khyer te rta 'khrid bzhin bskyod srol/tshes nyer gnyis nyin smon lam chen mo'i dgong ja'i 'dus tshogs thog 'bras spungs tshogs chen zhal ngo bgres pas tshogs gtam btang ba nyan 'jog zhu bar yā sor dpon 'khor rnams lcang gseb shar nas 'dod 'jo zam pa brgyud bar bskor brgyab ste jo bo dbu skra'i mdun du slebs 'phral rta las bshol/ khyams rwa'i yang steng dbu g.yab 'og bka' shag gi bka' blon tsho dang / yā ser dmag dpon rnams la bka' shag gdan gnyer nas go babs kyi gdan brgyab yod par bzhugs gral la 'khod rjes bka' shag gsol thab pas bka' shag 'khor bcas dang / yā sor la gsol ja bzhes 'bras btegs zin 'phral bka' blon dang / yā sor bcas nas dge 'dun 'dus tshogs su phyag gsum re 'tshal te zhwa phud nas zhal ngo'i tshogs gtam nyan dgos/ de nas klu sbug sgar sar bskyod nas ‘‘dkyil sgar ’’zhes pa'i gur chen nang yā sor khri pa gnyis khri mthon por 'khod de dmag ston gyi mdzad sgo byed cing / gro bso phye mar dang / rgyan bzang mas chang phud dngul phor btegs par phud gtor/ ja dang gro ma 'bras sil btegs rjes yā sor khri pa bgres pas smon lam chen mo'i rjes 'brel gyi byed sgo khag le thogs med pa gra 'grigs 'thus tshang dgos rgyu'i bka' khyab gtam bshad zin 'phral/ yā sor khri pa gzhon pas sbug dam bca' khrims sgrog sbyang zin rjes mdzad sgo grol nas khungs so so'i gur du dmag ston gsol tshigs gtong srol/28

tshes nyer gsum nyin gra bzhi rtsis bsher zhes lha sa grong khyer gyi byang phyogs grwa bzhi thang du gur phubs te bka' shag dang / shod skor rtsis phrug pa dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs/ bla phyag ngo las rnams bskyod dgos shing / yā sor rta dmag dpon 'khor dang bcas pa klu sbug nas rtse pho brang la g.yas bskorakhyas te ru nyis bsgrigs kyi ru 'gor srung ma dmar nag gnyis kyi rten mdung gdan zhu ba rta pa gnyis rmog dang mi rta gnyis ka lcags kyi khrab gyon cing / lta 'khrid pa dang bcas rten mdung gnyis kyis thog drangs gra bzhir 'byor skabs bka' shag gi gur mdun phyag 'bul ba dang bcas bzhugs gral du 'khor 'phral ja 'dren pa dang / yā sor bgres pas bka' blon khri pa'i gsol lcog steng du rta dmag dmag gzhung gi tho phul rjes/ bka' blon khri pas rta dmag dmag gzhung la zhib bltas kyis bka' drung zhig la ‘‘g.yume las rnam par rgyal ba'i g.yas ru dang po sde dpon dga' bzhi ba gzab 'don dang bcas rta pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi mizhes brjod 'phral bka' drung des mar tsam 'ong / de mtshams zhol pa'i nang zan rgan pa zhwa 'bog dang rgya gri phor shub bcas las gos gyon pa zhig gis bka' shag gur la kha phyogs te pus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugs zhwa phud nas yod pa der bka' bsgyur gtong / nang zan des zhwa 'bog gyon te lag g.yugs byed bzo dod pos rta pa yod sa'i phyogs su mar tsam yong nas skad gsang mthon pos ‘‘g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba g.yas ru dang po sde dpon dga' bzhi ba gzab 'don dang bcas rta pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi ’’zhes skad 'bod byed pa dang / rta pa de rnams bka' shag gur mdun du rim bzhin rta bzhon bzhon par thon te gral bstar bsgrigs pa de dag la zhib bsher byed po shod drung zhabs gsar ba gcig dang / rtsis phrug pa bzhi gral bstar 'grigs pos rta pa'i sar bskyod de kha grangs dang / rta mi sha shed go thang yin min/ go mtshon chas gos tshang dang ma tshang blta zhib byas rjes/29

zhib bsher ba rnams bka' shag gi mdun du gral bsgrigs nas yar tsam yong thog dang po shod drung zhabs gsar ba des/ bka' shag gur mdun rdo dkar gong chung ngu zhig bzhag yod pa der zhwa 'bog ma reg tsam gyi zhwa phud sgur sgur dang bcas te ‘‘g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba g.yas ru dang po sde dpon dga' bzhi ba gzab 'don dang bcas rta pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'grigs lags ri’zhes phyag 'bul gyi snyan seng zhus/ gnyis pa rtsis phrug pa rgan pa des/ ‘‘rta shed bzang / mi go thang / rta sga sga 'bol kha gsar cha tshang dang bcas pa 'grigs lags ’’zhes phyag 'bul zhus/ gsum pa rtsis phrug 'bring bas/ ‘‘gu sha'i a khrab/ kha sha'i sha dor/ dpa' dam 'u du gzugs/ gong shub kha gsar rta mdung sogs rnga dang bcas pa 'grigs lags ’’zhes phyag 'bul zhus/ bzhi pa rtsis phrug gzhon pas ‘‘bsra rmog zhwa ldan 'byar lam rma mdongs me long bzhi/mtha' lcags byang khebs dang bcas pa 'grigs lags ’’zhes phyag 'bul zhus/lnga pa rtsis phrug pa chung shos nas phyag 'bul zhu bzo dod pos/ ‘‘sag thag mda' gzhu rgyan bcings me mdel cha lag cha tshang dang bcas pa 'grigs lags ’’zhes zhus zin 'phral rta pa rnams rang gi sdod gur du log de bzhin du dmag gzhung nang gsal re re bzhin zhib bsher gyis g.yas ru mjug rdzogs mtshams tshang ma nyin dgung gsol tshigs su 'gro zhing / bka' shag gtsos gzhung zhabs rnams la bla phyag las khungs nas sngar srol gnyer pa ma byan zur bskos kyis sha 'bras sha to ra'i nang stabs bder gtong ba/ nyin dgung gsol tshigs zin rjes ‘‘g.yon ru dang po yab gzhis bsam grub pho brang pa gzab 'don dang bcas rta pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi ’’zhes sogs gong bzhin rtsis bsher byed/ de nyin lha sa grong khyer nang rta 'gros ma nyar mkhan phal che bas bang 'gros 'gran bsdur yang byed/ rtsis bsher byed sgo zin mtshams/yā sor rta dmag dang bcas pa rta hrag gral bstar 'grigs pos klu sbug sgar 30

sar phyir log bskyod pa dang / bka' shag sogs de min rnams khungs so sor log tshotshes nyer bzhi nyin smon lam gtor rgyag la yā sor rta dmag dang bcas pa rtse pho brang la zhabs bskor gyis dgon gseb shar du dmag ston bshams/smon lam dgong ja'i gsol tshogs grol ba dang 'dod 'jo zam pa brgyud bar skor du ru bzhi bsgrigs kyis thon/ bla brang rnying pa zhes sde dpon thon pa ba'i gzim shag gi mdun yā sor khri pa gnyis khri mthon por bsdad de dga' nye khag nas rten 'brel kha btags g.yogs srol dang de skabs mi mang bas ha cang gi 'tshang ga chen po yod pa/ gtor rgyag ma thon tsam la gtsug lag khang gi gzim chung kun gsal zur 'phyongs rab gsal nas tā la dang / snang srid gzim chung nas srid blon/ khyams rwa'i sgo 'phyor steng gi khams gsum rab gsal nas bka' shag zur 'phyongs gzim chung 'og g.yu lo bkod rab gsal du bla phyag ngo las bcas nas gtor rgyag zhal mjal dang / yā sor rnams zur 'phyongs gzim chung la mngon phyogs te phyag 'tshal zhus zin pa dang jus yag dar chen la bskor ba byas te bar skor thengs gnyis par bskyod/gtor rgyag khag gnyis yod gshis khag gcig rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang ba rnams khyams rwa chen mo nas thon dgos pa dang / gcig shos 'bras spungs sngags pa grwa tshang gsung chos rwa ba nas thon dgos/ gtor ma 'phen yul sa cha klu sbug rgyal sgo zhes sngar gyi grong khyer gyi rgyal sgo chen po'i shul zhig yod pa de'i nye 'gram du gtor khung chen po gnyis bslangs te der 'phen srol yod/ gtor rgyab tu dga' ldan khri pa rin po che dang / dge bshes lha rams gsar pa nyi shu rtsa gcig de bzhin smon lam gyi dge 'dun yongs rdzogs bcas phebs dgos pa/ gnas chung chos skyong rten gzhir khog brlams kyis lha mda' 'phangs/ rkang dmag gzim chung dmag rnams kyis bod mda' 'dzam grags 31

zhes skad chen dgu shog rgyag bzhin par lam gyi g.yas g.yon nas bskyod/lam gyi dkyil nas rta dmag rnams ru bzhi bsgrigs kyis dpa' skad ngar sgra sgrog bzhin par gtor phung 'gram nas phyir log gis klu sbug sgar sar bskyod pa bcas byed srol yod pa red/tshes nyer lnga nyin byams pa gdan 'dren zhes nam langs snga char lha ldan gtsug lag khang nas byams pa mched bzhi shing rta 'khor lo'i nang bar bskor du gdan 'dren zhus par thog mar bla phyag las khungs nas ‘‘thugs smon snyan shal ririzhes pa kha btags nang mdzod phyag mdzod pas sgron 'bul zhus/gzhan yang ser skya mang pos smon lam btab ste snyan dar 'tshang ga shig shig gis 'bul srol yod/ de nas me skyogs kyi skad brda grags ma thag rta rgyugs mi rgyugs dus gcig tu glod gtong byed pa de yang rta rkyang rnams spyi ri'i zur zhes 'bras spungs dgon pa'i mdun gsham dang / mi rgyugs rnams dang /bar rgyugs zhes sog zhwa gyon pa'i rta pa rnams rkyang thang na ga nas glod gtong byas te lha sa'i bar bskor lho phyogs gsung chos rwa ba'i mdun brgyud bskyod srol/ mi rgyugs tsho'i ang ki dang gnyis shing byang bla brang rnying pa'i mdun nas sprod pa dang / bar rgyugs pa rnams kyi shing byang me tog ldum rwa dang / rgyugs ma zhes rta rkyang rnams kyi shing byang jo bo rag rgyag nas sprod kyi red/ rgyugs ma glod gtong byed po spyi khyab dza sag gcig dang / las bya shod drung brgyad/ jo lags phyag nang gnyis bcas gsung chos rwa bar 'byor te mi rta tshang 'dzoms byung 'phral yab gzhis bsam grub pho brang gi byang phyogs skal bzang dar chen gyi 'gram du rgya lcog bsgrigs pa'i sdings cha'i steng du bla phyag ngo las dang /rgyugs ma'i spyi khyab ngo las rnams 'khod de spyi khyab pas rta mi rgyugs chen gyi ming gzhung bklags pa ltar bya dga' gnang sbyin zhu bar skal bzang dar chen la g.yas bskor gyis zur 'phyongs mdun rta rgyugs ang dang por gnang kha 32

btags a she dang / gos chen kha phyed gsum re yod pa'i tshos sna lnga'i tshan grangs dgu tshan/ ja 'khor drug gcig pho rta nyams bzang gcig 'bru dkar ltang gcig bcas gsol ras sprod pa dang / ang gnyis par kha btags bar mdzod dang / gos tshos sna'i tshan grangs bdun tshan/ ja 'khor gsum gnyis/ pho rta nyams 'bring gcig ang gsum par kha btags zub she dang / tshan grangs lnga tshan/ ja 'khor gsum gcig pho rta dkyus ma gciga.ang bzhi pa nas bco lnga bar kha btags zub she dang tshan grangs gsum tshan re/ja 'bru gnyis sbag re/ ang bcu drug nas nyer lnga bar tshan grangs gsum tshan re/ ang nyer drug nas bzung kha btags zub she re bcas dang / de bzhin mi rgyugs par yang gnang cha gong bzhin yod/ bar rgyugs ang dang por kha btags zub she dang / gos tshos sna lnga tshan gcig ja 'khor drug gciga.ang gnyis par kha btags dang tshan grangs gsum tshan/ ja 'khor gsum gcig ang gsum par kha btags the bas tshan grangs gsum tshan dang / ja sbag gnyis/ de byings la kha btags zub she re bcas sprod srol yod/ de nas gzim chung dmag g.yas ru g.yon ru gnyis sbe ga ab stangs 'gran bsdur dang / phyogs phan tshun nas yong ba'i skyes pa shed shugs rtsal 'gran gyi rdo 'gyogs byed po rnams dang bcas par ske dar kha btags dang / rgyal kha thob mkhan la dngul srang gsum re bcas gsol ras sprod pa/ de rjes smon lam grol ston gsol tshogs 'tshogs/ gsol ja bzhes thug dang dge 'dun rer grol ston bkra shis kha btags re phul te smon lam grol ba dang / zangs rkyan dang dngul rkyan rtsis len byed mi bla phyag jo lags bzhi nas zhib bsher rtsis len byas te mdzod khang du bsdu 'jug byed dgos/ 'bras spungs tshogs chen zhal ngo las byed dang bcas pa shod gzim chung 'gag tu thon phyag mjal bcar gyis 'bras spungs dgon par phyir log byed/33

tshes nyer drug nyin/ rdzong rgyab zhar 'phen zhes yab gzhis lha klu dga' tshal gyi mdun thang spro khang du bka' shag lhan rgyas dang shod skor yongs rdzogs 'gro dgos shing / rta'i rgyugs lam gyi lho phyogs nas byang gtad kyi gur phubs pa'i nang bzhugs gral 'khod nyid bka' shag gsol thab pas ja 'bras gtong ba dang / bka' blon khri pas rta gzhung zhib bltas thog grwa bzhi rtsis bsher ltar zhib bsher gyis rta pa rnams 'be+en dang por me mda' dang /gnyis par mda' 'phen dgos pa/ tsho khag ste rta pa khag rta mjug 'gril ba dang bka' shag gur mdun bskyod skabs gar phrug pa gnyis nas dngul phor stegs par phud kor dang 'brel bla phyag nas ske dar re g.yogs pa dang gral 'grigs pos gom gsum mdun bskyod kyis pus mo g.yas pa btsugs pa'i gus 'dud zhus 'phral gom gsum phyir 'gros byas te log g.yas ru rdzogs pa dang nyin dgung gsol tshigs gtong ba/ de nas g.yon ru 'go 'dzugs byas te nyin gang 'gor gyi red/tshes nyer bdun nyin gnam mda' zhes smon lam rjes 'brel dga' ston lta bur rdzong rgyab spro khang nang bka' shag lhan rgyas kyi dbus shod skor tshang 'dzoms thog gzim chung dmag gi 'go byed rnams dang / ju nang pa dang /gzhung sog pa bcas nas rgyang ma zhes mda' 'phen 'gran bsdur gyi mda' yig zhu bar shog ces bka' shag gzim 'gag shod drung gnyis kyis spro khang dbu g.yab kyi zur g.yas g.yon nas rgya lcog steng 'dzegs te skad gsang mthon pos rta ring 'then srol 'di lta ste/ ‘‘rgyangs ma cha red/ ju thal ya red/ de mtshungs ju gzhung dang bcas dma' yig zhu bar shog cig wa ye ’’zhes skad thengs gsum gsum res mos kyis bsgrags zin ma thag khungs so so'i mda' bka' drung la phul bar mda' so sor ming 'god bka' shag gi mthong lam du gral bsgrigs nas bzhag rjes ngang tsam nas mda' pa rnams zhwa 34

'bog gyon zhing / lag tu gzhu ol ma thogs te g.yas g.yon gnyis su gral bsgrigs pus mo g.yas btsugs te 'khod skabs/ bka' drung nas ming gzhung nang gsal ltar mda' rnams sprod pa blang thog gnam mda' 'phangs/mda' 'phen mjug 'gril ba dang / yā sor khri pa ngo 'khor thang chen sa gnas su mda' skor ngo bskyod kyis mda' rgyangs ang ki rim 'god byas pa bka' shag tu 'bul/ slad mdzad sgo bskyar tshugs kyi spro khang sdings cha'i 'og mdun gzim chung dmag sgar 'go dmangs rnams sngar srol rgya lu chas spras te mda' gzhu thogs nas gral la 'khod/ bla phyag las khungs nas gtong sgo sngon stsal ltar dmag ston ja thug gtong dgos pa/ kha sa rta rgyugs skabs rta pa tshos zhwa mo dang mda' gzhu sogs zag lhungs byung rigs gzim chung dmag mis sgrugs nyar byas pa rnams rta pa so so len par yong dgos/ de nyin dmag ston zin rjes bka' blon tsho yang zhwa mo sog zhwa gyon/ zhol pa las khungs nas chang 'dren gar phrug pa rnams kyis chang btegs/ gzhung zhabs mda' pa rnams nas sbi shu tho ril zhes skad snyan gyi mda' 'phen byed pa'i 'ben la phog mkhan tshor bla phyag las khungs nas legs dar re sprod srol de dag sked par gzer nas mda' 'phen gyi yod pas mkhas pa rnams gzugs po 'khor mor kha btags mang po dkris rgyu yod pa red/ bka' blon tshos gtsos pa'i dza thal rim sras las dkyus dang bcas pa mtho dma' med pa nang tsha lta bur chang btegs res byed pa dang / 'dam brgya shog brgyad kyi yā sor dpon 'khor nas bka' blon tshor chang dngul phor 'dren skabs yā sor ngo ma gnyis pos btegs dgos shing / 'dam brgya shog pa'i glu gzhas thun mong ma yin pa'i gdangs dbyangs 'then te bka' blon re re bzhin la chang 'dren pa dang / gar dpon gyis gtsos gar pa rnams nas rol cha sna tshogs dang bcas snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gar glu gtong ba/ bla phyag las 35

khungs nas shing 'bras sne 'dzoms kyi zhal tog 'jung pa med pa gtong dgos/tshang mar ske dar bkra shis kha btags re g.yogs te grol bsangs btang nas mdzad sgo grol ba bcas byed srol/de min lo ltar zla re'i byed sgor mtshon na/ bod zla gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin po ta la'i rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi 'du khang du sa gar mchod gar dang / sa bcud bum sgrub kyi rab gnas gnang ste bum pa rnams yul gru kun tu gnas ri khag dang / mtsho dang mtshe'u/ chu mig sogs la lo ltar 'grems spel gyis ar chog kha dbye dang sba chog zhu bar rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi dge 'dun pa dang /rgyud grwa rnam gnyis kyi dge 'dun khag bgos kyis phebs srol la rta khal sdod sgrig sa gnas so sos zhu dgos pa'i bka' shag gi lam yig dang bcas rgya khyab gang sar gtong srol yod/ tshes bcu dgu nyin nas gtsug lag khang du gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum sogs kyi dge 'dun rnams sngar lam ltar na tshogs mchod chen mo nyin bcu'i ring tshogs srol gyi thog la dga' ldan khri thog dgu bcu pa khri byams pa chos grags nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum par snyan zhus kyis tshogs mchod 'phar ma nyin gnyis kyi mchod bsnyen ma rtsa thebs sbyar sbyor 'bul zhus don ltar/ phyis tshes bcu bdun nas dbu 'dzugs kyis tshogs mchod nyin bcu gnyis kyi mchod bsnyen bla phyag las khungs nas gtong 'bul zhu dgos pa dang / zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes sum cu nyin/ tshogs mchod ser sbreng chen mo zhesu (tā la'i bla ma lnga pa'i dgongs rdzogs mchod sprin du sde srid sangs rgyas pas btsugs )zhes pa'i dus chen khyad par can yin gshis/ser sbreng chen mo 'di'i 'gan 'dzin gtso bo mchod rdzas do dam pa zhes pa'i rtse drung gnyis dang / las bya rtse drung bcu gnyis/ 'bras spungs tshogs chen dge bskos gnyis dang / zhang po shing gnyer/ chab dam pa gnyis/ dge g.yog bcu dgu bcas 'khur mnyam len gyis gra sgrig 'thus tshang yong ba zhu dgos 36

shing / mi 'gro dge 'dun 'khri khungs gdan sa'i grwa tshang khag dang / rgyud grwa rnam gnyis/ me ru bzhi sde/ gling phan tshun bcas kyi chab ril rnams tshes nyer brgyad dgong mo 'khyams rwa chen mor 'gugs 'bod thog mchod rdzas do dam pas byed sgo'i bka' btang ste tshes nyer dgu nyin mchod rdzas 'dra min khag khungs so sor rtsis sprod byed/ tshes sum cu nam langs snga char gtsug lag khang gi khyams rwa chen mo nas rim thon gyis dkyil gdugs dkar po zhes ser sbreng gi dkyil mtshams su gos chen las bzos pa'i gdugs dkar po de nyid dge 'phel dbu rtser nyi ma shar ba dang khyams rwa'i sgo 'phyor 'og thon pa dus mtshungs pa dgos gshis dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams kyi 'dra 'bag dang / chas gos/ phyag mtshan sogs cha tshang ba sde tshan ma 'khrugs par rim thon gyis khyams rwa'i sgo 'phyor 'og tu lha so so'i gar 'cham dang 'brel zhal 'don cho ga gsungs/ rang rang gi gral bstar rim pa ma 'chol ba dal bu'i ngang bskyod de zhol 'bras bu g.yul khar phebs 'phral gar 'cham dang / gar phrug pa rnams kyis gar 'khrab/ ser sbreng pa rnams kyis phyag 'tshal zhus/ de nyin po ta la'i mdun phyogs bkram pa'i gos sku chen mo'i zhal mjal dang / ser sbreng zhal mjal sogs la ser skya mang po 'du 'dzoms kyis spos dang snyan dar phul te smon lam gsol 'debs byed pa dang / ser sbreng ba rnams 'bras bu g.yul kha nas rtse pho brang la zhabs bskor gyis rdzong rgyab klu khang gi shar ngos dgon gseb shar du nyin dgung zhal lag dkar skyong 'bul bzhes dang / de nas ra mo che gtsug lag khang gi jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i spyan sngar dang / ra sa gtsug lag khang gi khyams ra'i sgo 'phyor 'og so sor gar 'cham zhal 'don dang / gar 'khrab ston bcas byas te khyams ra chen mo'i nang du phebs pa bcas tshogs mchod chen mo'i ring gi mchod sprin dang / sri zhu bsnyen bkur rnams bla brang phyag mdzod nas bsgrub dgos pa red/37

bod zla gsum pa'i tshes brgyad nyin rtse pho brang po ta la'i tshoms chen du brgyad gtor gyi mdzad sgo tshugs/ de nyin nas gzhung zhabs ser skya tshang ma gyon pa dgun chas phud de dbyar chas gon dgos pa red/bod zla bzhi pa sa ga zla ba'i dus chen la lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang /ra mo che/ rtse pho brang / gdan sa khag gsang chen rgyud grwa rnam gnyis sogs kyi rten mchog rnams kyi gsol lhungs brje bkang dang 'brel sna lnga'i stong mchod dang / brgya mchod sogs mchod 'bul rgya che dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/ ngan sprang la ja dang rtsam pa sogs sbyin gtong byed cing /tshes bco lnga nyin rten mchog rnams la sgron 'bul zhu rgyu'i mjal dar nang mdzod dang / a she/ zub she bcas bla phyag las khungs kyis sngon tshud nas go sgrig gis rtse yig tshang las khungs brgyud thugs smon zhu rgyur phul ba phyir zhus te tshes bco lnga nam langs snga char gtsug lag khang gi steng shod bar gsum dang /ra mo che/ tshe dpag lha khang / phyogs bzhi rigs gsum lha khang bcas par thugasasmon snyan shal 'bul phyir bla phyag las khungs kyi ngo las tshang ma mchod mjal la 'gro dgos pas/ ra mo che nas 'go 'dzugs kyis gling bskor du 'gro ba dang / bla ma ma ṇi ba dang / phyogs mtha' nas 'ong ba'i sngags pa grwa btsun khag rang rang gi sdod gur nang sku thang bkram zhing mchod 'bul dang / grub mtha' rang rang gi cho ga phyag len gyi thog nas zhal 'don byed cing / de rnams kyi sku thang la snyan shal dang / maṇ+ḍal steng dngul/ sngags btsun rnams la dngul 'gyed/ dbul phongs ngan sprang rnams la'ang dngul 'gyed bcas sprod gtong byed bzhin du gtor rgyag gling khar 'byor skabs bla phyag ngo ma bzhi dang / phyag drung / bla brang khang gnyer/ bzo khang do dam pa rtse drung gnyis bcas nor bu gling gar drung jar bcar dgos pa dang / jo lags rnams gtor rgyag gling gar ngal gsos te sdod/ drung ja grol ba dang / mu mthud 38

gling skor du bskyod nas po ta la'i sku rgyab mtsho dkyil rdzong rgyab klu khang du ko gru btang nas 'gro zhing / klu khang dkon gnyer rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi sku zhabs nas bla phyag las khungs kyi ngo las yongs rdzogs la gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang /zhal tog 'bul srol/ mchod mjal grub pa dang ko gru'i nang zhugs te rnam thar gtong bzhin par klu khang la skor ba bskor/ klu khang byang sgo brgyud mu mthud gling skor byas te ra mo cher 'byor rjes rang rang gi rtar bzhon nas so so'i nang du log rjes boka' shag lhan rgyas dang / shod skor gzhung zhabs tshang ma klu khang du bskyod de mchod mja la dang / grwa tshang sku zhabs dkon gnyer lags nas gsol ja bzhes 'bras/ zhal tog 'bul ba/ lha sa'i nang ma'i skyid sdug ces dmangs khrod rol cha'i tshogs pa nas nang ma dang / stod gzhas snyan 'jebs dkrol gtong dang 'brel zhabs bro 'khrab gtong byas par legs skyes kyi dngul shog chag dang / tshang mar kha btags g.yogs/ rol cha gar mkhan rnams la'ang dkon gnyer lags nas gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang /zhal tog gtong ba/ de nyin lha sa grong khyer gyi mi mang rdzong rgyab klu khang gi gling ga'i nang za btung khyer te gling ga gtong ba dang / ltad mor 'ong ba/ ko gru'i nang pang leb bting ste rkang bro glu gzhas 'khrab pa/ rnam thar gtong ba sogs byas te ko gru mang po klu khang la skor ba bskor te nyin gang sdod srol yod/tshes bcu drug nyin grib rdzong btsan gyi dus chen zhes lha sa grong khyer gyi lho phyogs tshe mchog gling dgon par mi dmangs mang pos bsangs dang / dar phreng / cod pan sogs 'khyer te snga dro mchod mjal dang lha gsol byed/nyin dgung phyir log skabs lha sa'i lho rgyud gtsang chu'i 'gram gyi gling ga khag gi nang gzhas rnam thar dang / zhabs bro rgyag pa/ sho sbag rgyag pa sogs byed/dgong dro khyim du log dus lam bar la'ang gzhas rnam thar gtong bzhin du log pa dang / de nyin bla phyag las khungs kyi ngo las rnams kyang phyag mdzod 39

gling kha'i spro khang du spro skyid gtong srol yod/bod zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu nyin/ gnas chung chos skyong dang / dga' ba gdong gnas srung gnyis la dbyar gsol zhu bar bla phyag las khungs kyi ser skya bzhi dang / phyag drung / bla brang khang gnyer rtse drung / bzo khang do dam rtse drung / jo lags phyag nang / zha'u li/ rtse mo gnyer pa bcas ngo las yongs rdzogs 'gro dgos pa dang / gnas chung sgra dbyangs gling grwa tshang dang /dga' ba gdong grwa tshang gi dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed dang /bzhes thug 'bras tsha/ chos skyong so sor bskang 'phrin bshags bstod sogs byed pa'i dgos cha'i gtong sgo rnams bla phyag las khungs nas gtong dgos/tshes bcu gcig nyin bla phyag las khungs kyi spyi gnyer thun mong nas brda tho gtong ba'i nang don ni ‘‘gnangs nyin tshes bcu gsum nas bzung rang re'i spro chung tshugs rgyur na bza' gzab bzhes kyis snga dro'i chu tshod brgyad par las 'gag tu lhan 'dzoms thub pa gnang dgos ri’zhes 'khod don ltar tshes bcu gsum snga dro bla brang steng du tshang 'dzoms rjes phyag mdzod gling gi spro khang du skyod skabs rgyal sgo'i g.yas g.yon gyi bsangs khung nas bsangs gtong ba dang / spyi gnyer jo lags gnyis dang / khrung zhu rgyan bzang ma gzhon nu gnyis kyis gyon chas gzab mchor gyis rgyal sgo'i 'gag tu phebs bsu phyag 'bul zhu ba/ spro khang tshoms chen du bzhugs gral la 'khod 'phral ja 'dren pa dang / gro bso phye mar 'degs pa/ khrung zhu rgyan bzang ma gnyis nas chang phud dngul phor btegs/ ja gnyis pa drangs rjes gro ma 'bras sil gtong ba/ja gsum pa drangs rjes bzhugs gral grol/ las zhwa las gos phud de rtsed 'jo sna tshogs la rol/ sngar spro chung nyin bdun dang / spro chen nyin bcu gcig gtong srol yod kyang / tā la bcu gsum pa'i dus spro chung nyin gsum dang /spro chen nyin lnga btang na 'thus rgyu zhes bka' dpyad phebs pas phyis de ltar 40

lag bstar byed cing / spro chung nyin gsum po'i dgong dro'i gsol tshigs grub pa dang grol ston bzhugs gral la gro bso phye mar dang / rgyan bzang khrung zhu ma gnyis dang / g.yas g.yon khrung g.yog gnyis kyi lag tu dngul rkyan thogs shing / bzhugs gral la kha phyogs te rgyan bzang ma'i rgyab phyogs nas gzhas dpon sog zhwa gyon pas rten 'byung gzhas chen gtong ba dang / zhabs bro brgyab zin 'phral rgyan bzang ma gnyis kyis bla phyag sku ngo ser mo ba tshor phud stor dang / skya bo rnams la dngul phor gtsang ba zhes kyi mchod chang btegs/de nas sku ngo rnams kyis dngul phor lag tu khyer nas jo lags tsho dang spyi gnyer gnyis/ khrung zhu ma/ khrung g.yog gnyer pa/ rgya zas ma byan/dkar rtsis pa/ gur pa gdan gnyer/ ja ma/ chang ma/ lag g.yog rnams dang bcas par legs chang dngul phor re blugs rjes tshang mar ske dar re dang /las byed pa rnams la legs skyed dngul shog chag re sprod/ de nas gzhas chen gsum pa tshugs pa dang ngo las tshang ma yar langs te lcags ri nang ma'i bsangs la me spar/ ngo las rnams go bab ma 'chol ba'i gral bstar bsgrigs/gzhas chen gyi zhabs bro brgyab zin mtshams gral mjug nas bkra shis them pa yar 'dzegs kyi phye mar 'bo chen btegs par tshang mas phye mar nas lag gi snyim pa gang re blangs thog rnam thar ‘‘tā la'i la mo'i rtse nas ’’zhes pa btang /mjug tu bsu bsu su gsum 'then pa dang / ki bswo'i lha rgyal skad gsang mthon pos sgrogs/ khrung zhu mas gral 'go nas bzung dngul phor btegs par phud gtor dang / rnam thar gnyis pa ‘‘dgra mgo phar 'dul dang /gnyen 'khor tshur skyong mi’zhes pa btang ste sku bsangs dang bcas mdzad sgo grol nas/ spyi gnyer gnyis dang / khrung zhu ma gnyis kyis bar sgo'i 'gram nas sku mgron dang bcas pa re re bzhin phebs skyel phyag 'bul zhus te dga' gyes byed srol mchis/41

bod zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi nyin/ ston pa shākya thub pas bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen la gtsug lag khang dang / ra mo che/ rtse pho brang gi rten gtso 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra sogs kyi spyan sngar sna lnga'i stong mchod rgyas pa 'bul bshams dang / mchod 'bul ba dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur gsol ja bzhes thug dang sku yon/ mchod khang khag gi lhungs bzed rnams la 'bras dang shing 'bras brje bkang / rgyun 'dzugs mchod kong khag mar khus 'gengs rgyu/ gzhan yang gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum dang /rgyud grwa rnam gnyis/ lha sa'i nye 'khor dgon pa dang ri khrod khag la'ang mchod sprin rgya che 'bul gnang mdzad srol ltar mchod bsnyen dgos cha rnams bla phyag las khungs kyis nyin kha shas sngon nas zhu sprod byed dgos pa red/bod kyi zlos gar lha mo tshogs pa khag mang yod pa'i nang nas sngar srol ltar zho ston gzigs 'bul du bcar dgos mkhan rin spungs rgyal mkhar chos rdzong pa dang / stod gcung ri bo che/ shangs ri bo che/ dbus skyor mo lung pa/ yar lung bkra shis zhol pa dang / thang po che spun bdun pa/ shel rong 'brong rtsed pa bcas la nor gling rtse phyag las khungs nas bkod brda btang don bzhin lha sar 'byor 'phral rtse phyag las khungs su 'byor tshes snyan seng zhu dgos pa dang / bod zla drug pa'i tshes nyer dgu nyin snga dro sngar srol dpal ldan 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang du zho ston lha mo'i gzhas phud 'khrab 'bul zhus rjes 'bras spungs gos sku rin po che bkram pa'i spyan sngar gzhas phud 'khrab 'bul dang / de nyin gos sku'i spyan sngar 'bras spungs tshogs chen dge bskos gsar rnying 'pho len byas te dge bskos gsar pa gnyis kyi gsar mjal che 'don mdzad sgo byed srol yod pa red/tshes sum cu nyin/ snga dro rtse pho brang po ta la'i bde yangs shar du karma shar gnod sbyin bya khri ba'i ru 'dren rnams kyis gar 'cham dang / zlos gar 42

tshogs pa rnams kyis gzhas phud 'khrab 'bul zhus 'phral nor gling pho brang khams gsum zil gnon gyi zhal dkar 'og gi sdings char 'cham dang /gzhas phud 'khrab srol/bod zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig nas bzung zho ston nyin lnga'i ring nor gling du nyin dang po rin spungs rgyal mkhar chos rdzong pa dang / nyin gnyis par stod gcung ri bo che ba/ nyin gsum par skyor mo lung pa/ nyin bzhi par shangs ri bo che pa/ nyin lnga par yar lung bkra shis zhol pa bcas kyi lha mo tshogs pas rgyal rabs 'dra min gyi zlos gar lha mo nyin 'khyongs 'khrab 'bul byed srol bzhin tā la'i bla ma dang / yongs 'dzin gnyis pho brang khams gsum zil gnon gyi gzim chung dbus ma'i zhal khra nas dang / gzim chung zhal khra'i 'og dkar gur dbu g.yab shar gtad nang srid blon sogs dang / sdings cha'i g.yon phyogs lho blta'i g.yab gur dang po'i nang bka' blon rnams/g.yab gur gnyis pa'i nang gzhung zhabs shod skor dza thal dang / phogs dpon/ rtsis dpon/ mda' dpon/ rim bzhi/ sras rnam pa/ g.yab gur gsum pa'i nang shod skor las tshan pa dang / drung dkyus/ sdings cha'i g.yas phyogs g.yab gur byang blta'i nang gdan sa'i mkhan po dang / bla sprul/gzhung zhabs rtse skor dza sag dang / tā bla ma/ dar mkhan/ nang ma mkhan chen/ mkhan chung khag g.yab gur gnyis pa nar mo che'i nang rtse skor las tshan che chung khag drung dkyus/ dmag sgar khag gi ru brgya/ drung gtogs khag bcas sdod srol mchis/ sdings cha'i khor yug g.yas g.yon gang sar dri ngad ldan pa'i me tog khog ma ltar sgrig byed dgos/tshes gcig nyin nas bzung nyin ltar snga dro sku srung dmag sgar gyis gtsos lha sdod dmag sgar khag gi 'go dmag yongs rdzogs sdings cha'i 'og spang gshongs steng ru sgrig gis mdun phyogs su mda' dpon dang / ru dpon/43

brgya dpon bcas gral ltar 'grigs pos langs sdod pa dang / dmag spyis sdings cha'i sgang du langs te skad gsang mthon pos gus 'dud zhu ba'i skad brda bsgrags nyid dmag mi stong phrag kha shas yod pa rnams ru sgrig gis rol cha dang bcas dmag lugs gus 'dud zhus rjes/ nor gling lcags ri phyi'i g.yas g.yon gling kha'i nang rang rang gi sgar sar log de nas rgyal mkhar chos rdzong lha mo bas rnga sbug gis 'don dang gnyis dang bcas 'khrab ston 'go 'dzugs byed/ dgong dro slar yang dmag sgar khag gi gus 'dud ru sgrig skabs lha( mo'i 'khrab ston gyi mjug sdom 'khrugs cha dod shos 'khel bas ltad mo ba rnams phyogs gcig nas lha mo'i ltad mo che sgang yin la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas drag po'i 'go dmag yongs kyi dmag rtsed ‘‘brang pan ’’gyi rol cha snyan pa sogs 'khrug cha dod pa'i ltad mo che shos yin/ ltad mo ba skye bo ser skya pho mo stong phrag mang po 'du 'dzoms la bde 'jags kyi blta rtog zhol pa las khungs nas byed dgos shing / zhol pa'i nang bzan rnams kyi lag tu lcang gsar lo 'dabs can ring po thogs te 'tshang ga bshang ba dang / kha ta byed pa tsam gyis rang khrims theg pa 'khur len byed pa dang / mi sna khag gi blta rtog srung bya sku srung dmag mi rnams kyis byed dgos/ nor bu gling ga'i nang sngar chang rag dang / tha mag 'thung 'then mi chog pa ma zad/ bod chas kho na las chas gos ya ma zug spras mi chog pa dang / bud med rnams kyang gyon pa phu med gyon mi chog pa/ nyi gdugs phibs mi chog pa sogs sngar srol dgag bya mang po zhig yod kyang / bar skabs shig nas lhug tu song ba red/bod zla brgyad pa'i tshes shar la gzhung zhabs rnams nor bu gling gar nyin bdun ring nyin ltar ‘‘chab zhugs ’’la bcar dgos shing / chab zhugs ring ja 'bras dang / lug sha btsos pa/ spel gzhi zhes pa/ mog mog snum bsregs/ rmug thung / nya shag kon chen/ kam krag pin tog bcas 44
