bzhes spro sne 'dzoms/ ku shu dang / li/ se'u/ mngar kham/ lo gsum kham bu sogs shing 'bras sos pa bcas gya nom pa'i gtong sgo gtong len byed pa dang / de rjes bka' shag thugs spro dang / rtse drung dbyar skyid/ shod skor drung spyi dbyar skyid/ rtse yig tshang dang / bla phyag rtse phyag zhol gnyer/ rtse gnyer tshang / lha sa gnyer tshang sogs las khungs khag gi spro chen rgyas spros che la nyin grangs mang po gtong srol yod/ tā la bcu gsum pa'i dus de dag nyin grangs nyung du btang ba ma zad/ gsol tshigs sgrog rtse gtong ba sogs rgyas spros mi chog pa'i bka' spyad phebs don ltar khu 'dus su phyin/ de rjes rgyal tshab stag brag skabs las khungs khag so so ma yin par gzhung zhabs che chung ser skya yongs rdzogs mnyam 'dzoms kyis ‘‘drung spyi dbyar skyid ’’ces zla bsgril te gsol tshigs stabs bde gnad smin gtong rgyur gtan 'bebs byas don ltar rtse drung gling ga'i spro khang du lo ltar spro chen spro chung gtong srol chags/bod zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin ‘‘lha babs dus chen miril bla phyag las khungs nas rtse pho brang gi mchod khang khag dang / gtsug lag khang / rwa mo che/ tshe dpag lha khang / gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum/ gsang chen rgyud grwa rnam gnyis kyis dbus dgon sde khag la stong mchod brgya mchod dang /lhungs bzed brje bkang / rgyun bkang / mchod kong brje bkang sogs kyi gtong sgo khag gtong dgos/bod zla bcu pa'i dpal lha'i ri rab kyi tshes bcu gsum nyin dngos grub gtor ma zhes lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi yangs steng rtse mor dpal lha zhi drag gi rgyun gtan bskang gso ba rnams kyi thog rme ru ba dge 'dun bgres gras bsnyen song zhal grangs drug cu dang / dpal gsol ma bud med lha lcam gyi rgyan chas spras pa rnams nas bdun gcig gi ring bskang 'phrin gnad smin tshugs pa'i gtang rag tshogs 'khor stong tshogs 'bul lam zhus pa rnams 45

tshes bcu gsum nyin mang tshogs la tshogs 'gyed gtong zhing / skye bo stong phrag mang po dngos grub gtor ma'i byin rlabs len par yong srol dang / de'i nub mo srod 'khor la lha mo drag mo sbal gdong ma'i zhal 'bag sku gsob sku brten rme grwa bsnyen mtshams su bsdad pa des gdan drangs te rtse mo'i g.yab 'khor du zhabs skor mdzad nas phyogs bzhi so sor ngang tsam re bzhugs su gsol ba la gser skyems 'bul mi 'tshang ga shig shig yong mkhan yod/ tshes bco lnga zhogs pa snga por lha mo drag mo lha sa'i bar bskor la gdan 'dren zhu srol 'di ni 'dod khams bdag mos ri rab la zhabs bskor mdzad tshul mtshon pa rgan rabs pa'i ngag rgyun du yod/ dpal lha'i ri rab tshugs nas tshes bco lnga bar phru gu dang gzhon nu tshos ‘‘dpal lha'i gdan chang ’’zhes dngul slong bar tshang mas ster srol dang / de'i ring mchod mjal du bskyod skabs dkon gnyer rnams nas 'bru phran bu yod pa'i tha sbag phyag tu bsnams pa'i nang dad ldan tshos gdan chang zhal 'debs 'bul srol 'dug tshes nyer bzhi dgong mo sa srib mtshams bzhi mchod ces se ra dgon pa phyag 'debs pa po byams chen chos rje'i dgongs rdzogs dang / tshes nyer lnga dgong mo lnga mchod chen mo zhes rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i dgongs rdzogs dus dran la brten skye bo ser skya thams cad kyis dgon khyim gang sar khang pa'i yangs thog pu shud mtha' 'khor du mar me'i 'phreng ba phul te ngag nas gzungs sngags dmigs brtse ma skad gsang mthon po'i rta dbyangs 'then srol dang / rtse pho brang dang / nor bu gling ga lha ldan gtsug lag khang bcas su mar me'i rgyal mtshan sogs dang /gar mkhan rnams khag bgos kyis mchod sprin gar rol thog mtha' bar gsum du 'bul ba dang / gzhan yang rtse pho brang dang / nor gling / dgon sde khag bcas nas dung dang rgya gling gi mchod rol 'bud dkrol zhu lam dang /lhag par du tshes nyer lnga nyin lnga mchod chen mo'i snga dro rtse pho brang po ta la'i 46

tshoms chen du mdzad sgo gzab rgyas kyi sar gzhung zhabs ser skya rnams snga dro dbyar chas gyon pa rnams mdzad sgo'i skabs ser skya tshang ma dgun chas su brje dgos/bod zla bcu gcig pa dang / bcu gnyis pa gnyis kyi nang bskyed dngul bsdu rgyu dang / rdzong gzhis khag gi yong 'bab rtsis len rgyu/ lo gsar dang smon lam chen mo'i gra sgrig byed sgo sogs gong du bkod zin pa ltar dang / bla phyag las khungs kyi 'bab deb la'ang jo lags bslab pa rgan gras ang bcu par ma slebs par blta mi chog de lta'i gnas tshul la brten bla phyag las khungs kyi lo rgyus kyi yig lam mthong myong yod pa shin tu dkon pa dang / rang nyid kyis kyang mthong myong med/ 'on kyang rgan rabs ngag rgyun ltar zhus na/bla brang phyag mdzod las khungs kyi gtso 'gan dang thog sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad lugs dang / de skabs las byed pa sri zhur brtson pa dag la gzengs bstod dang bya dga' sprod pa dnge / las byed pa sgyid lug ya yol byed mkhan gyi rigs la skabs 'phral ber rgyug gis rdung rdeg byed kyi yod pa red ces zer srol 'dug la/ sde srid kyi ber rgyug ces pa'i rgyug pa lcags shan ma lung thag bya lung 'byar ba zhig kyang bla phyag las khungs kyi ka ba'i ldebs la bkal nas yod pa de dag 1959lo'i bar mthong rgyu yod/ gzhan yang khro'i zhag blug cig kyang 'dug 1933lo tā la'i bla ma sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa'i skabs rang nyid bla phyag las khungs kyi zha'u lir 'dzul dus las khungs der phyag mdzod pa rtse skor mkhan chung gnyis dang / shod skor rim bzhi gcig bla brang khang gnyer rtse drung gcig bzo khang do dam rtse drung cigaphyag drung drung tog gcig phyag nang ngo ma phyi'i drung tog jo lags mi grangs nyi shu tham pa/ zha'u li zhes jo lags gzhon pa bzhi/ gzhan yang khang gnyer dang / gad pa sogs 'dug de rjes rwa sgreng dang / stag brag gnyis kyi rgyal 47

thog skabs mi grangs rim 'phar gyis phyag mdzod pa mkhan chung gnyis dang /rim bzhi gnyis/ phyag drung las tshan pa gcig bla brang khang gnyer rtse drung gcig bzo khang do dam pa rtse drung gcig phyag nang 'phar ma brgyad bsnan jo lags ngo ma mi grangs nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ zha'u li 'phar ma mi bdun bsnan mi grangs bcu gcig rtse mo gnyer pa zhes rme ru grwa pa gcig bla phyag ja zhu ba mi gcig gar dgos las byed mi gcig phyag mdzod steng shod gnyis la gtan sdod gad pa mi grangs nyi shu tham pa/ khyams ra khang gnyer gnyer nang gcig dang / gad pa bcu/ lho rgyud khang gnyer gnyer nang gcig dang /gad pa bcu/ ltag sgo khang gnyer gnyer nang gcig dang / gad pa bcu/gzhan yang 'bras spungs dgon par sku tshab pho brang sde pa dang / se rar gzirma khang sde pa/ dga' ldan du ban dgon sde pa sogs las khungs kyi sku tshab khag bcas khyon bsdoms na las byed ngo las mi grangs brgya lhag tsam zhig yod pa red/ bla brang phyag mdzod kyi las 'gan gtso bo ni yong 'bab bsdu len dang / gtong sgo gtong rgyu gnyis red/ de yang gtong sgo'i gtso bo ni/gtsug lag khang khag dang / rtse pho brang / nor gling pho brang yas mas/ gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum sogs dgon khag shin tu mang po yod pa dang /mdo khams khul sogs sa thag ring ba'i dgon khag la sngar snga mo nas khungs so sor mchod rgyun gtong dmigs yul lung so so'i yong 'bab nas ched 'dzugs byas yod pa ltar rang khongs so sos bsdu gtong dgos pa phud/ de byings dgon sde mang che ba bla brang phyag mdzod rang nas mchod bsnyen gtong sgo nar gtong byed dgos pa'i 'char 'phar gyi mchod rgyun 'gro cha re re bzhin yi ger 'god kyis mi lang ba yod/ de 'brel gzhung khang khag gi ar las dang /rdo shing / ar 'ul/ bzo las pa khag gi phogs thob ja mar sha phyur sogs dang / sman rtsis khang dang / lcags po ri sman khang / dmag sgar khag gi sman 48

khang bcas par sman rigs sna tshogs gtong sprod dgos pa sogs gtong gron shin tu che ba gtong dgos/smon lam chen mo dang / tshogs mchod gnyis kyi bzhes 'bras kyi gtsos rgyun gtong dgos pa'i 'bras 'phon che gtong dmigs sdod khul rdzong gzhis rong shar dang / skyid grong / gnya' nang bcas kyi 'bras 'bab rdzong sdod so sos dbus 'bul dgos pa dang / gting skyes dang / phag ri/ mtsho sna bcas 'bras thon khungs cung che ba khag gsum la las khungs rang nas 'bras sgrub pa phyag nang bsko rdzong gis gtong lam/ gzhan yang lho brag lha khang dang /kong po phad rdo gzhong sogs nas kyangacho 'bras 'bab rdzong gzhis khungs so sos las 'bul byed dgos/ rdzong gzhis khag nas dpya khral yong 'bab gtso bo 'bab deb nang gsal yul lung so so'i thon khungs gser dngul zangs lcags/ khrag rwa/ gla rtsi/ ghi waṃ/ dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu sogs rtsa che'i sman rigs dang / rdo sman/ sngo sman/ stag gzigs la sogs pa'i gcan gzan gyi pags rigs sna tshogs/ 'bras/ 'bru/ mar/ phyur ba/ spu bal/ bal snam/ sbra snam/ 'phying pa sna tshogs/ sur pan/ mog ro/ kham kar/ rgun 'brum/ dmar tshos/ rgya tshos/ shing 'bras sna tshogs/ lcam shing dang /pang leb sna tshogs/ spang mthing / ldong ros/ btsag dmar/ sa dkar/ram la sogs pa'i tshos kyi rigs/ tshags sha/ lug sha/ ra sha/ phag sha/ nya sha la sogs pa'i sha rigs bcas rnam grangs khag grangs rtsis dang / 'bo brer gshor 'jal/ 'degs 'gyogs/ 'dom 'jal/ srab mthug dang / zheng dkyus ring tshad/ srus ka legs zher sogs zhib bsher rtsis len dang 'brel chad med 'bul mkhan la deb sbyor gtsang 'dzin dang / de min 'bab deb la sbyor 'god kyi byung 'dzin las tham 'byar ma sprod dgos pa/ gtong sgo mang shos ni mar yin gshis/ der brten rtswa za bzang rigs kyi yul khag la bla 49

phyag las khungs rang gi she 'bri ched 'dzugs kyis gzhung she khag mang po yod pa dang / bsdu len byed po nye 'khor she dpon phyag nang rgan pa gnyis dang /dwags kong khul sku rnam she dpon/ 'on gtam chu she dpon/ lho kha gri gu she dpon/ stod khul gro shod she dpon/ byang dwags po mtsho srib bam yang can she dpon bcas khag so sor she dpon jo lags re bsko gzhag gis gtong lam dang / stod sa dga' khul gyi mar 'bab 'bras spungs rgyun mar ga 'thab tu sa dga' 'go pas bsdu 'bul byed pa/ rgyal ston khul gyi mar 'bab dga' ldan rgyun mar ga 'thab tu rgyal ston rdzong nas bsdu 'bul byed pa/ nag chu khul gyi mar 'bab se ra'i rgyun mar ga 'thab tu nag chu 'go sbrel nas bsdu 'bul byed pa/ de 'brel bla brang khag dang / sger pa 'byor ldan khag la skyes med 'chi med kyi shed 'bri ched 'dzugs kyis she 'bab 'gel dkri byas yod pa bcas de rnams kyi 'bul 'bab la gzhigs pa'i 'or 'dren 'gel khal lam yig bka' shag tham sbyar re khungs so sor sprod/ gzhan yang rdzong gzhis khag gi dpya khral 'bul 'bab rnams la'ang khungs so sor 'gel khal lam yig gtan 'jags sprad yod/ yong 'bab rnams lo ltar 'char can bod zla 10tshes 25snga mchod chen mo'i gong gtsang 'bul dgos pa'i skor sngon tshud bka' shag nas bka' rgya zhu gtong byed dgos/ las khungs kyi gzhung she khag la las khungs rang nas bkod rgya gtong srol bcas dang / bla brang phyag mdzod la rdzong gzhis khag nas dpya khral yong 'bab yod pa tsam ma zad/ lha sa gtsug lag khang gi yong 'bab rnams dkon gnyer dpon nas bla phyag las khungs su 'bul dgos pa dang / zhol pa las khungs dang / snang rtse shag las khungs/ gnyer tshang las khungs/ bsher dpang las khungs bcas kyi yong 'bab dngul dngos rnams kyang lo ltar bla brang phyag mdzod las khungs su bsgrigs 'bul byed dgos pa/ las khungs de rnams kyis phul ba'i dngos po 50

rnams la bla phyag las khungs nas rin 'bebs dang bcas dngul 'bab 'bul 'bor che chung ang rim bkod thog smon lam skabs bla ma dga' ston zhes bla steng gzim chung kun gsal du mdzad sgo'i sar dge bshes lha rams gsar pa ang rim bkod pa rnams la gzengs bstod kha btags dang /dngos po'i bya dga' gsol ras sprad rjes mu mthud las khungs khag gi bsgrigs 'bul ang rim la bya dga' gsol ras sprod srol/ rtsa ba'i yong 'bab kyi thog nas lo ltar bla brang phyag mdzod las khungs kyi bang mdzod g.yang khang mdo sbug tu bkar 'jug byed lam bzhin gser/ dngul/ ṭam dkar/dar gos bcas lo ltar bkar 'jug skabs rtse'i sku tshab rtse mgron gcig dang /bka' shag sku tshab mgron drung gcig bcas gdan zhus kyis zhib bsher dang 'brel sbug dam dang / bka' tham 'byar ma bkar 'jug byas te ma deb bu deb so sor brjod bkod 'gad gtsang byed pa/ rnam kun dngos po gang ci gad pa tshos dbor 'dren byed kyang g.yang khang bang mdzod nang gad pa 'gro bskyod mi chog stabs/ gser/ dngul/ ṭam dkar/ dar gos sogs do po tshang ma jo lags gzhon pa tshos dbor 'dren byed dgos/ las khungs su dgos mkho nang 'dren byed dgos pa rgya gar nas kha che sha kha ma dang / gur kum/ na gi/ a bar skyur gsum/ dza ti/ cu gang sogs sman gyi rigs mang po dang / shing 'bras kha bsur dang / rgun 'brum dkar po/ mngar kham/rgya gar star kha/ bha sha rgun 'brum/ shel dkar ting par/ byi ril sbu dkar/shel dkar rta so ma/ dngul chu/ ti tshwa/ ras tshos sna tshogs dang / me tog tshon khra sna tshogs/ lcags rigs sna tshogs/ rgya mtshal dang / spang mthing sogs tshon sna tshogs/ gzhan yang rgya zog tsag tsig bcas nyo sgrub byed par bla phyag ‘‘rgya gar sman sgrub pa ’mizhes jo lags re lo ltar rgya gar la gtong srol ltar phran rang yang sman sgrub par thengs kha shas rgya gar la 'gro myong yod/ gong 51

gsal shing 'bras khyon 'bor che tsam nyo sgrub byed dgos don ni lo gsar gyi gtsos mdzad sgo mang por shing 'bras 'gro gron che bas mdzad sgo re re bzhin 'dir 'bri khom ma byung ba bcas bla phyag las khungs kyi byed sgo'i rim pa rnams rang blor gang nges 'god bris zhus khul yang / gus rang myong goms shes yon dman stabs go rim 'khrug pa'am/ skyon nor ji snyed srid pas bgres rabs myong can mkhyen ldan rnams nas bka' slob yo bsrang gnang rgyu'i re ba zhu rgyu yin/52

bzhi/ 1939lo nas 1940lo bar bla phyag gi zha'u li sogs byed ring gi 'brelayod gnas tshul/phran lha dbang tshe ring rang lo bco brgyad 1933lo'i rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu bya zla brgyad pa'i nang bla phyag las khungs kyi las bya zha'u li bsko gzhag byung skor gong bkod ltar dang / gzhon khral dka' sbyong che ba le med hur brtson thog lhag par rtse phebs byams pa'i khongs tshud de res gza' spen pa nam yin zhogs pa nam langs snga char rkang 'gros spyong brdar byed par se 'bras dgon pa gnyis dang / 'dam rar skor rgyag tu 'gro skabs phebs byams 'go pa dra khri'i nang bsdad de mi bzhi res btegs 'gros byed dgos pa dang / skabs 'gar tshes gsum thang dang / jo bo rag rgyag gi rta 'gros ma 'gros bsdur byed sar 'khrid de phebs byams 'go pa dang / byams pa rgan pa tsho ci sgros mol kyis sdod pa dang / de byings mi bzhi re thang chen la bskor ba byed par dra khri'i nang bye ma rtswa phad che ba gnyis blug yod pa btegs te mgyogs 'gros kyis chu tshod skar cha dus bkag la phyir 'khor thub pa byed dgos/ skabs 'gar sang nyin mnyes thang la phebs sbyong yin pas phor rtsam 'khyer nas yong dgos zhes spyi mi gnyis nas brda bskyel byas pa bzhin de'i sang nyin mnyes thang lha chen po bar 'gro dgos/ nyin dgung lto chas mnyes thang du zas nas phyir log pa bcas rkang thang mar thag ring de tsam mgyogs 'grormakhyed dgos pa ha cang gi dka' ngal che yang rang 'khri'i byed sgo dka' 53

ngal khyad bsad 'phyugs med dang len hur skyed kyis bsgrubs/rang lo nyer gcig 1936me byi lo bla phyag sman sgrub pa zhes rgya gar nas sman rigs dang ras cha sogs mkho sgrub tu rgya gar la bskyod de lo gsar gong lha sar 'byor thub dgos pa ltar phyir 'khor skabs bza' zla bsod nams dbyangs can la bu ye shes brtson 'grus skyes 'dug rang lo nyer gnyis 1937me glang lo lha sar gtan sdod kyis las khungs las kar rtag bcar byas/smon lam tshogs mchod skabs jo lags mang che ba 'gyed gtong bar 'gro dgos pa de khongs phyin na 'gyed skal len rgyu yod kyang / srol ngan rgyun 'jags kyis zhal ngo dge g.yog tshos lag pa bzed nas dngul thengs mang slong gi yod pas ster ba la ni rang sger gyi min pa ma zad/ dad sbyin khag gis dge 'dun pa dmigs pa'i dad rdzas ster mkhan dang slong mkhan gnyis ka las ngan gsog pa'i rgyur 'gro/ ma ster na ni rtse drung dang jo lags gzhan dag tshang mas ster bzhin par song / zhal ngo dge g.yog tsho khong khro dang blo pham yong rgyur brten de bas yig 'bri'i las ka ni ma gzhi dka' tshegs che la 'gyed skal med kyang cung las stabs bde bas dngul rtsis khang gi yig 'bri kho na'i las ka lo bstud nas mtha' 'khyongs byas/ rang lo nyer gsum 1938sa stag lo slar yang rgya gar du las khungs kyi dgos mkho sgrub par btang bskyod kyis gzhes ning lo gla rtsi'i tshong nyes gyong gun phog par song / na ning nas gla rtsi spus dag dang / wa lpags/ g.yi lpags/ rnga ma dkar nag bal bcas tshong zog gang 'tshams dang / lhag par 'phyi ba'i pags pa stong phrag kha shas nyos/ zi ling tshong pa 'byor skabs zing drel na chung lag gnyis (grangs 18)nyos te zla ba gcig lhag tsam ring rgya ri tshal gzhis kar gso tshags byas/drel pa pho gzhon gnyis dang / 'go 'tshor phan po lcang shar mag pa gcung po dkon mchog bstan 'dzin lags bcas sngon tsam la btang / phran ngo g.yog 54

rjes thon byas kyang rgyal rtser rjes zin pas de nas mnyam bskyod kyis ka sbug tu 'byor/ gla rtsi rnams ka li ka tar 'tshong rgyur 'khyer ba las/ de byings drel dang bcas pa ka sbug tu btsongs par khe gang legs thob/ ka li ka tar gla rtsi brin kha rgyugs pas ldab tshong lhag tsam byung zhing / las khungs kyi nyer mkho dang tshong zog rnams nyos te ka sbug tu btang / phran dang gcung po dkon mchog bstan 'dzin lha sa byang gling tshong khang jo lags phun rnam lags bcas rgya gar gnas chen khag mjal bskyod zin 'phral ka sbug dang / gro mo brgyud lha sar 'byor/ de lo khyim 'dzin bsod nams dbyangs can la bu mo bde skyid chos sgron skyes/ rang lo nyer bzhi 1939sa yos lo tā la sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid lha sar gdan zhu byed kyi yod lugs kyi gtam brjod mang po zhig byed kyang / yang srid skor 1935shing phag lo rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che chos 'khor rgyal gyi lha mo'i bla mtshor mtsho gzigs brtag dpyad la phebs pa'i bla tsho'i nang gi gzigs snang du yi ge dbu can a ka ma dang / thog brtsegs gsum ldan gyi dgon pa g.yu rtsi can gyi mda' g.yab steng gser zangs kyi rgya phibs yod pa'i dgon pa'i shar phyogs kyi 'gro lam ri chung ngu mchod rten gzugs gyi rtsa bar thug pa/ ri chung de'i thad du sngon dus ma mthong ba'i khang pa dang lam khag gnyis yod pa sogs gsal bar gzigs tshul dang / sku gong ma sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku gdung zhal lho gzigs bzhugs bzhin nas lan gnyis shar phyogs su gcus tshul/ gser sdong gsar pa'i shar phyogs ka ba skam po rdo btegs can gyi steng dkar sha chen po sha ba'i rwa co 'dra ba skyes pa tshang ma'i mthong yul du gyur pa sogs yang srid shar phyogs nas phebs rgyu'i rtags mtshan ji snyed byung thog gnas chung chos skyong nas kyang shar phyogs su dar dkar 'phangs pa sogs snga phyi'i lung bstan dang bcas rtsad gcod byed phyogs skor gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan po rnams bka' bsdur 55

gyis rtsad gcod zhu bar phebs mkhan bla sprul mang po 'os thor bkod 'bul la gnas chung chos skyong gi phyag rtags dang rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che'i bka' dgongs ltar dwags po sogs shar lho'i phyogs kyi yul gru khag la phur lcog rin po che dang / a mdo sogs byang shar khul gyi yul grur ke'u tshang rin po che/chab mdo sogs shar phyogs khams khul khang ser rin po che bcas phebs rgyur gtan 'khel/ de rjes bsam yas chos skyong khog brlams kyi skabs shig la ke'u tshang rin po che dang lhan du phebs mkhan gzhung zhabs drag 'dems zhol gnyer khe smad sras bsod nams dbang 'dus dang / nag chu mkhan po rtse mgron mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin/ rtse drung blo bzang tshe dbang / zhabs gras bcu phrag skor bcas la bsam yas chos skyong gis thugs gsal me long yang sprad pa bcas rdo don khag so sor rtsad gcod zhu bar mngags gtong byas/phyogs phan tshun nas yang srid 'os khongs khye'u rtags mtshan ldan pa bzhi lnga yod tshul mang tshogs nang gleng grags che yang / gsang rgya byas te gtan 'khel go thos mi 'dug spyi lo 1939sa yos ston 'go'i mtshams su the tshom bral ba'i byis pa rtags mtshan can sku 'bum gyi nye 'dabs shig nas rnyed de lha sa'i byang shar rta pa'i nyin lam bcu tsam gyi lam thag yod pa'i sa gnas nag chur spyi zla 9tshes 20nyin phebs 'byor gnang rgyu red ces lha sar grags/ sa yos zla dgu pa zla nag yin stabs zla brgyad pa'i nang nges par du lha sar phebs thub pa dgos gal che zhes spyi zla 9tshes 13nyin gdan zhur zhabs pad bon shod pa dang / bla phyag mkhan chung sne'u shag thub bstan thar pa/ rim bzhi rin sgang pa bcas gsang stabs kyis nag chur thon/ gdan zhu bar gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po dang / gzhung zhabs mkhan rim las dkyus sogs mi grangs lnga bcu skor dang / rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi dbu slob dang / gsung zhabs pa dge 'dun nyi shu skor/ sku gong ma'i phebs byams dang / phebs khri gsar rnying 56

gnyis gdan zhur phebs byams 'go pa las tshan dbang rgyal nor bu dang /chophebs 'go gzhon pa byams pa tshe ring / rtse phebs byams pa byings mi grangs nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i thog 'phar du mthud ka mi grangs bcu gnyis/ byams 'then pa dmag sgar khongs nas ru dpon gnyis dang / brgya dpon bzhi/ lding dpon nyi shu rtsa bzhi bcas bzhugs khri gling gar sgar bsgrigs kyis spyi tshes bco lnga nyin rtse pho brang po ta la nas phebs byams dang / phebs khri gdan zhus kyis lha sa nas nag chu'i phyogs su thon bskyod bya gtan 'khel zhing / skabs der yang srid gdan zhur ma bskyod gong rwa sgreng dgon nas srid skyong rin po che lha sar phebs rgyu'i gdan zhur 'gro dgos zhes phebs 'go (phebs byams 'go pa )gnyis nas bshad par/ rang nyid nas rtse phebs byams pa srid skyong gi zhabs zhur gtong srol med pas 'gro ma dgos pa gnang rogs zhes bshad par/‘‘skyabs mgon srid skyong rin po che'i zhabs zhu zhu 'dod med pa tshabs chen gang min tshad yin pas lus steng du bkod pa shod rgyu yin ’’zhes tshig ngan drag pos gshe gshe dang bcas dzig gtam bshad byung bar rang nas ‘‘sngar med gsar spros med pa zhus pa las gzhan gang yang zhus pa med ’’ces bshad/ de nas phebs byams pa rgan pa kha shas kyis phebs 'go gnyis la ‘‘dgongs dag ’’ces zhu brgyud byas/ rgan pa kha shas kyis nga'i rgyab nas 'then te bka' gang gnang zhus pa legs lugs bshad pas gang ltar rwa sgreng du bskyod dgos byung /nga'i rogs par gom bgrod legs pa'i mi gsum dang / rwa sgreng bla brang gi phebs 'gor rtse phebs byams pa rgan pa khyams ra khang gnyer skal rnam bcas nga tsho rwa sgrong du bskyod 'byor skabs phran ngo g.yog gnyis rgyal tshab rin po che'i gzim chung mjal kha zhus pa las srid don sogs sger don tshig gcig zhus pa med kyang / lha sar phyir 'khor mtshams phebs 'go gnyis la sprel lad 'khrab mkhan zhig gis phran rwa sgrong du bskyod skabs pherdas 'go bsko gzhag byid+ngha ba

zhes rgyal tshab rin po cher gzim chung mjal kha zhus lugs dbyen spyor gyi rkyen pas phebs 'go gnyis nas kha ma gsangs pa ma gtogs snying nas phran la ma dga' zhe 'dzin byed pa ngas re zhig ma shes/ de ga'i mur yang srid gdan zhur 'gro ba'i gra sgrig byed sgo'i khongs bka' dgongs gus tsho'i sdod gur rta gzugs ma dgos lugs phebs pa ltar nga tsho bla phyag jo lags lnga'i sdod gur rta gzugs gsar btsem dang / gur thag kar rgyugs sogs cha tshang bzo skrun zin mtshams gur rta gzugs ma las tshan par ma gtogs de byings la rgya gur gzugs rgyags dgos zhes bshad stabs/ rgya gur g.yar khungs blta bar nga rang rgan par song 'khur 'gan blangs te g.yar 'tshol du bskyod ring phebs byams pa tshogs 'du'i sar lam yig nang gsal mi rer za nyal 'gel byed khal ma gnyis re yod pa tsho khag gzhan dag gi khal ma phal cher phebs 'go gnyis la ster yod 'dug nga tsho'i tsho khag la khal ma bcu la rtsam pa/ gro zhib/'bras/ phing / bye ma ka ra/ gzhan yang dgos mkho tsag tsig dang mal chas bcas kyi thog bla phyag sne'u shag gi thugs mkho rgyab gcig bcas yod pas/khal ma lhag 'khro med gshis/ phebs 'go gnyis kyis ‘‘khyod tsho'i khal lhag gang byas song ngam ’’zhes dris 'dug pa der nga'i rogs pas za chas sogs kyisakhal lhag med lugs bshad par/ ‘‘com pa gro zhib mang po 'khyer mi dgos/ nag chu sgrol tsam las 'gro dgos med ’’lugs dang / gzhan gang yod ces dris par nga'i rogs pa jo lags bstan 'dzin snyan grags zer ba rnam kun nas hol rgyugs tsha po zhig yod pa khong gis bla phyag las khungs kyi do po rgyab gcig kyang yod ces bshad 'dug pa der le khag btags nas khal ma phebs byams pa'i khongs yin par bla phyag las khungs kha 'khyer byed pa 'os min yin zhes ra bzi skyur 'gong lta bus bstan snyan la rta lcag gtong gi yin zhes bshad pas zhed snang ma bzod par bla phyag las khungs kyi sku chas jo lags 58 dze

lha dbang lags nas khas len zhus shag ces lab dgos byung 'dug par/phebs 'gos jo lags lha dbang tshe ring zer ba'i mi 'di ‘‘mgyogs pos ma ded 'gor pos ma zin ’ pa zhig red/ kho da lta rang 'khrid shog bkod pa shod kyi yin ces mthar bkag btang 'dug par nga'i rogs pa tshos skyabs rten dngul srang lnga bcu dang / kha btags btang ste 'di skor jo lags lha dbang tshe ring la'ang dgongs 'gal med pa zhus mthar da lam thengs gcig ring dgongs yang byas mthus khas len byas pa de skor phran la'ang gsang ba byas nas lab mkhan ma byung / de'i sang nyin rtse pho brang du gzab mchor gyis 'du 'dzoms thog phebarmo 'go gzhon pas bla phyag jo lags tsho zhe drag yin zer yang /rtse phyag jo lags dang 'gran ya mi 'dug 'di 'dra'i cha 'grig po zhes rtse phyag jo lags tsho'i sked rag mdun phyogs/ (rda' lan tse )zhes sna ru'i shub 'thag drub ma zhe mtshungs yod pa la mdzub mo btsugs nas bshad song / ngas dngos 'brel 'gran ya yod pa ma red gzigs dang zhes/ nga tsho'i gru rtsi tshos tshogs kyi shan tse dang / stod thung / gos krang man rgya dmar gyi dor khug byu ru'i 'phreng ba sogs zhe mtshungs spus dag rnams re re bzhin ngoms ston byas par khong (phebs 'go gzhon pa )sna shu brgyab nas ngo nag por gyur song /nga'i bsam par a ya mtshan rnam kun bzhad gad ku re byed res byed bzhin du de ring gang yin nam snyam pa las gzhan gyi dogs 'char gang yang ma byung /de 'phral rtse nas phebs byams gdan zhus phebs thon gyis lcang gseb shar brgyud khrom gzigs khang gi byang phyogs rgyud smad grwa tshang gi mdun la slebs dus phran phebs byams g.yon gyi dang por yod cing / rgyab phyogs dpung ya rtse phyag jo lags mthong smon zer ba rnam kun gzugs gzhi thang po de tsam med la gom bgrod zhan pa de'i lham gyi rting pa phebs 'go gzhon pa byams pa lags kyi rta'i lag pas brdzis te dpung pa shor ba phran gyis lam seng rgyab slog byas te 59

phebs mda' nas 'ju thub pas phebs byams yo 'khyoms tsam las dbu thod rgya phibs ma lhung pa gang legs byung song yang / mthong smon jo lags la phebs 'go gzhon pas rta lcag 'phyar bar khyed kyi rtas nga'i rting pa brdzis pas byas song zhes bshad pa dang / nga la ngo gdong steng rta lcag shugs chen gzhus byung bar tsha ba las/ mi dmangs kyi dkyil du ngo tsha ba sdug pa byung / de'i dgong dro 'brom thod la slebs dus rta lcag gzhus shul rnams skrangs sbos kyis mig kyang zum la khad byas byung / yang phar lam la gnyis zhes pa'i lung pa de'i phu chu che ba de phar brgal tshur brgal mang po byed dgos pa der nga'i rogs pa bstan 'dzin snyan grags lham 'bud long ma byung bar phebs khri 'khyer 'khyer bar chu 'gram du slebs pas nga la tshab la 'gro rogs zhes skad 'bod byas byung bar/ nga chu'i dkyil du slebs yod kyang rta steng nas lham phud de chu nang 'dzul nas khong gi tshab la phyin/ chu'i pha khar lham gyon rtsis kyis rkang pa phyis skabs phebs 'go gzhon pa rta lcag 'khyer te ‘‘khyod rang ma yong ba gang yin ’’zhes brjod ma thag lham lag par 'khyer nas rta bzhon par rta steng du rta lcag tshar gnyis mig kho nar bsdigs nas gzhu gi 'dug nga'i bsam par a tsi ngas hur thag 'bad thag 'di tsam byas pa dang / bsam pa bzang po 'di tsam byas na'ang ma nyes kha yog 'di 'dra yong ba tshe sngon las ngan mang po zhig byas pa 'dra snyam nas sems sdug phran bu byung / de nub la gnyis nang zhag sdod sar nga'i rogs pa rnams dang lhag par shod gnyer nang tshe dbang dngos grub zer ba phebs byams pa rnying pa gzugs stobasga che ba gom 'gros legs pa zhig yod pa khong nga'i gnas tshul la ya nga nas mig chu shor te brjod gsal/ phebs 'go byams pa lags phebs byams 'go pa yong ba'i rogs byed mkhan khyod rang gi snying nye lags kyi pā lags red/ da khyed rang la sku drin gsab rgyu'i tshab la sdang zug 'di 'dra shin tu ma 'osasni pa red/ 'di skor 60

zhabs pad bon shod par snyan seng zhu bar nga tsho tshang ma mnyam bcar zhu gi yin zer yang / yang srid gdan zhu gal cher de lta'i ka kor zhu 'os ma che ba'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa yin/ de'i sang nyin la lung dkar mor slebs pa'i dgong mo nga'i rogs pa tshos zhabs pad bon shod la snyan seng zhu bar 'gro zhes nan tan gyis brjod rung / mno bsam zhib btang gis ngas phebs 'go gnyis la gnod pa'i las ka byed rgyu phar bzhag rgyab bshad trem byas pa rtsa ba nas med/gang byas pa'i rkyen yin nam rogs pa tshos shes sam zhes dris par/ rtse phyag jo lags sogs nga tsho gzhan tshos dos 'gel khal lhag phal cher phebs 'go gnyis la ster te mi ser sa nas khal gla len rgyu byung ba dang nga tshor khal lhag med pa'i skor ka kor mang po byung ba'i gnas tshul rnams gzhi nas bshad byung /nga'i rogs pa tshang ma gsar pa yin tsang khyim tshang so sos phebs 'go so sor phebs rdzong phul yang / nga rang rnying pa phyogs 'gro gcig pas phebs rdzong ma phul ba sogs gnas lugs mang po zhig gis phebs byams 'go pa gnyis ma dga' ba'i gnas tshul zhib rtogs byung gshis/ ngas rgya gar gyi sman 'bras legs pa smyug slom gru bzhi gang dang / srang gang bag leb smyug slom gru bzhi gang / kha btags gcig bcas 'khyer te phebs 'go gnyis kyi sar bcar te ‘‘lha sa nas thon khar brel 'tshub kyis bcar khom ma byung / ngas phebs byams zhabs zhur tshud pa nas bzung da bar rang gi bgo skal zhu sgo smos ci rogs pa tsho la'ang mthun 'gyur rogs ram sogs hur thag zhus khul yang / phebs 'go gnyis kyi gnang bab gang la gzhigs kyang phung krol g.yo zhu byed mkhan zhig byung bar nges gshis/ rang nyid nas khyed rnam gnyis la gnod pa'i bya ba lta ci/ tha na smad tshig tsam yang brjod pa med/ phung krol zhu mi su yin zhal gsang gnang rogs/ de min zhabs zhu hur thag 'di tsam zhu bzhin du snga phyir lag 'gyogs mdzad pa 'dis 6spyang rdo brdungs kyis ma shi sems sdug gis shi ’61

ba'i dpe ltar da phyin zhabs zhu 'grub re bral nges lags na 'di skor zhal sang gnang rogs ’’zhes kha btags btang nas zhus par/ phebs 'go rgan pa las tshan dbang rgyal nor bu kha sangs sems pa bzang bas ‘‘khag med/ ngas phyag sbrel la zer gyi yod/ lab byung ngam/ phyag mdzod gling kha'i jo lags 'di sems bzang la las ka hur thag byed mkhan zhig la de 'dra ma byed zer byung ngam ’’zhes bshad song / gzhon pa byams pa lags sgam tshugs che mdog gis tha mag gang zag gang 'then nas ‘‘de ga rang red/ da res nga tsho yang srid gdan zhur bcar rgyu 'di ni gal 'gangs shin tu che ba zhig yin pa zhu ma dgos pa zhig red/ der brten drag po'i 'go 'doms ru brgya lding gsum dang / rang re phebs zhabs pa tshang mar tsha gcun che tsam mi byed thabs med kyis khyed rang la'ang lag 'gyogs byed dgos byung song ba las/ ngos gnyis la phung krol byed mi ma byung / sngar byung 'das par sems pham ma byed/ da phyin lag 'gyogs lta zhog tshig ngan tsam bshad mi yong / de bas shon pad brgyab nas sdod ’’ces bshad pa ltar de'i mtshan mo gang 'tshams shon pad rtsed nas sdod dgos byung / de nas bzung bla phyag jo lags 'di tsho yon tan che ba dang / ya rabs pa sogs gleng ba ma gtogs tshig ngan tsam yang shod mkhan mi 'duganye sngon lha sa nas rdog thon gyis dgongs jar 'brom thod du 'byor te zhag sdod bya rtsis kyang zhabs pad bon shod pa nas phebs byams pa 'go byings dang / rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi sku zhabs rnams nam nyin ltos med kyis 'phral 'byor thub pa dgos zhes yig skyel rta shad a drung ched 'byor ltar mtshan mo'i chu tshod bcu gnyis thog 'brom thod nas thon te phan po'i mda' lcags ri phra mor nyi shar snga char 'byor nas tsha phog zhogs ja btung / de nas nyin mtshan ltos med shar skyod kyis nyin lnga pa'i dgong mo'i chu tshod bcu gcig tsam la nag 62

chur 'byor/ de nub zhag sdod bya rtsis kyang slar yang a drung ched 'byor gyis sang zhogs nam langs snga char dga' bzhi na mo cher (bkra shis thang )'byor pa dgos zhes gsal ba ltar myur bar za 'thung byas nas mgyogs 'gros kyis thon te dga' bzhi na mo cher slebs pa dang ri rtser nyi ma shar ba dus mtshungs 'byor/ de 'phral gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang / zhal tog bcas btang ba dang / ngang tsam nas nga tshor mjal kha btang / phebs khri gsar rnying gnyis spyan bstar zhus/ ke'u tshang rin po ches ‘‘chung srid rin po cher phebs khri gang gi nang phebs ’’zhes zhus gnang song bar phebs khri rnying pa der phyag mdzub 'dzugs gnang gis 'di'i nang phebs kyi yin gsungs/ de nas phebs thon gyis sngar sku gong ma rgya nag nas phyir phebs skabs phebs bsu'i bzhugs sgar sgron yul dga' bzhi na mo cher phebs skabs nyi ma shar ba dang dus mtshungs bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod 'phral/ zhabs pad bon shod pas sku phyag gsum phul te sku gong ma'i yang srid 'khrul bral du nges pa'i skor srid skyong rin po che'i zhu yig dang / maṇ+ḍal rten gsum/ gser dngul dar gos sogs rten byung 'bul ba btegs 'bul dang 'brel phebs bsu ba rnams nas mjal kha zhus/ de gar ma 'byor bar yab yum sogs nas 'os sprul 'ba' zhig las yang srid dngos gtan 'khel ba yin min mkhyen tshor byung mi 'dug dga' bzhi na mo cher mdzad sgo'i skabs yab yum dang / sku nye ltos bcas rnams la na bza' sku rgyan sogs sgron 'bul zhus pas blo bde bag phebs byung song gsungs/ yang srid dang / gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan gnyis lhan du drel byams nang gdan 'dren zhus 'dug dga' bzhi na mo che nas nag chu grong rdal bar phebs khri'i nang phebs bzhugs kyis zhabs brtan dgon bde chen pho brang gi 'du khang chen mor phebs te mdzad sgo'i thog ser skya yongs rdzogs la mjal kha btang / der nyin gsum bzhugs ring mi dmangs la'ang 63

mjal kha btang / de nas la lung dkar mor phebs 'byor skabs rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che phebs bsur phebs nas spos sne dang bcas bzhugs sgar lcags ri ser po'i nang gi dbu gur chen mor gdan zhus kyis sku phyag dang bcas maṇ+ḍal rten gsum btegs/ de'i sang nyin bzhugs zhag dang gnangs nyin shar gsum mdor bzhugs/ de'i sang nyin rwa sgreng dge 'phel gling du phebs nyin rwa sgreng bla brang gi gzim chung khag gi bsham bu dang sgo yol/gsang dang khra yol bcas gsar brjes dang / gtsug lag khang gi thug dang rgyal mtshan rnams gsar brje/ yang thog tu bkra shis khra bsgrigs sogs mchod rdzas rgyan 'grems/ lam g.yas g.yon du mchod rdzas thogs pa'i dge 'dun gyi ser sbreng dang bsangs kyi dud sprin nam mkha' bkang ba/ rol mo dung rgya dang / sil snyan/ rdar ma/ sur ṇa sogs 'bud dkrol/ bro pa gzhas ma rnams kyis bro 'khrab pa dang / glu gzhas gtong ba/ ser skya pho mo mang po'i spos me dang bcas rwa sgreng bla brang gi gzim chung tshoms chen du sku gong ma'i bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod de dkar spro bsgrigs 'bul gyis mtshon mdzad sgo gnang / rwa sgreng du nyin gsum bzhugs ring rwa sgreng khu byug mchod pa 'phar ma tshugs pa'i 'cham gzigs nyin gnyis 'khrab 'bul zhus pa gzigs nas de'i sang nyin zhogs pa gnas gzigs grub 'phral lha sa phyogs su phebs rgyu gtan 'khel zhing / de skabs nga tsho bla phyag jo lags tsho'i sdod gur che legs shig yod pas phebs 'go gnyis nas khyed tsho'i sdod gur che legs shig 'dug pa de'i nang nga tsho mā cang rgyag dgos zhes bshad par nga tsho jo lags kyi khrod du mā cang shes pa bstan 'dzin snyan grags dang / rtse phyag jo lags tshe ring rdo rje/ rta tshe lags/ phebs 'go gnyis bcas nyin mtshan sbrel nas mā cang brgyab ste nga tsho lto tshang jo lags rnams gnyid kyang yag po nyal rgyu ma byung / khu byug mchod pa nyin dang po'i dgong dro lha sar phebs byams chen 64

mo sdems rgyag dang chibs sbyong du phebs 'go gcig dang / las rogs su lto tshang gcig lha sar sngon bskyod byed dgos skor 'go byings rnams tshogs 'du 'tshogs par phebs 'go rgan pa dbang rgyal nor bu lags nas nga dang /rogs par bla phyag jo lags tsho'i lto tshang 'khrid nas lha sar sngon du 'gro rgyu yin zhes bshad song bar/ ngas ‘‘lto tshang su 'gro rgyan rgyag gnang dgos ’’zhes bshad/ nga'i rogs pa tshos ‘‘kha rogs bzhugs dang nga tsho lha sar rta bzhon nas 'gro rgyu yod pa red ’mices zer bar/ phran nas ‘‘de 'dra ma zer lto tshang gzhan dag blo pham yong gi red/ lar nas thag ring de tsam zhabs zhu thubanas da cha nyin shas las med par lhan bcar zhabs zhu zhus na legs ’milugs bshad kyang / rogs tshos u tshugs byas stabs phebs 'go rgan pas ‘‘rgyan rgyag dgos kyi ma red nga tsho da lta rang 'gro ’’zhes bshad don brel 'tshub ngang sdod gur gtib nas bsdog cha brgyab/ de'i sngon tsam la kha lag bzo rtsis kyis gro zhib g.yos brdzis zin pa rnams kyang ras phad nang bsgril nas lam seng thon te phod mdor zhag sdod byas/ de nub mā cang rgyag mkhan mi ma ldeng pas shon pad rtsed nas mtshan gang mgo 'khor/ sang nyin chag la brgyab ste glang thang du zhag sdod kyis de'i sang nyin nam langs snga char rgod la brgyab ste lha sar 'byor 'phral de nyin rang phebs byams chen mo sdems rgyag sogs gra sgrig byas/ phebs byams pa rnying pa rnams sang nyin snga 'dzoms dgos pa'i brda tho btang / de'i sang nyin nas bzung nyin gnyis kyi ring 'dod rgu thang nas lha sa gtsug lag khang brgyud nor gling pho brang bar chibs sbyong thengs gnyis byas te phebs byams chen po 'dod rgu thang du bskyal/sa yos zla brgyad pa'i nang yang srid ston 'khor rnams dang / gzhung zhabs ser skyas gtsos ser skya du ma'i phebs bsu gzab rgyas dang bcas grong khyer lha sa'i shar ngos 'dod rgu thang du dbu gur rma bya chen mo'i nang phebs 65

'phral phebs bsu'i mdzad rim khag gnang / de'i sang nyin ri skya bsam khyi gtan gling du gnas gzigs bskyangs/ de skabs gzhi byes zhabs 'bring ser skya mang po zhig nas rang rang gi gur nang bag yod tshul ldan gyis ma bsdad par lha sa dang / glang ru/ sgang stod/ lcag rong sogs la spro skyid mā cang rtsed 'jor 'khyams nyul du phyin te gur nang bsdad med pa mgron gnyer chen mo dang / sne mgron gnyis kyis shes nas bskor g.yeng gis gur nang bsdad med pa'i rigs kyi shing byang bkog thog tho 'god byas 'dug par/sgar gyi rgya khyon che stabs gur srung zhabs gras spyang grung 'dzoms rigs kyis so so'i sbyin bdag sku ngo rnams 'bod par bskyod pas phyir log gis gur nang gnas sdod yin khul byed thub 'dug phebs 'go gnyis dang / g.yu lo shar jo lags skal bzang nor bu lags/ gus pa lha dbang tshe ring bcas phebs 'goganyis kyi gur nang shon pad rtsed 'jor rol te sa bzhu spar nas dgong dro'ikha lag gsol gzhong bsgrigs pa za ba'i sgang glo bur du sne mgron mkhan chung thub bstan legs smon dang / rtse mgron lha'u rta ra ba can gur nang 'dzul byung ba dang nga tsho har langs nas gus pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis bsdad par skad cha gang yang ma bshad par nga tsho tshang ma'i ming tho bris te phyin song / khong tsho phyir log rjes phebs 'go rgan pa khong khro langs nas ‘‘a pha'i ro mi de tsho mi byed dgu byed la ang / khyed tshos yang srid gdan 'dren zhus pa 'grigs shag ces bya dga' sprod rgyu ma byung na'ang / nga tshos rang gi 'ba' khug dkrugs nas spro skyid gtong bar yang btsan dbang gi nyes chad gtong rtsis red do/ngas srid skyong rin po cher de 'dra byed 'jug pa ma gnang rogs zhes snyan seng nges par du zhu gi yin/ zhed snang byed dgos ma red ’’ces zer yang nga tsho blo ma bde tsam byung / 'on te khong gis srid skyong rin po cher dngos gnas snyan seng zhus lugs go thos ltar rjes su gur nang ma bsdad pa sogs la'ang nyes 66

chad phog pa byung ma song / 'dod rgu thang du nyin zhag gsum bzhugs nas nyin bzhi pa'i snga dro 'dod rgu thang nas lha sar chibs bsgyur gnang zhing /thog mar bla rtsis pas srid pa ho'i bris thang gi rgyab yig klog zin pa dang rta bzhon nas lag g.yas pas srid pa ho'i rten mdung thogs te chibs rag gi dang por thon/ de nas rta dar ba rnams dang / gar pa'i rdar ma dang / sur ṇa sogs rol cha ba/ rgyab cha ba rtse phyag jo lags/ gser dam gdan zhu ba/chibs dpon chen mo ba shod drung gnyis nas na bza' gdan zhu rta ti 'bi cag 'khrid/ gzhan yang shod skor drung dkyus dang / las tshan pa/ sras rnam pa/rim bzhi/ mda' dpon/ rtsis dpon/ phogs dpon/ tha'i ji/ dza sagazhabs pad rnam pa/ srid blon bcas shod skor rnams phebs byams kyi mdun phyogs su sngon bskyod dang / dbus dkyil du phebs byams chen mo dbu thod rgya phibs gser gyi tog can dang / gzhi mdzod gos ser po/ hor sangs ser po'i nang yol/ shel yol stong skud ser po'i dra ba dra phyed stong sbod 'dzar ldan nang yang srid nyid mdzod gos ser po'i jo zhwa dang / mdzod gos ser po'i na bza' bsnabs bzhes kyis bzhugs shing / phebs byams pa zhwa mo tung ma'o tse ser por rgod sgro'i tog dang / gyon pa mdzod gos ser po'i la shag steng gos chen dpal g.yu ma zing dmar gyi sgog tse/ gru tse dkar ljang gi shan tse nyis brtsegs/ krang ton rgya dmar gyi dor khug lham spu ma nag po'i shol tse/ gser gyi rna rgyan mu tig sog byil/ gyon pa'i rgyab mdun dang g.yas g.yon gyen brjes sked par gzer zhing / glo 'dog byu ru'i phreng ba dang / gru tse tshos tshogs kyi kha 'phyis bcas zhe mtshungs kyi chas gos spras pa'i pho gzhon mi grangs nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas brje len cha gsum du dbye ste pho gzhon brgyad re'i phrag steng btegs shing byams 'then pa gyon pa mdzod gos sngon po'i la shag dang / zhwa mo lcags mda' phru tog can/ rna rgyan gser gyi mu tig sog byil/67

lham 'ja' chen rgya mug gyon pa'i dmag gi 'go khrid pa ru dpon gnyis dang /brgya dpon bzhi/ gyon pa 'go snam ljang khu'i la shag dang / zhwa mo sog zhwa/ rna rgyan gser gyi mu tig sog byil/ lham spu ma nag po'i shol tse gyon pa'i dmag mi'i lding dpon nyi shu rtsa bzhi bcas kyis sra thag sbom po gos chen ser po'i phyi btums can phebs byams g.yas g.yon gyi phebs mdar btags pa dpung steng lag pas 'jus 'then gyis phebs byams dge rgan gyis 'gro sdod dal mgyogs sogs kyi skad brda dang bstun nas dang po dge rgan gyis gdangs dbyangs ring pos ‘‘dpung btegs ’mizhes brjod pa dang skad len pas kyang ‘‘dpung btegs ’ zhes brjod de phrag par bkal/ de nas ‘‘'gro ’’zhes skad gsang mthon pos bsgrags pa dang gsham gyi skad len pas kyang ‘‘'gro ’’zhes brjod ma thag gom gral 'grigs la gzugs po 'drong zhing rkang lag gi stangs stabs mdzes par bskyod/ phebs byams g.yas g.yon gnyis su phebs byams 'go pa gnyis dang / rgyab bca' ba rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi sku zhabs gzugs stobs che ba gnyis lag tu gri ring thogs te rkang thang du phebs/ rgyal tshab rin po che'i mgyogs byams pa tsho'i gyon pa 'go snam ljang khu dang / zhwa mo sog zhwa red/ sku sger dza sag gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum gyi bla sprul mkhan po dang / gzhung zhabs dza tā/ dar rgan/ mkhan chen/ mkhan chung / las tshan che chung / rtse drung dkyus ma/ drung gtogs bcas rtse skor chibs rag dang phebs byams g.yon phyogs su rtse mkhan mgron che ba/ chibs rag g.yas g.yon gyi zur du rtse gzim 'gag rnams dang / rtse mgron rnams kyis chibs gral la blta rtog byed pa dang / mi dmangs la lta rtog 'tshang bshang byed pa bcas chibs rag brgya phrag kha shas kyi dbus su phebs te lha sa grong khyer gyi sne zin pa dang / ser sbreng / bro gzhas sogs kyi phebs bsu 'dod rgu thang du zhus pa nang bzhin dang / lha sa gtsug lag khang gi chos srung bya khri ba (karma 68

shar )rten gzhir khog brlams tshul gyis grong khyer shar phyogs phyag 'tshal sgang du phebs bsur bcar/ bar skor lho phyogs gsung chos rwar phebs 'byor skabs gnas chung chos skyong rten gzhir khog brlams tshul gyis phebs bsur bcar/ chos skyong nyid nas yang sha dod pos phebs byams dge rgan gyi tshab tu 'dzul nas gang 'tshams bar gdan zhu byas/ khyams rwa'i sgo 'phyor 'og phebs byams las bshol te gtsug lag khang du gnas gzigs su phebs/gus rang phebs byams zhabs zhu rnying par song bas gdan zhu'i khong 'gro ma dgos pa'i dgongs zhus chog kyang / de skabs dgongs pa ma zhus par khas len zhus te phyin/ phebs byams pa ni lus sems dka' ngal dang nyen 'gan ha cang che stabs gdan zhur ma thon gong sngar gyi goms srol bzhin sger gyi zhabs rim 'bad sgrub dang / chos srung khag la 'phrin bcol/ gtsug lag khang dang / rwa mo che/ rtse pho brang bcas la mchod mjal gyis sri zhu gegs med lam lhongs yong ba'i smon lam 'debs pa sogs byas/ rang nyid rnam kun nas phebs byams zhabs zhur sbyang brtson cher bskyed kyis rang gi sdod gnas phyag mdzod gling khar zhogs pa snga langs byas te shing gdung ma phrag steng 'khyer nas gling kha'i nang rang 'gul gyis sbyong brdar rngul chu thig thig byed pa dang /dgong dro las khungs grol 'phral khyim du shar bskyod kyis gong bzhin sbyong brdar dus rtag tu byas par brten gom bgrod bde la dbugs thag ring ba dang lus kyi rnam 'gyur sogs phebs byams pa'i yang rtser son pa zhig yin pa phyi nang gang sar gleng grags che ba byung /spyi lo 1939zla 12nang tā la'i bla ma khri phebs kyi mdzad sgor go min tang bod sog las khungs kyi spyi khyab wu'u u yon krang dang / rgya dpon zi lon ngo 'khor rgya gar brgyud lha sar 'byor bar sa gnas srid gzhung gi bkod sgrig ltar gra bzhi dmag sgar gyi 'go dmag rnams kyis ru sgrig gus btud zhus pa 69

dang / wu'u u yon krang ngo 'khor sdod yul zas zhim pa'i khang par phebs sgrig thog phebs bsu'i gsol ston gshoms skabs sne len zhabs zhu'i khongs nga rang phyag nang lha dbang tshe ring yang bskyod dgos byung / spyi lo 1940rang lo nyer lnga/ lcags 'brug lo khyim 'dzin bsod nams dbyangs can la bu mo gnyis pa tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms (deng sang bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par khang gi yig bsgyur ba )skyes/

lnga/ gting skyes 'bras sgrub pa'i las 'gan 'khur ba'i skor sogs/spyi lo 1941rang lo nyer drug lcags sbrul lo phran lha dbang tshe ring la gting skyes 'bras sgrub pa sngon ma'i phogs lam bzhin lo lnga'i ring las 'dzin bsko bzhag byas don ltar chu rta nas las sgo rtsis len byed dgos par brten las sgo'i tshong tshwa lha rtse dang / bzhad/ rta nag gdong dkar/ shangs nang khul bcas nas nyo sgrub byed mi tshwa sgrub las byed khag bsko gtong byed lam dang / phran gyi las rgyun lo lnga'i ring lha rtse tshwa sgrub pa'i thad lha rtse mi ser 'du spyir bka' shag nas bsko gzhag byas don ltar byed sgo'i skad cha byed par sa gnas lha rtser bskyod de byed sgo zin 'phral lha sar phyir log byas/ spyi lo 1943rang lo nyer bdun/ chu rta lo gting skyes 'bras sgrub pa rtsis len du skyod skabs skyabs rje pha bong kha'i bkas slob ltar yar lam rong byams chen dang /dben dgon/ ser mdog can/ bkra shis lhun po/ zhwa lu/ byang chen sgang ri/ snar thang / gangs chen chos 'phel sogs dgon khag la mjal mchod dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen 'gyed 'bul lam zhus/ de lor zar 'bras khang du sdod skabs bsod dbyangs la bu 'bring bstan 'dzin phun tshogs skyes/'di lo 'bras khang thog mar song gshis gang ci'i rgyus mnga' med khar/'bras khang rnying pa phyag nang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las lags dgung lo bgres la myong goms che yang / gang cir gnod skyon yong gzhi kho na bzo ba ma zad/71

gting skyes mi ser dang phran gyi dbar la sel 'jug gis mi mthun pa'i gleng slong mang tsam byung rung / rang ngos nas rgan gzhon babs kyi gus zhabs dang / bka' slob rogs ram yong re'i dman sa bzung ste 'gro bzo sdod mkhas gang yong zhus pa'i 'bras bur rjes sor zhi mthun la gnas thub pa byung /'bras khang rnying par tshwa lhag 'bor chen bsdad pa nang nyo bya rgyur rin gong mtho po brgyab par brten gang 'tshams las nyo stabs ma 'grig pa de yang tshong ya wa lung pa sogs la lo rjes mar 'bras len rgyur bun gtong byed rgyu tsam las/chu rta lo'i tshong rwa 'bras khang rnying pas tshong be+ed spyad de 'bras 'bab phal che ba 'bras khang rnying pas lnga lo'i tshwa rin yin zhes g.yo 'phrul gyis nyo sgrub byas nas phran gyi gzhung 'bul 'bras dos 'bul 'bab kyang 'bras khang rnying pa rang la g.yar nas 'bul dgos byung / gor bod kyi mi zar tshong rwar 'byor skabs rgyab bsher byed lam yang wa lung 'go pa'i bu pa sangs nas de sngon thengs gcig rgyab bsher ma byas pa dang / da lam yang rgyab bsher ma zhus par 'byor pa shes tsher byung bas slar mig ltos la phan ched ngas g.yog po grwa shar go thang btang ste wa lung 'go pa'i bu der mkhu mtshur gyis nyes rdung drag po zhig gtong du 'jug dgos byung / chu lug 1943lor zar las sgor rong phyogs nas 'bras 'khyer yong mkhan tshong chung re zung ma gtogs/ tshong pa che 'bring phal che ba'i 'bras rnams 'bras khang rnying pas tshwa sngon sprad zin pa'i rin 'bras yin lugs kyis khong tshor rin gong rnam kun tshad gzhi las cung drag par nyo tshong byas par brten las sgo'i gzhung 'bab bogs ma phran nas 'bul dgos gshis/ tshong 'bab bed spyod 'bras sgrub rnying pas btang na 'grig min zhes 'phros mol byas par sngar 'bras khang rim can gyis bun bsdu las 'jug byed srol bzhin yin lugs nyag rkyang bshad byung bas 'khrug rtsod yong rgyu las ma 'das kyang / gun med pos 'khur zer ba'i dpe bzhin rang 72

nas sdug 'khur gyis mtha' don slar yang chu lug lo 'di'i nang 'bras 'bab bsdu len byas 'thus kyi khas len byed dgos byung / shing bya/ rang lo sum cu (1945)lo bkra shis lhun po'i rgya rje drung rin po che'i zhal snga nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dang / paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung 'bum pod lnga dang / brgyad stong pa bcas kyi ljags lung thob/ de lo khyim 'dzin bsod nams dbyangs can la bu gzhon pa skal bzang rdo rje gzhis rtser skyes/ me khyi 1946lo gus tsho'i pha gzhis stod lung rgyal stag gzhis dang /gzhis lag skyong ba bcas dza sag ngag dbang rgyal mtshan nas thab rten la gsol ras yong ba'i snyan zhu phul lugs go thos byung ba bzhin lha sar ched bskyod byas par g.yo snyan nges tan phul 'dug cing / gus tsho'i pha gzhis thad pha mes nas zhabs 'degs legs grub byung ba'i bzos sgor mi mus rgyud bcas la ji srid bar kha 'dzin gtan 'jags su stsal ba'i bka' gtan tshigs zhal gsal btsan dmigs che ba yod pa spyan zhur phul ba dang 'brel bka' shag mtshan 'khod kyi snyan zhu phul kyang / lo gcig song mtshams gus tsho'i pha gzhis stod lung rgyal stag gzhis dang / skyong pa/ rta pa sgo brgyad ces pa'i rjes 'jug gi pha gzhis stod lung brag phug gzhis dang / le lag thang skya mdun pa bcas pha gzhis khag bzhi dza sag ngag dbang rgyal mtshan la kha 'dzin gtan 'jags gnang bas ma tshad/ gus tsho'i pha gzhis rgyal stag pa'i ming thogadza sag ngag rgyal mi mus rgyud bcas la shod skor zhabs sdod zhus 'thus 'khod 'dug pa/ skabs der srid kyi dbang 'dzin pa gtso bo rgyal tshab stag brag dang / srid blon yab gzhis glang mdun/ bka' blon bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen/ bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs/ phun khang bkra shis rdo rje/ ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma/gyi stag brag phyag mdzod chen mo bcas kyis srid dbang 'dzin pa'i skabs su 'khelasmozhing / de'i dus su bod sa gnas 73

srid gzhung de nyid ming tsam ma gtogs las don che phra rgyu brngan rjes 'brang gi dbang du song ste bden pa yod mkhan la gyong gun phog rgyu kho na las mi 'da' ba'i skabs yin pas/ de sngon pe cin du bod kyi don gcod sku tshab mkhan mgron lo gsum zhes rtse drung gsum gtong srol khongs ngag dbang rgyal mtshan rtse drung dkyus ma lo tsā ba'i ming 'khur gyis bskyod thog pe cin du sdod yun ring phog sa dang / tshong khe sogs gang legs byung ste 'byor phyug tu gyur par brten bla dpon rnams kyis rgyu brngan rjes 'brang gis gus tsho'i bka' gtan rnams la brtsi med rdog rol ‘‘yig nag chu bshal ’’zhes pa kha rgyun du shod pa bzhin nga tshos mngon sum nyams su myang ste gnam gyis sa brdungs pa lta bur g.yo zhu ngan mthun gyis btsan 'phrog byas pa blo pham bzhin du sdug 'khur bya dgos byung / sa khang rtsis sprod ston dus su yin yang gting skyes 'bras sgrub pa'i las 'gan rgya che yod stabs gtam ngan la song rung / sa zhing thon skor gyi rin 'bab sprod len bya rgyur gnyis mos byung don bzhin sa zhing sngo thog la tsis sprad pa'i 'bru rin dang / mdzo phyugs ra lug so nam yo byad sogs kyang yul thang rin 'bebs tshad ldan byas te nyo 'tshong bgyis pa'i rin dngul rnams sprod thengs gnyis la dus thog grangs tshang sprod len bya rgyu'i 'dzin yig yod kyang / dngul 'bab dus thog tu ma sprad par thengs mang 'gro dgos byung ste dka' bsun che khar/ dngul 'bab sdeb sprod ma byas par nyung shas rim sprod kho nas dngul rnams rten dmigs 'di yin ston rgyu med par 'thor gyar du phyin song /me phag (1947)lo phyi lo sa byi (1948)lo nas bzung gting skyes zar 'bras khang gzhung 'dzin gnang rgyu'i mi 'gro jo lags gnyis re bsko gzhag byas te las rgyun lo gsum re bya rgyur gsar pa ya gcig phyag nang o rgyan rig 'dzin dang / ya gcig rgyus babs kyis khyod rang la bsko gzhag gnang song na 74

ma dngul sogs zhu sgo'i skor la (lha sar )'phral 'byor dgos rgyu zhes bla phyag las khungs kyi bka' rgya zhig btang 'byor bzhin lha sar bcar/ sger gyi las mjug bsdu rgyu tshong 'khos kyi snying po gal cher brten gzhung sger gnyis lcogs bya rgyu 'grigs min gyis gting skyes 'bras sgrub gzhung 'dzin mi 'gro zhu ma dgos pa zhes dgongs pa zhus kyang dgongs 'phrol rtsa ba nyid nas yong gi ma red ces bshad stabs dang len mi byed thabs med byung zhing / sngar srol mna' gan bzhes 'bul sogs byed sgo rnams jo lags o rgyan rig 'dzin dang / phran gnyis thun mong nas bgyis te gting skyes su thon/ sngar 'bras khang gzhung 'dzin skabs mi 'gro so so'i sger shag tu lhan 'dzoms las ka byed srol 'dug kyang / gzhung sger mnyam 'dres lta bu'i las ka ni gtam don gnyis gnod yong gzhir bsams nas lhan khang las khungs tshugs yul sogs zur du khe gtsang bzos te nyin ltar las khungs tshugs grol thog khang khungs so sor gzhung srol sgo zam sgo lcags dang / la cha'i thel tse brgyab pa sogs gzhung srol 'gan gtsang bsgrubs/ gus rang gzhung 'dzin las 'khur bya rgyu las 'gan lci la sems 'khur shugs bskyed mi zhu thabs med la song sger gyi las mjug byed sgo rnams khyim 'dzin ma dang / g.yog por rkang 'gan 'khur bcug pa dang gzhung sger dbar dam gtsang yong ched sger gyi 'bras len rgyu yod rigs kyi gan rgya ngo ma khag lhan rgyas khang du spyan zhu dang 'brel tho 'god zhus/ de sngon nga rang 'bras sgrub gsar pa'i skabs 'bras khang rnying pas lo gnyis kyi ring 'bras 'tshong rgyag srol skor yig lam yod pa ltar byas 'thus chog kyang / sger gyi 'bras 'bab yong bsdad rnams lo dang po'i nang mjug sdom bya rgyur khas len zhus pa bcas lo gsum 1947dang / 1948lo nas 1949lo'i ring gzhung 'dzin tshong byus lam lhong gang legs kyis gzhung 'bab gzengs thon 'bul lam zhus/ sa glang (1949)lo rta nag sger shud khud pas 75

tshwa dos bkag skor sa gnas gzhis rtse spyi rdzong tha'i ji zur phud pa dang /mkhan chung thon pa gnyis la lugs mthun snyan seng zhus kyang rgyu brngan rjes 'brang gis gzhung gun gnod rkyen yong gzhir brten bka' shag tu snyan seng zhu bar phran lha dbang tshe ring lha sar ched bskyod kyis gzhung gi tshwa dos khrims 'gal byed gte shud khud pa bka' 'gugs yong ba zhes bka' shag tu snyan seng dang 'brel zhu shog phul/ skabs der lha sar go min tang gi gsang myul ba yin tshul gyi rgya rigs mi grangs lnga bcu skor zhig sa gnas srid gzhung nas rgya gar brgyud phyir 'bud byed pa'i dus skabs dang 'khel zhing / nga tsho bla phyag jo lags rnams dbyar mjal thugs spro tshugs te nyin dgung gsol tshigs dang / gsol rgyab mchod chang btegs zin tsam la bka' shag bka' 'brel gal che'i las don gyi ched jo lags mi grangs bcu gsum da lta bde zhib las khungs su yong dgos zhes brda tho 'byor 'dug par/ phyag drung gis jo lags gzhon pa mang che ba chang gis bzi 'dug da res gal che yin 'dug pas khyod rang yang 'gro dgos zhes bshad don ltar nga tsho mi bcu gsum bde zhib las khungs su bskyod pa yin/bde zhib las khungs spug ma'i nang dmag spyi dza sag mdo mkhar ba dang /mkhan drung 'bum thang pa chos 'phel thub bstan/ rtsis dpon rnam gling pa bcas 'dzoms 'dug las khungs mdor rtse drung dang / shod drung / phyag nang / gnyer nang bcas mi grangs lnga bcu skor dang / gzhan yang mi dmangs gang 'tshams bcas bsdu bskong byas 'dug mi dmangs de tsho ni so nyul dogs gzhi yod rigs kyi gnas tshang dang / khang gnyer yin 'dugadagong dro'i chu tshod lnga pa tsam la ming tho shog lho dang sbrags pa khul so sor phyogs bgos kyis btang don ltar rtse drung grags pa yar rgyas dang / shod drung byang ngos pa/ gus pa phyag nang lha dbang tshe ring / grwa bzhi dmag mi go mtshon 76

thogs pa mi bcu tham pa bcas lha sar bar bskor lho phyogs mtsho sgo ba'i nub mtsho sna 'bras khang rnying pa'i nang sdod pa rgya rigs bsod nams rin chen dang /kra'u shan san zhes pa'i sar khang gnyer mnyam khrid kyis phyin pa yin/ khong gnyis khang pa thog brtsegs gsum pa'i nang du bsdad 'dug nga tsho khang pa'i nye 'gram du slebs dus byang ngos pas nga tshos byed phyogs gang dge'i dgongs bzhes gnang dgos kyi 'dug ces bshad par/ gus pas dmag mi rnams smin drug nub kyi sgo rwa'i nang bzhag ste/ nga tsho thad skyod kyis bka' mol gnang rgyu dang gal srid khrims 'gal rtsing spyod 'dra byas tshe dmag mi rnams skad 'bod gnang na snyam pa'i bsam tshul bshad par de rang byas 'thus mos mthun byung don bzhin khong gnyis sar phran rang sngon tsam la bskyod/ ‘‘nga 'dir yong don ni/ deng lha sar go min tang dang / gung khran tang gi so nyul ba mang po yod 'dug pa de skor zhib mol mdzad po bde zhib las khungs nas gzhung zhabs gnyis khyed gnyis sar phebs kyi yod mirices bshad/ de rjes grags pa yar rgyas lags dang / byang ngos pa gnyis phebs 'byor gyis gnas lugs gsungs te bka' shag gi bka' don la ‘‘khyed gnyis nyin bcu bzhi nas ma 'gyangs par lha sa nas thon te rgya gar sa mtshams su 'gro dgos pa dang / phar lam rta 'ul dang / sdod sgrig yod pa ma zad/ lam rgyus pa mi gnyis gtong rgyu dang / bdun gnyis kyi ring khrom sogs la 'gro dus nga tsho dang khang gnyer mnyam bskyod bya rgyu ma zad/ khyod gnyis la gsang tar yo byad yod med sngog bsher bya rgyu yin ’ lugs gsungs te sgam dang / nyal 'jo sogs zhib bsher byas kyang gsang tar yo chas sogs thon rigs byung ma song /bde zhib las khungs nas nga tsho thun mong thog rgya rigs khong gnyis btang shor mi 'byung ba'i dam 'dzin dgos lugs bshad kyang / grags pa yar rgyas lags dang / byang ngos pa rnam gnyis las khungs su gnas lugs zhu bar 77

phebs rgyu yin tshul gyis de nas bzung phyir log phebs ma byung / phran ngo g.yog gnyis dang / khang gnyer ni nyin bcu bzhi ring nyin mtshan khor yug tu rgya rigs gnyis srung bya byed rgyu dang / khrom sogs la mnyam bskyod bya rgyu sogs dka' bsun che tsam byung yang rang 'gan lhod med bsgrub cing / phyir thon rgya rigs gzhan dag gi srung bya ba phal che bas 'gro mkhan tsho'i nang chas dngos po rin thang phyed rin tsam la nyo tshong byas yod tshod 'dug pa ltar/ nga tsho'i khongs kyi rgya rigs gnyis pos kyang 'dzin chas dngos po'i khongs nas khyed rang la mkho ba gang yod nyar 'thus rin 'bab ma dgos zer yang / nga la dgos mkho gang yang mi 'dug khyod gnyis kyi dngos po pham tshong ma shor ba byed dgos zhes bshad pa yin/ 'on kyang dngos po kha shas pham tshong byas tshar 'dug pa nyo mkhan tshor gnas lugs bshad de rin 'bab kha snon bskyar sprod byed du bcug lhag par du kra'u shan san la lag dngul ldeng nges mi 'dug pa rtag par ngu bzhin ya nga ba'i gnas la brten nga rang sger gyis khong la zhal 'debs dngul srang brgya tham pa ster ba yin/ khong gnyis thon khar nga la dga' zhen lhad med kyis mig chu lhung lhung du 'bab bzhin par lag pa dam por 'jus te ‘‘thugs rje che khyed nas nged gnyis la pha ma lta bu'i rogs ram gnang ba sems kyi gting nas brjed mi yong mgyogs po mjal yong mi’zhes zer yang khong gnyis bod la bskyar du slebs ma song / skabs der bod nas phyir bskrad mi grangs lnga bcu skor yod pa nas ngas shes pa 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal lags rjes su bcings 'grol dmag dang mnyam du bod la phebs 'byor gyis phun dbang pu'u krang zhes pu'u krang gi go ming dang las 'gan yang bzhes 'dugade nas shud khud pas tshwa dos bkag pa'i gyod don skor bka' shag tu zhabs bskul snyan seng zhus par zhib gcod phyi 'brel las khungs (〈de snga'i 78

bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid 'dzin sgrig gzhi 〉zhes pa'i nang phyi rgyal las khungs zhes 'khod yod )su bsko gzhag grub zin pas de gar bcar dgos zhes gsung don bzhin phyi 'brel las khungs kyi 'go 'dzin gtso bo dza sag sne'u shag thub bstan thar pa dang / phyag sbrel dza sag zur khang zur pa gnyis kyi lhan rgyas khang du bskyod de ‘‘byed gte shud khud gzhis sdod 'phral du bka' 'gugs gnang rogs 7zhes zhus/ de'i skabs brag ri rdo rje 'chang mchog nas brag ri ri khrod du gsung chos gnang rgyu yin lugs thos pas de gar bcar te lam rim myur lam dmar khrid dang / thugs rje chen po'i dbang chen/'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang dang zab 'khrid bcas legs par thob/ 'jigs byed dpa' gcig las bsnyen brag ri ri khrod du 'phral mar btang / de rjes sbyin bdag tsha rong mgron gnyer ju nang tshang nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin brag yer par brag ri rdo rje 'chang nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang bka' gdams thig le bcu drug sogs dbang chen khag bcu gcig dang / rjes gnang nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ gzhan yang ljags lung khag mang bcas zla gcig ring gnang ba cha tshang zhu thub pa byung bas shud khud pa'i byed bab de yang rkyen ngan grogs shar lta bu gang legs byung / gyod ya rta nag shud khud pa nas gzhung khral dos khal gtong mi dgos pa 'byung thabs kyi re ngan bcangs te mi bden brdzun bsgrig gi g.yo khram thabs shes yod rgu rtsal sprugs bton nas lha sar bcar 'byor la zhib gcod phyi 'brel las khungs nas gus nas phul ba'i zhu shog sgrog sbyang dang 'brel zhu lan dgos lugs brjod don bzhin/ shud khud pas 'bras khang g.yog pos spyi sger yongs la brdabs bsigs mnar gcod btang ba dang / lhag par mi ser them dud sum cu so drug la rta khal 'phar bskul za bed brdabs bsigs byung lugs 'khod pa'i mi ser rnams kyi thel 'byar zhu shog gcig dang chabs cig zhu lan phul 'dug 79

pas/ phyi las nas gus par sgrog sbyangs byas byung bar/ de lan gus pas gting skyes 'bras khang ngo las sus kyang za bed brdabs bsigs byas rigs gtan nas med nges lags na/ mi ser them dud so drug gi ngo ma so so bka' 'gugs dang 'brel re re bzhin gdong bsher ra sprod yong ba ’’zhes zhus/ de rjes shud khud pas mi ser them dud so drug gi 'thus mi lha 'byor dang mnyam du phyi las su bcar te gting skyes 'bras khang gi tshwa dos dka' ngal che tshul dang / g.yog pos brdabs bsigs btang tshul mang dag cig g.yo zhu byas stabs zhib spyod lhan khang nas phran la gsungs gsal/ ‘‘mi ser mang po 'di tsam gyis zhu babs la gzhigs na khyod tsho'i g.yog pos brdabs bsigs mnar gcod btang ba gzhir bcas pas drang bden gsal zhu dgos ’’lugs phebs par/ gus nas ‘‘shud khud pa'i ngan g.yo dpung sgrig spom tshig gi zhu dbang du ma song bar mi ser re re bzhin 'dri brtsad zhu bzhes gnang skyong yod pa dang / de bstun zhu lan 'gag med 'bul lam zhus chog ’mices zhus par/shud khud pas mi ser gcig bsgril gyi zhu shog sngon phul de gar cha 'jog yong ba zhes nan zhu byas kyang zhib gcod phyi las nas mi ser re re bzhin zhu ba bzhes skabs tshwa dos dka' ngal che lugs tsam las g.yog pos brdabs bsigs byung lugs zhu mkhan gcig kyang ma byung bar brten shud khud pas mi ser blu khrid g.yo zhus byas pa dngos ra 'phrod de zhib lhan nas mi ser rnams la ‘‘khyod tshos khrims 'gal gyis gzhung khral tshwa dos bskyel 'dren zhu sems bor te ngan mthun byed babs la gzhigs na do dam btson 'jug gis byed gte ther 'don khrims gcod byed 'os las ma 'das kyang / lung khug mi ser shes rmongs la bsam da lam thengs gcig ring yangs pa byas shing / slad gzhung sa'i bka' drin snying bcang gis 'khri khral le thogs med pa dgos rgyu ’’zhes bsgrags te khungs so sor phyir slog byas/ shud khud gzhis sdod par 80

‘‘gzhung sa'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i sger pa zhig nas gzhung bsam bor ba'i bya ngan tshabs cher brten do bdag ngo ma'i lus steng du rtsa ra gcod dgos pa 'dug rung da lam thengs gcig ring yangs bzos gang che'i nyes pa gser srang bco lnga bsgrub 'bul thog sa gnas su yod pa'i tshwa 'bab rnams gzhis rtser 'phral du bskyel 'dren zhu dgos pa dang / slad phyin sbug dam bka' rtsa rin po che'i dgongs don gzhung 'bab tshwa dos sngar bzhin bskyel 'dren dgos rgyu ’’zhes bka' dpyad btang ba bcas de ltar shud khud pa dang zlos rtsod kyis lha sar zla ba dgu tsam ring 'gor yang mtha' mar chu ngan lam shor ma song ba bzo thub pa byung /lcags stag (1950)lo lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i dngul rtsis khang gi yig 'bri sngar bzhin byas/ smon lam grol rjes gting skyes gzar las sgor thon bskyod kyis 'bras dos rim gtong las mjug byed sgo rnams sgrub mur lha sa phyogs nas yong ba'i mi zhig gis/ rtse phyag las khungs kyi stod khul gzhung tshong pa'i 'bras dos dpal dir 'byor pa rnams chu bzhi sgang drug jag dmag gis 'phrog 'khyer byas pa mig mthong byung bas 'bras dos gtong rgyu ngang 'then gnang ba legs lugs brjod byung ba dang / yang bal po'i mi khongs tshong pa rgya gar 'gro mkhan zhig gis go thos su tā la'i bla ma rgya gar rdo rje gling du phebs kyi yod lugs brjod pa/ yang kha shas kyis rgya gar rdo rje gling du phebs zin tshul shod pa sogs sbir gtam sna tshogs lhag gshis/ phyag sbrel jo lags lcang sbug o rgyan rig 'dzin lags dang gros mol gyis de skor yang snying ji yin rtsad gcod byed par mi do chod cig 'phral gtong gis gal te phebs kyi yod tshe nged gnyis ngo ma gcig phyag sne 'bul bar bcar gal che lugs bshad par/phyag sbrel gyis rgya gar du mi btang yang nyin nyi shu rtsa grangs 'gor nges/ de bas byang phug jo bo'i spyan sngar gzan brtag zhus na legs lugs gsungs pa 81

ltar de don tshes bzang stabs bstun gyis byang phug jo bo rin po che'i spyan sngar sna lnga'i brgya mchod 'bul gshom dang 'brel gzan brtag phul don la yid ches cha 'jog gis 'bras dos khag 'phral gtong byas pa dang / 'bras khang ngo g.yog rnams gzhis rtser thon bskyod kyis srad rin chen rtser slebs skabs gzhis rtse phyogs su rta chag brgyab ste tā la'i bla ma gro mor phebs kyi yod lugs zer/ de'i sang nyin snga tsam thon te gzhis rtser 'byor nas gnas tshul 'dri rtsad skabs rtsis dpon rnam sras gling pa dang las bya sbrag spyi pad+ma lags ngo 'khor gzhis rtse yab gzhis su phebs lugs zer don bzhin/ phyi nyin snga dro phyag sbrel o rgyan rig 'dzin nged gnyis rtsis dpon rnam gling pa'i sar bskyod cing / rtsis dpon rnam gling pas tā la'i bla ma snga 'phros gro mor phebs rgyu yin lugs dang gnangs nyin rgyal rtser phebs 'byor gnang rgyu yin lugs brjod byung bas/ nged gnyis nas ‘‘gus 'bras khang mi 'gro gnyis su rung gcig gro mor thugs mkho bzhes 'bras dang / phyag shog sogs dang phyag sne hin sgor lnga khri tsam zhig 'bul bar bcar na snyam par ji dge'i bka' slob yod pa ’’zhes brjod par/ rnam gling pas ‘‘de don gang legs yong rgyur rta khal ji dgos bka' tham phran la yod gshis lam yig sprad chog ’’zer don/ bzhes 'bras stang 108dang / shog bu dang mog ro sogs tsag tsig do 10bcas la khal ma 59rta 'ul bzhi bcas kyi lam yig sprad byung bas/ de dag skyel bar phyag sbrel nged gnyis mol bsdur gyis phyag sbrel gting skyes gzar du bskyod nas thugs mkho rnams bsnams te gro mor bskyod rgyu byas don/ gro mo dung dkar dgon bzhugs sgar du ‘‘gus gting skyes 'bras khang gzhung 'dzin mi 'gro gnyis su rung gcig ring min thugs mkho 'bul lam zhu bar bcar chog ’’ces pa'i snyan zhu btang yang / de rjes bkras lhun dza sag bla ma rong dpal lhun tar khang thub bstan chos ldan lags nas gsungs gsal gro mo chu 'bi pho brang srid 82

zhi dge legs su phebs rgyu gtan 'khel lugs gsungs kyang / gus gnyis kyi snyan zhu sngon phul zin pa de gro mor 'byor nyin bzhugs sgar chu 'bi dung dkar dgon par spo ba'i nyin der 'khel 'dug phyag sbrel lcang sbug jo lags gting skyes gzar las sgor phyir 'khor gyi gnas 'phrin 'byor gsal bzhin las mjug gang myur bsdu phyir phran lha dbang tshe ring yang gzar las sgor bskyod/ phyag sbrel o rgyan rig 'dzin lags gro mor thugs mkho phul ba rnams la sbug dam 'byar ma'i 'byor 'dzin zhig sprad 'dug de nas gzhung 'dzin las mjug sdom ste phyag sbrel lcang sbug gzhis rtser thon/ phran sger gyi las mjug bya rgyur zla gcig lhag tsam 'gor/ 1951lo'i zla dang por gting skyes 'brasakhang gi las mjug bsgril te tshur lam sa skya dgon pa sogs la mchod mjal dang bcas gzhis rtser 'byor rjes/ phyag sbrel phyag nang o rgyan rig 'dzin lags gzhis rtser sngon phebs bzhugs mus yin gshis khong gis gting skyes 'bras sgrub pa'i rtsis khra lha sar slebs nas 'god bris byas 'thus gsungs/ lha sar las brel che bas rtsis khra 'di gar bkod na legs lugs zhus te khong rang bzhugs yul du zla ba kha shas ring lhan tshogs kyis gting skyes 'bras khang gzhung 'dzin lo gsum gyi rtsis khra kha gsal khams dwangs zhib 'godakhyas te lha sar 'byor 'phral rtsis zhu byas chog chog bzos/ bkra shis lhun po'i rnam rgyal lha khang gi rten gtso rje yab sras gsum gyi spyan sngar ltung bshags dang 'brel ba'i phyag 'bul 'go 'dzugs byas te kha skong dang bcas bsags par zla ba drug tsam 'gor/lcags yos (1951)lor khyim 'dzin bsod nams dbyangs can la bu chung shos tshe brtan dge legs skyes/ gzhis rtse khul gyi las mjug bsdu rgyur 'bad/ lha sar phyir log ma byas gong bkra shis lhun po dang / zhwa lu/ snar thang / gangs can chos 'phel/ byang chen sgang ri sogs dgon khag la gnas 83

mjal rdu nang mi bu phrug ngo g.yog tshang ma mnyam bskyod byas/chu 'brug (1952)lor gting skyes 'bras khang gi las mjug gtsang bsgril gyis gzhis rtse nas lha sar phyir log skabs mar lam dben dgon dang /rong rin spungs byams chen sogs la mchod mjal dang dge 'dun la mang 'gyed phul/ lha sar 'byor nas lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang / ra mo che/ po ta la/ se 'bras dga' gsum/ rgyud grwa stod smad bcas la mjal mchod dang bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed phul/ de nas bla phyag las khungs su phyin te gting skyes 'bras khang gzhung 'dzin lo gsum byed ring gi rtsis khra phul bar sngar phan gzhung 'dzin mi 'gro rim byung gi nang nas gzhung 'bab che shos byung yod pa ma zad/ las don gang ci tshags tshud kyi rtsis khra khams dwangs 'phral 'bul zhu thub pa bcas byung bar mi 'gro nged gnyis so sor gzengs bstod kyi bya dga' kha btags a she re dang / gos chen phyu pa gyon ldeng re/ nā gru dkar po stod ldeng re/ ja sgam re/ mar ltang re/ 'bras ltang re bcas las khungs ngo las lhan tshogs sar sprad byung ba ma zad/ de snga gting skyes 'bras sgrub pa sger 'dzin lo lnga byas pa'i gzhung 'bab dang / bogs ma lo ltar chad med gtsang 'bul zhus par gtsang 'dzin las dam 'byar ma zhig kyang sprad byung /chu sbrul (1953)lo yongs 'dzin khri byang nas me ru grwa tshang 'du khang du yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dang / zab 'khrid cha tshang thob par las bsnyen 'bum bzhi gtong dgos dam bca'i don ltar brag ri ri khrod du las bsnyen 'bum gcig 'phral gtong byas/ de rjes lho gnas mjal bar dgongs pa zhus par lho kha khul gyi gar khral 'ded rgyu zhor lcogs dgos lugs ltar byed dgos byung / phran bza' 'tsho dang / bu phrug rgan gzhon drug bu rdzi gcig pho g.yog gnyis bcas 'khrid de sbrag la brgyud bskyod nas brag yang rdzong dang / rdzong sku 'bum/ zung mkhar/ bsam yas/ has po ri/84

mchims phu/ glo mchod rten bkra shis 'od 'bar/ 'on mda' mnga' ris grwa tshang / gdan sa mthil/ zangs ri mkhar dmar/ de nas kha btags la brgyud 'ol dga' rdzong gi byams pa dang / rdzing phyi dgon pa/ chos lung / chu bzang / bsam gling / nyi ma gling / rgyas sog lha sding / byams pa gling /rin chen sgang / de nas la lung nang nas slong la brgyud chos 'khor rgyal me tog thang du bskyod cing / rgyal gtsug lag khang dang / shar phyogs rgyal mtshan dkar dmar sogs zhib mjal thog lam rgyus 'khrid de chos 'khor rgyal lha mo'i bla mtsho mjal bar bskyod pa dang / de nas slong la brgyud 'ol dgar phyir log byas rjes nya mgo gru brgyud rtsed thang du 'byor zhing / rtsed thang dga' chos grwa tshang sogs dgon khag che chung khag dang yar klung rten gsum gnas gsum rnams mjal bskyod kyis dgon pa che khag la brgya mchod dang / de byings la spos me sogs kyi mchod 'bul dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed sogs 'khos bstun blos bcad kyis dad 'bul zhus/ de nas bza' zla'i spun mched sbrag bya tshang dgon pa zhes pa'i zhing pa zhig yod pa der bskyod de gnas 'khor bca' bzhag bdun phrag gnyis ring spro skyid btang ste lhod sdod byas/ de nas sbrag la brgyud lha sar phyir log thog de sngon gus tsho'i pha gzhis btsan 'phrog byung skor bka' shag tu snyan zhus kyis zhib dpyod pa mkhan drung ngag dbang don grub dang / rtsis dpon shud khud pa gnyis bsko bzhag byas kyang khong gnyis nas ya yol kho na las gyod gzhi bdag sprod byas ma byung / 85

drug mes rgyal nang saratā la bcu bzhi pa'i chibs zhabs su bskyod skor sogs/shing rta (1954)lo phran bla phyag khongs kyi phyogs 'gro yangs pa can she dpon res 'khor 'khel bas 'gro grabs phal cher zin te 'gro chog ang bsar byed bzhin skabs su tā la'i bla ma krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes nas lo lnga 'khor ba'i rten 'brel dang / rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs 'du chen mor phebs rgyu'i chibs zhabs gras su byes phyag mdzod khang gi las byar jo lags gsum 'gro dgos khongs phran la drung tshab bsko gzhag dang 'brel ming 'don byas 'dug kyang / phran rang jo lags phyag nang gi las 'khur rjes 'brel thugs spro khag mang gtong dgos sogs kyi 'gro gron mang dag btang zin khar/ bu phrug mang po gso skyong bya rgyus rkyen pas dngul bun che tsam chags pa'i sprod rten dang / mi tshe'i 'tsho rten gyi dmigs sgo phyogs 'gro yangs can she dpon res 'khor la brten chibs zhabs khongs bcar ma dgos pa zhes dgongs zhu'i snyan seng zhus par ‘‘da lam chibs zhabs su zhabs pad nas bzung bsko gzhag grub pa rnams sus kyang dgongs zhu ka kor mi chog pa bod ljongs tshogs 'du chen mos bka' khyab gnang song ba dgongs 'khrol yong thabs med cing / da lam chibs zhabs su 'gro 'dod yod pa'i jo lags mang po yod kyang / khyod rang drag 'dems kyis bsko gzhag byas shing / khyod rang sger gyi gnas tshul dngos 'brel la brten phyogs 'gro'i 86

thad sngar phan bogs gtong mi chog kyang / da res dmigs bsal gyi ngo tshab gtong ngam bogs gtong ji byed 'dod blo bzhin byas 'thus ’mizhes nan brjod la brten de don bcar rgyur khas len mi bya thabs med kyis phyag mdzod chen mo dza sag sne'u shag thub bstan thar pa dang / de 'og rtse phyag mkhan chung smon grub spug bla phyag rim bzhi sman stod sras bcas phyag mdzod ngo ma gsum dang /las byar phogs dpon pha lha sras dang / chang khyim mkhan chung / sku srung ru dpon shod drung las tshan sreg shing pa/ rtse drung blo bzang chos grags/ rtse phyag nang byams pa bkra shis dang / tshe brtan dpal 'byor/ bla phyag phyag nang gus pa lha dbang tshe ring dang / bsod nams dpal 'byor/ blo bzang sbyin pa bcas phyag mdzod ngo las rnams gtsug lag khang yang steng kun gsal gzim chung 'gag tu lhan tshogs kyis rten chas dang / phyag rtags/ gzhan yang gang ci'i thugs mkho rnams 'char gzhi 'god 'bul dang 'brel gra sgrig byed sgo khag la 'bad/shing rta (1954)lo'i zla lnga pa'i nang tā la'i bla ma ston 'khor po ta la nas thon skyod kyis lha gdong shan kha'i lho phyogs nas ston 'khor hrag bsdus khebs ṭor gsum dang / sku srung 'go dmag 'jib 'khor/ chibs zhabs spyi byings rta thog tu bskyod nas dga' ldan du phebs/ dga' ldan du nyin gsum bzhugs nas mal gro dwags po dgon dang / rin chen gling dgon/ rmang bde skyid thang / rgya mda' bcas so sor bzhugs bzhag re/ rgya mdar phebs 'byor dgong dro chibs zhabs rnams tshogs 'du 'tshog nas phebs phyogs skor spo bo brgyud phebs thag thung na'ang phebs lam nyerna kha che zhing / byang lam nas gdan zhu gnang dgos zhes krung dbyang sku tshab lhan bcar krang cin wu'u la snyan seng phul bar/ krang cin wu'u yis phebs lam lam bzo mi mang po ched btsugs kyis skyon med yong rgyur byang lam du phebs rgyu 'grigs min 87

gsungs/ spo bo nang ri gzar 'bab chu che ba sogs nyen 'gan ci cher brten byang lam rang la gdan zhu chog pa zhes nan zhu mdzad par/ krang cin wus ‘‘tā la'i bla ma dang / tshogs 'dur phebs dgos mkhan mi 'ga' shas rnams shad phebs ma mdzad tshe tshogs 'du'i dus tshod gong la phebs mi thub stabs nyes skyon mi 'byung ba'i 'gan srung ngos rang nas chog rgyur spo bo brgyud gdan zhu zhu rgyu yin/ khyod tsho gzhan rnams lhan bcar zhu dang mi zhu 'dod 'dems chog rgyu ’’zhes gsungs pas spo bo brgyud phebs rgyu gtan 'khel byas don ltar rgya mda' nas bzung spo bo thang stod bar chibs thog phebs/ lha sa nas nyin nyi shu rtsa gnyis song mtshams spo bo thang stod la phebs/ spo bo nang g.yang gzar che la ri mtho ba 'dzeg babs mang po dgos khar/ char zhod che rkyen shwa 'od kyis 'dag ma'i ri bo nyil ba dang / brag rdo che ba g.yag gzugs tsam nas chung ba mi mgo tsam mang po rbab 'gril sogs dngangs tshab shin tu che ba'i mur brgal sgrol zin na'ang / sa bab dza drag gi snang tshul yid yul du 'char skabs 'jigs dngangs skye dgos pa byung / ston 'khor skye bo mang po dang /bzhon 'gel rta drel ha cang mang po yod pa dang / kun bde gling bla brang gcig pu nas gzhung gi thugs mkho 'gel khal dang blangs kyi dre'u brgya dang nyi shu tham pa dang / drel pa rang 'grigs mi rta'i 'gro gron gyi rgyags phye sogs rang 'khur gyis phebs skyel zhus khongs nas phyag mdzod khang gi snam bu rgyab gcig dang dre'u rang 'grigs gtsang chur lhungs pa dang / drel pas skyob sar bskyod skabs drel pa'ang rgyab 'khyer me mda' rang 'grigs chur lhung nas shi ba las/ de min lam phrang dog la shwa 'od mang po de 'dra'i khrod du ston 'khor mi zog gang la yang nyes skyon byung med/ spo bo thang stod du phebs skabs nang sa nas phyir phebs bka' blon mdo mkhar ba dang / mkhan chung dga' brang ba sku 'khor rnams kyis mjal bcar zhus/ dga' brang mkhan chung la bka' 88

blon las tshab bsko gzhag gnang don che 'don gsar mjal zhus/ chibs zhabs rnams kyis dga' brang la bkra shis bde legs kyi kha btags g.yogs/thang stod nas ston 'khor yongs rdzogs phebs ṭo che chung sna tshogs nang zhugs te spo bo spra rmog bzhugs zhag sar ser byes dge bshes lha rams pa ang dang po blo bzang dbang phyug la ser byes mkhan po bsko gzhag gnang bas gsar mjal zhus/ de nas tsha ba grong gsar dang / tsha ba spom mda'/ brag g.yab dkyil khang bcas brgyud chab mdor 'byor/ chab mdor 'byor kha'i nyin lam gcig tsam gyi bar lam g.yas g.yon brag ldebs sogs la krung dbyang sku tshab krang cin wu'u dang / tā la'i bla ma lhan rgyas la gus 'dud kyis dga' bsu zhu ba'i sbyar tshig bod yig dang rgya yig gnyis ka mang po sbyar 'dug chab mdor bzhugs pa'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi dmag dpon wang chi me'e nas dga' bsu'i phebs sgrig gang legs zhus gnang 'dug pa ma zad/tshogs khang nang phebs bsu'i mdzad sgo'i skabs wang chi me'e nas thog mar gsung bshad gnang zhing / khong gis tā la'i bla ma rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs 'dur phebs rgyur bkra shis bde legs dang / phebs lam bde bgrod yong ba'i smon 'dun zhus/ de nas chab mdo nas phebs thon gyis lam bar dgon khag mang pos phebs bsu'i ser sbreng sogs phebs sgrig gang legs zhes 'dug kyang / tshogs 'du chen mo'i dus tshod gtugs par brten phebs bsu'i dbu gur so sor khyug phebs tsam las chos 'brel sogs gnang khom ma gyur par sde dge dang / tre+e bo/ li thang / dar rtse mdo bcas brgyud khren tur phebs/ lha sa nas khren tu bar lam bzo ba'i mi grangs stong phrag mang po'i 'go khrid pa so sor legs skyes gnang cha chu tshod dang / rgya ther gyi gos ldeng / lam las la bsngags brjod 'khod pa'i gos chen dmar po si shan gyi 'dzar ldan dang kha btags bcas pa'i tso dga' gnang / khren tu nas tā 89

la'i bla ma dang / chibs zhabs mkhan rim yan mkha' lam brgyud phebs pa dang / chibs zhabs byings rlangs 'khor dang / me 'khor nang zhugs te rgyal sa pe cin du 'byor/ nga tsho chibs zhabs khag rjes ma rnams tā la'i don gcod khang sogs la bsdad/ tā la'i bla ma ston 'khor g.yu hā cha'o zhes par phebs sgrig dang / de min pe cin mgron khang dang / tung tan sogs la bsdad 'dug nga tsho phyag mdzod ngo las rnams kyis phyag rtags rten 'bul khag gra sgrig byas/ rten chas sku gsung thugs rten gyis gtsos gser gyi ze'u lha khang / gser gyi maṇ+ḍal/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong / gser gyi mchod kong / gser ting bdun tshar/ bod rigs lha 'bri ba a mdo byams pa'i sor mo'i 'du byed las bskrun pa'i ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku brnyano tshon khra mtho dma' spyi khre gang tsam yod par gser gyi par sgrom mtha' 'khor du gro'i snye ma dang /zhi bde'i bya phug ron 'phur lding can nyi shu tsam gyi gzugs brnyan ldan pa tshags ris bzo brkos phul du byung ba/ gsham du ma'o kru'u zhir bsngags brjod zhu ba'i snyan tshigs ste/ ‘‘ma'o kru'u zhi'i rlabs chen nyi ma'i 'od/ mi nub 'dzam gling dpal du rtag 'char bas/ srid zhi'i rgud tshogs rmongs mun kun sel nas/ kun phan zhi bde'i snang bas khyab par smon ’’ zhes bris bkod shel sgrom rang 'grigs yod pa/ gzhan yang gna' bo'i bod chas rin rgyan zhes rin chen mang po'i rgyan chas gser g.yu mu tig byu ru/ pha lam/ in+da rnyil/ mar gad sogs kyi phra ldan gyi snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ rna rgyan sogs dang / gos chen rnying ma rgyu spus legs kyi gyon chas/ zhwa lham sogs cha tshang /gzhung zhabs ser mo ba'i dbyar chas dgun chas/ shod skor gyi dbyar chas dgun chas/ rgya lu chas/ bud med lha lcam gyi chas mu tig spa phrug dang /gtsug g.yu thag pa/ sdig rwa glo 'phreng / ga'u/ a sgor/ lan tse/ skra sbrel/'ba' khug khab shub/ gos rgya se'i phu yod phu med/ gru tse tshos sna'i 'og 90

'jug si shan 'ja' sgrig gi spang khebs dang / dpung gzan/ gser gyi lag gdub dang / gser gyi ser gdub/ gser gyi phyang phrul phra ldan bcas dang / gong gsal gzhung zhabs shod skor gyi chas gos khongs gser gyi mu tig sog byil g.yuphra 'byar ba dang / gser gyi phru tog tshe bum gzugs khra ldan/zhwa mo'i mdun phyogs sbab rgyan gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram g.yu sogs kyi khra 'byar/drag po'i chas gos lcags rmog gser tshags gser ris can dang / gna' bo'i bod mda'/ gri/ mdung / mda' gzhu/ phub/ mchod chas ting shags/ dngul gyi gtor chas/ maṇ+ḍal/ dngul gyi mchod kong / ting /dngul gyi ma ṇi lag bskor gser tshags ma/ dngul rkyan/ dngul phor/ lhag par bod kyi khyad nor chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i phyag bzo rdza'i khog ldir che ba lto mgrin zhabs sogs la gser gyi sbab rgyan 'byar ba cha gcig se ru'i rwa dang / khrag rwa/ glang chen gyi mche ba/ gla rtsi/ stag gzigs gis gtsos pags pa sna tshogs/ bod kyi dmangs khrod kyi gyon chas cha tshang / rta sga gser sga dang / dngul sga/ sbo sga/ dbang sga bcas srab med glo gong / rnga dom rang 'grigs/ bal gyi snam bu spu phrug spyan ang dang gnyis dang / thig ris/ dkyus snam bcas bub sna tshogs/ rdza ko g.yu rtsi'i snod chas sna tshogs/shing brkos ma'i khri lcog sogs bod kyi lag bzos dngos po rnam grangs stong phrag brgal ba'i 'bul ba rgya che spam mtho 'bul gnang mdzad/spyi lo 1954lo'i zla bcu pa'i tshes gcig nyin snga dro'i chu tshod brgyad pa'i thog rgyal sa pe cin gyi gnam bde sgo mo che'i yang steng du krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes nas lo lnga 'khor ba'i dus chen gyi mdzad sgor/ tā la'i bla ma dang kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che lhan gnyis ston 'khor chibs zhabs tshang ma phebs bcar thog pho brang zhal khra'i mdun phyogs kyi dbus der rlabs chen gyi gtso 'dzin kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung dang / su'u len gyi gtso 91
