'dzin/ de'i g.yas phyogs dang g.yon du dbu khrid rnam pa'i khongs g.yon ngos su tā la'i bla ma dang / kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis kyang 'dug ma'o kru'u zhi'i rgyab tu li'u hra'o chi dang / kra'u en la'e/ kru'u te sogs tang krung dbyang gi dbu khrid che khag dang / gzhan yang mdun gral g.yas g.yon du 'dzam gling rgyal khab mang po'i sku mgron che khag rnams dang /gnam bde sgo mo che'i phyi ngos g.yas g.yon du bang rim mtho la ring po'i steng sku mgron 'bring rim nas bzung phyi nang gi sku mgron thams cad bcas ma'o kru'u zhis gtsos pa'i tshang ma snga dro chu tshod brgyad pa nas dgong dro chu tshod gsum pa bar bzhengs te mang tshogs kyi gus 'dud dgyes bzhes kyis bzhugs dgos kyi 'dug gang lags zer na/ rgyal khab kyi skam mtsho mkha' gsum gyi dmag mi dang / go mtshon/ 'phrul chas/ bzo zhing 'brog gsum dang / slob grwa ba/ mi dmangs bcas kyi rang rang gi go mtshon yo chas dang thon skyed dngos po sogs 'dra min rigs kyi gzigs 'bul dang 'brel ba'i gus btud 'bul zhes gnang dgos kyi 'dug tshang mas ma'o kru'u zhi sku tshe khri lo brtan par shog krung go gung khran tang khri lo brtan par shog ces dga' mgu'i rnam pas lag pa brkyangs te skad gsang mthon pos 'bod sgra sgrog bzhin par bskyod kyi 'dug mdzad sgo grol nas dgong dro gnam bde sgo mo'i thang chen du skye bo pho mo shin tu mang po 'du 'dzoms kyis tshos gzhi sna tshogs kyi shog sbag spar te nam mkhar 'phangs pa dang / bya phug ron mang po zhig gnam la glod de khungs so so'i nang la log bskyod byed thub kyi yod lugs bcas gang ltar mtshan gang shog sbag gi sgra dang / 'od mdangs kyis nam mkhar 'ja' tshon rnam par bkra ba lta bur mngon/ mdzad sgo grub rjes de'i gnangs nyin tā la'i bla mar dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho rin po che nas gsol btab bzhin pe cin dga' ldan byin chags gling dgon par rgya sog bod 92

rigs mi dmangs stong phrag kha shas la gsung chos gnang song / de rjes tā la'i bla ma dang / bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs/ bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ dza sag sne'u shag thub bstan thar pa/ kun glingadza sag 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ drung yig chen mo mkhan chung ngag dbang don grub/ mgron gnyer chen mo pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan/ rtsis dpon khe smad sras/ rtse phyag mkhan chung smon grub sbug bla phyag sman stod sras blo bzang dbang 'dus/ sku bcar gsol gzim mchod gsum dang / 'bras spungs dgon gyi mkhas dbang shag sgor mkhan po rgan nyi ma/ se ra dgon gyi mkhas dbang ser byes dge bshes lhun grub thabs mkhas/ dga' ldan dgon gyi mkhas dbang shar rtse dze smad sprul sku/ gzhan yang gzhung zhabs mkhan rim dang / rtse mgron/ bka' shag mgron drung sogs pe cin du bzhugs/ de byings bkras lhun bla grwa dang sa gnas srid gzhung gi zhabs 'bring dang /dbus gtsang / mdo khams khul gyi 'thus mi/ bod kyi zlos gar tshogs pa bcas rgyal yongs nang lta skor du gtong gnang gis blta skor tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso tha'i ji ram pa ba dang / de 'og mkhan chung bkras khang thub bstan bsam mchog dang / bkras lhun rim bzhi wang dpal ldan/ las tshan bde legs gzim khang dpal mgon tshe ring bcas kyis sne khrid de pe cin nas ched gtong me 'khor nang zhugs nas thog mar byang shar hren dbyang dang /wu'u han/ tā lan/ har pin/ khrang khrun/ wu'u shi'i/ shi'i hu'u/ an hran/ lan kro'u/ mtsho sngon/ hang kro'u/ hrang ha'e/ khrung chin/ than cin sogs grong khyer mang po'i bzo grwa khag dang / slob grwa khag rgas gso khang /dgon pa khag zhing pa mnyam las khag sogs mang po zhig la lta skor du skyod skabs grong khyer dang grong rdal sogs pa gnas gang sar sne len dang / dga' bsu'i rnam 'gyur legs shing / sems rtsa 'khol po byed mkhan sha stag red/93

dper na grong khyer me 'khor babs tshugs su slebs pa dang / de ga'i sne len las khungs nas rlangs 'khor che chung sna tshogs ang bsar dang / khungs so so'i sdod khang dang / nyal khri'i ang grangs shog lho sngon sprod byas te sa gnas su 'byor nyin rang rang gi ang gi 'khod pa'i khang par shar bskyod chog pa dang / khang pa so sor sne len zhabs zhu ched 'dzugs la gang dgos nang lhug bshad chog par/ khong tshos dga' spro'i 'dzum mdangs kyi sgo nas legs sgrub byed kyi 'dug grong khyer che khag hrang ha'e la nyin bcu gcig bsdad pa las/de byings che khag la nyin bdun re dang / 'bring khag la nyin lnga re/ chung khag la nyin gsum re bcas bsdad pa dang / grong khyer chung khag nas phebs bsu'i gsol ston dang / phebs skyel gsol ston bshams/ che 'bring gnyis kyis phebs bsu phebs skyel dang / bar ston bcas gsol ston thengs gsum re bshams kyin 'dug gsol ston grub pa dang / dgong dro glog brnyan dang khrang shi'i zhabs bro sogs gar phebs rang rang gi blo 'dod ltar gyi lag khyer sprad de dus tshod zin mtshams phebs bsu'i rlangs 'khor khungs so sor dus thog tu 'byor ba'i nang phyin te/ gzigs mo ma grub bar rlangs 'khor sgug sdod byed 'dug pa ma zad/ nga tsho zhabs bror 'gro mkhan tshor tshogs khang du gsol ja zhal tog dang / chang rag dang tha mag sogs gang 'dod yod pa ma zad/ nyal khang du log yong dus dmigs bsal gyi zhal tog tan shin spus dag sder ma byur khengs re sprod kyi 'dug pa de ni zhabs bro brgyab ste lus 'khrugs nas bkres pa sel byed red 'dug gong gsal grong khyer sogs yul gru de rnams la lta skor du dus yun nyin grangs brgya dang nyi shu tham pa song nyin rgyal sa pe cin du phyir 'khor zhing / de nas pe cin grong khyer nang gi dga' ldan byin chags gling dgon dang / pe ha'e sogs la mchod mjal dang /gzhan yang slob grwa khag dang / bzo grwa khag bcas la lta skor byas/ lta skor 94

mjug 'gril mtshams lta skor gyi mthong tshul dang / bsam tshul phyogs sdom gyis snying don rnams snyan 'bul zhus/ nga rang gi mthong tshul ni thog mar lha sa nas thon te kong po'i nang nas spo bo khul sa rong tsub po der rlangs 'khor lam bzo ba mang po zhig gis dka' ngal khyad bsad dang rgyal khab kyi 'gro gron phangs med btang yang sa thag ring po de tsam gyi lam la rlangs 'khor shar gtong thub rgyur lo bcu tsam yun 'gor yong nges snyam yang / lam bzo'i 'go khrid pa tshos lo 'khor gcig nang rlangs 'khor shar gtong thub pa'i 'gan len zhus song ba skabs der nga'i bsam par ham zom chen po'i skad cha red snyam byung yang / blo yul las 'das pa zhig la nga tsho wu'u shi'i la lta skor du 'byor te dga' bsu'i mtshan tshogs zhabs bro grol nas sne len mgron khang du phyir log zin tsam la tar 'phrin zhig 'byor te mtsho bod dang / khron bod gzhung lam khag gnyis kyi rlangs 'khor lha sa bar shar gtong thub nas de ring lha sar 'byor ba'i rten 'brel yin gshis slar yang dga' spro'i mtshan tshogs zhabs bror yong dgos zhes brda 'byor byung ba bzhin bskyod de rnam kun mtshan tshogs mtshan mo'i chu tshod bcu gcig tsam la grol yang / de nub nam phyed yolahote chu tshod gnyis pa bar sdod dgos byung / de'i phyi nyin mno bsam zhig gtong skabs lam bzo dus tshod sngon bkag las legs bsgrubs thub pa'i krung go gung khran tang gi lam bzo byed phyogs kyi thabs jus la ngo mtshar skyes byung / gzhan yang rgyal sa pe cin la hri dbyi zhes spyi zla bcu pa'i tshes gcig nyin rgyal ston mdzad sgo rngams brjid che la zhi drag yongs kyi rang rang gi byed sgo sgrig khrims ldan zhing rnam 'gyur yag pa/ 'go khrid dang mi dmangs dbar mdza' brtse'i gus bkur gyi rnam pa yod pa gsal por mthong de 'brel slob grwa khag gi sgrig khrims dang / slob khrid byed stangs/ bzo grwa khag gi thon skyed byed phyogs sogs 'dzugs skrun gyi bya ba mang po mthong skabs 'di 95

lta bu zhig bod la'ang gang myur 'dzugs skrun thub na ci ma rung snyam pa 'char zhing / bzo grwa'i thon skyed byed pa'i khongs nas gos 'thag srin 'bu gso khang dang / rdo tha/ tha mag gi bzo grwa bcas bod la dgos pa med pa phud/ de byings bzo las tshang ma bod la dgos nges sha stag red/ de'i nang nas bod la dgos gal che shos glog gi yo chas dang / bal 'thag mu zi/ yi rtsi/ shing bzo'i 'phrul chas/ ko pags/ rlangs 'khor/ ar 'dam sogs kyi bzo grwa 'phral 'dzugs yong ba zhes nga tshos lta skor las don phyogs sdom snyan zhu'i nang 'god 'bul yang zhus/ de rjes phyag bzhes rim bstar mdzad pa deng skabs mthong chos su gyur pa ltar lags/ bod rab byung bcu drug pa shing lug gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dgung gsar pe cin du tā la'i don gcod khang gi tshoms chen la mdzad sgo stabs bde zhig gnang / tshes gnyis nyin rgyal po lo gsar sngar srol sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung zhabs gsar pa zhabs sdod pa gnyis bsko gzhag stsal lam bzhin 'di lo zhabs gsar ba pe cin mi rigs slob grwa'i khongs nas bod rigs phal pa'i phru gu slob skyong legs pa gnyis dus bstun bsko gzhag gnang mi yong ngam gnang na yag po red ces zhabs gras tsho dang / gzhung zhabs dkyus ma lho gzan tsho'i nang gleng grags re 'dun che tsam byung song yang / ‘‘rgyal kha blon po'i sgyur phyogs ’’kyi dpe bzhin song rtse skor zhabs sdod gsar pa pha lha'i sras gcig dang / shod skor g.yu thog sras sri chos lags gnyis la bsko gzhag gis gsar mjal zhus song bar zhabs 'bring dkyus ma mang che ba blo pham byed kyi 'dug kyang bya thabs dben/ nga tsho lta skor tshogs pa lta skor du bskyod ring pe cin rgyal sar bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang krung dbyang dbu khrid bka' bsdur gnang skabs bkras lhun bla brang nas de sngon paṇa chen sku gong ma rgya nag tu bros byol phebs dgos byung ba dang / gtsang khul gzhis lus bla brang gi 96

zhabs 'bring dang / mi ser dud tshang mang po zhig gi mkhar dbang bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas btsan len byas pa rnams phyir slog yong ba dang /gzhis ka rtse spyi rdzong gis gtsos gam pa la yar rgyab bkras lhun bla brang gi bdag thob byas chog pa dgos lugs sogs nang khul rtsod rnyog ji snyed cig gleng slong byung bar krung dbyang gi dbu khrid rnam pas ‘‘gsar spros rtsod pa ma dgos par slad phyin tā la'i bla ma sku gong ma dang / paṇa chen sku gong ma mthun po'i skabs kyi gnas stangs ji yod la cha 'jog byed dgos ’zhes gsungs te lhing 'jags byung / de nas bod du phyir phebs skabs chos lugs rnying ma mang che sa'i lung par sku tshab tu bdud 'joms rin po che dang / las bya gzhung zhabs ser skya kha shas/ smin gling gcung rin po che dang / las bya gzhung zhabs ser skya kha shas/ chos lugs sa skya lugs mang che bar sku —tshab tu sa skya bdag khri rin po che dang / las bya gzhung zhabs ser skya kha shas/ chos lugs bka' brgyud pa mang sar sku tshab tu mtshur phu karma pa dang / las bya gzhung zhabs kha shas/ chos lugs dge lugs mang sar yongs 'dzin khri byang dang las bya gzhung zhabs ser skya kha shas bcas bsko rdzong gnang ste ris med dgon sde khag la mchod 'bul dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed sogs rgya che bstar/ phebs lam 'khel yul dgon khag la mchod 'bul dang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed sogs 'bul bar phyag mdzod khang nas mkhan chung 'chang khyim pa dang / phogs dpon pha lha sras/ gus pa phyag nang lha dbang tshe ring gsum sngon du gtong gnang ltar thon bskyod kyis khren tur 'byo ra skabs sa yom brgyab ste dar rtse mdo dang / g.ya' rngan dbar ri kha sbyar gyis bgrod lam 'gag nas lam bzo ma tshar bar khren tur sdod dgos byung / lam bzo zin mtshams su tā la'i bla ma ston 'khor yang khren tur phebs 'byor byung bas de nas lhan du bcar/ khren tu nas phebs te g.ya' 97

rngan dang dar rtse mdo dang / de nas li thang ra ma gsum mdo zhes pa'i thang chen shin tu rgya che ba der phyogs phan tshun nas mjal khar yong mkhan de gar zla ba 'ga' shas song zer ba'i ras gur dang / sbra gur sna tshogs kyi gur tsho stong phrag kha shas dang / rta drel 'phon chen gyi sgar chen phab nas bsdad 'dug pas chos 'brel gsol btab bzhin ma ṇi'i ljags lung dang 'brel mjal kha nyin gsum ring gnang / de nas mi nyag mgar thang dgon du bzhugs zhag nyin gsum ring ser skya mang tshogs la mjal kha chos 'brel gnang ba dang / mgar thang dgon pa'i shar phyogs lung shur zhig gi nang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gcig pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs khang der (yab gzhis phun khang )chibs zhabs khongs nas mjal bskyod byed mkhan mang po byung song / phran rang phyag mdzod khang gi las brel che bas bcar thub ma song /de nas tre hor ta'u nyi tshe dang / brag 'go/ dkar mdzes/ dar rgyas/ be ri/sde dge/ lha thog chab mdo bcas kyi dgon khag so sor nyin gsum re bzhugs zhag dang 'brel ser skya mang tshogs la mjal kha dang chos 'brel yang gnang / chab mdo nas brag g.yab dkyil thang dang / tsha ba grong gsar/ spo bo spra rmog spo bo thang stod/ de mo chab nag kong po nying khri/ mal gro dwags po dgon/ tshal gung thang bar phebs lam 'khel yul ser skya mi dmangs la mjal kha chos 'brel gnang / tshal gung thang du gung thang bla brang sger khe smad pa dang / sa gnas srid( gzhung nas phebs bsu gra rgyas thog gsol ston nyin gsum gzab rgyas 'bulo bzhes mdzad/shing lug (1955)lo'i zla lnga pa'i tshes nyin bzhugs sgar gung thang bla brang nas sngar srol chibs bsgyur chen mo'i lam ltar phebs te ra sa gtsug lag khang du gnas gzigs mdzad nas nor gling bskal bzang pho brang du phebs ston mdzad sgo 'char can bstar/ de ltar shing rta zla ba lnga pa nas/ shing lug 98

zla ba lnga pa bar mes rgyal nang sar lo 'khor gcig hril po phebs bzhugs ring gi mdzad rim rags tsam gang dran tsam las gus rang phyag mdzod khang gi drung tshab kyi zhu bya tsam ma gtogs gam bcar gtan sdod zhabs zhu'i gras min gshis phra zhib zhu spobs dbe+en/ phar phyir phebs lam dang bcas la mjal bcar 'bul ba dngul dngos ji phul tshang ma spyan zhu tsam las phyir sprod bya dgos zhes nga tsho phyag mdzod khang la bka' nan phebs don bzhin tshang ma khungs so sor phyir sprod byas/ lha sar 'byor rjes nga tsho byes phyag mdzod las khungs nor gling zhabs brtan lha khang du tshugs te thog ma'i rten chas dang /phyag sne sogs gnang ba'i lag 'dzin nang gsal gyi grangs 'bor dang / de thog nas rim song song deb kyi nang gsal zhib rtsis kyis rtsis khra kha gsal khams dwangs bkod de skabs de'i sa gnas srid gzhung gi ‘‘bod ljongs tshogs 'du chen mo ’’zhes par sprad thog zhib khang las khungs nas zhib mchan dang 'brel sku chas lhag ma gang yod phyir 'bul zhus/

bdun/ lha sa slob 'bring du dge rgan gyi las 'gan 'khur ba'i skor sogs/1956lo lha sa'i slob grwa chung ba zas zhim dang / rme ru gling kha gnyis kyi slob phrug shes yon mtho gras rnams bsdu bskong gis sbyar rag gling kha'i nang lha sa slob grwa 'bring ba gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i dge rgan bod rigs mi grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga dgos khongs gus pa'ang gtong gnang mdzad don bzhin bskyod par rig slob khru'u nas shes tshad rgyugs bzhes gnang ba'i nang phran rang cung legs gras su 'dems sgrug byung gshis ma bcar thabs med byung / sbyar rag gling kha'i nang 'dzin grwa tshugs yul khang pa kha shas tsam las rgyab ma tshar bas mang che ba tir par gyi gur phub pa'i nang 'dzin grwa tshogs dgos byung /phyogs mtha'i rdzong gzhis khag nas dge rgan 'os sbyong pa mi grangs brgya dang bzhi 'byor pa rnams phran lha dbang tshe ring la rtsis sprod kyis gur chen po zhig gi nang slob phrug phyed bgos kha spros su bsdad nas slob sbyong byed du bcug rtsa ba'i 'char gzhir slob phrug mi grangs chig stong nyis brgya tham pa yin kyang gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum dang / gling phan tshun gzhis dgon khag sogs grwa rigs slob phrug khongs nas mi grangs drug cu tsam las ma 'byor bas lo der slob phrug mi grangs dgu brgya tsam las med pa dang / de'i khongs nas glog brnyan slob sbyong pa mi grangs nyi brgya lhag tsam zhig zur du tshugs/ slob grwa 'bring ba'i 'dzin grwa drug dang / slob 'bring gra sgrig 'dzin grwa khag drug 100

bcas dngos su tshugs/ phran ni slob 'bring 'dzin grwa gsum pa'i 'dzin grwa'i kru'u ren bya rgyu dang / slob 'bring 'dzin grwa dang po dang / gnyis pa gsum pa bcasa'i slob khrid byed par 'gro dgos la/ dge rgan 'os sbyong pa'i 'dzin grwa'i kru'u ren bya rgyu sogs las 'gan mang po zhig 'grub min la ma ltos par 'jam mkhas kyis 'gan dkri gnang ba ltar ngal ba 'dzems med kyis 'gan 'khur byas pa ma zad/ phran dang dge rgan rtse drung blo bzang bstan 'dzin gnyis la slob grwa'i dpal 'byor las khungs nas drag res yin khul gyis slob phrug tsho'i gyon chas dang / nyal gdan/ lham sogs gsar bzo bya rgyu'i rgyu cha nyo dgos pa'i 'gan dkri yang gnang ba ltar slob phrug tshang mar gu thung stod thung dang / bod chas ther brdzus kyi gyon pa/ grwa rigs slob phrug tshor grwa chas cha tshang de yang dgon pa so so'i rgyun chas ltar lham sha gzugs ma dang / ras zon/ snam zon bcas 'dra min khag bzo mngags dang / khrom skor bya rgyu sogs gzhung gron gang chung zhus te las yun de'i ring slob 'bring rang du gtan sdod byas/ slob 'bring gi dge rgan byed mus su 1956lo der 'dzam gling nang bstan chos tshogs kyis shakyā thub pa 'khrungs nas lo ngo nyis stong lnga brgya tham pa 'khor bar dran gso zhu ba'i mdzad sgor tā la bcu bzhi pa dang /paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bcu pa rnam gnyis phebs rgyur gdan zhus ltar phebs skabs/ gus pa lha dbang tshe ring slar yang byes phyag mdzod khang gi las byar ‘‘bod ljongs tshogs 'du ’mizhes pa nas bsko gzhag byas 'dug don ltar bskyod dgos byung zhing / de skabs byes phyag mdzod pa dza sag khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus dang / dngos gzhi mkhan chung thub bstan bsam mchogalas byar phran phyag nang lha dbang tshe ring / rtse phyag jo lags tshe dpal bcas nga tsho ngo las mi bzhi las med/ phyag rtags gnang cha sogs gros bsdur dang dgongs skor zhus te 'og grabs byas/ bkra shis lhun por kun gzigs paṇa 101

chen rin po che mjal 'dzoms gnang ched phar lam gzhis ka rtser phebs shing /gzhis ka rtse chu shar la bkra shis lhun po bla brang gis phebs bsu'i dbu gur dang / bla brang du phebs sgrig gra rgyas phun sum tshogs pa zhus 'dug kyang /phebs bsu'i dbu gur du kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che ngo phebs ma gnang ba der sa gnas srid gzhung gi chibs zhabs zhabs 'bring pa rnams yid ma rangs pa byung ba dang / paṇa chen rin po che kun gzigs gzim chung gi byang sgo ka brgyad ma'i nang gi sgo 'gram la phebs bsu zhus na 'grigs lugs bkras lhunabla brang gi zhabs gras 'ga' shas nas dgag cha zhus lugs rjes su thos/bkras lhun bla brang gi zhabs gras gtso che ba lha smon dza sag zhu ba sngar gdan sa se rar chos zhugs gnang ste rig lam la sbyang brtson gang legs gnang myong yod pas shes yon che ba yod tshod 'dug kyang / khong zhal gsang po rang med skad ltar dza sag bkras mthong pa sogs kyi kha shed la song tshod 'dug gzhis rtse nas gro mor shar phebs kyis gro mo chu 'bi pho brang srid zhi dge legs su bzhugs/ de nas sna thod la rtser phebs skabs rgya gar gyi phebs bsu dang sku srung ba bcas 'byor 'dug lha sa nas lhan phebs krung dbyang gi sku tshab li khru'u krang dang bcas 'bras ljongs nas mal le bco brgyad trem gyi sa thag yod pa mtsho mgor bzhugs zhag gnang zhing / de gar 'bras ljongs rgyal po dang /stag 'tsher sprul sku/ rgya lo don grub bcas phebs bsur 'byor 'dug de nas phyi nyin 'bras ljongs pho brang gtsug lag khang gi yang steng pho brang du phebs/de'i sang nyin kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che yang 'bras ljongs su phebs 'byor byung bas lhan du shi li gu li bar phebs ṭo dang / de nas mkha' lam brgyud rgya gar gyi rgyal sa ldi li gsar par phebs/ gus tsho chibs zhabs byings shi li gu li bar mo ṭa dang / de nas me 'khor nang zhugs te ldi li gsar par 'byor/ tā la'i bla ma had dar sba tha zhes pa'i pho brang der phebs sgrig zhus 102

'dug pa dang / gus tsho chibs zhabs rnams rgya gar gzhung gi za khang 'jam pa di zhes pa thog brtsegs drug ldan zhig gi nang sdod sgrig gzabs rgyas byas 'dug ston pa bcom ldan 'das sku 'khrungs nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya 'khor ba'i 'dzam gling nang pa'i chos kyi mdzad sgo chen mo ldi li gsar par 'tshogs pa der gus rang ngo bcar zhu 'dod byung yang phyag mdzod khang gi las brel ci ches 'gro khom ma byung / mdzad sgo grub rjes rgya gar gnas chen khag la gnas gzigs phebs par mnga' sde so so'i spyi khyab 'go dpon dang / chos lugs khag gi bla chen tshang mas phebs bsu gus 'dud gzab rgyas zhu bzhin 'dugade nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / lha sde mi sde'i 'thus mi'i phebs bsu dang po 'byor bas gnas gzigs grub rjes bod phyogs su chibs zhal bsgyur nas 'bras ljongs kyi sgang thog tu phebs/ skabs der sna thod la la kha ba che babs kyis phar tshur 'grul lam 'gag stabs 'bras ljongs rgyal pos gnas skabs sgang thog tu sku ngal gsos te lhod bzhugs gnang 'dun zhus don de gar zla ba gcig tsam bzhugs/ ston 'khor mi grangs brgya dang nyi shu tsam la gsol ja dang gsol tshigs sogs gang ci bod kyi thugs spro chen mo ltar bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas zhus/ bkras lhun bla brang nas gdan zhu thengs mang po sgang thog tu 'byor/ de nas sna thod pa'i 'grul lam bcos zin 'phral bod du phebs thon gyis tshur lam gro mo dung dkar degon du nyin zhag gsum dang /phan rir gsol ja mdzad de rgyal rtse dpal 'khor chos sder phebs/ bod me bya lo gsar mdzad sgo rgyal rtser gnang / lo gsar mdzad sgor gzhung zhabs gsar pa ser skya gnyis bsko gzhag bya lam ltar rtse drung zhabs gsar ba drung yig che mo lcogs steng thub bstan nor bzang gi zhabs gras bu nyi ma dang /shod skor zhabs gsar ba pha lha'i sras gzhis bzhugs dbang phyug la rim bzhi'i go gnas dang bcas zhabs gsar bsko gzhag byung ba gsar mjal 103

zhus/ bkras lhun bla brang nas phebs bsu thengs gnyis pa bcar/ 'brong rtse dang / pa snam dga' gdong dgon par rim phebs kyis rten mchog la stong mchod dang / 'dus tshogs su bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed/ chos 'brel yang gnang / de'i sang nyin pa snam dga' ba gdong nas phebs thon gyis gzhis rtse bkra shis lhun po'i bla brang nas ser sbreng dang / bro gzhas sogs phebs bsu phebs sgrig ang sar zhus 'dug kyang / sa gnas srid gzhung gi mtho rim sku drag re zung nas g.yo thabs kyis gzhis rtse spyi rdzong gi yang steng tā la'i bla ma lnga pa chen po'i pho brang du rtags rten ched zhabs bkod mdzad na legs tshul zhus pa ma zad/ gtsang spyi sbrel por yang sngon nas bka' btang yod tshad ltar gzhis rtse spyi rdzong du thad kar gdan 'dren zhus/ de'i phyi nyin bkras lhun bla brang du gdan zhus ltar chibs bsgyur gyis phebs ston dkar spro bsgrigs 'bul sogs mdzad sgo grub pa dang gsol ston du gdan zhu byas/ de'i snyi nyin gdan sa bkris lhun po'i tshogs chen dang / grwa tshang khag sku gdung lha khang khag bcas la stong mchod dang / brgya mchod/ rten mchog rnams la zhal gser spyan dbye sogs bstar 'bul dang 'brel gnas gzigs gnang /de'i phyi nyin tshogs chen rdo gcal chen mor ser skya mang tshogs la lam gtso rnam gsum gyi gsung chos kyang gnang / 'on kyang skabs der phebs sgrig zhu phyogs skor bla brang zhabs 'bring khag cig yi ma rangs par phebs bsu'i ser sbreng go sgrig sngon zin rnams kyang phyir 'then dgos pa'i brda khyab btang yod skad/de nas shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor dgon nas gdan zhus ltar gzhis rtse —nas gling ko sa bar phebs ṭor dang / chu pha ri nas chibs thog phebs te shangs mdo sger sa lung pa'i gzhis kar bzhugs zhag mdzad par ston 'khor yongs rdzogs la sri zhu gzab rgyas dang / sa lung ngo ma de snga nag tshang 'go pa byed mkhan thabs shes zung gzim chung mjal bcar thog maṇ+ḍal rten gsum 104

dngos mdog dang kha btags nang mdzod/ dngos 'bul spam mtho'i khar/lcam chung gi mu tig spa phrug dang / gser gyi ske ga'u dang a sgor sogs rgyan chas cha tshang dad 'bul zhus/ chibs zhabs che phra tshang mar yang legs skyes mjal dar dang dngul shog chag re sprad/ de'i sang nyin dga' ldan chos 'khor gling du phebs nyin phebs bsu'i ser sbreng dang / bro gzhag sogs dang /dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang dang 'du khang chen mo/ sger gyi bla brang khag dang /grwa shag bcas kyi khang pa'i yang steng du bkra shis khra bsgrigs dang / dar phreng /dung rgya/ lam g.yas g.yon du bsang khung gsar rgyag gis bsangs dud sogs kyi phebs bsu gzab rgyas dang bcas dga' ldan chos 'khor du phebs shing / de gar rten gsum 'degs bzhes sogs kyi mdzad sgo dang / dge 'dun 'dus mang la 'dod chos/ de'i sang nyin rig lam rtsod grwa ba rnams la gzigs zhib dang rten mchog spyan sngar mchod sprin/ 'dus tshogs su bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed bca4'bul gnang mdzad/ de nas bkras lhun khongs bde chen rab rgyas dgon nas gdan zhus ltar phebs te gnas gzigs grub rjes dga' ldan chos 'khor gling du phyir phebs/ de'i sang nyin gling gru brgyud gser mdog can dgon par phebs te bca' bzhugs dang / de'i sang nyin phebs ṭo'i nang stag gru kha brgyud bon dgon ra lag g.yung drung dgon gyi phebs bsu dbu gur du gsol tsha dang de nas mar rkyang du bzhugs zhag mdzad/de'i sang nyin yangs pa can dgon par bzhugs zhag gis gnas gzigs mdzad/ yangs can dgon nas stod lung dmar la bzhugs zhag mdzad/de'i phyi nyin lha sar phebs 'byor byung ba bcas/ 1958lo mjug la rgya gar nas lha sar phyir phebs rjes byes phyag mdzod khang gi byung song rtsis khra khe smad dza sag dang / gus gnyis nas 'gan 'khur gyis khams dwangs bzo 'god byas te zhib khang las khungs brgyud bka' shag tu spyan zhur phul/ de nas gus 105

rang lha sa slob 'bring bod yig dge rgan gyi las 'khur du rang 'jags bskyod de rang 'khri'i las 'gan sngar bzhin sgrub/me bya (1957)bod zla bcu gcig pa'i nang bza' zla bsod nams dbyangs can la bu mo mtshe ma gsum skyes/ a ma gzugs po ha cang zhan pa dang / phru gu gsum gso skyong bya rgyu bcas dka' ngal tshad med kyis phyogs gcig nas a mar sman bcos 'phrod bsten bya rgyu dang / gcig shos nas bu phrug gsum la nu zho 'o ma'i 'jib ru ster zhing dus tshod dgu 'grims pa'i skabs 'khel bas shin tu grang ngar che zhing / ghig dam nang chu tsha po blugs te ghig dam gnyis gshibs steng phru gu re bsnyal nas mal chas dro 'jam yang pa g.yogs/ chu tshod gnyis re'i mtshams 'o ma dang / chu 'khol la mngar cha btab pa res mos kyis ster zhing chab gcin gyi skam rlon brje rgyu sogs nyin mtshan bar med kyis zla ba gcig dang zhag brgyad ring slob grwar dgongs pa zhus te bu rdzi nga rang pa pha rang gis lag bstar gces skyong byas/ de rjes bza' zla bsod nams dbyangs can gyi pha gcig ma gcig yin pa'i spun ne chung ri'i btsun ma blo bzang chos sgron dgon pa'i spyi mi las 'khur 'khyur 'dug pa khong la phru gu gsum po blta skyong bya rgyur rtsis sprad de nga rang slob dger bskyod/ 'on kyang dgong mo slob grwar sdod ma dgos pa'i dgongs pa zhus/ de nas a ma yang rim bzhin drag skyes byung ba dang / phru gu gsum yang 'tshar long yag po byung song / phran rnam kun gzugs po yag po yod rung phru gu gsum zla gcig zhag brgyad ring blta skyong byed skabs sked rag kyang bshig rgyu ma byung khar nyin mtshan mang po gnyid lhod po zhig nyal rgyu ma byung ba'i rkyen gyis lus stobs shor bas ngo shes khag thug skabs ngo ma shes pa lta bu chags nas khyed rang bar skabs na byung ngam zhe drag rgas 'dug zer mkhan yang mang po byung / yin na'ang a ma dang phru gu gsum bde ldan byung rjes nga rang yang bag phebs blo bde'i gnas su gyur/106

brgyad/ mtsho sna 'bras khang gzhung 'dzin byed par bskyod skor sogs/sa khyi (1958)rang lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum lo ble phyag las khungs khongs mtsho sna 'bras khang gzhung 'dzin mi 'gro dang blang zhu mi yod med 'bod bskul byas kyang 'gro mkhan med pa dang / phyi lo'i tshong tshwa sbas tshang dang / yangs pa can khul gyi 'brog pas 'char can mtsho sna dang / lhun rtse khul du tshwa 'bebs tshongakhya dgos ltar tshwa g.yag rgyab nyis stong brgal ba lhun rtser 'byor yang tshwa rtsis len byed mkhan med par lus te 'brang dpon dang g.yag pa mi grangs brgya dang bzhi/ khal g.yag nyis stong bdun brgya tsam 'gag 'gyangs byung yod stabs khong tshos bka' shag tu snyan zhu snga rjes su phul bar brten bka' shag dang legs bcos las khungs nas bla phyag las khungs su 'bras sgrub mi 'gro 'phral gtong dgos pa'i bka' khyab btang ba ltar bla phyag ngo las tshang ma gros bsdur gyis mthar jo lags bgres song nas/ zha'u li gzhon shos bar mi tshang ma dpal lha mo'i spyan sngar zan rtag zhus te su thon rung dgongs zhu mi chog pa'i thag gcod byas te brtag sgril zhu bar bla phyag ngo ma bzhi dang / phyag drung / jo lags gon dar gzhon gsum dang / zha'u li bcas kyi 'thus mi dpal lha mo'i spyan sngar phyin nas zan brtag zhus par phran lha dbang tshe ring dang / gzhon pa rdo rje rig 'dzin nged gnyis phebs pas bsko gzhag bka' bsgyur gyis gnangs gzhes nas mi 'gyangs par thon dgos bshad don ltar de nyin rang lam 'khel rdzong gzhis khag la rta khal dang / sdod sgrig ko gru'i 107

sgrol 'don sogs gra sgrig byed dgos pa'i mda' yig ras dmar thog 'bru tsha'i yi ge bris te btang / de'i sang nyin log gro ba'i sa nas bzhon drel drug nyos/ rdzong gzhis khag nas zog 'bru len rgyu'i bka' rgya dang / lam yig zhus/ lo gsum ring las 'khur lhag bsam rnam dag zhu rgyu'i mna' gan bzhag sbas tshang pa dang / yangs can pa'i 'brog pa rnams la sngar srol gnang cha ja dang / ma dngul sogs bla phyag nas rtsis len gyis bsko gzhag byas pa nas nyin lnga pa'i dgong dro nyi ma ma bzhud tsam la lha sa nas thon te de nub rwa ma sgang la bsdad/ de skabs lho kha khul khams jag 'go gtso a 'brug mgon po bkra shis kyi gtsos khams jag mang pos rgya bod zhi mthun la dkrog rkyen dang / mi ser la brdabs bsigs tshod med/ phan tshun 'grul bzhud mi bde ba/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag phar tshur phebs skabs 'jab rgol gtor skyon gtong ba sogs dus zing che tsam yod stabs bla phyag las khungs nas nga tsho ngo g.yog mi bcu la me mda' dbyin ji kha ring bcu dang mde'u stong sgam gcig sprad byung yang / rang gi bsam par de ni bod bzhugs bcings 'grol dmag nas nga tshos drag chas spras par ngos 'dzin gnang srid la/ khams jag gis kyang me mdel 'phrog bcom byed srid pa sogs dge med skyon 'gyur gyi gnas las ma 'das snyam ste me mda' dang mde'u gcig kyang ma blangs par nged rang ngo ma gnyis so so'i lag mda' chung ngu re am phrag nang 'khyer ba las g.yog po rnams la go lag gang yang med par mtshon srung ga'u re rgyab tu bskur nas phyin/ rwa ma sgang nas shel grong la zhag sdod byas/ de'i sang nyin zhogs pa snga po bye la brgal te ri sked tsam la slebs dus me mda'i skad sgra go thos la zhib skabs lho kha gong dkar khul du yin tshod 'dug de nub rdo rje brag tu bsdad/ de'i sang nyin gru don te lce bde zhol du 'byor skabs sa gnas rgan po nas brjod gsal ‘‘kha sa gra nang du khams rigs nas 108

bcings 'grol dmag mi'i rlangs 'khor che ba gnyis la me brgyab ste gtor skyon btang lugs dang / dus zing 'di 'drar mtsho snar thar thabs med gshis phyir log phebs pa legs gnas zer ba dang / bla phyag las khungs nas kyang thon khar gal srid lam bar du dus zing gis bgrod lam mi bde ba yod tshe phyir log byas 'thus bka' 'khrol yod kyang / lhun rtse khul sbas tshang pa dang / yangs pa can pa gnyis kyi mi zog sems can bkag 'gyangs su yod pa rang blos ma bzod par de'i sang nyin lce zhol nas phran dang / g.yog po gnyis sngon 'gros lta bur thon/ rogs pa jo lags rdor rin dang / g.yogs po byings/ mi ser rta khal slog mi bcas rjes su bzhag nas phran ngo g.yog gsum gra phyi rta rmig ces bsam pho'i zhabs gras shig gi pha gzhis khang pa chen po de'i byang phyogs su 'byor skabs rgya lam du rlangs 'khor che ba gnyis skyon shor bzo bcos byed mi bcings 'grol dmag mi nyi shu skor zhig 'dug pa khong tshos nga tsho gsum mthong 'phral go lag 'khyer ba khag gnyis su phyogs bgos byas te khag gcig nga tsho phyogs la blta rub kyis lam bkag byung / ngas thung si thung si zhes bshad par ‘‘sbu ṭi tog ’zer gyi 'dug nga rang lha sa slob 'bring gi dge rgan yin tsang rgya skad re zung shes pa mno bsam btang ste/‘‘yu'u mi yu'u h+phan yi'i ’’zhes brjod pas rgya rigs rnams bzhin mdangs gsal du phyin te ‘‘yu'u yu'u ’’zhes zer nas skad sgyur ba skad 'bod byas song /dus yun gang 'tshams ring sgug kyang yong mkhan med stabs me mda' og shol ring po can thogs pa'i dmag mi gnyis phran dang mnyam du yong ste rta rmig khang par bskyod/ bcings 'grol dmag mi rnams nyin dgung kha lag za ba'i sgang red/ steng shod bar gsum dang / sgo 'gram lcang gseb 'og bcas la bcings 'grol dmag mi ha cang mang po 'dug steng khang shar gyi gzim chung nang 'khrid pa der dpung rtags skar ma bzhi re yod pa'i dmag dpon gnyis dang / dpung rtags skar ma gsum re yod pa'i dmag dpon bcas 'dug109

de khongs nas bod skad phran trem shes mkhan zhig 'dug pa khong gis gar 'gro 'dri rtsad byas byung / ngas mtsho snar 'gro rgyu'i skor rgya skad re zung dang bcas gsal bshad gang yong byas mthar ra 'phrod byung ste nga'i rogs pa dang / mi ser rta khal bcas rjes su yong rgyur kho tsho bkag med shar gtong byed rogs lab/ de nub nga tsho gra phyir bsdad/ de'i sang nyin rnam sras gling la tsha phogs brgyab nas sne gdong du nyi ma la rgas tsam la 'byor/ ja 'khol te dkar yol nang blugs tsam la khang pa'i thog kar rdig sgra mang po byed 'dug pa g.yog pos blta bskyod skabs bcings 'grol dmag mi mang po thog ka dang / khang pa'i mtha' bskor 'dug zer/ de ma thag gyon chas sngon po lag g.yas me mda' lan kru'u dang g.yon la bzhu mar glog bzhu 'khyer ba mi gnyis dang / me mda' ring mda' og shol can 'khyer ba'i bcings 'grol dmag mi bzhi bcas phran ngo ma gnyis sdod khang sar yong ste khyod tsho ga par 'gro mkhan yin/da lta ‘‘sgang spu'u ’’la yong dgos zhes dza drag chen pos bshad par ngas nga tsho mtsho sna 'bras sgrub pa gzhung 'dzin mi 'gro yin zhus/ lam yig ga par yod ston dang zer ba ltar sprad par snum bzhu'i mdun du lag pa'i glog bzhu spar te zhib blta byas song yang gang ltar da lta ‘‘sgang spu'u ’ril dpon po'i sar yong dgos zer zhing / ngas do dgong phyi po red sang nyin nges par du yong gi yin/nga tsho bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis btang ba song tsang / krung dbyang las byed dang 'khur mnyam len byed dgos pa zhig yin gshis/ lho khul spyi khyab pa dang sne gdong rdzong bzhugs mkhan mi 'dug kyang / sang nyin rgan po 'khrid de ‘‘sgang spu'u ’’la bcar nas 'di khul gyi las don bka' mol zhu rgyu yin zhes brjod par/ 'o na sang nyin chu tshod gang la yong gi yin nam zer/ nga tsho'i sne gdong tshwa sgrub pa 'phyod la bsdad yod tshod 'dug pas do dgong bang mi btang ste sang nyin khong 'byor 'phral mnyam 'khrid kyis bcar yong zhes bshad/khong tshor ja thang blug lha sa'i skor 'dri rtsad gnang byung bar lan btab/110

khong tsho log pa dang / khang pa'i mtha' skor dang / thog steng du yod pa'i dmag mi rnams kyang phyir log byas 'dug de nas nga tsho lto bzas nas nyal la khad la slar yang bcings 'grol dmag dpon gnyis dang / dmag dkyus bzhi sngon ma bzhin me mda' 'khyer nas 'dri rtsad byed par phebs byung ba sngon ltar gsal bshad byas/ sang nyin ‘‘sgang spu'i ri’la 'gro rgyu'i skor bcas bshad nas khong tsho log song / de'i sang nyin tshwa sgrub pa 'phyod nas 'byor 'phral nga dang / nga'i rogs pa jo lags rdor rin lags/ tshwa sgrub pa/ sne gdong rgan po bcas ‘‘sgang spu'u ’’la bcings 'grol dmag gi 'go khrid sar bskyod pas wang hru'u ci da lta las don gal che zhig gnang gi yod ces pu'u krang bod skad shes mkhan zhig dang 'phros mol byas shing / khong ni bod rigs skye yul 'ba' pa red 'dug (skabs der ming shes byung yang lo mang song stabs da lta brjed 'dug) khong gis gsung gsal ‘‘deng sang khams pa jag tshogs kyis 'di khul spyod ngan byed pa go ma byung ngam/ zang zing 'di tsam byed bzhin du khyod rang tsho 'di phyogs su yong don gang yin zhes gsungs/ de lan ngas ‘‘khams rigs don ma go nas 'khrugs zing byed kyi yod lugs go thos byung yang / mtsho sna 'bras sgrub pa'i tshong tshwa sbas tshang pa dang / yangs pa can pa gnyis kyis 'char can mtsho sna dang / lhun rtse bcas la tshong tshwa 'bebs 'dren byed srol ltar kha sngon nas tshwa rgyab gnyis stong skor sa gnas su 'byor yod kyang mtsho sna 'bras sgrub pa 'di lo nas gzhung 'dzin bskyangs pa'i mi 'gro gtan 'khel ma thub paranar 'gyangs su gyur zhing / da cha ngos gnyis gtong gnang ltar yong pa yin/ las sgo'i tshong tshwa 'on khul nas tshur 'or 'dren dang /'bru 'bab phar 'dren byed dgos thad sger pa gru dang / nya mgo gru gnyis ka klu khang gru khar 'khrid 'dug pa tshwa 'bru dbor 'dren byed ched ko ba rogs ram yong ba zhes brjod pas/ de lan khong tshos ‘‘de ga rang red/ gru klu khang gru sar 'khrid mkhan nga tsho ma red/ khams pa jag tshogs red/ khams pa jag 111

tshogs khrims 'gal byed 'jug mkhan bka' shag dang / gdan sa'i mkhan 'thus red/ nga tshor le khag med/ lar nas khyod rang tsho gcig pa red pā ’’zhes gsungs byung / ngas ‘‘de 'dra e yin/ nga tshor bka' shag nas 'gro khar bka' mngags la lho kha khul du khams rigs nas rmongs zhen gyis 'khrugs rkyen slong gi yod tshod de tsho dang ngan 'brel byas mi chog lhag par rgya bod dbar mthun lam gtor bshig mi 'gro ba byed dgos ’’zhes bka' phebs byung ba de dag la gzhigs na de 'dra'i dwogs 'char gnang dgos med lugs bshad par/ khong gis gsung don ‘‘khams pa jag tshogs kha rgyal du 'jug mkhan bka' shag dang / gdan sa'i mkhan 'thus tsho yin thag chod red/krung dbyang gis mdzad phyogs brtan pos bzod sgom gnang ba red ma gtogs khong tshos ‘bstan srung dang blangs mdag ’ces pa khri phrag mang po yod lugs rdzun gtam bshad kyang / don du bod sa khul gyi jag tshogs tshang ma bsdoms kyang stong phrag lnga drug lhag las med pa red/ khong tsho mthar skrod gtong bar dus yun chu tshod kyi skar cha bcu lhag las 'gor gyi ma red/ 'on kyang krung dbyang nas khong tsho shes rmongs la go bskon gses dkrol gyis lhing 'jags yong thabs gnang gi yod pa red ’’ces dang / yang khong gis ‘‘khyed tshos brjod don mtsho sna 'bras khang gzhung 'dzin la rgya bod zung 'brel gyis las don sgrub dgos dngos 'brel yin yang nga tsho la ni ko ba gcig las med/de yang ral rdol gyis las ka bskul 'pher med ’’ces gsungs/ de lan phran nas ‘‘deng sang lho spyi gnyis dang sne gdong rdzong bzhugs mkhan med pas rgan po dang / 'di ga krung dbyang sku tshab las khungs thun mong nas gru kha yas mas kyi ko gru rnams la bka' khyab gnang ste tshwa 'bru phar tshur dben 'dren bkag 'gyangs mi yong ba'i thugs 'khur bzhes rogs ’zhes zhus par/ khong gi gsung don ‘‘ko gru'i nang mi ngan log spyod pa 'gro 'ongs mi byed pa'i 'gan 112

len khyod nas byed dgos ’’gsungs/ phran nas ‘‘bod mi phar tshur 'grul bzhud nangog spyod pa yod min khyed tshos brtag zhib gnang dgos pa las/nga tshos 'gan len byed mi thub ’mices zhus pa dang / tshwa sgrub pa ngo g.yog gsum la mthun 'gyur rogs ram gang 'os gnang rogs zhus nas sne gdong du phyir log dgong dro khra 'brug tu 'byor tsam bskyod/ de'i sang nyin chu bzhi sgang drug zer ba'i 'go gtso a 'brug bla ma'i sar phyin/ lam 'khel sa 'gag so sor bkag med 'phral gtong dgos pa'i ngo sprod yi ge zhig dgos lugs bshad par/ kho pas ‘‘ngos sprod yi ge 'phyongs rgyas dmag spyi lhan khang nas len sprod byed dgos pa las 'di nas sprad mi chog ’’zer bas/ de'i sang nyin khra 'brug nas thon te lha chung sa tshigs babs tshugs sar rogs pa ngo g.yog rnams bzhag ste phran ngo g.yog gsum 'phyongs rgyas su bskyod nas nang pa shar zhes pa'i 'phyongs rgyas las drung gi khang pa che legs der khams jag gi dmag spyi khang zer ba 'tshogs par phyin pas rgyal sgo'i sgo srung pas lam seng thad skyod mi chog ces zer bas ngang tsam sgug sdod byas rjes 'go byed khams rigs gcig yong ste yar phebs zhes mnyam 'khrid kyis bskyod thog phran gyis ‘‘nga tsho mtsho sna 'bras sgrub gzhung 'dzin mi 'gror gtong gnang mdzad pa bzhin yong dgos byung bas yar lung khul sa gnas khag la khyod tsho'i mis bkag sdom mi chog pa'i ngos sbyor yi ge zhig sprod rogs ’’zhes lab pa yin/ ngo log jag dmagagi dmag spyi red zer ba'i mi bzhi 'dug pa'i nang sngar lha sar mthong myong ba'i dar rgyas dgon pa'i tshong pa se se dang / rag phrug ngag dbang zer ba gnyis 'dug khong tshos lag khyer sogs sprod mkhan tshan pa gzhan zhig yod lugs kyis nga dang mnyam du mi gcig btang nas lag 'khyer len sa'i tshan pa'i sar phyin/ de nas lag 'khyer sprad pa blangs te lam seng phyir log gis lha chung sa tshugs su zhag sdod byas/ de nas yar lung pho brang dang / chos 113

sde gong / yar stod sbrag la/ e chu mdo rgyang / gnyal shol po mkhar steng bcas sa gnas brgyud lhun rtse rdzong du 'byor/ de'i phyi nyin zhogs pa sbas tshang pa dang / yangs can pa'i 'brang dpon khag 'gugs 'bod kyis tshwa 'bab rtsis sprod len de nyin nas 'go 'dzugs bya rgyu byas shing / 'brang dpon tshos zhu gsal ‘‘kha sngon chu bzhi sgang drug gi phogs khang nas nga tsho 'brang dpon rnams ngo 'gugs kyis tshwa dang g.yag ji yod e lha rgya ri dmag spyi khang du 'bul dgos pa dang / khyod tsho 'brang dpon the bas g.yag pa tshang ma ‘bstan srung dang blang dmag ’ khongs 'dzugs zhugs bya dgos pa dang / sang gnangs mi 'gyangs bar lha rgya rir 'gro dgos zhes bshad byung bar/ nga tshos de ltar ma dgos pa'i rgyu rkyen rim par bshad kyang nyan 'jog ma byas par nyin lnga nas 'gyangs med 'gro dgos zer stabs gzhung nas khams rigs tshor zhi 'jam dgos rgyu'i bka' khyab gnang mkhan mkhan chung dngos gzhi thub bstan bsam mchog dang / rtsis dpon rnam sras gling pa rnam gnyis lhun rtser bzhugs mus la song rogs mgon yong ba zhus don mkhan rtsis gnyis kyis khams pa'i phogs khang la bka' gnang ste lha rgya rir 'gro ma dgos tsam dang /khal g.yag rnams sprod ma dgos tsam byung yang / khong tshos tshwa ru'i khal chig stong lnga brgya tham pa ma byung thabs med ces bshad don sprod rgyur khas len byed dgos byung ’’zhes zer gyi 'dug nga tsho 'bras khang gnyis ma 'byor bar bka' 'gyangs ma zhus par tshwa 'bor chen po khas len byas pa 'grig min bshad par/ ma byas tshe nga tsho 'brang dpon rnams gsod brdung gang min yong gtan 'khel bas 'gan blos ma bzod par khas len mi bya mthu med la gyar song zar ba bzhin de mus su phogs khang nas yin zer ba'i khams rigs rta pa sa/sum nga tsho'i sar yong nas ‘‘hor pa tshos dmag sgar gyi rgyag tshwa ru'i khal chig stong lnga brgya tham pa phul song bas 'bras khang nas rtsis bzhes kyis nga tshos rim 114

zhu byas chog pa zhu bar btang byung mi’zhes zer 'dug par/ phran nas slokhong tshor gzhung tshwa sprad chog pa'i dbang cha med gshis tshwa 'bab mtsho sna 'bras khang rang gis rtsis len gyis khong tshor tshwa rin 'bru 'bab sprod dgos kyi red/ zhib cha sang nyin phogs khang 'go khrid sar nga gnyis slebs yong ’’zhes lab par khams jag gsum phyir log byas/ de'i sang nyin nged tsho 'gro khom ma byung bas dgong dro slar yang rta bzhon pa'i khams jag mi gcig 'byor te ‘‘sang nyin 'bras khang gnyis phogs khang la nges par du yong dgos ’’zhes lan bskyal byung don sang nyin phogs khang gnas yul skya bo khang gsar du ngos tsho ngo g.yog bzhi phyin pa yin/ 'go khrid rgan pa cha phreng ye shes dang / ya gcig 'ba' pa dbang 'dus zer ba gnyis 'dug cing 'ba' pa dbang 'dus zer ba des kho pa tsho sangs rgyas bstan don yin tshul mang dag cig bshad thog ‘‘khyod tsho sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la yid ches yod mkhan zhig yin tshe nga tshor rgyab skyor byed dgos pa smos med red/ de las ldog ste gzhan gyi rogs skyor byas pa de'ang 'gog rkyen bzos pa 'os min red de lam mi 'jog thag chod yin ’’zhes zer nas rgya lcog steng khu mtshur brdungs te gdong gshis 'gyur nas bshad byung /ci der rgan pa cha phreng pa de ‘‘de 'dra ma zer gang yang byed kyi ma red/ skad cha ga ler bshad chog gi red/ da cha hor pa tshos sprad pa'itswa khal chig stong lnga brgya tham pa de nga tshos rim zhu byas chog pa zhig gnang rogs ’’zhes ngag 'jam gyis bshad byung / skabs der mkhregs bzung byas na gyong 'khel rgyu las med stabs khams jag rgan pa cha phreng ye shes la ngo bzo btang ste tshwa 'bab sprod rgyu'i khas len byed dgos byung / gal srid khas len ma byas tshe ngos gnyis la ma dga' zhe 'dzin bya rgyu ma zad phran lha tshe'i srog la'ang nyen kha chen po yong nges red/ gang lags she na/ de'i sngon tsam la khong tshos dpung ngoms kho nas mi kha shas bsad pa dang / kha shas la nyes rdung tshad med btang 115

'dug pa ma zad/ lhun rtse rdzong gnyis kyang khams jag phogs khang nas 'gugs 'bod kyis mi ser la 'di dang 'di zhes bkod 'doms byed du bcug pa des kyang 'dod blo ma khengs tshe kho pa tshos rang shed kyis khrims gcod byed kyi yod pas red/ de rjes kho pa tshos ja tshong dgos zer zhing / ja tshong yag med lab kyang khyod tshor ja yod nges la ma btsong rung snga g.yar dgos zhes ja sbag bcu gsum dang / ja ril bdun chag bcu gnyis snga g.yar sprod dgos byung ba rjes su bskyin tshab sprod mkhan mi 'dug yang kho pa tshos bkod yig snag tsha dmar pos bris pa zhig btang 'byor nang ‘‘mtsho sna 'bras khang nas lha rgya ri dmag spyi khang gi dgos mkhor mtsho sna'i shog yug do gsum dang / las shog do lnga bcas lhun rtse phogs khang du gnangs nyin 'byor pa dgos rgyu ’mizhes 'khod 'dug pa shog yug bcu ltebs kha shas dang / las shog bre kha do gcig sprod dgos byung / lhun rtse rdzong rtse drung ngag dbang blo bzang lags su gzhung 'bru rnams khams jag gi dmag phogs la dgos lugs brjod 'dug par/khong gis bka' shag tu dgongs skor zhu dgos la bka' gsal ma 'khor bar sprod thabs med lugs brjod 'dug par khams jag 'ba' pa dbang 'dus nas khong la tshig ngan sna tshogs bshad 'dug de nas hor pa tsho'i sa nas tshwa 'bab rnams gshor kha rtsis len gyis tshwa rin 'bru 'bab spus gtsang sprad la dang / sngar srol khong tshor spro skyid nyin gsum gtong rgyu'i dgos cha chang rgyu dang / rtsam pa/ gro zhib/ 'bras la sogs pa gya nom pa dang / lag rtags 'brang khag che chung la gzhigs pa'i ja sbag lnga drug nas gsum bzhi'i bar babs 'os yid mgu ba bstab ste hor pa rnams khungs so so'i yul du phyir slog byas/sngar srol lo gsar du po ta la dang / nor gling gzim chung khag rtse 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra/ gser gdung khag lha sa gtsug lag khang / rwa mo che 116

gtsug lag khang bcas la rten 'byung ched tsha lu ma 'bras bu yal ga lo ma rang 'grigs mtsho sna 'bras khang nas 'bul dgos ltar sa phag (1959)lo tsha lu ma sngon mngags zin pa 'byor zhing / lha sar 'bul bar 'bras khang ngo ma bcar dgos rung skabs der khams jag nas phar tshur 'grul bzhud bkag bskyil byed 'dug pas khams jag gi phogs khang sar phyin te gnas lugs zhib phra bshad kyang nyan 'jog ma byas par khyod gnyis 'gro rgyu 'grigs min zer zhing /shing 'bras ni gzim chung 'gag tu 'bul dgos blos 'gan bzod min la phogs khang nas rtsis len gyis dgung gsar gong du nor gling gzim chung 'gag tu 'bul thub pa byed dgos zhes bshad par/ 'ba' ba dbang 'dus zer ba des ‘‘nga tshos 'bul rgyu 'grigs min la khyod tsho'i g.yog po gcig btang na 'thus shing / lam 'khel khag la bkag med shar gtong dgos pa'i ngos sbyor yi ge sprad chog mi’ces zer bas kho pa tsho'i 'dod mthun ltar g.yog po gcig 'bul bar gtong dgos byung / sa phag lo gsar gnyal du 'khel zhing /mkhan chung bkras khang pa dang / rtsis dpon rnam gling pa/ lho spyi mkhan chung tsha thor gzhon pa/ lho spyi gzhon pa shod drung las tshan 'byor rgyas pa/ lhun rtse rdzong rtse drung ngag dbang chos bzang dang / shod drung lcog spe ba/ mtsho sna 'bras khang phran lha dbang tshe ring dang / phyag na rdo rje rig 'dzin bcas lo gsar mnyam gtong gis mgron 'bod byed res byas/ tshes bzhi nyin phran lha tshe'i spun mched gnyal smad bde skyid gling du lo gsar gtong bar yong dgos nan brjod ltar 'bras khang ngo g.yog mi brgyad phyin nas nyin bdun bsdad pa lung khug grong gseb yin na'ang kan tshal sogs sne kha 'dzoms pas bdun phrag gcig gi ring gsol ston gzab rgyas dang / chang rag zhal tog rtsed chas mā cang dang / bod sbag sho/ skad par 'khor lor bcug pa'i stod gzhas dang / rnam thar/ rgya gzhas rnying pa ‘‘mi la'i phan ’’gyi gzhas skad 117

grags can/ sgra snyan/ pi wang / yang chin/ gling bu bcas rol cha 'dzoms pa sogs kyi rtsed 'jo'i dga' ston la rol/ yang gnyal smad zhol chung 'og ma nas lo gsar mgron 'bod byas pa bzhin nyin bdun bsdad par gong bzhin rtsed 'jo'i dga' ston la rol/ de nas lhun rtse rdzong zhol du phyir log byas par sna dkar rtse rdzong sdod nas/ dwags kong rdzong khag yan rdzong gzhis nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rdzong dpon dang / gtso 'thus bcas lhun rtser 'du 'dzoms tshogs 'du tshogs 'dug pa phran 'bras khang gnyis kyang tshogs 'dur yong dgos zer yang tshogs 'du'i snying don rdzong gzhi so so'i khongs nas yul dmag go thang bsdu bskong byed rgyu yin tshod de ltar yin tshe phran mtsho 'bras gnyis la ngo g.yog mi bcu las gzhan khyab khongs gang yang med gshis/ nga tsho ngo g.yog bcu pos spyi mtshungs zhu rgyu zhes bshad de tshogs 'dur 'gro dgos mtshobyung / mtsho 'bras khongs lhun rtse tshwa sgrub pas gnyal sde drug tshong 'dus la sngar srol rgya zog lha sa nas nyos te gnyal du tshong thabs byed dgos la brten khams jag phogs khang la bskyod de phran gnyis rgya zog nyo sgrub dang / bla phyag las khungs nas ma rtsa zhu rgyu bcas kyi don du lha sar 'phral bskyod ma byas tshe lo 'khor gcig gi tshong 'thab la skyon gnod chen po yod tshul bshad par lha sa nas lho khar phyir log yong rgyu'i 'gan len khag theg dgos lugs zer ba ltar gnyal smad bde skyid dang / zhol chung 'og ma gnyis nas khag theg gis gan rgya bzhag ste lha sar bskyod chog pa byung / khra 'brug tu 'byor skabs sa gnas rgan pos brjod gsal rtsed thang shar rgyud sgang sbu'u zhes par bcings 'grol dpon dmag yod khul dang / chu'i nub phyogs batren thang g.yu'i lha khang yas mas su 'byor bsdad kyi khams jag dbar me mda' 'phen res kyi rkyen pas yar mar 'grul bzhud byed thabs dka' lugs dang / de bas 'phyod phu brgyud la chen brgyab na rnam sras gling gi phur slebs rgyu/ la de la thag ring la 118

sa rong tsub tsam yod lugs sogs bshad byung bar the tshom ngang shanas mur btsan thang phyogs nas 'ong ba'i mi zhig gis brjod gsal khams dmag rnams mdang dgong lho kha gong dkar du 'gro dgos kyi yi ge 'byor te tshang ma thon song zer yang / yid ches dka' bas dgong dro nyi ma bzhud tsam la khra 'brug nas lho phyogs thon khul gyis rag rtsis pa'i nub nas gtsang chu brgal te btsan thang du 'byor skabs khams jag mi gcig kyang bsdad mi 'dugabatsan thang g.yu'i lha khang du tshwa phog rgyab/ bya sar gnyid sha sbud tsam byas/de nas thon te rnam sras gling la 'byor pa dang rta drel rnams sga chas bshus te lhod lhod ngang tsha phog —rgyag bzhin skabs rgan po nas tā la'i bla ma sbin grol gling la phebs kyi yod lugs zer yang dkrog gtam yin 'dra snyam pa byung /'on kyang za 'thung myur bar byas nas thon/ gra phyir 'byor dus sbir gtam tsam las phebs sgrig sogs gang yang mi 'dug gra nang du ma 'byor tsam la gra nang nub phyogs gzhung lam nas thal rlung nam mkha' gang ba lta bu rgyang ring du 'phyur ba je nyer 'gro skabs tā la'i bla ma ston 'khor gra thang du phebs song /119

dgu/ rgya gar duwos byol phyin pa'i skor/1 lam bar gyi gnas tshul/nga tsho ngo g.yog rnams gra nang sa tshigs sgrig khang du 'byor 'phral ngas g.yog po gcig 'khrid de gra thang bka' shag sar bskyod nas lo gsar mdzad sgor bcar ma thub pa'i lo rgyus skor sogs bshad par/ tā la'i bla ma ston 'khor ‘‘snga 'phros lho kha khul du g.yol bzhugs gnang rgyu glo bur du phebs skabs bka' shag mgron drung gcig kyang med pas khyod rang la bka' drung bsko gzhag song zhing / bka' drung las 'khur gyis chibs zhabs khongs bcar dgos ’’zhes brjod byung / skabs der lha sar yod pa'i bza' zla bu phrug kha bral ma dgos tsam byung na snyam yang chibs zhabs khongs ma phyin na khams jag gis gsod rdung bcom 'phrog byed rgyu nyag gcig las ma 'das par brten bka' drung gi las 'khur blangs nas chibs zhabs khongs 'gro rgyu dang len byed dgos byung zhing / sgrig khang du phyir log gis phyag sbrel jo lags rdor rin lags su de don gnas lugs bshad pa dang / ‘‘khyod rang yang lha sa phyogs su thar thabs med gshis chibs zhabs lhan bcar 'gab lugs gsungs kyi 'dug kyang 'gro sdod ji byed khyod rang gis 'dod mos gnang 'thus ’rizhes brjod par/ ‘‘khong gis khyod rang gang du phebs par mnyam bcar zhu rgyu yin ’lugs brjod byung / kho bos ‘‘bka' shag nas gnas skabs lho kha khul du bzhugs 'jags gnang rgyu yin tshul zer yang /120

ngas bsams na phal cher rgya gar du phebs dgos mi yong ngam snyam zhing /galasrid rgya gar la phebs na zhabs 'bring khongs su tshud na las/ de min rang kha rang gso'i las ka zhig bya rgyu las ma 'das par rang res skad ni mi shes/ lag rtsal gyi shes yon ni med/ mtha' mar lam bzo dang ku li rgyugs rgyur nges pas de skabs 'gyod pa med pa zhig dgos kyi red ’’ces bshad par/khong gis ‘‘ku li rgyugs dgos byung yang kha 'phangs zhus mi yong mnyam bcar zhu gi yin mimizer te mnyam du bskyod/ de'i phyi nyin zhogs pa lnga po za po la rgyab nasaspyan g.yas la tsha phog dang / 'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen du zhag sar phebs rjes zin pa bskyod/ de nub nas bzung sa dbang zur khang gis bod kyi lo rgyus skor sogs dang 'brel rgya gar gzhung la skyabs bcol rogs ram la brten nas bden rgyab gnas lugs zhu bar ngal ba khyad bsad kyis phebs lugs sogs zin bris brgyab pa rnams phran la gtsang bshus byed bcug pas dgong mo zhag pa gar 'khel la dgong ltar mtshan mo yi ge bshu 'bri kho na byed dgos stabs nyin mo 'grul bzhud skabs gnyid cog thib thib kyis rta steng nas lhung grabs thengs mang byas byung / 'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen dgon nas yar stod chos sde gong dang / e chu mdo rgyang / gnyal sho po mkhar steng dgon brgyud g.yul rgyal lhun rtse rdzong du 'byor/ der nyin gsum bzhugs ring de gar rten 'brel gzab gsol zhig kyang byas thog rdzong gzhis khag la'ang lha sar zing 'khrug gis rkyen pas da cha g.yul rgyal lhun rtser ‘phubyes srid gzhung ’’gsar du tshugs pa yin na gnyan zhu sogs lhun rtse bka' shag tu 'bul dgos zhes pa'i dril bsgrags bka' rgya zhig kyang 'grems spel byas pa dang / srid tshab lta bur kun gling dza sag 'od zer rgyal mtshan dang / de 'og bka' tshab lta bur mkhan chung dngos gzhi thub bstan bsam mchog dang /mda' dpon bkra shis dpal ra ba/ mdo mkhar sras/ gzhan yang gzhung 121

zhabs 'ga' shas bcas la byed sgo bkod khyab byas te tā la'i bla ma ston 'khor dang srung dmag bcas lhun rtse nas bya yul brgyud mtsho sna dgon pa rtser phebs pa dang / de'i sang nyin legs po la brgal nas nags gseb stug po zhig tu slebs/ legs por bca' zhag gsum ngal gsos te bzhugs skabs/ rtse drung blo bzang ye shes ra ma sgang la shor 'das kyi bsngo rten gser ṭam gcig 'byor pa bka' shag brgyud phul/ 1959lo'i zla 3tshes 19nyin legs po nas tā la'i bla ma sna lo dkar po zhig la bcibs te hin bod sa mtshams chu dwangs mor phebs skabs rgya gar gzhung gi sku tshab dang / rta dbang khul gyi rdzong dpon phebs bsur bcar/ chu dwangs mor gsol tsha sar bod phyogs nas 'phrin yig cig 'byor gsal kun gling dza sag dang / mkhan chung rta rab sogs mi brgyad phebs rjes bcar 'thus gsal don ltar sa mtshams 'go khrid la bkag med shar gtong yong ba gsungs/ khong tshos mi ngo shes min la brten chibs zhabs khongs nas mi gcig 'jog dgos zhus song bas phran lha dbang tshe ring sdod dgos byung / byes bka' shag nang bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / bka' blon las rogs shan kha ba 'gyur med rdo rje/ bka' blon las tshab sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa/ bka' tshab dga' brang blo bzang rin chen/ kun gling dza sag 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ sku bcar mkhan drung tā bla ma rong rnam sras thub bstan nor bzang / rtse mkhan mgron che ba pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan bcas dbang tshad 'dra mnyam gyis bka' shag 'tshogs kyi 'dug phran bka' drung gi las 'khur byed bzhin par sa mtshams su sdod dgos brjod mkhan pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan yin pa dang /khong ni bka' bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mi rgyud yin pas/ mi dmangs khrod nas gzhung zhabs zhu mkhan la sdang zug dang mthong chung byed mkhan zhig yin pa ma zad/ phran lha sa slob grwa 'bring ba'i dge rgan byed dus slob grwa'i las 'gan 122

hur bskyod sgrub par gung khran tang yon las lhag lugs bshad pa sogs mi dga' ba byed kyi yod/ bka' shag nas nyin bdun song mtshams mkhan chung rta ra ba can sa mtshams su 'byor rgyu red ces zer byung / phran nas rgya gar sa srung 'go dmag la lag rtags ro do gcig dang / phyur zhib smyug po gru bzhi gang / phyur skam 'phreng shal bcu bcas sprad/ khong tsho mi brgyad ma 'byor gong 'bras blo gling mkhan po pad+ma rgyal mtshan dang / 'ba' la kha sprul sku/gzhan yang grwa pa nyi shu rtsa lnga bcas chu dwangs mor 'byor brwa sne len byas/khong tsho ming tho'i nang med kyang 'di rnams 'bras spungs dgon pa'i mkhan po bla sprul dang / dge 'dun dngos 'brel yin pas rgya gar nang du bskyod 'thus chog pa zhes bshad de 'gan len rang nas byas/ de'i gnangs nyin gnas chung sku rten dang / dga' gdong sku rten sogs mi bcu drug 'byor pa 'di rnams kyang 'phral gtong byed rogs zhes lab par sa srung pas rgya gar gzhung nas nga tsho sa srung tshor bka' nan che bas ming tho nang gsal las de min btang na nyen 'gan che lugs zer yang phran nas u nan bshad pas btang tsam byung / nyin bdun song nyin kun gling dza sag dang / mkhan chung rta ra ba/tsha thor mkhan chung rgan pa/ bar zhi rje drung / rtse drung skal bzang kun dga' sogs ngo g.yog mi grangs nyi shu skor zhig 'byor/ khong tshos da dung bod mi mang po rjes su yong lugs zer stabs phran rang sa mtshams su gnas skabs bsdad na mi mang por phan thogs yong rgyur bsams/ chu dwangs mor sdod rtsis byas kyang rgya gar sa srung 'go khrid des khyed rang gi las 'gan yod pa'i mi rnams 'byor zin pas da cha khyed rang 'dir bsdad na nga tsho'ang yag po yong ba mi 'dug khong tsho'i mnyam du 'gro dgos zer don ltar rta dbang phyogs su mnyam thon byas/ kun gling dza sag nas khyed rang 'brug yul du bskyod de nga'i rta sngon po de 'brug rgyal por phul nas bod mir rogs ram yod pa zhu dgos 123

zer bas 'gro rgyu'i khas len byas kyang / rjes su gzhan la mngags 'dug nga tsho rta dbang du 'byor pa dang rgya gar gzhung gi sne len ched btsugs kyis 'bras gro zhib dang / ja/ bye ma ka ra/ 'o rtsam/ mar/ tshwa/ tshal sna tshogs sogs kyi skyob gso yang sprad byung / kun gling dza sag sogs rta dbang du nyin shas ngal gso sdod rtsis 'dug kyang / bka' shag gi yig cha phran la yod stabs phran ngo g.yog gnyis 'bum di lar bzhugs sgar gyi phebs rjes zin pa shar bskyod byas/ 'bum di la nas 'grul 'khor nang chibs zhabs khongs nas mi re gnyis shong mi 'dug bka' shag nas khyod rang zhabs gras rnams kyi 'go 'tsho byas te rlangs 'khor kha lo pa sdod gnas mnyam du bsdad 'thus zer zhing /phran rang chung dus rgya gar la thengs re zung 'gro myong yod stabs rgya gar gyi za skad 'thung skad phran bu shes pa des phan thogs chen po byung / 'bum di la nas ca gu khyim du zhag sdod byas/ de'i sang nyin snga dro nags ri babs mtshams phu kril zhes par rgya gar gzhung gi dmag sgar zhig nas gsol tsha phebs sgrig byas 'dug de nas ta'i ci spur me 'khor 'bab tshugs su 'byor skabs rgya gar gzhung gi sku tshab dpon rigs dang phyi rgyal gyi gsar 'god pa'ang mang po 'byor 'dug dgong dro ta'i ci spur nas ri li dmigs bsal gra sgrig byas 'dug par tā la'i bla ma dang / bka' blon/ de min nga tsho chibs zhabs nyin mtshan gsum pa'i thog shi li gu rir 'byor skabs ka rdor khul gyi bod rigs mang po zhig kyang phebs bsur slebs 'dug ta'i ci spur nas bzung nyin mtshan brgyad kyi thog ḍas ra ḍon du 'byor/ de gar ri li'i 'bab tshugs su rgya gar gzhung gi sku tshab dpon rigs khag gis phebs bsu dang bcas mo ṭa'i nang ma' su'u ri bzhugs sgar phebs sgrig sar phebs 'byor byung song / de'i sang nyin rgya gar gyi srid blon ne he ru tā la'i bla ma mjal 'phrad la phebs song bar bka' blon gtsos chibs zhabs rnams nas gral 124

bstar 'grigs pos gus 'dud zhus par srid blon ne he rus phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar te gus 'dud bzhes song / ma' su'u ri zhes pa hi ma la'i ri rgyud kyi ri steng la grong khyer zhig chags 'dug pa grong khyer de nas mal le gsum tsam gyi sar rgya gar ba 'byor ldan zhig gi ku ṭi red ces pa zhig 'dug pa der bag phebs dngos gtsang zhig 'dug cing / gsol thab thad rgya gar gzhung nas chibs zhabs ngo ma spyir thab chung tsho gcig dang / zhabs gras spyir thab chen tsho gcig bcas khag gnyis las mi 'dug gsol thab skor mgron che pha lhas bkod sgrig byed kyi 'dug pas/ ha cang ya mtshan pa zhig la pha lhas phran lha dbang tshe ring zhabs gras tsho'i thab chen khongs ming 'god byas 'dug cing / nga mi dmangs phal pa'i phru gus bka' drung sogs kyi las 'khur byed par pha lha gting nas mi dga' ba byung shag pha lhas phran la mthong chung snga phyir byas kyang mi yul du yul gyar thabs rdugs kyi gnas dus la brten ngas rnam 'gyur ngan pa tsam bstan pa med/2 rgya gar du 'byor rjes sne len gyi las don sgrub pa/nyin zhig bka' shag nas bkod khyab byas don/ ‘‘bod lho kha khul yod dmag mi rnams la ka spug nas gyon chas dang ja sogs mkho sgrub kyis khyod rang lho kha khul du las don sgrub par 'gro dgos mi’zhes zer don ltar 'gro rgyur khas len byas kyang de nas nyin 'ga' song mtshams bcings 'grol dmag mtsho snar phebs 'byor zin lugs rgya gar rlungs 'phrin nang khyab bsgrags byas song bas ka sbug tu 'gro rgyu'ang phyir 'then byas/ mon rta dbang brgyud bod mi mang po zhig bros byol du yong lugs gleng grags che bar brten yul gyar srid gzhung gi tshogs 'dus bsko gzhag gtan 'khel byas don ltar bka' blon 125

zur khang pa dang / kun gling dza sag sku srung mda' dpon stag lha phun tshogs bkra shis/ skad bsgyur 'phreng ring rim bzhi rig 'dzin rnam rgyal/phran lha dbang tshe ring bcas ngo g.yog mi bcu gnyis rgya gar shar me sa ma rir bod mi yong mkhan la sne len du bskyod cing / me sa ma rir rgya gar gzhung nas skyabs bcol bod mi'i 'phral sel sdod gnas mi grangs drug cu re shong ba'i smyug khang khang mig brgya dang bcu med bzhi gsar rgyag byas khul der dmag sgar zhig kyang bzhag 'dug dmag dpon 'jam sab zhes pas sne len ja mngar mo blugs thog dgong dro'i lto chas 'bras gro zhib gang dga' sprod rgyu byas don sa srib mtshams 'bras gro zhib phran bu dang / tshal zho khog dang /long ko'o pad tshal/ tsong bcas bskyal te ‘‘zhal lag mchod rogs gnang ’’zer bas nged tsho tshang ma gad mo shor/ nga tshor bskol chas ha yang sogs gang yang med pas de nub zhal tog sbi si ku spring zas rjes smyug khang nang smyug ma'i gdan khri yug sbrel steng so so'i nyal 'jo ma gtogs gang yang med par nyal/phyi nyin zhogs pa phran ngo g.yog gnyis snga langs kyis rgya gar gyi dmag sgar nang phyin nas chu len snod sba kring gnyis dang / smyug ma'i phrag rgyug gcig bskol chas ha yang che chung gnyis/ ha yang khog ldir gcig bcas g.yar/ lho chu len yul ni mal le gnyis trem sar grong gseb kyi khron pa zhig nas len par 'gro dgos pa dang / nga'i g.yog por phrag rgyug rgyag rgyu'i goms gshis med stabs gom pa spo ma thub pa/ nga rang de sngon phebs byams 'degs 'dren byed myong yod stabs chu phrag steng du skyon med bde bgrod ngang khyer te blangs/dmag dpon 'dam sab la me shing slong nas zhogs ja bskol te tshang mar blugs/ 'dam sab nas brjod don gnangs nyin bod nas bla ma dge 'dun mi grangs nyis brgya skor zhig 'byor rgyur khong tshor zhal lag sha 'bras gtong dgos zer nas 'bras dang / zhog khog do po kha shas dang / tshwa/ ja spa ti/126

'o rtsam/ me shing / ha yang / khog ma dang / khog ldir/ chu snod lcags spring sogs ldeng nges sprad byung / smyug khang khag bzhi so sor me khag re gtong rgyur phyogs bgos kyis ja dang sha 'bras gtong rgyu byas shing / nga'i g.yog po bsam gtan de snga shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor gyi grwa btsun yin gshis ja bskol shes pa phud/ de byings gzim dpon rnams kha lag bzo mi shes mkhan zhe gcig red 'dug nga rang gcig pus thab tsho gcig 'gan len byas pa dang /de min zhabs gras gnyis rer thab re rtsis sprod kyis sha 'bras gtong rtsis byas kyang rang gzhan tshang mas 'bras 'tsho stangs ma shes pas 'bras thug tu 'gyur/gzhung dngul thog nas tshur zhor ka sbug nas nyos pa'i phag kring sgam do kha shas yod pa de nas thug rdor brgyab ste tsha ba'i nang 'bras thug gtong rgyu 'khel zhing / pha bong kha sprul skus gtsos bla ma dge 'dun nyis brgya brgal bar nga rang gcig pus thug pa sba kring nang smyug khang so sor 'or 'dren byas/ stabs legs pa zhig la de nyin char pa sim sim rgyun mi chad par babs stabs gnam bsil drod snyom po byung bas tshang mas bzhes thug spro po zhe drag byung zer gyi 'dug de'i sang nyin 'dam sab kyi 'go khrid 'og phogs khang las byed rgya gar ba kha shas 'dug pa khong tsho'i sa nas mi grangs drug cu yod pa'i thab khag rer bskol chas ha yang khebs ldan che ba gsum re dang khog ldir gnyis re/chu snod sba kring gnyis re/ mi rer ha yang phor pa lung yod re bcas dang /'bras/ gro zhib/ rda li/ ja/ sha/ mar spring / 'o rtsam/ sha sman/ tshal sna tshogs/ si pan/ yi tsi/ me shing / mu zi sogs sne kha nyi shu rtsa gnyis bdun phrag rer thengs re sprod len byas/ de nas nyin re bzhin bod mi je mang 'byor rim bzhin mi grangs drug cu la khang pa re dang bskol chas sogs gong bzhin rtsis sprod dang / rgya gar gzhung nas sman khang ched mngags btsugs nas tshang ma 'byor rim bzhin brtag dpyad sman bcos dang gyon chas rnying pa 127

dri can rnams chur btsos ras kyi stod thung gu thung re dang / khrus chas a cor yi rtsi re sprad/ de ltar nyin re bzhin mi 'byor tho 'god rgyu/ khang pa dang /za chas/ sman bcos bya rgyu sogs gang ci'i blta rtogs 'gan 'khur phran lha dbang tshe ring gcig pus byed dgos pas rgya 'ub mi 'dus pa byung dus/ zur khang dang kun gling dza sag gnyis kyis gros 'go bton te skyabs bcol khongs nas mi go chod khag la re 'dun bton nas mi gnyis re yod pa'i sne len las don khang dang / 'phrod bsten sman bcos las khang / khang pa'i las khang /phogs thob sprod len las khang / rta drel rtsis len las khang / dngul rda yang dang / ṭam dkar sogs dngul chas spus 'tshong bya rgyu'i las khang bcas btsugs nas khag bgos kyis las 'gan sprad pa dang / don gcod spyi khyab las khang nas rgya gar gzhung dang / phran lha dbang tshe ring las khang khag gi 'go khrid mnyam du las 'gan 'khur dgos pa'i las 'gan sprad don/ las don khag don gcod las khungs kyi tshab byas nas khyab bsgrags bya rgyu dang /gzhung sger sbrag yig khag rtsis len khungs sprod bya rgyu sogs gar dgos lta bu byas pa dpen na/ las khungs tsho khag gnyis nye 'gram la yod kyang / smyug khang tsho khag gcig mal le gsum gyi sa la yod cing der brda skyel 'gro skabs dang thog rkang thang du thengs mang bskyod pa dang / de rjes don gcod khang nas rkang 'khor gcig nyos stabs dka' ngal sel te gnas tshul lan brda sprod par bskyod skabs rkang 'khor bzhon rgyu yod kyang nyam chung dma' sa bzung nas ngag snyan pos rnam pa lhan rgyas la zhu rgyur/ da lta don gcod khang nas bka' phebs dgongs don 'di dang 'di zhes gsungs 'dug na tshang mas dgongs 'jags gnang rogs gnang zhes gang mkhas mkhas shod kyi yod/'on kyang chu sgang khongs kyi smyug khang kha shas nang na la ma'i rgya lcog bzos te mā cang rgyab nas sdod mkhan kha shas kyis nyan 'jog de tsam byed kyi mi 'dug de 128

nas nyin gcig kun gling dza sag nas khyod rang sang nyin 'bum di lar bskyod de mtsho sna rdzong gnyis dang / chu sgang phogs khang mkhar chen phyag mdzod can mi gnyis bcas nas rta dbang dang / 'bum la khul sogs la bod nas 'byor ba'i mi rnams kyi 'go 'don 'tsho skyong gi 'gan bskur thog rgya gar gzhung gi 'bum la spo li hri kar la khong tsho bzhi ngo sprod dang 'brel las don mngags cha byed dgos zer don ltar de'i sang nyin rang 'jib 'khor nang bsdad nas phran ngo g.yog gnyis 'bum lar thon/ khong tsho rtsad gcod kyis bkod mngagasakhyas te spo li hri kar sar mnyam 'khrid kyis ngo sprod sogs byed par nyin gsum 'gor/ phran ngo g.yog gnyis phyir log skabs lam bzo tshugs te 'khor lo'i 'grul bzhud 'gag 'dug par/ spo li hri kar la zhus par khong gis nga rang la kun gling dza sag nas ster ba'i pho rta rkyang po de las gzhan dag la rta yod pa ma red/ nga'i rta de khyod rang gi bzhon rta byed/ khyod rang gi g.yog po rkang thang la 'gro dgos byed kyi red/ gzhan gyi thabs shes med lugs zer byung don ltar khong gi rta der ngos gnyis kyi za nyal bkal nas thon/me sa ma ri bar nyin gsum 'gor/ dgong mo gcig gnas tshang dang lto chas gang yang med sa zhig la nyal dgos byung / me sa ma rir phyir 'byor skabs kun gling dza sag ma su rir bskyod dgos byung 'dug pas/ phran la kun gling dza sag nas yi ge zhig bzhag pa'i nang ‘‘'bum di'i las don skor don gcod gsar pa bzhi la zhib mngags thog khyod rang gis da bar las 'gan dngul gnyer byas pa'i rtsis khra kha gsal bkod 'khyer gyis bzhugs sgar du yong dgos ’’zhes 'khod 'dug kyang / de gar don gcod pa gsar pa de snga lhun rtse rdzong rtse drung ngag dbang chos bzang sogs rtse drung bzhis phran la khyod rang rgyus babs kyis sdod rogs zhes zer don de gar zla ba gcig ring bsdad de rgyus babs byed 'os gang thub byas/ de nas pha lha mgron che me sa ma rir 'byor te 129

brjod gsal ‘‘khyod rang me sa ma rir rang 'jags sdod dgos pa las bzhugs sgar du log na 'grigs min ’’zhes gnas tshul dri ba tsam med pa'i btsan bka' gtong rkyang byas par blo pham chen po byung yang / bzod bsran ngag 'jam gyis ‘‘ngas da bar dngul gnyer zhus pa'i rtses khra 'phral 'bul gyis zhib rtsis zhu bar ma bcar thabs med yin ’rizhes brjod nas kho rang phyir log 'gro nyin der phran rang me 'khor nang ma su rir bskyod/ ma su rir tā la'i bla ma mjal khar bcar 'thus kyi gnangs brda snyan seng zhus par de nyin rang mjal kha btang byung bas/ gus rang gi sngar gyi gnas tshul lam tsam dang / lhag par nye char me sa ma rir zur khang dang / kun gling dza sag sku srung mda' dpon/ gsung bsgyur phreng ring / bkras mthong tshe dbang chos rgyal/ phur bsam/ gus rang bcas kyis hur bskyed byas lugs rnams g.yo zol med par snyan gsol dang 'brel rang nas me sa ma ri'i sne len don gcod las khungs kyi dngul gnyer byas pa'i rtsis khra dang dgos dngul lhag ma rnams don gcod kun gling dza sag la rtsis sprod khams dwangs byas/3 zlos gar sgrig 'dzugs dang 'khrab ston gyi las ka byas pa/bka' shag tu bka' drung las 'khur rang 'jags byed mur nyin gcig bka' shag shod pa las tshan shod drung bar mtsho rdo rje don grub dang / rtse drung skal bzang kun dga'/ shod drung spyi lcags bkra shis rdo rje/ phyag nang rdo rje rig 'dzin/ gus rang bcas bka' shag tu 'gugs 'bod kyis ‘‘dril bsgrags la shugs snon rgyag ched zlos gar zhig 'dzugs thub na phan rlabs chen po yong nges la bka' shag nas de don 'phral du lag bstar thub pa byed dgos zhes tā la'i bla mas bka' phebs gshis khyod rang rnams ka spug tu 130

bskyod nas gzhung bskos min khul gsang ba'i sgo nas zlos gar zhig 'go 'dzugs thub pa'i 'khur len dgos rgyur phogs thob kyang go babs la gzhigs pa'i las tshan bar mtsho bar zla rer hin sgor brgya dang bcu med lnga re dang / rtse drung skal kun dang / shod drung spyi lcags so sor zla rer hin sgor brgya re/ phyag nang gnyis so sor hin sgor drug cu tham pa re bcas shes rig las khungs brgyud nas sprod rgyur de don tshang mas 'phyar ba gru 'degs dgos rgyu ’rizhes bka' phab byung / nged rnams phyir thon mtshams phran nas las sbrel tshor ka sbug tu tshong don las byar lo mang sdod myong yod pa'i shod drung nor nang ngag dbang nor bu ni bod kyi rol cha sne mang shes pa'i mkhas pa zhig yin pa dang / khong gi bu phrug kha shas yod pa de rnams kyis kyang rgya gar skad dang /dbyin skad legs shes la song nor nang nga tsho'i 'go 'dzin la bsko gzhag yod pa zhes zhus na rang re'i las don bsgrub rgyur phan thogs chen po yong nges red ces bshad par/ khong tshos kyang de 'dra byung na gang legs yong ba 'dug zer bas/ bar mtsho ba dang / ngos gnyis bka' shag tu phyin nas de don gnas lugs bshad par/ sa dbang sne shar ba nas ‘‘'o red nor nang lags dngos gnas rol cha dang zhabs bro mkhas pa red/ de gas 'grigs kyi ma red pas ’ zhes bshad song bar bka' blon gzhan tshang ma mos mthun gyis nor nang bka' shag tu bskong nas zlos gar 'go 'dzin byed dgos pa'i bkod khyab byas 'dug de tshonas nga tsho 'dzoms sar nor nang yong ste ngo nag khro mdangs dang bcas ‘‘khyod tshos mi zhu dgu zhu zhus nas nga la zlos gar 'go 'dzin byed dgos zhes bka' phebs byung yang / ngas la/ la/ zhus pa las khas len zhu rgyu ma byung / nga ni gzhung don las ka lta zhog sger don yang 'jon gyi med/ngas nyin dgung ma zin bar nyal rgyu dang / langs nas rtsed mo mā cang rgyag rgyu/tha mag nyal thag 'then rgyu bcas kho na las gzhan gang yang byed thub kyi med 131

la yong gi yang ma red do ’’zhes sna shu rgyab ste tha mag 'then nas bsdad song /gus pas ‘‘sku ngo / gang yang gnang gi ma red/ sku ngo nas rgyus babs bka' slob gnang na zhabs zhu nga tshos hur bskyod zhus chog gi red ’’ces bshad par/‘‘ngas bka' slob kyang mi yong ngo ’’zhes brjod nas kha gcus te bsdad song /nga tsho gnangs nyin ka sbug tu thon rgyu byas shing / bka' drung gsar pa rtse drung shan kha ba dge legs dar rgyas dang / shod drung bar mtsho rgan pa bsod nams dpal 'byor gnyis la bsko gzhag byas 'dug gshis/ khong gnyis la bka' shag gi yig cha rnams rtsis sprod byas/ nga tsho ma su ri nas thon te ḍas ra ḍos nas me 'khor nang zhugs dus ka sbug phyogs la thon mkhan de snga'i gzhung zhabs mi grangs bcu gsum 'khor khang gcig nang mnyam du 'dug cing / de dag gi khongs nas rtse drung skal kun dang / blo bzang ye shes gnyis nas ‘‘rang re ka sbug tu slebs nas dbyin ji'i skad yig las zhor slob sbyong byed thub na ga 'dra 'dug gam ’mizhes gros 'go bton song bar tshang mas yag po 'dug ces dga' spro chen pos mos mthun byung song / nyin mtshan kha shas song mtshams shi li gu lir 'byor nyin phran gyis khong tshor kha nyin las zhor dbyin ji'i skad yig slob sbyong bya rgyur tshang ma dgongs mthun byung song ba de ri li'i nang lus rgyur gtan 'khel 'dug ces bshad par/ bkras khang mkhan chung thub bstan bsam mchog nas de gar lus kyi ma red/ lus pas 'grigs kyi ma red ces bshad song / de skor gtso bo'i 'khuralen byed po gros 'go 'don mkhan rnam gnyis nas byas na legs lugs phran nas bsam 'char bshad par tshang mas de rang yin no zhes mos mthun byung song / nga tsho ka sbug tu spyi lo 1959lo'i zla 8tshes shar la 'byor zhing skabs der ‘‘'dzam gling khrims dpon tshogs pa ’’zhes pa zhig rgya gar gyi khrims dpon spu sham tam las rogs dang bcas rdo rje gling du 'byor yod pas bka' shag nas kho tshor 'brel gtug byed 132

mkhan rim bzhi 'phreng ring rig 'dzin rnam rgyal dang / las tshan sa 'du rin chen/ las rogs su mkhan chung bkras khang thub bstan bsam mchog dang /mda' dpon bkra shis dpal ra ba/ phran lha dbang tshe ring bcas bsko gzhag byas 'dug pas nged tsho rdor gling du ched bskyod kyis bdun phrag gnyis tsam 'gor/ de nas phran rdor gling nas ka sbug tu bskyod 'byor gyi phyi nyin ka spug na'u mal le ku trir nor nang sdod shag tu bskyod nas nga tsho'i zlos gar 'go 'dzugs byed phyogs ji 'gab skul lcag byed skabs nor nang nas ‘‘jo lags/brel 'tshub byed yag yod pa ma red/ bka' shag gis bzhugs gdan sgang gi bka' mol kho na da lta'ang gnang gi yod pa red/ nga tshor dgos yag dngul pad shag gcig kyang med par zlos gar btsugs gsungs pa gang 'dra zer 'dzugs thub kyi red dam/ rgya gar la ni 'gul 'gul byas tshad la dngul sprod dgos kyi red/ byas tsang 'grub thabs 'dug gam/ de bas nga rang tsho zla re thengs re tsam tshogs tsam tshogs tsam bya rgyu las yod pa ma red ’’ces zer gyin 'dug de mur khong tsho mā cang 'go tshugs song / phran la'ang rtsed do zer ba'i zi shon gcig brgyab ste log 'gro khar/ phran nas ‘‘da res kyi zlos gar 'dzugs rgyu de tā la'i bla ma'i dgongs gzhi dngos 'brel yin pa las bka' shag gis bzos pa min nges dang / sa dbang sne shar nas kyang gus par da res gzab gzab byed dgos ’’zhes nang gnas gsungs byung bas/ de skor ji 'gab tshang 'dzoms bka' mol gnang na legs tshul bshad par nor nang pas ‘‘'o na nyin gcig 'dzoms chog ’’zer/ phran nas ‘‘gnangs nyin gza' tshes dge bas khong tshor lan brda btang na 'grigs sam ’’zhes bshad par de don chog lugs zer don ltar tshang mar gnangs nyin nor nang bzhugs sar dus 'dzoms dgos pa'i lan brda btang don de'i gnangs nyin tshang 'dzoms gros bsdur gyis rol cha sgra snyan dang / pi wang phra sbom/ yang cin/ gling bu 133

bcas dgos gal che bas g.yar khungs yod med nor nang la dris pas/ ka sbug tu sdod mkhan lha sa ba i si bur sgra snyan dang / pi wang phra sbom gnyis ka yod pa las de min su la'ang med lugs zer bas/ ‘‘byas na i si bu la khyed nas 'brel ba gnang rogs ’’bshad par/ nga tsho tshang ma 'gro zhes bshad don tshang ma mnyam bskyod kyis i si bu'i nang du 'gro skabs khong ni nad mnar gyis mal du lus 'dug pa dang / rol cha rnams chag skyon zhe gcig red 'dug kyang / i si bus ‘‘nyams gso khyed tshos gnang na g.yar po phul chog nga ni deng sang nyam thag dbul phongs su song bas zla re g.yar gla phran bu re gnang rogs ’’zhes zer 'dug pas de don nyams gso bya rgyu dang / g.yar gla ji dgos lab rogs bshad par zla re hin sgor bcu re dgos zer don bzhin sprod rgyu byas te 'khyer yong nas bzo bcos su bskyal rgyu phran gyis 'gan len byas te/ de snga rtse mgron sngags pa lags kyi g.yog po chos 'phel klu sgrub zer ba ka sbug tu sngon 'byor zhig yod pa khong la rgyus babs re bcol gyis rgya gar ba'i shing bzo zhig gi sar bzo bcos bskyal bar mnyam bskyod kyis nyin bzhi'i thog len rgyu byas/ nyin lnga pa'i nyin gza' skar legs pas 'go 'dzugs byas na legs lugs skor nor nang sar phyin te tshes cha de don gtan 'khel byas/ nor nang lcam la bod lugs gsol ja dang rten 'byung gro 'bras shig gra sgrig gnang rogs bshad/ rogs pa tshor lan brda btang thog spyi lo 1959zla 8tshes 23nyin zlos gar 'go 'dzugs kyi rten 'brel dang 'brel rol cha rnams skad sgra bsgrigs/ thog mar bod gzhas nang ma ‘‘bkra la shis pa ’’dang / stod gzhas ‘‘zla ba'i gzhon nu/’’ ‘‘shar lung brag’’ ‘‘gzugs mdzes lags ’’ sogs dang / 'khrugs gzhas/ ‘‘khams gsum dbang 'dus ’’dang / ‘‘brag stod dkar po/’’ ‘‘'brug la/’’ ‘‘mtsho sna 'bras gzhong /’’ ‘‘so'o yar la mimisogs sne mang btang zhing / zhabs bro brgyab 134

bsdad par tshang ma dga' skyo gnyis 'dzoms kyi nyi ma'ang thung ngu lta bur gyur/nor nang lcam dang / a war/ zhal lta ma sogs dga' spro'i rnam 'gyur dang rang yul dran pa'i skyo shas kyi mig chu shor ba sogs byung song / de nyin gyi ja dang / zhal tog sne 'dzoms/ kha lag 'bal lhug 'du longs che ba bcas nor nang sger gyis btang song / de'i sang nyin nas bzung nyin ma gnangs char tshang 'dzoms thog nor nang dang phran lha tshe gnyis kyi rol cha'i sgra gdangs snga mo a jo rnam rgyal skabs kyi dge phrug gi srol rgyun gzhir bzung thog rtsa ba gcig pa yin yang phran bu'i mi 'dra ba bar skabs rdo rje dang / ye shes sgrol ma'i dge phrug spyi lcags bkra shis rdo rje dang / bar mtsho gzhon pa rdor don bcas kyi sgra gdangs go bsdur gyis legs cha btus/ ‘‘sgo'o mis ’’zhes pa bar gseng sgra rkyang gtong srol mang nyung gtan 'bebs sogs sngar srol mi nyams pa gzhi rtsar bzung ste sbyong brdar byas/ rtse drung skal bzang kun dga' rol cha dang / gzhas bro ma shes pa ma gtogs de min tshang mas sngar nas shes pa sha stag la song / 'dzoms thengs kha shas nang gcig gyur snyan 'jebs ldan par gyur/ ka sbug nas rma bya bla ma lags dang / chos 'phel klu sgrub gnyis rol cha gang 'tshams shes par brten khong gnyis 'dod mos ltar zlos gar nang bcug rtsa ba'i 'khrab ston byed par gzhon nu pho mo nyung mthar mi grangs bcu skor ma byung thabs med la/ tshang mas nang khul 'bod bskul byed rgyu byas/rgya gar gzhung sogs kyis dri ba 'dra byung na tshang mas gcig gyur gyis lan 'debs rgyu'i go bsdur skabs nga tsho rang rang gi lag shes sogs gang shes kyis rang kha rang gso'i 'bad brtson byed dgos kyang nga tshos lag shes sogs mi shes pa dang / lam bzo 'ul mi byed ma thub pas sngar rang yul du dga' skyid la rol te gzhas zhabs bro dang / rol cha shes mkhan nga tsho kha shas gros mol mnyam rub kyis nga tsho'i 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen sgrub ched glu gar tshogs pa zhig 135

'dzugs rgyu'i 'bad brtson bya rgyu yin lugs bshad rgyu gtan 'khel byas/nor nang sdod shag tu nga tshos zla ba gcig tsam sbyang brtson 'du 'dzoms ring nyin ltar ja kha tog nor nang nas nar gtong btang / gla phogs len khungs med pa dang mthun rkyen zhan pa ma zad/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i goms gshis su zlos gar glu gzhas gtong mkhan la mthong chung gi mig rgyun yod pa'i shugs rkyen gyis thog mar zlos gar khongs 'dzul zhugs byed mkhan ha cang dkon po byung / ka sbug tu sngon 'byor sngar tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i chibs g.yog byed myong mkhan lha sa bye jus 'ding gnas kyi pā lags bza' 'tshor bu gcig dang / bu mo gnyis 'dug pa sngar phan ngo shes kyi med rung khong pha ma gnyis la nang ma'i gnas tshul bshad par pa phas phru gu gsum car nga tsho'i khongs su gtong rgyu khas blangs song yang a mas a tsi phru gu gsum car btang na nang gi me gtong chu len nga gnyis kyis mi thub pas/ bu ngag dbang grags pa dang / bu mo rgan pa spen pa gnyis gtong 'thus zer ba de don ltar bya rgyu byas/ de'i sngon nga tsho sku drag ser skya mi bcu gsum gros bsdur byas pa'i las zhor dbyin ji'i skad yig slob sbyong bya rgyu'i skor slar yang 'dzoms mol gyis slob khang thad ‘‘cung 'bid kring ’’yid mthun slob grwa dgong dro tshugs yul der snga dro'i ring nga tsho tshugs 'thus byung bar khang gla sprod ma dgos pa dang / khang pa 'og shod la glog bzhu spar ba'i glog rin sprod rgyu nor nang nas thabs 'tshol byas/ dbyin yig dge rgan thad phran lha tshes phreng ring lha lcam ka spug tu yod pa khong la re bcol byas pas khong phyi rgyal phebs gtan 'khel 'dug kyang /khong gis ‘‘khyed tshos dbyin ji'i skad yig slob rgyur 'bad brtson gnang ba gang legs la brten nas phyi rgyal la 'gro rgyu 'then te dga' spro'i ngang bcar chog nga'i 'tsho ba ni hi ma la'i ho krel gyi bdag po grogs mos sprad tsang gla cha'ang zhu dgos kyi ma red ’’ces khas len thob stabs slob grwa nyin dang por nga 136
