tsho mi bcu gsum las med kyang slob khang nang rkub stegs grangs nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'dug pas/ sang nyin nas bod rigs gzhon nu slob sbyong byed 'dod yod mkhan ming tho len rgyu byas/ slob grwa'i 'go khrid dang dge rgan thad nga rang lha sa slob 'bring gi dge rgan byed myong yod pa dang bcas nga rang nas byed dgos zer yang / sgrig khrims blta rtogs byas 'thus las dge rgan byed par ngas dbyin ji'i skad yig mi shes stabs yong min dang sgrig khrims blta khur rogs pa gcig dgos lugs brjod pa yin/ blo bzang ye shes nged gnyis nas 'gan khur gyis ming tho rim 'god kyi nyin gsum par rkub stegs khengs/slob yon sogs sprod mi dgos par brten ming tho sprod mkhan mang po byuja yang khong tshor da lta rkub stegs khengs yod gshis stong pa byung rim bzhin ming tho snga rting gis lan brda gtong rgyu byas/ de snga'i sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung zhabs khongs nas re zung sgang thog dang / re zung sbag sar 'gro mkhan gtan 'khel bas khong tsho'i tshab ming tho snga rting gis sprad/ chu bzhi sgang drug gi skad sgyur khams phrug gser dga' zer ba des nga la dmigs bsal gyi rkub stegs dgos lugs zer bar ming tho'i ang rim la slebs mtshams lan btang chog ces bshad par ‘‘khyod tshor da lta'ang dngul dang kha btags dgos kyi yod pa red dam/ ngas skad sgyur gyi las ka dka' ngal de tsam brgyab par dmigs bsal mi sprod pa gang red dam ’’zer nas khrom dkyil la'ang skad cor gyis nyes rdung gtong grabs thengs gnyis byas byung yang / rang nas kho par ‘‘de 'dra ma zer/ gser dga'/ rim pas tshud kyi red ’’ces ngag 'jam pos bshad/ nged rang nas zlos gar dang slob grwa gnyis ka'i las don 'khur 'gan rkang len byas stabs lus sems brel la mi mang po zhig gi blo dang mthun pa'i las don bsgrub dgos pa dka' bsun che yang skyo ngal spangs te hur brtson byas pa yin/ slob grwa'i nang rta'u tshe phun gyi bu mo g.yu sgron zer ba na 137

gzhon zlos gar 'os nges shig 'dug pa la ‘‘khyod rang zlos gar slob sbyong nang yong 'dod yod dam/ yong na dga' bsu zhu rgyu yin ’’bshad par/ ‘‘nga rang yong 'dod yod de pha mar khyed nas gsung rogs ’’zer don bzhin pha ma gnyis sar bskyod de 'phros mol gyis zlos gar slob sbyong la gtong rgyu khas blangs byung / yang slob grwa'i nang phan po 'byor ldan khang gsar gyi bu ye shes rgyal mtshan zer ba na gzhon grung sha dod po gcig 'dug pa khong yang zlos gar nang yong rgyu byas/ nga'i rogs pa tshor ‘‘khyed rnam pas zlos gar nang yong mkhan thabs shes gnang rgyu ma byung ngam mi’zhes bshad par/ khong tshos ‘‘bod mi phal cher nyam thag dbul phongs la brten 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen med stabs yong mkhan mi 'dug ’’ces zer/ rma bya bla ma ngag dbang mthu stobs zlos gar la sems shugs chen po 'dug pas ngas khong la ‘‘gzhon nu pho mo gang 'tshams shig ma byung na zlos gare 'khrab ston byed thabs bral gshis/ nga tsho'i mtho rim mi sna khag la sras dang sras mo mang po 'dug kyang btang e yong snyam ste zhu yang ma phod ’’ces bshad par khong gis ‘‘de yag po 'dug khyod rang gis spyi don gal cher dgongs bzhes gnang dgos pa'i 'bod skul brda tho 'thus nan zhig bris dang / ngas khyed rang dang mnyam du yong chog ’’ces zer ba ltar 'bod skul brda tho'i nang zur khang gi bu bu mo dang / pha lha'i bu/ rnam sras gling gi bu mo/ 'bru phogs kyi bu mo/ chab mdo yab tshang gi bu mo/ sde dge gling tshang rgyal po'i bu/ dil mgo mkhyen brtse rin po che'i bu mo gnyis bcas ka sbug tu yod pa rnams la ‘‘nga tshos bod kyi rig gzhung rgyun 'dzin gces nyar ched zlos gar zhig sgrig 'dzugs byas kyang nga tshor gla phogs 'bul dmigs gang yang med stabs yong mkhan dkon pas khyed rnam pas 'tsho ba rgyag rang 'khur gyis zlos gar slob sbyong nang phebs gnang yod pa zhu rgyu dang / dgongs bzhes ma gnang mkhan yod mdog ma kha'ang / nga tshos btsan shed zhu thabs 138

dben pas de don thugs mos byung rigs khungs so so'i mtshan gyi 'og tu mtshan rtags phyag bstar ma re gnang skyong zhu rgyu ’’zhes 'khod pa'i shog lhe kha btags dang sbrags zlos gar 'go 'dzin nor nang la gnas lugs ngag lam nas brjod de shog lte bstan thog mi 'gro ngos gnyis nas phyin chog ces bshad par/ nor nang pas ‘‘zlos gar nang gtong mkhan khag po red/ 'on kyang khyed gnyis phebs na 'grigs kyi red ’’ces zer zhing / skabs der zur khang ka sbug tu slebs 'dug par thog mar zur khang mdun phyin te gnas lugs zhib bshad dang 'brel brda tho shog lte bstan par ‘‘de gas 'grigs shagakhyed tshos 'bad sgrub gang legs byung 'dug nga'i bu mo dang / rgya ri sras chung gnyis ka gtong rgyu nga rang rang gis khas len zhu rgyu ’’zhes pa'i ming rtags bris thog ‘‘'byung 'gyur khong gnyis skad yig slob grwa'i go skabs 'dra byung na dgongs 'khrol yong ba gnang dgos ’’zhes dang / ‘‘khyed tshos da bar hur bskyed byas 'dug pa da dung yang 'bad brtson cher bskyed byed dgos ’’lugs kyang bshad byung / de nas dil mgo mkhyen brtser brda tho spyan 'bul dang 'brel gnas tshul ngag zhu byas par ‘‘lags so/ lags so/ khyed rnam pas thugs 'khur de tsam bzhes pa thugs rje che nga'i bu mo gnyis ka btang chog ri’gsungs te mtshan rtags bskyon/ gsang yum des kyang ‘‘de don zhus chog ’’ces khas len byas/ de nas rnam sras gling sar bskyod par khong gis ‘‘nga'i bu mo 'dis zlos gar la phan thogs yong gi ma red/ rnam kun phyi'i mi gcig nga'i sar yong na'ang yib sdod byed pa red/ 'on kyang spun chos mdzad lha dbang tshe ring btang chog ’’ces zer nas ming rtags bkod/ de nas pha lha'i phogs dpon sar bskyod par khong gis ‘‘bu rang la gsung rogs ’’zhes zer/bu de gar 'dug par ‘‘sras sku zhabs zlos gar nang phebs gnang yod pa ’’zhes bshad par khong ngo gdong khro gnyer bsdus te ‘‘nga sprang po byed par yong 139

long mi 'dug ’’zer bas/ de nas zhabs phyi sgang du mar thon dus nga'i rogs pa rma bya bla ma lags khong khro drag po langs nas ‘‘kho phru gu de'i kha gog der gcig ma gzhus par 'grigs ma song / khos nga tsho sprang por cha 'jog byed pa gang min tshad red ’rices 'dar skad brgyab ste ‘‘kho sgug sdod byed kyi yin ’’zer gyi 'dug pas/ phran rang nas ‘‘phru gu'i kha la blta yag yod pa ma red ’’ces lab nas 'dzing rtsod med pa bzos/ de min gong gsal ming smos khag la phran gnyis ngo bskyod byas par tshang mas dga' spro'i ngang khas len byas byung / rnam kun nga tsho tshang ma snga dro nyin dgung bar dbyin ji'i skad yig slob sbyong dngo /nyin dgung kha lag zas nas chu tshod dang por zlos gar sbyang brtson byas pa/sbyong yul khang pa ni dang po nor nang sar yin pa dang / de nas ra ye bha dur ku ṭi/ de rjes 'phreng ring tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms lags nas thabs shes gnang ste ka sbug ‘‘kran hol mi’zhes pa'i khang chen spang gcal yod pa zhig nang yin/ dgong dro chu tshod bzhi par ja mngar mo shel phor do re dang / bag leb chung ba yin na mi rer gang tshang re dang che ba yin na phyed ka re yod pa/ ja dang bag leb nyo rin nga tsho gzhung phogs yod mkhan mi lnga nas zla re sgor lnga re bsdus nas btang / zlos gar slob sbyong la chu tshod skar cha dang bcas pa'i 'byor tho bkod/ sbyong khang la gad phyis bya rgyu phran lha dbang tshe ring nas 'char can snga bskyod kyis byas thog 'byor tho yang bkod/ dgong dro chu tshod bzhi pa'i ja bzo rgyu dang / bag leb nyo rgyu sogs thog mar phran nas byed pa de ltar yang / rjes sor ja bzo res sogs res 'khor bya rgyu byas/ 'phreng ring tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms lags zlos gar dga' po yod stabs khong nga tsho'i tshogs mir zhugs shing / bu mo tshos zhabs bro rgyag par thog mar ngo tsha byed kyang khong gis sne khrid kyis spyong brdar byas te phan thogs chen po byung / nga tshos thog mar de snga'i gzhas dang zhabs bro rnying pa rnams slob sbyong byas pa 140

dang / de rjes rang nas zlos gar gsar pa brtsams pa dper na/ dga' gzhas skya rengs dang po (rtsom pa po phran lha dbang tshe ring /) bstod pa'i glu dbyangs (rtsom pa po nor nang ngag dbang nor bu )sogs rim bzhin sbyang /de rjes bod kyi bzo zhing 'brog gsum gyi gnas tshul dngos yod dang bstun pa'i gzhas dang zhabs bro/ chos gsum so so'i glu gzhas zhabs bro/ (rtsom pa po rma bya bla ma ngag dbang mthu stobs/) chos gsum mi sna pho mo mnyam 'dzoms kyi glu gzhas zhabs bro sogs 'khrab ston dus yun chu tshod gnyis nas gsum bar 'khyongs pa'i zlos gar gyi le'u zhig sbyang brtson byas/ zla re'i bsdu cha rim 'phar gyis mi res sgor brgyad re bsdus/ zlos gar gsar zhugs mi grangs 'phar stabs phogs yod rnams kyis da ni bsdu cha rgyab thub yag mi 'dug ja dang bag leb mtshams 'jog byed rogs zer yang / phran gyis de 'dra ma gsungs nyin ltar chu tshod drug ring gzugs po brdabs 'khrug dang / glu gzhas gtong rgyu dka' ngal che bas ja dang / bag leb ma byung thabs med yin lugs bshad de snga 'phros dngul bun g.yar rgyu byas kyang / nor nang gis ‘‘dngul g.yar mkhan khag po red/ gal te g.yar yang skyin tshab sus sprod kyi red dam ’’zer bar rang nas skyin tshab rjes su 'khrab ston byas nas sprad chog ’mices bshad de ka sbug don gcod khe smad dza sag gi mdun du phyin te gnas lugs bshad de ‘‘dgos dngul snga g.yar gnang rogs ’’zhes bshad par/ khe smad pas don gcod khang la dgos dngul med kyang / chos don lasakhungs la 'bul rgyu'i sgor gsum brgya tham pa yod pa des phan thogs na chos don la snyan seng zhus chog gi red mimizer byung bas/ ‘‘de rang g.yar po gnang rogs ’’zhes bshad/ de'i sang nyin zlos gar bu mo gnyis la gnyer pa bskosate 'o rtsam dang / ja pa ti/ bye ma ka ra/ shel gyi phor pa nyi shu rtsa lnga bcas nyos/ nyin re ja res kyis gnyer pa'i lag nas dgos cha blangs te ja 141

dang / bag leb ma chad tsam sprod thub pa byung / de dus stabs ma legs pa zhig la phran lha dbang tshe ring ngo g.yog gnyis sdod khang g.yab 'khor ras yol las med stabs dgong mo zhig ngos gnyis kyi gyon chas tsag tsig tshang ma rkun mas 'khyer te sang zhogs langs dus gu thung yang med par mal chas nang btsog pur sdod dgos pa bzos byung / nga gnyis la dngul hin sgor nyi shu skor las med/ phran gyi stod thung nyal gur nang ldeb la gzer ba'i nang smyu gu phom krin gcig dang / hin sgor drug yod pa de bsdad 'dug pa las de min gyon chas rkang lham dang bcas pa 'khyer 'dug nga'i g.yog bsam gtan de'i nub mo gu thung stod thung gyon gyon par nyal tsang phyi rol du 'gro bskyod bya rgyu yod stabs sgor mo drug po bskur te ras kyi gu thung gcig nyo bar btang /rnam kun kha gyon phyu chen gyon nas phyi bskyod byas stabs dor rkyang mar 'gro ma shes pa lta bur sdod skabs stabs legs pa zhig la de sngon ma su ri bzhugs sgar tshogs 'dus/ da phyin gzhung zhabs tsho'i gyon chas bod lugs phyu chen zhe cig ma gtogs tsha phyu ma gyon rgyu med pa bzos stabs phran gyi 'go snam rgya smug gi tsha phyu ma zhig yod pa bzo bcos brgyab ste phyu chen bzo rgyur bskyal ba de/ de nub dgong dro ngos gnyis zlos gar nas ma 'byor gong gnas tshang la sprad 'dug pa gnas tshang nas stabs yag pa gcig la ‘‘kha sa khyed gnyis ma 'byor gong na bza' 'go snam de bskyel bar slebs pa ngas nyar te mdang nub 'bul rgyu ma byung ba 'dir yod ’’ces sprad byung bas dpe mi srid pa'i phan thogs chen po byung / 'char can snga dro dbyin ji'i skad yig slob sbyong la skyod skabs ras kyi gu thung thung drags nas nywa dmar hreng hreng byed pa dang / tsha phyu ma phyu chen bzos pas cha chung la phu thung khra bar brten slob grogs rgan pa tshos/ ‘‘o twas/da rang na bza' stabs bde ba dang gu thung hab 'dra ba khyad mtshar zhe drag gyon 'dug ’’ces 'phya dmod byas kyang / rang la gang yod gyon pa las mchor 142

po'i re ba byed pa'i dpal 'byor med par song ngo tsha yag gang yang mi 'duga'on kyang phran gyi gyon chas sogs tshang ma rku shor ba skad grags byung bar brten dga' nye blo dkar khag nas ster ba'i dngul rkyang hin sgor brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / g.yu thog lha lcam rdo rje g.yu sgron lags nas ther ma'i phyu chen gru rtsi g.yu mdog gi nang sha byas pa kha babs gcig ster byung / dngul sgor nyi shu tsam zhig bor brlag song bar 'thol pa sgor brgya tsam byung bas lag sne 'bal 'bal lhug lhug byung / nyin gcig dbyin ji'i skad yig dge rgan 'phreng ring lha lcam rigs 'dzin sgrol ma nas kha par brgyud ‘‘hi ma la'i ho krel du phyi rgyal nas yong ba'i gangs rir blta skor ba kha shas kyis bod kyi rol cha dang /gzhas zhabs bro blta 'dod yod pas do nub nges par du khyed rnams 'di ga ho krel du (za khang )phebs rogs zhu gi 'dug pas 'go khrid rnam pa dang / rol cha ba rnams da lta chu tshod bdun pa'i thog hi ma la'i ho krel du yong dgos ’’zhes gsungs don ltar nga tsho rol cha shes pa tshang ma phyin pa yin/ a ri dang /dbyin ji/ ir ṭa li/ h+pha ran si bcas nas yong ba mi grangs brgyad 'dug pa khong tshos nga tsho'i sgra snyan dang / pi wang / yang chin/ gling bu sogs la blta zhib kyis par brgyab/ nga tshos nang ma dang / stod gzhas kha shas btang ba dang / zhabs bro rgyab par zhabs bro rgyag mkhan gyi rkang par do snang chen pos blta gi 'dug dgong mo'i kha lag ḍi nar (dgong zas )khong tshos btang ba ma zad/ shing tog dang / a rag sba si ki rta dkar po/ sba ran ḍi spus dag btegs byung / nga tsho log khar khong tshos ‘‘chen po byung ma song yang gsol ja zhal tog mchod rogs ’zhes hin sgor sum brgya tham pa sprad pa ma blangs par ‘‘thugs rje che gsol ras de 'dra zhu gi min ’’zhes bshad par/ ‘‘dngul mang po yod pa ma red de khyed rnams gsol ja zhal tog bzhes rogs mi’zer byung / de nas zlos gar sbyang 'bras gang legs byung mtshams nga tsho'i dngul 143

bun sprod dmigs dang / rol cha sogs nyo rin yong ched zlos gar 'khrab ston byed rgyu'i tri ka si dpar 'debs byas zin yang / tri ka si dngul grangs 'khod pa btsong na gzhung khral chen po thob lugs dang / de bas dngul kha grangs ma bkod par rogs ram shog lhe bzos nas bkram na gzhung khral sprod ma dgos pa'i 'bab yong che lugs rgyus babs bslab bya byed mkhan byung ba ltar byas shing / ‘‘'khrab chas tshang ma g.yar khungs blta rgyu dka' ngal che tsam byung yang bu mo'i gyon chas rnams ka sbug khul yod 'byor ldan 'ga' zhig sa nas g.yar/ bu'i chas gos kyang de bzhin zhe mtshungs gang thub g.yar khungs btsal/ 'brog pa'i zhwa gos thad nga tsho'i zlos gar bu ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi pā lags su pags tshags rnying pa zhig 'dug pa de ster byung bas des rgya btsugs te rgyab sha tir par dkar po g.yogs/ zhwa mo pags zhwa ras dkar gyis bzos/gzhan yang pho mo'i chas gos khongs nas mdo smad a mdo'i chas gos pho mo gnyis ka cha tshang spus legs shig g.yar mkhan byung ba bcas chas gos dang yo chas thabs shes gang 'tshams son pa dang / nang sbyong byas par rgya che'i mang tshogs la 'khrab ston 'phel tsam byung rjes tshes cha gtan 'khel gyis rin 'bab ma 'khod pa'i tri ka si rkub stegs ang grangs 'khod pa ngo shes brgyud 'grems tshong byas/ ka sbug tu yod pa'i rgya gar gzhung gi khrims khang du'ang 'khrab ston byas 'thus kyi snyan seng zhus te bka' 'khrol thob nas ka sbug kron hol tshogs khang du dgong mo gnyis 'khrab ston byed 'char gyi le'u dang po rol cha sne 'dzoms kyi nang ma (bkra la shis pa )cha tshang gi thogs bod kyi bzo las dang / zhing las/ 'brog las gsum gyi zhwa gos sogs chas gos dang ngal rtsol byed stangs mtshon pa'i glu gzhas zhabs bro dang bar seng la bod gzhas rnying pa nang ma dang / stod gzhas khag btang / de 'brel bod dbus gtsang khul gyi zhwa gos lham gsum dang rgyan gos mtshon pa'i glu gzhas zhabs bro dang /144

mdo stod khul gyi zhwa gos lham gsum dang / pho mo'i rgyan chas sogs mtshon pa'i glu gzhas zhabs bro/ mdo smad khul gyi zhwa gos lham gsum dang / pho mo'i rgyan gos mtshon pa'i glu gzhas zhabs bro sogs 'khrab ston byas/ thog ma'i 'char gzhir dgong mo gnyis las 'khrab ston byed rtsis med kyang rang rigs mang po zhig gis yang bskyar dgong mo gcig 'khrab ston byed dgos kyi re ba byas stabs slar yang dgong mo gcig 'khrab ston byas par tshang mas dga' mos chen po byed pa ma zad/ dgong mo gnyis pa gsum par dang blangs kyis zlos gar 'go byings tshor kha lag sha mog mog gtong mkhan dang sha 'bras gtong mkhan yang byung / tri ka si btsongs rin hin sgor nyis stong bdun brgya skor byung 'dug pa nas/ spyi lcags bkra shis rdo rje lags ka li ka tar rol cha bha lin dang / pi wang phra sbom/ rnga chen rnga chung / dung sogs nyo bar btang /da dung pho mo'i gyon gos zhe mtshungs gsar tshem byas/ ka sbug tu yod pa'i donagacod khang la lnga g.yar dngul skyin sgor sum brgya tham pa sprod par phyin kyang bka' shag nas chos don las khungs la skyin tshab sprad zin 'dug pas de yang sprod ma dgos pa byung / de nas spyi lo 1960lo stod nga tsho'i zlos gar bas thar pa gling du 'khrab ston byas par dga' bsu bstod bsngags chen po thob nas yag po yod lugs skad grags chen po byas 'dug pas de nas mi ring bar lo de'i zla 3tshes 20nang e sha ya'i rgyal khab khag bco brgyad rgya gar ldi li gsar par tshogs 'du zhig 'tshog skabs ldi lir bca' sdod sku tshab don gcod zhwa sgab pas da res e sha ya'i tshogs 'du'i sar ka sbug tu yod pa'i bod kyi zlos gar ba rnams 'khrab ston du 'gugs 'bod chog pa'i snyan seng sgron 'brel bka'i 'khrol byung ste ldi li'i don gcod khang nas gus tsho ‘‘zlos gar 'go khrid dang / rol cha ba/ 'khrab ston pa/ gzhon nu pho mo bcas mi grangs bcu drug ldi lir 'phral 'byor dgos rgyu dang / mar lam me 'khor gyi 145

gla cha dang zas gron snga 'phros khyod tshos btang ste ldi li nas skyin tshab sprod rgyu dang / ldi lir zlos gar 'go byings sdod khang ho krel (mgron khang )du gra sgrig 'thus tshang zin pas dus 'gyangs ma song ba byed dgos ririzhes pa'i yi ge 'byor don ltar nga tsho mi grangs bco brgyad ldi lir bskyod par don gcod khang nas gra sgrig yag po byas 'dug nga tsho'i zlos gar tshogs pa cha rkyen zhan pas 'khrab chas gyon gos brje len de tsam med par song yab gzhis stag lha'i rgyal lo lags kyi lcam nas nga tsho 'byor nyin gyi mtshan mo tshong khang la jo lags bkra shis tshe ring dang phran lha dbang tshe ring gnyis mnyam khrid thog lcam kho rang ngo bskyod kyis 'khrab ston pa gzhon nu pho mo bcu drug gi gyon chas kyi rgyu cha cha tshang nyos nas mtshan mo de rang la 'tshem rgyur bskyal/ de'i sang nyin zur khang dbang chen dge legs nas 'khrab ston bya yul sdings cha sogs la blta bar yong dgos brjod don bzhin zlos gar 'go 'dzin nor nang pa dang / phran lha dbang tshe ring / rma bya bla ma lags bcas bskyod thog nga tsho nyin mtshan khor yug tu nang sbyong byas/ skabs der ldi lir tsha ba 'go tshugs pas mang che ba mtshan mo sbyang zhing bar seng (lā sil )zhes zho la bye ma ka ra brgyab ste 'khyags pa blugs nas btung / dngos gzhi'i 'khrab ston ltad mo'i sku mgron gras su rgya gar gyi srid 'dzin rgan pa ra ta na pa sān dang / srid 'dzin gzhon pa ra ta kir shi na/ srid blon rna he ru/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi blon chen che khag dang /e sha ya rgyal khab bco brgyad kyi sku tshab rnam pa dang / bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / dmag spyi zur pa dza sag khe smad pa bsod nams dbang 'dus/ 'phreng ring lcam rig 'dzin sgrol ma/ las tshan sa 'du rin chen bcas dang / gzhan yang rgya gar gyi dpon rigs mang po slebs 'dug thog mar 'khrab stegs sdings cha'i yol ba ma phye gong rnga chen dang gling bu'i rol dbyangs snyan 'jebs dang ldan pa btang / de nas le'u dang po/146

rol cha ba rnams kyis gna' bo'i bod gzhas nang ma bkra la shis pa btang bar sku mgron tshang mas dgyes mnyes chen pos thal mo 'brug sgra ldir ba ltar bsgrags/ le'u gnyis pa/ bod kyi lag shes bzo las byed tshul yar 'brog dkar mo gling zhes lug bal bregs stangs nas 'khrus gses/ rgyu spun 'khel 'thag chags bcags/ spu shas/ snam 'thag dras/ gos gyon sogs kyi rnam 'gyur legs thon gyi gzhas dang zhabs bro/ le'u gsum pa/ zhing pas so nam 'debs las dang po zhing chu btang ba nas rmod log son 'debs/ yur ma/ btsas rnga/ tshar 'dren/ g.yul las 'bru 'don/ 'debs 'dren dang /lo legs byung tshul gyi thog nas dga' spro'i chang 'thung zhabs bro dang gzhas sogs btang / le'u bzhi pa/ 'brog pas gnag phyugs lug khyu rtswa thang rgya cher rtswa chur 'grems gtong dang / 'o ma 'jo zhing rtsi bcud mar phyur bton nas dkar phud dkon mchog mchod cing longs spyod byed tshul sogs/ le'u lnga pa/ dbus gtsang gzhon nu pho mo nas dbus gtsang glu gzhas zhabs bro/le'u drug pa/ mdo stod gzhon nu pho mos mdo stod khul gyi glu gzhas dang zhabs bro/ le'u bdun pa/ mdo smad gzhon nu pho mos mdo smad khul gyi glu gzhas dang zhabs bro/ le'u brgyad pa/ chol kha gsum gyi pho mo lhan cig tu dga' spro'i glu gzhas zhabs bro brgyab ste mjug rdzogs par byas/ de'i sang nyin nga tsho zlos gar 'go byings tshang ma don gcod las khungs nas mgron 'bod ltar bskyod par kha lag gzab rgyas bstar/ de skabs slob grwa'i spyi khyab kun gling dza sag nas nga tshor yi ge btang 'byor du ‘‘snyan zhus bka' 'khrol thob pa bzhin khyed rnams 'di ga gzhugs sgar ma su ri'i slob grwar zlos gar 'khrab ston du yong dgos pa dang / yar mar gyi 'khor gla dang / zas gron/'di gar nyin lnga sdod yun ring gi 'tsho ba dang sdod khang sogs 'di ga'i slob grwa nas gzab gzengs 'bul rgyu yin ’’zhes 'khod 'dug par/ nga tshos 147

dga' spro'i ngang yong rgyu'i yig lan btang thog de'i gnangs nyin ldi li nas nga tsho me 'khor nang zhugs te ḍas ra ḍos la babs/ de nas mo ṭa'i nang ma su ri bzhugs sgar du 'byor/ slob grwas sne len gra sgrig gzab rgyas byas 'duganor nang gis gtsos nga tsho 'gan 'khur mi sna rnams gros mol gyis slob grwar 'khrab ston dngos gzhi ma byas gong gzhas tshig sogs la nor nang nas zhib 'jugakhyed skabs rma bya bla ma lags kyis brtsams pa'i gzhas tshig kha shas la nor bcos byas par/ rma bya bla ma lags kyis ‘‘ngas gsar brtsams spyan zhu zhu skabs yag po ma gzigs par 'grig shag gsungs pa dang da cha nor bcos gnang na phru gu tsho'i kha la 'jags tshar bas de rang 'jags la 'jog rogs gnang ’’zhes khong khro chen pos zhus song / gzhi rkang khong rnam gnyis spun mched yin rung gcig gis gcig la dang ba mi ston pa zhig rnam kun nas 'dug nor nang gis kyang 'o na dbyugasnga zhog 'grigs kyi red zer yang phran lha tshe dang spyi lcags bkras rdor gnyis kyis legs bcos dang 'brel/ le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod pa'i 'khrab gzhung dang / de'i nang gi gzhas tshig khag bcas gtsang bris kyis tā la'i bla mar snyan zhur btang zhing / ‘‘le'u mang po 'dugapa sa dgong mo gcig la khag po yong rgyur 'khrab thengs gnyis byas 'thus ’’zhes phebs/ de'i sang nyin nga tsho zlos gar ba tshang ma mjal khar bskyod skabs ‘‘da res e sha ya'i tshogs 'du'i sar khyed tshos zlos gar 'khrab ston byas pa de yag po zhe drag 'dug ces zer ba bzhin nga tshos kyang blta 'dod kyis sgug bsdad yod/ 'di gar slob grwa'i 'char gzhi byas na khyed tsho nyin grangs lnga sdod rgyu yin kyang nyin brgyad sdod rgyu bzos pa yin ’’zhes gsungs/ nga tshos thog mar mtshan mo gnyis gzhas phud 'khrab ston byas par dga' spro chen pos bstod bsngags dang thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin zhes gsung mkhan mang po byung / nyin gsum pa'i dgong mo ma su ri slob grwa'i 'go khrid dang / dge slob las byed/148

gzhan yang nye 'gram du 'khod pa'i bod rigs mang po bcas la 'khrab ston byas/ slob grwa'i spyi khyab kun gling dza sag nas 'brel ba byas don nyin bzhi pa'i dgong mo ma su ri a ri'i slob grwar 'khrab ston du bskyod par sne len gzab rgyas dang legs skyes hin sgor chig stong tham pa sprad byung / nyin lnga pa'i dgong mo dbyin ji'i slob grwa zhig la 'khrab ston byas par sne len gzab rgyas dang 'brel legs skyes hin sgor lnga brgya tham pa sprad byung / de nas nga tsho de gar 'khrab ston zin te ḍas ra ḍon nas me 'khor nang zhugs te ka sbug tu thon/ ka spug tu 'byor nas zlos gar mang tshogs 'du 'dzoms sar nga tsho ldi lir bskyod pa nas da lam phyir 'khor bar gyi byed sgo zhib phra khyab bsgrags byas/nga tsho ldi lir 'khrab ston la ma phyin gong zlos gar ba phal che bas dgongs pa zhu rtsis byed kyi 'dug rung / de nas bzung tshang mar sngar las lhag pa'i sems shugs 'phel te 'khur cher skyed kyis sbyang brtson dang / sgrig khrims spyod lam bzang du phyin song / de rjes bzhugs sgar ‘‘shes rig las khungs ’’nas bka' rgya btang don du/ ‘‘shes rig zlos gar zhig sgrig 'dzugs bya rgyur khyod tsho'i khongs nas 'thus mi gcig dang / a mdo gung thang tshul khrims bcas 'di ga bzhugs sgar du 'khrab 'byor dgos rgyu ’’zhes 'khod par zlos gar mang tshogs nas nga tsho'i 'thus mir khyed rang lha tshe 'gro dgos zer don bzhin khas len byas te ngas gung thang tshul khrims thugs 'phrad kyis dus tshes gtan 'khel skor 'phrol mol byas par/ gung thang tshul khrims kyis ‘‘nga la'ang shes rig las khungs nas bka' rgya 'byor byung yang / nga tshos chos rgyal srong batren sgam po'i rgyal rabs lo rgyus shig 'khrab sbyong byas par 'bras ljongs rgyal pos sgang thog tu 'khrab ston byed par yong rogs gsung don dus sgo bzos zin pas gra sgrig tu nga rang ma bsdad thabs med yin gshis/ khyed rang sngon la phebs rogs/ ngas 'bras ljongs su 'khrab ston zin 'phral bcar chog pa zhu 149

rogs gnang ’’zhes zer bas/ nga rang ngo g.yog gnyis ka sbug nas rda ram sa lar thon bskyod byas/ rda ram sa lar 'byor nas shes rig 'go 'dzin kun gling dza sag dang / 'go 'dzin gzhon pa khe smad dza sag gnyis kyi sar bskyod/bzo zhing 'brog gsum gyi gnas tshul 'khod pa'i gtam brjod 'khrab gzhung khag gsum spyan zhu dang 'brel/ gung thang tshul khrims kyi gnas lugs bshad par gung thang tshul khrims 'byor mtshams mol bsdur bya rgyu yin zhes zer byung /phran rda sar 'byor nas zla ba gcig tsam song rung gung thang tshul khrims bskyar dgongs zhus te ma yong bas/ nyin gcig shes rig las khungs nas brjod gsal/ ‘‘gung thang tshul khrims la gnas 'brel thenges mang byas kyang ma 'byor stabs khyod tsho'i zlos gar da yod thog kha snon byed 'os bgyis te sgrig 'dzugs byas 'thus zhes snyan seng phul don bka' 'khrol thob cing sa gnas thad khyod tsho'i re 'dun bzhin ka sbug gam/ rdor gling gang rung zhig tu snyan seng zhus kyang rda ram sa rang la 'dzugs dgos phebs gshis de don 'dzugs phyogs kyi 'char gzhi zhig khyod nas bzo 'bul byed dgos ’’zhes zer bas/ rang la myong goms med kyang 'thus mi'i ming 'khur la brten 'char gzhi bzo rgyu'i 'khur len mi bya mthu med byung zhing / phran nas zlos gar 'di 'phral sel dril bsgrags byed sgo tsam yin nam/ slad phyin gtan 'jags rgyun 'dzin bya rgyu ji yin dris par/ rgyun 'dzin gtan 'jags kyi 'char gzhi 'bul dgos zhes zer byung bas/ 'char gzhir/ rol cha ba mi grangs nyi shu tham pa dang / bu rgan pa mi grangs nyi shu tham pa/ bu mo rgan pa mi grangs nyi shu tham pa/ bu chung ba mi grangs nyi shu tham pa/ bu mo chung ba mi grangs nyi shu tham pa bcas khyon bsdoms mi grangs brgya tham pa la mi rer zla re gla phogs hin sgor brgyad cu gya gnyis dang pad lnga bcu re dang / dbyar chas dgun chas cha tshang re/ sdod yul khang khungs/ tshogs khang / gnyer tshang / gsol thab/150

lto snod dang bkol chas/ nyal khri/ nyal gdan/ rol cha khag 'khrab chas dang gyon gos sogs kyi dgos mkho rnams dang / las byed pa bcas gra sgrig byed sgo'i 'char gzhi dang / nyin re'i bya rim gtan 'khel re'u mig bkod pa ste/ zhogs pa chu tshod drug par langs brda btang nas langs 'phral lus rtsal dang / gtsang spra/ zhal 'don/ zhogs ja/ bod yig dbyin ji'i skad yigahin di'i skad yig bcas slob sbyong bya rgyu dang / de nas nyin dgung kha lag btang rjes ngal gso gnyid nyal/ de nas zlos gar rol cha dang rkang bro glu gzhas sogs sde tshan so so slob sbyong / chu tshod bzhi par ja mngar mo sprod rgyu/de rjes rtsed rigs sna tshogs dang / ngal rtsol chu tshod gcig gzhas tshig sogs blo 'dzin skyor sbyang / dgong dro kha lag zin rjes ngang tsam nas mnyam 'dzoms 'khrab sbyong chen mo tshugs rgyu dang / 'khrab sbyong zin 'phral ja thang btang rjes dgong dro'i zhal 'don sgrol ma sogs skyor 'don dang / dgong mo'i chu tshod bcu par nyal brda btang ste khu sim nyal rgyu bcas kyi re'u mig bkod pa shes rig las khungs su 'bul skabs 'go 'dzin gzhon pa khe smad dza sag nas ‘‘o ho bka' blon dang las byed par zla phogs hin sgor bdun cu don lnga re las med par zlos gar bar sgor brgyad cu gya gnyis dang pad lnga bcu re bkod pa de 'dra gang yin nam 'grigs e yong ’’zhes zer bar phran nas ‘‘de ga rang red/ las byed pa zhogs pa las khungs chu tshod brgyad par tshugs nas dgong dro chu tshod lnga par grol te nyin re chu tshod brgyad kyi las rgyun yin pa dang / zlos gar ba zhogs pa chu tshod drug pa nas dgong dro'i chu tshod bcu pa bar chu tshod bcu drug ring slob spyong dang sgrig khrims brtsi bkur zhu dgos pa song tsang da dung phogs thob nyung skyon las med ’mices bshad par hā hā zhes gad mo dgod bzhin par ‘‘'o yong nga 'char gzhi de spyan zhur phul chog ’’ces zer don tā lar spyan 'bul zhus par bsgyur bcos med par chog 151

mchan gnang 'dug kyang / snga 'phros mi grangs 'char gzhi'i phyed tsam gyis 'grigs lugs phebs par shes rig las khungs nas ‘‘khyod rang ka sbug tu phyir log gis da yod zlos gar khongs mi rnams rang 'jags byed dang mi byed so so'i 'dod mthun byas 'thus dang / da lam gyi 'char gzhir phyag rtags phebs dgongs kyi phogs thob dang / sgrig khrims zhu sgo'i bya rim re'u mig nang gsal brtsi bkur zhu dgos sogs tshang mar khyab bsgrags thog 'di gar gang ci'i gra sgrig byed mi'ang gang myur gtong dgos ’’zhes zer don phran ngo g.yog ka sbug tu thon/ ka sbug tu 'byor pa dang 'go 'dzin nor nang gis gtsos zlos gar dge slob tshang 'dzoms sar 'char gzhir phyag rtags phebs dgongs kyi phogs thob dang / slob sbyong bya rim sogs re re bzhin gsal bshad dang 'brel tshugs yul sa gnas rda ram sa lar yin pas sgrig khrims spyod lam bzang po dgos gal che lugs dang / tshang ma rta sar 'gro thub pa byung na gang legs yong rgyu yang / 'gro dang mi 'gro rang rang 'dod 'dems byas chog pa yin ces bshad par/ ka sbug tu bza' zla lag shes pa yin pa'i bu mo mtshan nyid lha mo dang / g.yang 'dzoms gnyis dgongs pa zhus pa ma gtogs de byings tshang ma 'gro rgyu yin zer 'dug par/ phran gyis ‘‘khyed cag phal che ba zlos gar nang dngos su 'dzul zhugs gnang rgyu'i dgongs bzhes gnang ba yag po red thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ 'on kyang rnam kun dga' skyid bag g.yeng lang shor tsho da lta nas dgongs pa yag po bzhes na ma gtogs sgrig 'dzugs khongs su zhugs tshar na rang snang gang 'dod byed sa med cing / gal te sgrig khrims la gnod gzhi'i bya spyod shar tshe sgrig khongs nas 'bud 'then byed nges yin cing / de lugs nyin bdun ring gang dga'i dgongs bzhes gnang dgos mi’zhes bshad pa yin/ 'on kyang dgongs pa zhu mkhan mi 'dug pas rnam kun rtag bcar ma thub mkhan mdo stod pa gser dga' dang / lha 152

sa ba chos 'phel klu sgrub gnyis dang / sgrig khrims 'khur shes med pa gzhis rtse rta nag bstan 'dzin gsum ming 'don gyis khyed gsum bzhugs sgar la sgrig khrims srung brtsi zhu rgyur khag po yong gnas la dgongs pa zhus na legs lugs bshad kyang khong tshos sgrig khrims brtsi bkur dang len zhu rgyur/ 'gan len khag theg btsugs chog zer don ltar gser dga'i khag theg rma bya ngag dbang mthu stobs dang / chos 'phel klu sgrub kyi khag theg nor nang / gzhis rtse bstan 'dzin gyi khag theg spun mched rma bya lcam chung chos nyid bcas nas 'gan len gnang / rda ram sa lar zlos gar tshugs yul khang pa dang /gdan/ nyal khri sogs gang ci'i gra sgrig tu sngon la mi re zung 'gro dgos pas gros bsdur gnang dgos zhes bshad par/ nor nang nas gang ci'i rgyus bab dang bcas khyod rang 'gro dgos zer byung / rang nas ‘‘da res phran dgongs pa gnang rogs ’zhes zhus kyang tshang mas thog ma'i gra sgrig gal cher brten khyed rang 'gro rogs zhes u nan byed don bzhin khas len byas/de nas las rogs su gnyer pa'i dmigs sgor phan po 'byor ldan khang gsar gyi pha dpal 'byor nor bu dang / tshem bzo ba phan po blo bzang / rang g.yog bsam gtan bcas khrid de rda ram sa lar bskyod cing / shes rigs lasakhungs nas khang pa'i thad ko nem khang khungs ma lag rnams zlos gar la gnang yod/ da lta de gar sdod mkhan rnams khyod rang gis spo shugs byed dgos zhes bshad nas rtsis len byed dgos zer don ltar ko nem du bskyod parakhang pa tshang ma'i nang mis khengs 'dug pas/ nga tsho gra sgrig byed po mi bzhi sdod sa'ang med par sde srung las khungs su gnas g.yar byas/ ko nem la sdod mi khag gcig nang srid las khungs nas lam bzor btang 'dug pa de'i sang zhogs khang pa rtsis len du 'gro skabs slar yang mi gsar pa de bas mang ba zhig 'byor te 'dzul sdod byas 'dug par khong tsho sdod gnas med par song 153

bas de lam ma bzhag mthu med byung / de rjes nang srid las byed par zhib mngags kyis da phyin lam bzo ba 'gro khar khang pa nga tshor rtsis sprod yong ba'i 'phros mol byas/ 'on kyang mi grangs nyi shu rtsa gnyis phogs khang gi lag g.yog lta bu'i las ka byas te gtan sdod byed mkhan tshos ngan shed kyis zla ba kha shas ring spo shugs ma byas pa red/ de nas shing bzo ba mi gnyis glas te pang leb kyi nyal khri steng 'og gnyis re byas pa grangs nyi shu tham pa dang / kher rkyang rtswa thag lhas pa grangs bcu bcas gsar bzo byas/ rtswa thag lhas sgrog byed mi rgya gar ba mi gcig nyin gcig glas pa des sla stangs la de nyin nga tsho bzhi car gyis do snang lta zhib kyis sang nyin nas nga rang tshos lhas shes pa byung / phogs khang nas rtswa ras slong ste rtswa gdan lnga bcu tham pa nga tsho mi bzhis btsems/nang rgyong thang shing gi lo ma skam po sgrug gsog gis brgyangs/ shes rig las khungs nas bu gso khang du yod pa'i slob phrug pho mo sum brgya brgal ba'i khrod nas zlos gar ba slob phrug pho mo sum cu drag 'dems byed dgos zer don/phru gu tshang 'dzoms thog zlos gar slob sbyong byed 'dod yod med re re bzhin dris te dbye 'byed byas par mang che bas slob 'dod byed kyi 'dug de dag gi khrod nas bu bco lnga dang bu mo bco lnga byad bzhin dang / gzugs dbyibs la bltas nas drag 'dems byas/ ma tshud pa de tshos blo pham byed kyi 'dug par phran gyis gnas skabs mi grangs sum cu las phogs thob 'char gzhi med gshis rjes su rim pas bab lta byas chog lab kyang bu mo gcig gis shes rig 'go 'dzin khe smad dza sag gi pus mo nas 'jus te ‘‘nga zlos gar nang 'jug rogs sku mkhyen zer song bar mi grangs 'thol bar phogs thob med lugs bshad kyang / mos ngus nas ‘‘nga bod rigs ma red pas nga zlos gar nang ma bcug na chu la mchong gi yin ’’zhes ngu bzhin bshad song bas khe smad dza sag gis ‘‘lha dbang lags bu mo 'di 'phar ma nyar na 'grigs tsam byung na nyar 154

dgos mi’zer bas de don khas len byas/phru gu tsho'i bod yig slob dge sku srung dmag khongs gling bu shes mkhan rig 'dzin dar rgyas dang / dbyin ji'i skad yig slob dge gro mo ba bu mo chos 'dzoms gnyis dang / phru gu pho mo grangs sum cu so gcig bcas rtsis len gyis ko nim du slob 'go btsugs/ snga dgong zhal 'don sogs khrims ldan gyi srol gtod/ sde dge gling tshang rgyal po'i sras bshad sgrub bstan 'phel phyi rgyal la slob sbyong gtong rgyu'i khongs nas gzugs po thang min gyis tshud mi 'dug pa khong zlos gar nang 'jug dgos zer ba bzhin bcug sku srung mda' dpon la sngon zhus bzhin dmag sgar khag bzhi nas rnga dung shes pa'i na gzhon mi gnyis re zlos gar nang 'byor byung ba dang / ka ta nas bu ngag dbang grags pa'ang 'byor byung / phru gu tshor slob sbyong gtso bor zhal 'don skyabs 'gro dang / dga' lha/ dmigs brtse ma/ zhabs brtan/ ja mchod/ phyag stong 'khor bsgyur sogs dang / ljon dbang dang dka' gnad gsal ba sogs blo 'dzin dang gzhas tshig 'dzin skyor/ bod yig dang dbyin ji'i skad yigahin di'i skad yig sogs nyin re'i bya rim re'u mig gzhir bzung gis bslab/yab gzhis tshe ring sgrol mas bu gso khang gi khongs nas nga tshor 'bras gro zhib do nyi shu dang sha kring do drug cu tham pa/ 'o rtsam do gnyis/ rda li do gnyis/mar kring do bzhi/ bye ma ka ra do gcig bcas sprad byung ba rnams gnyer dpal 'byor la rtsis sprod byas/ de rjes sa gnas kang ra rdzong gi mdzad sgo zhig gi sar khong tsho'i 'khrab ston le'u khongs su bod kyi zlos gar glu gzhas 'khrab ston pa gtong gnang yong ba zhes zhus don bu chung ba brgyad dang / bu mo chung ba brgyad 'khrid de rda ram sa la shod kyi thang chen la phyin/ phran lha tshes sgra snyan dang / rig dar gyis gling bu btang ste dga' gzhas (skya rengs dang po )dang / (bstod pa'i glu dbyangs )sogs le'u lnga dang / bu chung shos thub 155

bstan gre ba bde mo yod stabs rgya gar gyi gzhas rnying snyan tshig phun sum tshogs pa'i glu dbyangs zhig sbyang brtson byas yod pa de btang bas rgya gar ba rnams kyis dga' spro'i thal mo drag tu brdabs te bskyar gtong dang / yang bskyar bcas thengs gsum btang ba bod rigs phru gu'i rig rtsal la ha las pa'i ngo mtshar chen po byung song / skabs der nga tshor 'khrab chas gyon gos yag po med pas bu gso khang gi phru gu tshor bod kyi tshong pa go bo chos mdzad zer ba des gyon chas zhe mtshungs bzo btsems kyis bster 'dug pa de nas g.yar te 'khrab/ de rjes 'khrab chas bzo dgos lugs zhus par shes rig las khungs la'ang dgos dngul dmigs thebs med gshis kun gling dza sag dang khe smad dza sag gnyis sger so so nas hin sgor lnga bcu re bsdus te hin sgor brgya tham pa phran la sprad byung ba rnams khyer nas rda shed du ‘‘lha sa tshong khang ’’zhes smon grong rje drung gi tshong khang la phyin pas khong gis rgya gar ba'i ras cha'i tshong khang chen po zhig gi nang 'khrid nas gos rdzus gser ma rgya dmar dang / ljang nag gos chen ngo ma nang bzhin yag po zhig 'dug pa de tshor rin gong ga tshod red ces dris song / ngas de yag drag 'dug nga la nyo rin sgor brgya tham pa las med ces bshad par khong gis de dag rin gong nan sgrig byas te bu brgyad dang / bu mo brgyad kyi gyon pa cha tshang gi rin smon grong rje drung lags khong rang gis zhal 'debs bton nas nyos song / rang la yod pa'i sgor brgya tham pas ras kyi stod thung 'og 'jug dang / ska rags bcas nyos te gsar 'tshem byas/bu tsho'i phyu pa gos chen btsems kyang gu thung skyob gos ras sna tshogs ral rdol can yin stabs zhabs bro rgyag dus mi mdzes pa yong rgyur song bu mo'i gyon gos bzos lhag gos rdzus ljang nag de'i gras kha snon nyos kyang bu tshor gu thung gang tshang ldang nges re med tsang dor khug pus mo khebs tsam re bzo tshems byas/bu'i gyon na gos rdzus lhag ma nas zhwa mo thi phi li re bzos pas babs chags 156

mdzes po gang legs byung song / de rjes zlos gar 'go 'dzin las rogs mi gcigagasar bsko bya rgyu'i ming shog bsdus par phran lha dbang tshe ring gi ming shog mang thon ltar 'go 'dzin las rogs bsko gzhag byas byung zhing / gang ci'i byed sgo 'go 'dzin nor nang dang mol bsdur byas par nor nang gis ‘‘khyed rang nas 'khur 'gan rkang len byed rogs ’rizer don ltar phran rang nas las 'gan shugs skyed kyis hur brtson byas/ de skabs zlos gar dge slob las byed dang bcas khyon bsdoms mi grangs bdun cu don brgyad yod pa rnams la rgya gar gzhung nas skyobs gso'i phogs thob zhus thon byung bar brten 'tsho ba spyi thab nas nar gtong bya rgyu dang / 'char gzhi sngon ma'i dngul phogs ma dgos par 'tsho snon khrus rdzas nyo byed/ 'go 'dzin gnyis so sor zla re sgor sum cu so lnga re dang / dge cher sgor nyi shu rtsa lnga/ dge rgan rer sgor nyi shu re/ dge rgan chung bar sgor bco lnga re/ byings mi rer zla re sgor bcu re/ spyi thab kyi tshal nyo rin zla re sgor lnga brgya tham pa re bcas shes rig las khungs nas 'char gzhi bzos phul la chog mchan thon 'dug zlos gar tshogs pa sgrig 'dzugs byas don bzhin nga tshos gtam brjod zlos gar bod kyi mes dbon rnam gsum gyi rgyal rabs shig 'khrab ston bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi yod khongs nas chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i rgyal rabs thad a mdo gung thang tshul khrims can gyis zlos gar zhig sgrig 'dzugs 'khrab spyong byed mus des 'thus pa byas shing / chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang / mnga' bdag khri ral gyi rgyal rabs 'khrab gzhung khungs btsan zhig yong ched bdud 'joms rin po cher brtsams sgrig yong ba zhus gnang ltar bdud 'joms rin po ches sngon la chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi rgyal rabs 'phral mar dbu 'dzugs gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang bas phyogs gcig nas 'khrab chas dang gyon gos mang po zhig gra sgrig bya rgyu dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas sbyang brtson bya rgyu sogs gzhi rgya che ba'i las don sgrub dgos shing / thabs shes yod rgu 157

rtsal sprugs kyis 'go 'dzin nor nang ngag dbang nor bu dang rol dge bar mtsho rdo rje don grub gnyis ka sbug tu 'khrab chas dang / gyon gos bzo 'tshem byed par dgos dngul hin sgor nyis khri tham pa shes rig las khungs nas sprad byung ba rnams khyer te thon bskyod byas/ btsun mo'i rgyan chas khongs gser gyi ske ga'u bal yul du bod kyi gser bzo mkhas pa zhig slebs 'dug pa rag la gser mdog bsgyur te do lo'i g.yu khra sbyar ba gser nang bzhin gnyis bzo mngags byas/ de min ga'u dang / sog byil/ skra ga'u/ rgya gri sogs shing la tshon rtsi btang ba dang zhwa 'bog rgya khug dngul rkyan dngul phor bzo rgyu sogs khe smad dza sag ngo ma dang / kun bzang rtse'i rtsis dpon/ dga' gdong blo bstan/ yangs can 'go pa'i g.yog rnying dbang chen bcas nas bzo skrun rogs ram byas/ tā la'i ‘‘gzim chung ’’nas rgyal po yab sras dang btsun mo bcas kyi nam rgyu gos ru su stag khun gser myo/ 'brug ris rgyu rnying kha gsar yug gcig dang / ri pin rgya se yug bdun/ ba na rgya se yug gsum/ gos spyan ldan tshos sna lnga so so nas yug gnyis re rtsis gos yug bcu tham pa/ rgyan gzhi'i phyu pa rnying ma lnga/ gos tshos man gyi la shag brgyad/ gzhan yang 'go snam dang / snam bu sogs kyi gyon pa dang / lham zon/ shol tse/ 'ja' lham/rta zon/ tre lham/ grwa lham/ ras zon sogs bsngo rten du phul ba'i dngos rigs sna tshogs dang / gser zangs kyi thub pa'i snang brnyan dang / spyan ras gzigs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sku thang gos bha na rgya se'i gong sham dang /dngul gyi thang tog rang 'grigs gcig dngul ting che ba bdun tshar gcig dang / 'bring ba bdun tshar gcig dngul gyi gser skyem yo chas 'bab gzhong phud dam nas ze bcas cha tshang gcig dngul kong che ba khru gang tsacha/ byas pa cha gcig dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal gcig zangs dmar gyi dung chen cha gcig dngul gyi rgya gling cha gcig dngul rkyan gcig dngul phor cha gcig158

rgya spub rnying ma cha gnyis/ gser gyi mu tig sog byil g.yu khra can che chung lnga/g.yu byur spel ma'i spa phrug gcig gser gyi ske ga'u bkag chas rang 'grigs gcig gri dpa' dam dngul shub la byur rgyan 'byar ba bzhi/ zhwa mo lcags mda' rag gi phru tog 'byar ba gsum/ rgya se'i zhwa mo thi phi li gcig sog zhwa rnying pa gnyis/ zhwa 'bog rnying pa gnyis/ rgya gri phor shub cha tshang lnga/ 'ja' lham rnying pa cha gnyis sogs tho 'dra gnyis bkod de sprad byung / de rjes zlos gar tshogs pa dngos su btsugs pa'i 'khrab ston gzigs phud rda sa'i pho brang du gzhas bro sna tshogs 'khrab khongs su 'go 'dzin nor nang ngag dbang nor bu dang / phran lha dbang tshe ring gnyis mnyam du nang ma (bkra la shis pa )dang /bar mtsho rdo rje don grub dang / spyi lcags bkra shis rdo rje gnyis nas nang ma'i zhabs gzhas/ sman stod tshe dbang rgyal po dang / rma bya ngag dbang mthu stobs gnyis nas stod gzhas zhabs bro bcas 'khrab gtong bya rgyu'i nang gros gtan 'khel byas yod kyang / rma bya ngag dbang mthu stobs nas skabs mtshams der gzigs lam du 'khrab nus pa mi 'dug zer bas khong gi tshab la chos 'phel klu sgrub nas 'khrab/ nga tshor khrab ston bya yul tshogs khang med stabs ko nem gyi khang pa che ba gnyis bar bcad gtor nas sbrel te khang pa gcig gi sa char 'khrab stegs sdings cha brgyangs/ khang pa gcig dang g.yab 'khor dang / de'i lhor thog med sa brgyangs nas ltad mo ba sdod yul bzos par ko ne+em khang gnyer rgya gar ba rgan po zhig yod pa khong yong nas mgo dkrugs dkrugs kyis nga tsho'i khang pa gtor bshig 'di 'dra btang na 'grigs min zer bas/ ngas slad phyin gsar bzo byas chog lab kyang ma nyan par rgya gar gzhung gi sku tshab la snyan seng zhus te rgya gar gzhung gi sku tshab dang shes rig las rogs thub bstan nyin byed lags ko nem du lta zhib la slebs byung bas thub bstan nyin byed nas ‘‘a tsi khag mi 'dug lha dbang lags 159

'di 'dra rang gtor drag pa ma red pas mi’zhes zer byung / ngas 'dis kyang chungaskyon las med gshis/ slad phyin nga tshos khang pa sngar bzhin nyams bzo gsar rgyag bya rgyu'i 'gan len zhus chog pa zhes rgya gar sku tshab la bka' mol gnang rogs zhes brjod pa ma zad/ de don slar gso bya rgyu'i gan 'dzin zhig kyang sprad nas mu mthud tshogs khang bzo bcos dang / sdings cha'i rgyab ljongs ri mo/ 'khrab ston pa pho mo phyogs dbye'i nyal khang khag drug sogs rang mi rang las kyis bzos/ nyal khang gi 'go pa re dang sdod bya'i dge rgan mnyam du nyin ltar dus tshod nges med gtsang sbra legs zhan blta bskor gyis tho bkod thog bdun phrag gcig gi res gza' spen pa nam shar la dgong dro tshogs 'du'i sar tho yig klog ste gtsang sbra legs shos la gru tse mtshal ga'i steng ‘‘gtsang sbra'i legs dar ’’zhes pa'i yi ge gser bris stong skud 'dzar ldan gyi dar cha sprad/ sdod res dge rgan drug las med stabs nyin gcig sdod res phran lha dbang tshe ring gis byas/ res gza' spen pa'i tshogs 'du'i gleng gzhi sgrig khrims srung brtsi'i skor dang / slob sbyong skor/ 'tsho ba'i skor bcas khag gsum la dbye nas gros bsdur dang / legs pa'i rigs la bstod bsngags/zhan cha'i rigs la slob gso go bskon sogs byas/ skabs re gros bsdur nyung dus ming 'bod kyi gzhas dang zhabs bro brgyab/ 'go byings dge slob thams cad mnyam za mnyam las byas stabs phan tshun mdza' brtse mthun sgril dang /spyod lam bzang ba/ las ka'i rigs la hur brtson che ba/ skabs 'gar phogs khang nas sprad pa'i me shing zad de mi ldeng ba'i skabs/ ri nas me shing 'thu bar nad gcong phud de byings tshang mas dga' spro'i ngang dang blangs kyis 'gro ba dang / phogs khang nas zla re za 'bru sogs phogs thob rnams len par dge slob tshang ma ru sgrigs kyis len bskyod byed pa sogs sgrig lam kun spyod dang / slob sbyong bsam pa'i 'khyer so gang ci ya rabs spyod bzang gi rnam pa zhig thon pas gong 'og tshang ma'i bsngags brjod thob pa dang / lhag 160

par slob phrug chung ba tshos zhogs pa nam zir la phred gling phu sbyong byed skabs skor bar 'gro mkhan tshos phru gu tshor rngan pa mang po ster gyi yod pa dang / res gza' nyi ma'i gung seng skabs khrom gzhung la 'gro dus zlos gar phru gu tshor rngan pa ster mkhan mang po yong gi 'dug de nas sku sger drung che mkhan chung rta ra ba bstan 'dzin chos nyid brgyud ‘‘bden tshig smon lam ’’zhes pa der rta dbyangs snyan 'jebs shig brtsams sbyong byed dgos kyi bka' 'byor don/gtso bo'i glu gzhas 'khrab ston gyi las 'gan dge che rma bya bla ma ngag dbang mthu stobs la yod kyang khong la nga tshos gzhogs 'degs dang bcas sgra gdangs mi 'dra ba khag bzhi la dbye nas bzo sbyong byas pa'i rta dbyangs de de rjes zlos gar ba ma zad/ slob grwa khag nas kyang gtong gi yod pa red/bdud 'joms rin po ches chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi rgyal rabs brtsams 'bul zhus 'dug pa gzhi bzhag gis shes rig las khungs nas 'khrab gzhung gsar bzo byas nas zlos gar tshogs par sprad byung ba/ nga tshos nyin mtshan ltos med sbyang brtson hur bskyed kyis tshang mar gzigs 'bul 'khrab ston byas shing / 'khrab tshan de ni thog mar snyan 'jebs rol dbyangs kyis mtshams sbyar nas rgyal po yab sras/ btsun mo/ blon po dang bcas pa thon nas bzhugs khrir 'khod/ blon po rnams g.yas g.yon gyi gral la 'khod rjes/gsol ja btegs/ yab rgyal pos blon tshogs rnams la ‘‘ngos lang tsho rgas gshis chab srid kyi 'gan 'khur sras su dbang bskur rgyur ring min che 'don gyi gra sgrig gyis shig ’’ces bka' stsal ba blon po rnams kyis zhwa phud gus 'dud kyis rgyal po'i bka' bzhin dang len zhus te sras khri srong lde btsan rgyal srid la dbang bskur ba'i mdzad sgo gzab rgyas kyi rnam pa dang 'brel gar dang rol dbyangs/ zhwa nag dang dur bdag gi 'cham/ bro gzhas sogs 'khrab ston byed par dus yun chu tshod gsum man tsam 'gor ba'i 'khrab tshan zhig yin/161

'khrab tshan der mi dmangs rnams kyis dga' mos chen po byed pa dang / phyi rgyal gyi mi rigs dang / rgya gar gyi dpon rigs mang po yong mkhan tshor yang 'khrab ston byed dgos par brten res gza' nyi ma'i gung seng skabs su sdod res dge rgan ko nem du bca' sdod kyis glo bur 'khrab ston zhu dgos 'phral sdod res nas dge slob tshang mar 'bod brda btang ste tshang 'dzoms byed dgos pas/ gung seng skabs su'ang rda shod dang / (gangs can skyid gshong /) bu gso khang / (mag lor snyan ji/) 'ba' su na sogs gang la 'gro na'ang sa gnas 'dir 'gro gi yin zhes zhogs pa sdod res dge rgan la kha gsal snyan seng zhu dgos pa dang / rnam kun bu mo'i nyal khang nang du bu rgan pa 'gro mi chog pa ma zad/ bu chung ba yin na'ang sgo'i phyi 'gram nas a ca che ge mo la dge rgan che ge mos lan 'di dang 'di gsung 'dug ces shod pa las nang du 'dzul zhugs mi chog pa dang / de bzhin du bu'i nyal khang la'ang bu mo rgan gzhon tsho phyin mi chog pa/ rang rang pha ma spun mched thug 'phrad byed dus kyang sdod res dge rgan la snyan seng zhu dgos/ pha ma spun mched kyis dgongs pa zhus kyang dgong mo zlos gar khang du log dgos pa las phyi la zhag sdod mi chog res gza' spen pa'i nyin gung nas gtsang sbra gad phyis dang /res gza' nyi ma'i gung seng la ke rem sogs rtsed mo rtse chog kyang mtshan mo'i chu tshod bcu par nyal brda btang ba dang / lam seng mtshams 'jog gis khu sim mer nyal dgos pa las phan tshun skad cha'ang bshad mi chog pa dang /dge rgan tshos slob tshan gra sgrig ma tshar ba sogs yod na chu tshod bcu pa yol nas bsdad chog kyang sdod res la zhu dgos pa sogs sgrig khrims ha cang dam po yod/ shes rig las khungs nas 'brel ba byas te ldi lir yod pa'i 'ju nyan tshogs pa zhes pa nas bod kyi zlos gar 'khrab ston du ldi lir yong na khong tshos rogs ram bya rgyu'i khas len byas yod stabs nga tsho'i mi grangs dang / 'khrab 162

ston gyi le'u dang tho shog le tshan sogs sprad de sngon tshud nas glog brnyan ltad mo'i ‘‘mi'u rdzig ’mices pa'i nang dril bsgrags kyis ltad mo'i tri ka si tshong bsgyur bya rgyu sogs gra sgrig dang nang sbyong hur brtson byas/spyi lo 1960lo'i zla 12tshes 26nyin ldi li nas 'ju nyan tshogs pas zlos gar ba rnams 'phral du yong dgos zhes shes rig las khungs la yi ge btang 'dug pa ltar ldi lir zlos gar ba sdod yul khang pa sogs gang ci'i gra sgrig byed mkhan mi kha shas de'i sang nyin sngon thon byed dgos pas/ 'go 'dzin nor nang nas phran la gra sgrig byed par 'gro rogs zer don/ phran dang /gnyer pa dpal nor/ ma byan mi gcig bcas ldi li gsar par thon 'byor gyis khang pa dang / gdan chas/ thab chas sogs gra sgrig byed sgo rnams sgrub cing / zlos gar byings tshes sum cu dgongs mo'i chu tshod brgyad par ldi lir 'byor skabs gdan gyi mu cu tshem 'phros re zung bsdad pa las gzhan dag brel 'tshub ci ches gra 'grigs tsam byung song / 'khrab ston bya yul rgya gar gzhung gi tshogs khang ‘‘sab tu ha'o ’mizhes par dgong mo rer gla hin sgor sum brgya tham pa re sprod rgyur g.yar 'dug pa der 1961lo'i zla 1tshes 3nyin nas 'go 'dzugs byas te 'khrab ston thengs bcu gcig byas par tri si'i rin dngul gang 'tsham byung 'dug kyang tshogs pas gzhi rgya chen po'i 'gro gron btang ste nga tshor sgor brgyad stong tsam las ma byung / 'khrab ston par bar seng ngal gso nyin re tsam bzhag cing / ngal gso'i nyin phru gu tsho grong khyer gyi khrom dang glog brnyan blta bar 'gro skabs rgya gar gyi phru gu tshos ‘‘ci na ci na ’’zer zhing nga tsho'i phru gu chung ba tshor rdo ded btang ba'ang thengs kha shas byung 'dug kyang /'khrugs rtsod byas na rtsa ba nas mi 'grigs pa'i slob gso yang yang byas/ ldi lir sdod yun zla ba gcig hril po'i ring 'khrab ston dang bcas pa gang ci gra 'grigs 'thus tshang byung ste ldi li nas grong khyer ka li ka tar thon/ ka li ka 163

tar ‘‘yid ches dngul khang ’’do dam byed po tsha rong nas nga tsho'i sdod yul sogs gang ci gra sgrig 'thus tshang byas 'dug pa dang / 'khrab yul ‘‘i'i 'bi'i se ’mizhes skad grags che ba'i tshogs khang der dgong mo rer khang gla nyin sgor chig stong tham pa re sprod rgyur g.yar po blangs 'dug ka tar nyin bcu bsdad de 'khrab ston thengs drug byas par tri si'i rin 'bab hin sgor stong phrag bcu drug 'bab 'dug ka ta nas ri li'i nang sbag sa chos sgar du bskyod/sbag sa'i gsham du sun tā la zhes pa nas mal le gsum tsam gyi sa la nga tsho 'go dge mi brgyad la rta bsu btang 'dug pa las/ de byings rkang thang mar 'gro dgos stabs dge slob tshang ma ngal dub phran bu'i byung bzo lta bu yang sbag sa'i don gcod thub bstan legs smon dang / thub bstan 'gro don gnyis kyis ‘‘khyed rnam pas rda ma dang / sur ṇa/ rnga gling sogs bsnams phebs 'dug pa do nub bco lnga mchod par mchod rol dang / rnga gling dung bcas sngar srol mchod gzigs kyi mdzad sgo ltar gnang rogs zhes zer don bzhin rol cha ba'i khongs nas bu bzhi la sur ṇa dang rda ma bskur te snyan gsan thog mtha' bar gsum 'bul rgyur mngags/ nga tshos pho mo'i gyon chas zhe mtshungs gzab gyon gyis rnga chen rnga chung dang / dung / gling bu bcas ru nyis bsgrigs byas te rol cha snyan 'jebs ldan pa gtong bzhin par dge 'dun tshogs chen la bskor ba gsum brgyab nas 'dus tshogs su phyag 'tshal zhus/ de skabs sbag sar nyin bdun bsdad de 'khrab ston thengs gsum byas par bla ma dge 'dun dang / khul de'i yul mi/ 'brug yul nas yong ba'i 'brug pa pho mo mang po 'byor 'dug ‘‘ltad mo chen po dge mtshan ldan pa 'di ga tsam yod 'gro bsam pa ma byung / khyed tshos sku las bskyon go chod zhag thugs rje che ’’zhes gsung mkhan yang mang po byung / 'khrab ston nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang /mkhan chen bho bhi sa twa/ slob dpon pad+ma sam bha bcas don dus 'brug pa pho mo ltad mo lta mkhan tsho'i nang nas phyag 'tshal mkhan yang mang po 'dug de 164

nas nga tsho sbag sa nas thon te ka sbug tu 'byor zhing / ka sbrug khul gang ci'i gra sgrig byed mkhan don gcod khang nas sa 'du rin chen dang / dom po ngag dbang rig grol ched 'dzugs byas 'dug 'khrab ston bya yul ‘‘kan cal rimizhes glog brnyan tshogs khang zhig glas 'dug pa de'i 'khrab stegs chung skyon la brten snga dro gdung ma dang pang leb bsgrigs te sdings cha bzos/ 'khrab ston nyin dang po der ltad mo ba tshang ma 'dzoms shing / zlos gar ba rnams 'khrab chas gyon tshar nas 'khrab ston byed la khad du khul de'i rgya gar gzhung gi khrims khang gis ‘‘rdo rje gling nas (ḍi si'i )rdzong dpon gyi bka' 'khrol ma byung bar 'khrab ston byas na 'grigs min ’’zhes bshad byung / ḍi si'i hom ser slebs 'dug zer don sa 'du rin chen dang / phran lha tshe gnyis 'jib 'khor nang hom se slob grwar phyin par ḍi si'i ni da nangs snga po rdor gling du song zin 'dug sa 'du rin chen nas ḍi si'i la kha par btang song bas ḍi si'i nas ka sbug tu 'khrab ston chog 'thus kyi kha par lam seng gtong rgyu byas song /dus tshod de'i ring rgyud smad mkhan zur nas bod kyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus dum bu gtam bshad byas/ sa 'du rin chen dang ngos gnyis ‘‘kan cal ’midu 'byor pa dang khrims khang nas bka' 'khrol lan brda 'byor pa dus mnyam byung zhing /yol ba'i nang nas mkhan zur la da 'grigs song zhes bshad pas/ mkhan zur nas gtam bshad mjug bsdoms gnang ste 'khrab ston 'go 'dzugs byas/ka sbug tu zla ba gcig sdod ring 'khrab ston thengs bcu drug byas pa tri si'i rin ka spug don gcod nas shes rig las khungs su sprad/sgang tog nas 'bras ljongs rgyal pos 'khrab ston du yong dgos gsung don ltar bka' mol zhu bar phran lha tshe bcar bskyod ring zlos gar ba bu kha shas chang ma'i nang phyin nas ra bzi ste 'khrugs 'dzings rma rmas kyi gnas tshul byung yod tshod kyang / gsang rgya dam po byas nas phyi gyar byung mi 'dug rgyud 165

smad mkhan zur gyis ‘‘da phyin khyed rang zlos gar ba gar yod par mnyam du bsdad na ma gtogs sgrig khrims ral zhig byed kyi 'dug ces gsungs byung /ngas sgrig khrims gnon sdem yengs med kyis 'phral 'phral slob gso dang /thag gcod nan po byed bzhin la brten 'go 'dzin nor nang nas ‘‘khyed rang gi sgrig lam dam po de 'dra sus kyang sgrub thub kyi ma red/ khyod rang ni dge slong gi 'dul khrims lta bu 'dug byas tsang khyed rang gi ming la nga tshos ‘‘sing ga la'i dge slong ’’zhes btags yod pa red ces bshad byung / rda ram sa lar thengs gcig nor nang las don snyan seng zhu bar 'gro skabs zlos gar ba'i sgrig lam skor tā la'i bla mas dris gnang bar/ nor nang gis ‘‘sgrig lam thad jo lags lha dbang tshe ring gis 'chun sdom gang legs byed par brten khong la nga tshos ‘sing ga la'i dge slong ’zhes ming 'dogs btags yod pa red ’’ces zhus 'dug ming 'dogs btags pa de nga la rten 'brel 'grigs pa lta bu byung nas rjes sor dge slong bsgrubs thub pa byung ba red/ slob sbyong dang las don gang yin yang gtso bor sgrig khrims yag po med na 'grub thub rgyu khag po song tsang sgrig lam gnon mkhan rang gis kyang sgrig khrims yag po 'khur nas hur skyed byas thog gzhan rnams la'ang slob ston dang 'brel sgrig lam gnon rgyur shugs skyed kyis do dam rgyun bsrings byed thub na byas 'bras legs thon yong gi 'dugade nas nga tsho ka sbug nas rdo rje gling du thon zhing / rdor gling du slob grwa'i spyi khyab lha dbang lags khul de'i rgya gar rdzong dpon dang 'brel ba dam zab la brten dril bsgrags byed sgo dang / tri ka si tshong rgyu sogs bde blag ngang 'grub pa dang / zlos gar 'go byings sdod yul slob grwa rang la gra sgrig byas 'dug 'khrab ston bya yul rta rgyugs tshogs pa'i tshogs khang g.yar 'dug pa der mthun rkyen 'dzoms po 'dug slob spyi lha dbang lags dang rdzong dpon 166

mdza' grogs mthun sgril che bar brten 'khrab ston ma byas gong nyin gsum ring nyin ltar grong khyer lam chen khag tu rnga dung rol cha dang / gling bu bcas gtong bzhin par bskyod de sa 'gag mi tshogs che sar bod kyi zlos gar 'khrab ston bya rgyur sa gnas dang dus tshod 'di dang 'di la yin zhes hin di'i skad dang / bod skad gnyis ka'i thog nas rgyang bsgrags lag 'khyer dung chen nang nas khyab bsgrags byas/ rdor gling du sdod yun zla ba gcig la 'khrab ston thengs bco brgyad byas pa'i ‘‘tri si'i ri’rin byung khongs nas 'gro gron khag bcags 'phros shes rig las khungs su sprod rgyur hin sgor brgyad stong tham pa nga tshor bskur byung / rdor gling nas 'bras ljongs la 'gro rgyu yin yang / shes rig las khungs nas yi ge zhig btang 'byor nang ḍa la ha'o ser 'khrab ston byed rgyu'i dus tshod bzos zin pas 'phral 'byor dgos rgyu gsal ba dang /'bras ljongs la phyin na rgya gar gzhung nas ri li'i gla cha chag yang gnang ba'i dus tshod kyang rdzogs pa bcas la brten 'bras ljongs la rjes su yong rgyu byas te rdor gling nas ḍa la ha'o ser bskyod/ ḍal hor don gcod 'jun pa ba dang /'od zer 'bum sde gnyis nas khong ci'i gra sgrig yag po byas 'dug ḍal hor la sdod yun nyin bco lnga'i ring 'khrab ston thengs brgyad byas pa'i tri si btsong rin don gcod nas shes rig las khungs su thad kar sprad/ tshur zhor spa kran ko trir dgong mo gcig 'khrab ston byas te rda ram sa lar phyir log byas/nor nang ngag nor zlos gar 'go 'dzin dgongs pa zhus 'khrol tshab gsar rtse mgron ngag dbang rig grol du bsko gzhag byas/ nga tshos gtam brjod zlos gar 'khrab sbyong rtsal bton hur skyed byas te mtshan mo'i chu tshod bcu pa nas/chu tshod gnyis pa bar sbyangs te snga rjes su shes las sogs la 'khrab ston thengs 'ga' byas/spyi lo 1962lo rgya gar pan jab mnga' sde'i khongs ku lu lam bzor bod 167

mi stong phrag mang po yod pa khong tshos snyan seng zhus don shes las nas ku lur zlos gar 'khrab ston la 'gro dgos pa'i bka' phab pa ltar phran zlos gar 'go 'dzin las rogs lha dbang tshe ring gis 'go 'khrid de mi grangs drug cu re lnga thon bskyod byas/ ku lu lam spyi de snga'i rgyal rtse dmag sgar gyi lding dpon rnam rgyal dbang phyug dang / lam spyi rmar khams a pho rab rgyas gnyis la nang srid dang / shes las kyis sngon tshud nas mngags 'dug ma nang lir 'khrab ston thengs lnga dang mar lam ku lu rgyal po'i pho brang la nyin gnyis 'khrab ston byas shing / nyin gnyis pa'i nyin pan jab spyi khyab blon chen ke rong sab ku lur lta skor du phebs par 'bum thang gnam gru babs thang du phebs bsur phran lha tshe yang ku lu rgyal po mnyam du 'jib 'khor nang bskyod/ phebs bsur sa gnas kyi dpon khag sogs mang po 'dug kyang khong gnam gru nas babs ma thag phran lha dbang tshe ring sar thog mar phebs byung bas mjal dar a she zhig phyag tu phul zhing / khong rang gis dgyes nyams chen pos zlos gar 'khrab ston skor dris byung ba ma zad/ sang nyin ma nang lir bskyar du gtam brjod zlos gar zhig 'khrab ston byed par yong dgos/ 'khor lo'i gla cha dang / mthun rkyen gang ci khong rang gis gra sgrig bya rgyu yin zhes gsungs don/ de'i sang nyin nga tsho ma nang lir phyir log gis gtam brjod zlos gar zhig 'khrab ston byas par ma nang li sa khul gyi yul mi mang tshogs tshang mar gla cha ma dgos par ltad mor yong dgos pa'i brda khyab byas 'dug stabs khul de'i yul mi stong phrag kha shas 'byor 'dug par 'khrab tshan nang don rnams skabs so sor rgya gar skad thog nas 'grel bshad byas pa bcas so/4 rab byung sgrub pa dang dge slong gi bslab gzhi blangs pa/phran lha dbang tshe ring de snga bod du gting skyes 'bras khang skabs rang lo 168

sum cu so bdun la slebs dus nad mnar lci lod du gyur te bza' zla bsod nams dbyangs can dang / phru gu rgan pa tshor kha chems sam snying gtam lta bur ‘‘da res nad gzhi 'dis 'chi 'das ma gyur na lo lnga bcu tham pa bar sdod rgyu'i re ba yod/ lo bzhi bcu zhe lnga la ma slebs bar du gzhung gi zhabs zhu dang /nang sger gyi 'gan 'khur da mus bzhin hur skyed bya rgyu dang / de 'phros lo lnga'i ring tshe phyi ma'i bde don zhig bsgrub rgyu ma byung na bod chos ldan gyi zhing sar skyes pa'i skyes go ma chod pa dang / tshe da res rnyed dka' ba dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/ mjal dka' ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang mjal/'phrad dka' ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa'i dus skabs bzang po 'di chud zos 'phro brlag tu song na ches phangs pas/ des na lo lnga'i ring thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob thub pa zhig byed ma thub na'ang /phyi ma ngan song gsum la ma lhung tsam gyi kha 'don dge sbyor bsha' ma zhig bya rgyu blo thag bcad zin pa yin na khyed ma bu rnams kyis dgongs 'khrol yong ba dang / ma 'khyags ma ltogs tsam gyi 'tsho gos shig khyed tshos ster dgos kyi red ’’ces zer rgyu byung ba dang / bza' zla bsod nams dbyangs can gyi tshe rabs las rtsis nang rang lo bzhi bcu zhe lnga la slebs skabs zla grogs bzang po dang kha bral rgyu zhes gsal yang / ngos bza' 'tsho gnyis ni 'cham mthun gcig sems gcig 'dzin ya rabs bzang spyod ldan pa kun gyis yid smon bya yul zhig yin pas gnyis phyogs nas bza' 'tsho kha bral yong don med pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod kyang / spyi lo 1959lo lha sa'i ngo log zing 'khrug gis rkyen pas phran lha dbang tshe ring lho kha nas rgya gar du yul gyar 'gro dgos byung /phran rgya gar du 'byor te de sngon gyi dam bca' yid la dran nas skra bcad lus bsgyur gyi rab byung bsgrub rgyu nyag cig blo yul du 'char yang / bod kyi zlos gar gsar 'dzugs byed sgo'i las 'gan rkang 'khur byed dgos byung stabs 169

gong bkod bzhin/ spyi lo 1959lo zlos gar thog mar ka sbug tu gsang stabs kyis 'go 'dzugs byas pa nas bzung / 1962lo rgya gar rgyal yongs grong khyer che khag dang / bod mi 'dus sdod khag sogs la rgyal rabs dang / gtam brjod/ bod kyi bzo las dang / 'brog las/ zhing las bcas kyi byed stangs dang gnas tshul/ bod kyi yul tsho khag gi rkang bro/ glu gzhas/ gar 'cham sogs 'khrab ston dril bsgrags byed sgo rnams legs bsgrubs zin te rda ram sa lar phyir 'khor mtshams su mchod dpon mkhan po'i sku gam ngo bcar thog snga phyi'i lo rgyus zhib gsol gyis da cha gus pa rab byung sgrub chog pa'i snyan seng gnang skyong yod pa zhes bshad par/ mchod dpon mkhan po hang sang 'dogs kyis ‘‘'a rdzis ngas zhu nus pa mi 'dug khyod rang zlos gar 'go 'dzin gyi las 'gan ljid po de bzhag nas rab byung sgrub rgyu ga par yong gi red dgongs pa ma tshom ’’zhes zer byung / bsam mno zhig btang nas sku srung mda' dpon phun tshogs bkra shis sar phyin te gnas lugs shod skabs yab gzhis tshe ring sgrol ma der slebs byung / khong gis ‘‘lha dbang lags khyed rang gi lcam dang a war tshang ma bod du lus tsang thugs sems skyo po yong gi red/ de gang yang gnang gi ma red/ nga tsho mgyogs po mjal gyi red/ khyed rang gis gzhung gi zhabs zhu hur thag gnang ba ma zad lhag par zlos gar gyi las don thog la ha las pa'i dka' las bskyon song 'grigs ga' da cha grwa pa gnang ba yag po red/ mda' dpon nga gnyis kyang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus pa yin zhes zer byung / mda' dpon gyis ‘‘ngas snyan seng zhus chog bka' lan ji stsal sang gnangs gsal cha byas chog ’’ces zer byung ba dang / de'i sang nyin mda' dpon gyis ‘‘bka' 'khrol byung ’’zhes pa'i yi ge zhig skyel bar btang 'dug grwa chas bzo tshem byed rtsis kyis rda shod kyi tshong khang khag tshang mar phyin kyang grwa chas kyi tshos gzhi mthun pa'i ras zhig rtsa ba nas rnyed ma byung /170

yar lam mag lor ghan ji nas rgyud smad mkhan zur ngag dbang lags mjal bas khong gis ‘‘'o 'grigs shag rab byung 'phral du sgrub na legs/ grwa chas ther ma ka sbug tu nyos chog yod gshis ngas mngags chog gnas skabs nga'i gzab spros cha tshang gcig yod/ des 'grig gi red ces gsungs te rngul len dang / stod 'gag zan sham cha tshang g.yar po gnang byung bas de 'phral khri byang rin po che'i sku mdun du bcar te maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang bcas rab byung sgrub rgyu'i skyabs 'jug zhus par/ ‘‘khyed rang sngon la dgongs pa 'khrol na ma gtogs lam seng sgrub rgyu 'grigs min gsungs byung bar bka' 'khrol byung lugs zhus pas/ ‘‘'o na 'grigs kyi red ’’gsungs te lo thor tshes cha gzigs nas nyin gsum song mtshams khri byang bla brang du bcar rgyu'i dus tshod bzos thog gang ci'i gra sgrig bla brang nang gnang rogs zhes zhus pa yin/dngos gzhi rab byung sgrub nyin gtso bo khri byang rin po che dang las slob tu dga' ldan dze smad sprul sku/ bla ti sprul sku/ ser smad dge bshes gcig bcas nas cho ga gnad smin dang 'brel rab byung gi sdom pa legs par nos/chos ming du ‘‘blo bzang bstan 'dzin mi’zhes 'dogs pa gnang byung / de nas zlos gar sdod yul ko nim du phyir log skabs skra bcad lus bsgyur grwa chas spras yod stabs tshang ma ha las ya mtshan skyes te blta rub byed pa dang / kha shas nasakha btags dang dngul 'khyer te ‘‘rten 'brel legs 'bul ’’yin ces sdod shag tu slebs byung / de dus bod zla bzhi pa sa ga zla ba 'khel yod/de rjes bod zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi nyin tā la'i bla mar a mdo kir ti sprul skus gsol btab bzhin rab byung sgrub mkhan mi grangs brgya dang nyer drug la bslab gzhi yongs rdzogs dge slong gi sdom pa nos pa'i khongs su gus pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin la yang dge slong gi sdom pa dngos su thob/171

5 yul gyar srid gzhung gi shes rig drung che'i las 'khur byas pa/1961lo yul gyar srid gzhung nas dmangs gtso'i ring lugs ldan pa'i ‘‘rtsa khrims gsar pa ’’zer ba zhig bzos pa'i nang don gzhir bzung bka' blonagyis gtsos ser skya yongs rdzogs mi dmangs spyi mtshungs su phab pa'i dril bsgrags dang / ‘‘dmangs gtso'i gzhung ’’zer ba de'i las byed che chung rnams gsar du bsko gzhag bya rgyu'i thad bod mi 'dus sdod khag nas shes yon ldan la spyi sems drang tshugs che ba'i 'thus mi 'dems shog nas thon pa mdo smad khongs nas 'thus mi skyes pa gsum dang / bud med gcig ste/ a mdo stong 'khor sprul sku dang / rgyal rong khro bcu dpon rdo rje pa sangs/ skye mdo dra bo dpon rin chen dang / bud med a mdo dga' g.yu grung bcas dang / mdo stod khongs nas skyes pa gsum dang bud med gcig ste/ tre bo sa 'du blo snyan grags dang / sde dge bya rgod rnam rgyal rdo rje/ ljang tsha chos mdzad/ bud med chab mdo yab tshang lcam/ dbus gtsang khongs nas 'thus mi skyes pa gsum dang bud med gcig ste/ chu shur bsam mkhar tshe ring dbang 'dus dang /de snga'i kha dang brgya dpon skal bzang dgra 'dul/ rgyal rtse ri shing rtsa'u dang /bud med dbus stod mal gung ka tshal dge bsnyen chos sgron/ chos lugs che khag bzhi so so nas 'thus mi re ste/ rnying ma khams sprul don brgyud nyi ma/ sa skya'i rtsed gdong tshe dbang rta mgrin/ bka' brgyud blo gros/ dge lugs 'bras spungs tsha phyag bcas dang / dmigs bsal du bsko gzhag byas pa bod kyi mkhas pa gcig ste/ ra stod chu dbar sprul sku bcas mi grangs bcu bdun yod pa'i 'thus mi gsar bsko byas shing / khong tshos zla ba mang po bsam zhib gros bsdur byas pa'i snying por da lta bka' shag nang yod pa'i bka' blon 172

rnams snga 'khros lo gsum ring rang 'jags dgos lugs dang / bka' blon las rogs khag dang / drung che sogs las byed gzhan rnams gsar bsgo bya rgyur gros 'cham byung yang / de snga'i bka' blon tshos ‘‘nga tsho gzhung zhabs rnying pa rang 'jags bsdad na dmangs gtso'i gzhung gi mtshan don gnyis 'gal las ma 'das pas nga tsho rtsa ba nas dgongs khrol yong ba ’’zhes bshad par/'thus mi tshos nga tshos bsam zhib nan tan byas te las byed che chung tshang ma gsar rkyang bsko gzhag byas chog kyang / cha rgyus gang yang med mkhan zhe gcig bskos na nga tshos blos 'gan rtsa ba nas bzod thabs bral lugs nan tan chen pos bshad/ 'on kyang bka' blon rnying pa tshos gnas skabs tsam yang rang 'jags sdod rgyu'i khas len ma byas stabs mthar tā la'i bla mas bka' blon tshor ‘‘da res 'thus mir dbang tshad sprad par brten khong tsho'i re 'dun ltar byed gal che ’’lugs mos khyab bzhin bka' blon rnying pa tsho lo gsum ring rang 'jags sdod rgyur khas len byas 'dug gong gsal 'os shog nas 'dems thon mi grangs bcu bdun las grub pa'i ‘‘mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen ’’zhes pa des bskos bsgrigs byas pa'i las byed kyi rim pa rnams gsham gsal ltar bsko gzhag gtan 'khel gyis spyi lo 1962lo'i zla nang rda ram sa lar ‘‘dmangs gtso gzhung ’zer ba btsugs pa'i rten 'brel mdzad sgo'ang byas/de'i sang nyin tā la'i bla mas shes rig bka' blon kun gling dza sag 'od zer rgyal mtshan dang / bka' blon las rogs bar zhi rje drung mkhyen rab bstan skyong / shes rig drung che phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin bcas 'gugs 'bod kyis ‘‘kha cis mdzad sgo'i thog las khungs che chung dang las rigs tshang ma'i byed phyogs mtha' dag gsal bshad byas pa ltar dang / lhag par de ring khyed gsum ched 'bod byed don ni/ shes rig gi las don 'di ha cang gi gal 'gangs che zhing / bod phrug rnams la shes rig yon tan slob sbyong bya 173

rgyur khyed tshos do 'khur che bskyed kyis phru gu tshor slob sbyong byed sgo lhod g.yeng ma song ba 'thus legs yong ba'i 'bad brtson nan tan byed dgos rimipa'i bkod khyab byas byung / skabs der sgrig bkod byas pa'i srid 'dzin mi sna'i go rim ni (1)tā la'i bla ma/ (2)srid blon/ (3)bka' blon/ (4)bka' blon las rogs/ (5)drung che/ (6)drung che las rogs/ (7)drung che gzhon pa/ (8)rgan drung / (9)gzhon drung /(10)las khungs khag gi yig skyel ba dang / kha lo pa sogs srid 'dzin mi sna'i rim pa bcu yod pa red/bka' shag nang bka' blon lhan tshogs dgos pas ma tshad bka' blon tsho las khungs gzhan la khag bgos kyis 'gro dgos shing (las khungs so so'i rtsa ba'i 'gan 'khur drung che so sos byed dgos/) de'ang ‘‘chos don las khungs ’ zhes pa'i bka' blon ni de snga'i bka' blon las rogs rnying pa shan kha ba 'gyur med bsod nams stobs rgyal dang / mkhan drung tā bla ma thub bstan nor bzang yin pa dang / ‘‘nang srid las khungs ’’zhes pa'i bka' blon de snga'i rtse mkhan mgron che ba pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan/ ‘‘shes rig las khungs ’rizhes pa'i bka'ablon kun gling dza sag 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ ‘‘phyi srid las khungs mi’zhes pa'i bka' blon bka' tshab rnying pa sne shar thub bstan thar pa dang /yabagazhis stag lha rgyal lo don grub/ ‘‘dngul rtsis las khungs ’’zhes pa'i bka' blon de snga'i spyi mkhan dga' brang blo bzang rin chen bcas dang /bka' blon las rogs gras/ rmar khams pa dam pa blo gros/ (chos don/)a mdo brgyad stong /(nang srid/) de snga'i rtse mgron bar zhi ba thub bstan bstan skyong (shes rig )bcas yin/ 6 las khungs che khag gi drung che/(1)‘‘sku sger yig tshang ’’zhes pa'i drung che mkhan chung rta ra ba bstan 174

'dzin chos nyid/ (2)bka' shag drung che zur khang pa'i de snga'i mdun g.yog gras dbang 'dus rdo rje/ (3) chos don drung che phan po bco brgyad khri chen/(4)nang srid drung che de snga'i mkhan chung thub bstan sangs rgyas dang de snga'i rtsis pa rab sgang pa/ (5)shes rig drung che zlos gar 'go 'dzin las rogs phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ (6)phyi srid drung che de snga'i rtse drung ngag dbang don grub/ (7)dngul rtsis drung che de snga'i rtsis pa bar mtsho ba bsod nams dpal 'byor bcas yin/7 las khungs 'bring khag dang chung khag(1)sde srung 'gan 'dzin sku srung mda' dpon stag lha phun tshogs bkra shis dang / drung che sogs/ (2)las byed bdag gnyer khang 'gan 'dzin de snga'i rtsis dpon kun bzang brtse dang / drung che sogs/ (3)shes rig khongs rtsom sgyur khang 'gan 'dzin brag g.yab ho thog thu dang / de snga'i dmag spyi rnying pa dza sag khe smad pa bsod nams dbang 'dus/ las rogs phyi srid drung che ngag dbang don grub dang / bkras mthong stobs 'byor/ las bya dga' gdong blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / gdong sna thub bstan tshe ring / (4)thad ka'i 'go khrid khongs/ ma su ri bu khyim kyi 'go 'dzin 'phreng ring rig 'dzin sgrol ma/ (5)rda sa bu gso khang 'go 'dzin yab gzhis ltag lha tshe ring sgrol ma dang / las rogs pha lha phogs dpon/ (6)ldi li bod khang 'go 'dzin gro mo dge bshes rin po che dang / drung che lcags sprag tshe ring sgrol ma/(7)gangs can skyid gshong dpe mdzod khang 'go 'dzin rgya mtsho bkra shis/(8)wa ra na si mtho rim slob grwa chen mo'i spyi khyab tsha ba zam gdong sprul sku/(9)rda ram sa la sman rtsis khang gi 'go 'dzin de snga'i rtse drung khang chung dkar po rje drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ (10)shes rig zlos gar 'go 'dzin rtse mgron ngag dbang rig grol dang / las rogs sman stod pa tshe dbang rgyal po/175

(11)shes rig dpar khang 'go 'dzin 'bru drung o rgyan bcas yin/8 don gcod khag(1)a rir don gcod phyi srid bka' blon sne shar dang / phyi srid bka' blon stag lha rgyal lo don grub/ (2)rgya gar rgyal sa ni'u ldi lir don gcod zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan/ (3)bal yul don gcod de snga'i rtse mgron rme ru thub bstan nyi ma/ (4)'brug yul don gcod 'phreng ring rig 'dzin rnam rgyal/ de rjes lha sding bsod nams dpal 'byor/ (5)sud si don gcod pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan dang blo bzang bsam gtan/ (6)sbags chos sgar gyi don gcod de snga'i mkhan chung thub bstan legs smon dang / de snga'i rtse drung thub bstan 'gro don/ (7)'bras ljongs sgang tog tu don gcod de snga'i mda' dpon mdo mkhar ba dang / rtse drung ngag dbang chos bzang / (8)rdor gling don gcod rma bya tshe dbang 'gyur med/ (9)ka sbug don gcod rmar khams rdo tshe/ (10)la dwags don gcod dang / gzhis chags khag gi spyi khyab gcig lcogs rtse drung byams pa blo gsal/ (11)ku lu khul gyi lam las khag gi spyi khyab de snga'i cha dang lding dpon rnam rgyal dbang phyug dang / rmar khams rab rgyas/ (12)cam pa lam spyi de snga'i chab dam o rgyan/ (13)ḍal hor bzo grwa'i 'go 'dzin de snga'i mda' dpon 'jun pa dang / rtse mgron 'od zer 'bum bde/ (14)sim la bzo grwa'i 'go 'dzin a mdo rin chen/ (15)rdor gling bzo grwa'i spyi khyab rgyal lo don grub kyi bza' zla/ (16)rda sa bud med mnyam las bzo grwa'i 'go 'dzin rmar lam phyag mdzod tshe brtan bcas yin/bod mi 'dus sdod gzhis chags khag gi ‘‘nang srid las khungs ’’zhes pa ngo tshab don gcod gras/ (1)rgya gar lho phyogs ma'i sor 'be le kob bod 176

mi'i gzhis chags ‘‘lugs zung bsam grub gling mi’gi don gcod de snga'i mkhan chung thub bstan nyi ma/ (rgyal mtshan star ga ) dang / pha lha dbang phyug(2)o ri sa gzhis chags don gcod de snga'i rtse drung shar rtse mkhyen rab bstan skyong dang / mdo mkhar g.yog gras phun tshogs bkra shis/ (3)ma da pa ti sha don gcod byang thang bkras gling phun tshogs rnam rgyal dang / sa skya mi 'gyur/(4)mon spa da don gcod gzhis rtse tshe dbang rig 'dzin/ (5)rgya shar ti rdzu don gcod pad bkod bla ma/ (6)mon go ṭa don gcod dang lho phyogs gzhis chags spyi khyab gcig lcogs bkras mthong tshe dbang chos rgyal/ (7)ku lu gal don gcod de snga'i spyan gling khang gnyer rtse drung rgyal mtshan chosta ldan/ (8)hon sur don gcod lcog steng nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ (9)sban da ra don gcod de snga'i rtse drung ye shes mthar phyin/ (10)ma'i sor gzhis chags gsar pa'i don gcod de snga'i rtse drung byams pa brtson 'grus/ (11)rgya shar lcags glang don gcod khang ser blo gros/ (12)'bum di la don gcod rmar khams bstan pa 'phrin las/ (13)bal yul nang gzhis chags khag bdun nang slob grwa dang / bzo grwa khag mang yod kyang gcig nas gnyis su zhib phra ma nges/(14)la dwags khul du'ang gzhis chags byang thang dang / chu shur sogs khag kha shas dang / khungs so sor slob grwa dang lag shes bzo grwa khag btsugs yod pa red/ (15)ka shi mir nang bod kyi kha che rnams gzhis chags/ 'go 'dzin rang khongs nas byed bcug ste rum 'thag las grwa sogs la yul gyar gzhung nas rogs ram byed pa/ (16)wa lung khang pa can gzhis chags 'go 'dzin de snga'i gting skyes 'khor chen gzhis sdod phun tshogs dbang 'dus/ (17)rdor gling chu sgang gzhis chags 'go 'dzin li thang a 'brug bu rta mgrin tshe dbang / (18)rdor gling su da na mda' 'brog las gzhis 'go rgyal rtse sde pa glang pa sangs rgyal po/ (19)rdor gling nub bal khongs stobs gling gzhis chags 'go 'dzin rgyal mkhar nang pa bcas yin/177

bod pa skyabs bcol ba yongs rdzogs sa khul lung tshan gcig la gzhis chags byas 'thus zhes rgya gar gzhung la thog mar bka' mol rim zhus la/ rgya gar gzhung nas mi grangs sum stong yan ma brgal na legs lam che lugs gsungs pa ltar gong gsal gzhis chags rer mi grangs sum stong re dang / mi grangs nyis stong lnga brgya re sna tshogs yod cing / ‘‘'dzam gling skyob gso tshogs pa ’’zer ba'i ngo tshab spu ru si trar zhes pa des tā la'i bla mar bod mi lung tshan so so gzhis chags byas na yar rgyas gong 'phel legs lugs yang yang snga phyir u tshugs nan brjod la brten/ yag po yong ba'i gdeng tshod yod na de don byas 'thus mol ba bzhin kho pas sa skya dang / mtshur phu karma pa/ khams sprul don brgyud nyi ma/ a mdo gung thang tshul khrims/ sde dge gling tshang / bon po/nang chen nam mkha' rdo rje/ nang chen rgyal po/ sde dge ka thog skye mdo gra bo dpon/ lhun rtse spro khang jo lags/ ‘‘chu bzhi sgang drug’’pe tog bcas tshogs pa khag bcu gsum la yul gyar ‘‘nang srid ’’las khungs zhes pa nas ngo tshab don gcod ched gtong ma dgos par rang khongs so so nas 'go 'dzin bsko gzhagakhyas 'thus zer don bzhin don smin thob ste gong gsal sbu ru si trar gyis rang gi 'dod mos yod pa'i mi la 'go 'dzin bskos nas de dag sger la mthun rkyen 'dod blo khengs pa ster zhing / spyi phan gyi las don sgrub khul las don du skyobs gso rogs ram yod rigs mig sman mig thog tu phan pa ma byung stabs 'tsho ba yar rgyas gtan nas ma phyin par dka' ngal ci cher gyar bar brten tsho khag mang che bas yul gyar gzhung la ‘‘nang srid las khungs rimikyi ngo tshab don gcod gtong dgos brjod don bzhin btang rjes de dag gzhis chagasaspyi dang 'dra ba byung yod/ sbru tu si trar zer ba des bod rigs nang khul 'gal zla dang / gzhung dang mang tshogs dbar mi mthun pa'i dbyen sbyor bya spyod ji rnyed cig spel thabs byas kyang nus pa de tsam ma thon pa red/178

9 slob grwa khag(1)wa ra na sir mtho rim slob grwa chen mo'i spyi khyab zam gdong sprul sku'i khongs su slob ma ser skya mi grangs 200skor/ (2)ma su ri slob grwa'i spyi khyab 'phreng ring 'jigs med rnam rgyal khongs slob phrug pho mo grangs 1200 (3)rdo rje gling slob grwa'i spyi khyab lha dbang gi khongs slob phrug pho mo grangs 1200(4)sim la slob grwa'i spyi khyab kun gling ngag dbang lung rtogs khongs su slob phrug mi grangs 1200 (5)ṭal hor slob grwa'i spyi khyab kun gling ngag dbang rgyal mtshan khongs slob phrug 1200 (6) ka spug slob spyi rdor gling gcig lcogs lha dbang khongs su slob phrug 1200 (7)spa cha ma ri slob spyi dga' ldan dze smad sprul sku'i khongs su slob phrug 1200 (8)rda sa bu khyim slob grwa'i spyi khyab yab gzhis tshe ring sgrol ma dang / rjes su rje btsun pad+mo'i khongs slob phrug grangs 1200 (9)mon ḍa a bur slob grwa'i spyi khyab blo bzang dge legs khongs slob phrug grangs 800 (10)shes rig zlos gar 'go 'dzin de snga'i rtse mgron ngag dbang rig grol khongs dge slob las byed bsdoms mi grangs 105 (11)shes rig dpar khang 'go 'dzin 'bru drung o rgyan khongs las byed mi grangs 15 (12)kang ra dge 'os slob dpon dze smad sprul sku'i khongs slob sbyong pa grwa grangs 25dang / dge 'os slob sbyong btsun ma 2 bod yig dge rgan spyi lcags bkra shis rdo rje/ (13)kang ra zur gsog slob spyi nyag re mkhan sprul ngag dbang dge legs khongs slob grangs 600 (14)rda shod zur gsog slob spyi rtse drung sbrag spyi pad+ma'i khongs slob phrug grangs 250 (15)rda steng zur gsog slob grwa shes las zhor skyong la slob phrug 165 (16)las byed bdag gnyer las khungs khongs su las byed slob phrug mi grangs 25(17) phyi rgyal du rgyal khab khag bcu drug nang slob phrug mi grangs 300skor 179

(rjes su rim 'phar/)10 dgon khag gras/(1)rgya gar lho phyogs ma'i sor mon sgo ḍar 'bras spungs dgon (dge 'dun grangs 1000tsam/) (2)dga' ldan dgon (dge 'dun grangs 1000) (3)gzhan yang sa dge bka' rnying dgon chung 'ga' shas kyang yod/ (4) ma'i sor 'be le kob lugs zung bsam grub gling gi se ra theg chen gling (dge 'dun 1000tsam/) (5)bkra shis lhun po (dge 'dun zhal grangs 30tsam/) (6)sa skya dgon (dge 'dun zhal grangs 20tsam/)(7)grong sde bzhi pa'i nang bka' brgyud dpal g.yu dgon (dge 'dun zhal grangs 30) (8)grong sde gnyis pa'i nang dge lugs brag skyabs sprul sku'i dgon (dge 'dun zhal grangs 60tsam/) (9)gzhis chags gsar pa'i bka' brgyud dgon/ (10)gzhis chags gsar pa'i rnying ma'i dgon/(11)ma'i sor hon sur gzhis chags khongs su rgyud smad grwa tshang (dge 'dun 200tsam/) (12)bka' brgyud dgon/ (13)rnying ma'i dgon/(14)sa skya dgon/ (15)rdo rje gdan bod dgon dge lugs bsam gtan gling (dge 'dun grangs 120skor/) (16)'bum la bstan 'dzin sgang dpal ldan rgyud stod grwa tshang (dge 'dun zhal grangs 200skor/) (17)ka sbug dge lugs dgon thar pa chos gling (dge 'dun zhal grangs 100tsam/)(18)ka sbug bka' brgyud dgon/ (19)ka sbug rnying dgon zangs mdog dpal ri/ (20) rdo rje gling dge dgon mkhar shangs dgon/(21)rdo rje gling dge lugs gum dgon/ (22)rdor gling bka' brgyud dgon/ (23)ḍas ra ḍon ka la man gru dge dgon a mdo bkra shis 'khyil dgon/ (24)ḍas ḍon sa skya chos sgar/ (25)'bras ljongs bka' 180
