brgyud rum stegs dgon/ (26)rda sa theg chen chos gling rnam rgyal grwa tshang (dge 'dun grangs 100) (27)rda sa mtshan nyid grwa tshang (dge 'dun grangs 70) (28)rda sa mo dgon ne byung ri dgon (btsun ma grangs 30)(29)gzhan yang bod mi 'dus sdod gzhis chags gang sar grub mtha' ris med kyi dgon chung mang po yod pa red/) (30)bal yul khul du 'phags pa shing kun gyi rir gser kong rdo rje 'chang gi dgon (dge 'dun zhal grangs 50skor/) (31)bal yul du gnya' lam 'phel rgyas gling dge lugs dgon (dge 'dun grangs 30skor/) (32)bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'khor du skyid grong bsam gtan gling dge lugs dgon (dge 'dun zhal grangs 70skor/) (33)bal yul mchod rten chen mo'i nye 'khor sa skya dgon/ (34)bal yul mchod rten chen mo'i byang phyogs su rnying ma o rgyan sprul sku'i dgon (dge 'dun zhal grangs 70skor/) (35)gzhan yang bal yul nang dgon chung gras mang po zhig 'dug11 rgya gar sa khul du yod pa'i bod kyi slob grwa khag la blta zhib byed par mngag gtong bzhin bskyod pa/spyi lo 1963lor rgya gar sa khul du yod pa'i bod kyi slob grwa yongs rdzogs kyi slob sbyong sogs kyi byed sgor blta zhib tu shes rig drung che phran blo bzang bstan 'dzin gtong rgyu yin zhes tā la'i bla mas rgya gar gzhung la snyan seng phul bar rgya gar gzhung nas gsung gsal la/ rgya gar byang phyogs sa khul khag drag po'i khyab khongs su yod stabs 'di lo lho phyogs dang / dbus nub kyi bod mi'i slob grwa khag la btang na legs lugs bshad don bzhin ma da ra si dang /mi sor/ ma da pa di sha/ o ri sa sogs la 'gro rgyu'i skad bsgyur lcog steng bu gzhon pa bsod nams yon tan dang / phran blo bstan gnyis la tā la'i bla 181

mas ‘‘da res khyod rang slob grwa khag la ngo bskyod kyis gang cir dge skyon shes rtogs dang legs spel slob ston gang gzab dgos rgyu dang / zhor la ma da ra si'i slob spyi dang slob phrug dbar dang / dge rgan dang slob phrug dbar 'gal zla byung nas slob sbyong la 'thus shor byung yod tshod 'dug pas de skor khyod rang nas gnas tshul zhib brtag gis le 'grigs 'thus tshang yong thabs byed dgos pa ma zad/ gzhan yang bod mi sdod yul gzhan dag la'ang zhor bskyod blta rtogs gang thub byas te yun 'gor ma song ba gang mgyogs phyir 'khor thub pa dgos rgyu ’’zhes pa'i bkod mngags bzhin ldi li brgyud me 'khor nang ma da ra sir bskyod cing / ma da ra si ka lag sha da ra slob grwa'i sbyin bdag rug ma ni da'i phig dang thug 'phrad byas pa dang / slob spyi shang dkar me'i non yang de gar mnyam du 'dug pas snga phyi'i yong rkyen gnas lugs gsal bshad zhib mol skabs slob spyis brjod gsal la gzhigs na slob phrug khongs nas lcags bzo slob phrug rgan pa mi bdun lag rtsal gang legs thon te las ka thob nas nyin re'i gla cha yong 'bab nas do bdag so sor lag sne phran bu re sprad de/ rtsa ba'i gla dngul rnams slob phrug byings kyi 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen gyi kha snon du btang ba des slob phrug mi bdun po 'dod blo ma khengs par khong tsho'i gla 'bab do bdag so so rang la dgos lugs bshad stabs/ khyod tsho'i gla 'bab slob phrug spyi phan la btang ba las nga tshos bar bzos byas med gshis sngar rgyun bya rgyu yin lugs bshad par/ slob phrug bdun pos gla 'bab cha tshang nga tshor ma sprad na nga tsho dgongs pa gnang rogs sdod kyi min zhes bshad stabs slob spyi shang dkar khong khro langs te de don 'grig gi red ces bshad rkyen slob phrug tshos de'i sang nyin zhogs pa snga por me 'khor nang phyir log byas pa bcas kyi gnas tshul tsam las/ de min gnas tshul nyen tshabs che ba gang yang byung med pa red/ slob spyis phran la khong tshor lag sne phran bu spar cha byas chog rang 182

'jags btang na'ang 'grig gi red ces brjod byung / slob grwa'i bod dge yid dga' sprul sku dang / sgo mo sprul sku gnyis nang khul mthun po med pa ma zad slob phrug tsho dang yang mi mthun pa/ slob phrug tshos kyang dge rgan la brtsi bkur med pa zhig red 'dug der brten dge rgan gsar pa 'ga' la sprul sku slob grwar ngo sprod byas te rnying pa gnyis phyir 'then gyis rda ram sa lar gtong rgyu byas/ nyin gcig slob spyi dang / phran/ skad bsgyur/ dge rgan gsar rnying gsum/ slob phrug tshang ma bcas bzhugs mol tshogs 'du 'tshogs shing phran nas snga phyi'i yong rkyen rnams gsal bshad dang 'brel phyin chad tshang ma'i byed sgor zhen bskul dang / legs slob byas/ slob grwa nas dge rgan gsar par rten 'brel kha btags dang / dge rgan rnying pa gnyis la skyel ma'i kha btags g.yogs pa bcas byas te tshogs 'du grol/ de'i sang nyin ma da ra si nas me 'khor nang zhugs te ma'i sor 'be le kob ‘‘lugs zung bsam grub gling ’’gzhis chags su 'byor/ gzhis chags 'go 'dzin rnying pa byams pa brtson 'grus dang / gsar pa 'bri gung dkon mchog bsam gtan gnyis nas sne len gyis don gcod khang du bsdad/ byed sgo rnams gsal bshad zhib mol dang 'brel de'i gnangs nyin grong sde dang po dang / gnyis pa gnyis kyi dbar la yod pa'i slob grwa 'bring ba'i tshogs khang du khul der gnas pa'i gzhis chags mang tshogs tshang ma zhugs pa'i tshogs 'du tshogs shing /thog mar don gcod rnying pa byams pa brtson 'grus nas tshogs 'du gtso skyong byas rjes phran blo bstan nas snga phyi'i yong rkyen mdor bsdus dang bcas/ da lam phran 'di gar yong don snying po slob phrug rnams kyi shes yon gong mthor 'gro ba'i thabs shes zhen bskul bya rgyu yin gshis/ des na gtso cher slob phrug rang rang gis slob sbyong la 'bad brtson lhod med byed dgos pa dang / dge rgan rnam pas slob ston byed mkhas thabs shes/ pha ma tshos kyang 'phral sel 183

nangagi las ka phran tshegs kyis phru gu'i yon tan la phugs gnod yong gzhir bsam shes byed dgos pa dang / phru gur bslab bya yag po bya rgyu sogs la phyogs tshang mas phywar ba gru 'degs kyis mi rabs gsar pa gang mang gso thub pa'i dgongs bzhes gnang rogs zhes sogs bshad de tshogs 'du grol/ de nyin don gcod gsar rnying dang / shes rig ngo tshab/ mang tshogs kyi spyi mi dang / brgya dpon bcas thun mong nas brjod gsal/ sang nyin zlos gar khag gis ltad mo 'khrab ston bya rgyu yin pas/ grong sde gnyis pa'i tshogs khang du yong dgos zer don de'i sang nyin zhogs pa snga po nas gzhis chags spyi'i zlos gar ba dang / slob grwa'i zlos gar/ grong tsho so so'i las zhor zlos gar ba dang slob phrug mang tshogs bcas khag so sos ru bstar bsgrigs te grong sde gnyis pa'i tshogs khang gi khor yug tu 'byor rjes khungs so so'i zlos gar ba rnams kyis rnga rol glu dbyangs dang bcas 'khrab ston le'u 'ga' shas byas/de nas don gcod khang du phyir log zin rjes don gcod gsar rnying gnyis kyis brjod gsal/ sang nyin nas 'go 'dzugs kyis snga dro gzhis chags khyim tshang khag la lta zhib dang / dgong dro zlos gar khag gi rol cha dang / glu gzhas zhabs bro rnams la legs bcos slob ston slob 'khrid byed dgos zer bas/phran gyis ‘‘de don bya 'dod med pa min rung yun 'gor ma song ba rang cag phyir log byed dgos pas nyin gnyis gsum lhag sdod khom med lugs bshad/sang nyin nas nyin mo khyim tshang khag la blta bskyod dang / mtshan mo glu gzhas gdangs dbyangs slob ston bya rgyu dang / zlos gar ba khag so sor 'khrab stangs dang / nyams 'gyur/ 'gyur khug sogs dge spel skyon bsrang byas par tshang mas dga' mos dang len gyis legs bcos byas stabs phan 'bras kyang cung zad byung song / de ltar dgong mo mtshan tshogs nam phyed yol yol skad gsang mthon pos slob sbyong slob 'khrid chags med byas pa dang / nyin mo blta skor 184

bar mtshams med par bskyod de dal lhod chu tshod gcig tsam ma byas na'ang bdun phrag gnyis yun 'gor byung song zhing / ma'i sor nas o ri sa gzhis chags su thon rgyu yin yang / gzhis 'go nas brjod gsal ltar na ma'i sor gzhis chags slob phrug khongs nas de sngon lcags bzo slob tu btang ba'i slob phrug gnyis lag rtsal legs shes kyis phyir log byung yang da lta las med du bsdad yod pas khong gnyis kyis shes pa'i las ka de rang re'i dge sde lcags mdong bzo grwa'i las ka'i nang zhabs zhu 'grub nges yod gshis/ des na ka li ka tar bzo grwa'i 'go 'dzin tsha rong sar lam kyog phran bu las med pas khong gnyis kyi lag shes gnas tshul ngo sprod byed par 'gro rogs zhes nan brjod ltar lag shes be+ed med du 'jog rgyu ches phangs par brten ka tar tsha rong sar bskyod de phru gu gnyis kyi slob sbyong lag 'khyer bstan par de don bzo grwar nyar 'thus kyi khas len byung bas/ ma'i sor gzhis 'go don gcod la lcags bzo ba gnyis po ka tar 'phral gtong byas 'thus kyi gnas tshul btang nas lam seng o ri sar bskyod/o ri sar gzhis 'go shar rtse mkhyen rab bstan skyong dang / mdo mkhar ba'i de snga'i g.yog gras phun tshogs bkra shis gnyis dang gros mol gyis ser skya mang tshogs kyi tshogs 'du tshogs pa dang / blta skor dang slob phrug rnams la slob ston sogs ma'i sor ltar byas te bdun phrag gcig nas ma da pa di sha gzhis chags su bskyod 'byor gyis gzhis 'go byang thang bkras gling phun tshogs dbang 'dus dang / sa skya mi 'gyur gnyis dang gros bsdur dang 'brel byed sgo rnams ma'i sor gzhir bzhag byas/ khul der mang tshogs spyi'i mchod khangaskya thog gnyis ka lcags shog yin pa de mang tshogs spyi nas gsar bskrun byas pa'i nang dang thog ris med mchod 'bul dang / yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu bcas gang legs yod 'dug kyang / bar skabs grub mtha'i dam sel 185

byung rkyen nam gang ltar chos phyogs kyi bya ba nyams chag tu gyur 'dug pa de skor rgyu rkyen rtsad gcod bgyis par don gcod khang nas chos kyi byed sgo'i thad tshang mas lta spyod gtsang ma'i nyams len yag po dgos lugs kyi slob ston byas par go ba ma lon par dogs 'drog lta bus tshogs 'dzoms ma byung ba ma gtogs dam sel che ba gang yang mi 'dug stabs rgyun gtan chos byed rnying ma'i chos lugs pa ser skya mi grangs sum cu tsam dang / dge lugs pa mi grangs sum cu tsam 'dug pa khungs so so nas 'thus mi do chod mi gnyis re ched 'bod thog phan tshun gros mol byas mthar/ mang tshogs kyi spyi rim sogs kyi skabs tshang ma mnyam 'dzoms bya rgyu dang / de min thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha' so so'i dus chen la rang rang khe gtsang bya rgyur mos mthun byung ba bzhin phyogs so so nas spyi mi gnyis re rang khongs so sos rang mos 'dems bsko dang 'brel da phyin tshang mas dge bcu'i spang blang 'dzol med lhur len zhu rgyur khas len byas don ltar gzhis 'go gnyis la zhib bshad byas/ skabs der mang tshogs kyi sdod khang gsar rgyag zin pa tsho khag cig rtsis sprod rtsis len bya rgyu yin gshis thog ma'i sgo dbye khyod nas byed dgos zer don ltar smon 'dun dang bcas te sgo dbye byas/ de'i sang nyin de nas thon bskyod kyis rlangs 'khor yang ri lir zhugs te nyin mtshan kha shas song mtshams ldi lir 'byor/ de gar shes rig ngo tshab dang don gcod gcig lcogs thub bstan nyin byed dang zhib mol byas shing / khong gis brjod gsal la/ da res slob grwa'i skor gyi las don byed sgo rnams rgya gar so sa'i krir lam seng gnas lugs bshad de slob sbyong dang 'tsho ba'i legs bcos gang dge myur khyad ched sngon la 'di gar byas na legs lugs zer don/ de gar nyin shas bsdad de so sa'i krir sa gnas so so'i gnas tshul dka' ngal sel dgos rnams ngag lam nas zhib zhu dang 'brel yig thog tu'ang bkod de snyan seng phul/ de nas rda sar 186

bskyod 'byor gyis shes rig bka' blon kun gling dza sag la gang ci'i byed sgo rnams shod skabs khong gis da res khyed rang ha cang 'gor yun chen po de 'dra bsdad nas 'di gar shes rig gi tshogs 'du chen mor yang ma 'byor ba zhes khong khro'i rnam pa ston yang / tshogs 'dur yong dgos kyi brda tho'i yi ge ma da spa di shar phran la 'byor skabs dus tshod rdzogs zin 'dug pa las phran nas ma yong ba min zhes gsal bshad byas/ de nas tā la'i bla mar 'byor phyag zhus 'thus zhes sde srung las khungs brgyud gzhes brda snyan seng btang yang lan gsal med par nyin mang song mtshams bka' drung dbang rdor bka' blon gsar mjal nyin mo der phran 'byor phyag stabs 'khel bas slob grwa khag la bskyod pa'i gnas lugs zhu sa ma byung / de rjes thub bstan nyin byed ngo 'phrad byung bas ngas khong la ‘‘'byor phyag ka kor kho nas snyan seng zhu ba'i dus skabs ma byung mi’zhes bshad par/ khong gis ‘‘skyon med ngas tshang ma snyan seng zhus yod ’’ces bshad byung yang dngos 'brel snyan seng drang bden zhig zhus med pa'i bzo bstan gyi 'dug phran gyis rnam kun las 'khur hur bskyed byas par thub nyin nas phrag dog gis ngas 'bad brtson byas pa'i snga phyi'i byas rjes mi mngon pa'i thabs shes sna tshogs byas pa shes tshor byung / der brten ‘‘gzim chung mjal bcar zhus chog pa ’’zhes sku sger yig tshang brgyud snyan seng zhus par/ drung che rta ra bas deng sang mdzad brel che bas rjes ma zhig snyan seng zhus na legs zer byung / nga rang nas lhag bsam zol med kyis las don gang ci nyin mtshan lhod med hur brtson che bskyod byas yod kyang / shes rig las khungs nas brda tho'i yi ge snga tsam ma btang rkyen shes rig tshogs 'du chen mor rjes ma zin pa dang / snyan seng zhib lhongs zhu sa ma rnyed pa bcas la yid mug ngang sdod rgyu las gzhan gyi bya thabs ma rnyed/ 'on kyang shes rig drung che'i rnam kun gyi las 'gan ngo lkog g.yo zol med pa sngar bzhin hur bskyed byas pa yin/187

12 rgya gar rlung 'phrin las khungs su lag ka byas pa/spyi lo 1965lo'i zla bdun pa'i nang wa ra na sir khri byang rin po che nas lam rim gsung chos gnang bar chos zhur dgongs pa zhus te bskyod/ rta sa nas bka' blon dga' brang gis yi ge btang don ‘‘rgya gar gzhung nas re 'dun gnang ba ltar ldi lir bod skad rlung 'phrin las byed mi gnyis dgos pa ye shes mthar phyin 'di nas ldi lir gtong rgyu dang / khyod rang de nas ldi lir thon bskyod kyis yab gzhis stag lha rgyal lo lags sar bcar te byed sgo'i skor bka' slob zhu dgos ’’zhes gsal ba ltar de'i sang nyin wa ra na si nas ldi lir thon te rgyal lo lags sar 'gro skabs khong gis lha lung pa blo bzang phun tshogs sar phyin na 'grigs lugs gsungs don bzhin lha lung pa blo bzang phun tshogs sar phyin pas/ khong gis sang gnangs 'gyangs med brda lan btang chog zer zhing / de rjes brda lan 'byor don bzhin ldi li rlung 'phrin las khungs su mnyam bskyod kyis phran dang / ye shes mthar phyin gnyis yi ge klog bcug ste sgra phab dkri 'khor du bcug de nas nyin gcig phran dang ye mthar gnyis rlung 'phrin las khungs su 'gugs 'bod kyis ‘‘ye mthar gnas skabs rda ram sa lar phyir log byas 'thus rjes su lan gsal bya rgyu dang /dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gnas skabs bdun phrag re'i nang thengs re yong dgos pa dang / rgya gar gzhung gi khrims srol ltar khyod rang rgya gar nang 'byor tshun chad las don ji byas brtag dpyad dang 'brel gang mgyogs las don nang dngos su zhugs dgos ’’zhes zer zhing / de don bdun phrag re'i nang thengs re phyin nas zla shas song mtshams rda sa nas bka' blon dga' brang gis yi ge zhig btang 'byor nang gsal snga 'phros rlung 'phrin las ka'i bar seng gang yod la ldi li don gcod kyi las rogs byed dgos zhes gsal ba 188

bzhin don gcod thub nyin la gang shes kyis rogs pa byas/ skabs der de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid blon zur pa bde mkhar ba (klu khang pa )ldi lir sman bcos su 'byor te don gcod khang du bsdad yod gshis/ nyin gcig dgong mo nam phyed yol tsam la thub nyin gyis phran gyi nyal khang sgo brdungs te ‘‘dge slong lags sku ngo srid tshab dgongs pa rdzogs 'dug par mchod 'bul smon lam 'don rogs ’’zhes zer byung ba lam seng langs te phyin pas zhwa sgab pa dang / rtse drung thub nyin gnyis rgya gar du snga 'byor gyi gras shig yin stabs chos phyogs kyi mig rgyun nyam chags je zhan du gyur pas mchod me lta zhog spos tsam yang mi 'dug pas phran gyi sdod shag nas mchod me kha shas dang / spos me tog sogs blangs te nyer mchod gshoms bsgrigs thog smon lam gyi rim pa gang rgyas byas pa ma zad/ sku phung zhugs 'bul sa gnas bar lam sne'ang phran gyis byas te gzhung zhabs bgres song la gnod lan phan 'jal gyi mthun 'gyur gang thub byas/ 'dir gnod lan phan 'jal zhes zer don gang lags she na/ sngar klu khang ba bka' drung byed skabs phran tsho'i pha gzhis stod lung rgya stag pa dang / smad tsho 'du khongs gnyis zlos rtsod gyar skabs gyod ya'i zhu shog la bka' bcos kyis gus tshor tshig mtshon rnon po'i brjod don lag bstar ma bris pas ma tshad khong tshor rgyab skyor shugs chen byas te gus tshe blo pham dgos pa byed myong yod pas yin/spyi lo 1966lor ldi li rlung 'phrin las byed par dngos su bsko gzhag byas don ltar rang 'khri'i las 'gan sgrub cing / rlung 'phrin las byed par dngos su gyur pa nas bzung gsung chos zhu bar bcar rgyu'i go skabs med pas chos kyi skal ba chad pa lta bur gyur/ rlung 'phrin rgyang bsring byed sgo sgrub mur ldi lir las byed slob phrug mi grangs bcu drug yod pa de dag la mdzub gnon yig dpar slob sbyong gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dzin grwa ched 'dzugs byas yod pa 189

der bod yig dge rgan gcig dgos shing / gdong thog sprul skus khas len byas kyang da cha khom lcogs med lugs bshad stabs rlung 'phrin gyi res gza' nyi ma'i gung seng la zhor slob byed rogs zhes don gcod thub nyin nas phran la re 'dun bshad don khas blangs te gung seng nam yin la bskyod nas bod yig yig gzugs dang / sum rtags/ bod kyi rgyal rabs mdor bsdus bcas slob ston bgyis par sbyangs 'bras kyang cung legs tsam thob song bas/ slar yang skabs gnyis pa'i slob phrug tshor lo gcig ring slob dgos zer bar de don slar yang ngal ba 'dzems med kyis bslab cing / thub nyin nas dang thog dge rgan gyi gla phogs rogs tshogs nas sprod rgyu yin lugs zer yang phran nas gla cha ma blang khar/ phar 'gro tshur log gi 'khor lo'i gla cha tshang ma nga rang nas sprad pa dang / skabs re slob phrug tshor ja dang bag leb ster nas slob sbyong la hur brtson dgos rgyu sogs kyi bslab bya 'bod bskul yang yang byas/ skabs re bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi lo rgyus dang / nga rang gi tshe stod kyi gnas tshul skor 'dra yang bshad par slob phrug tshang mas dga' po'i ngang dri ba yang mang po byed kyin 'dug par drang po'i lan 'debs byed kyi yod/spyi lo 1974lor ngos rang ldi li rlung 'phrin gyi bod skad khyab bsgrags tshan pa'i nang las 'khur byed mus skabs nyin gcig kun gling ngag dbang rgyal mtshan phran sar yong ste brjod gsal/ ‘‘dge slong lags khyed rang nas shes rig zlos gar thog mar 'go 'dzugs dka' ngal mang po brgyab pa dang /bar du zlos gar 'go 'dzin byas te yar rgyas gong 'phel gyi grub 'bras bzang po thob pa rgyal rabs dang / gtam brjod zlos gar la sogs pa sngar byung ma myong ba gsar gtod kyis 'khrab ston lam nas bod kyi rig gzhung dang don dngos khyab bsgrags byed pa'i sri zhu bsgrubs pa ma zad/ zlos gar nang lo bzhi sdod yun ring la'ang gang ci'i las don khyi nyal mjug lus ma song ba rtsis khra 190

khams dwangs 'god 'bul mig dper 'os pa gang legs byung 'dug kyang /dngul bun sprod 'jal bya rgyur bsdad pa 'di thad phran la'ang sems 'tshab 'dug cing / dngul bun zug dgos don ni khyed rang spyi don la sems 'khur che drags pa'i rkyen gyis yin pa las bag med longs spyod kyi dngul bun zug pa min nges ngas gsal po shes kyi yod la gzur nas skye bo mang pos kyang shes gsal red/ der brten da lam ngas khyed la rogs ram zhu rgyu'i go skabs shig mchis pa/ gang lags she na/ phran khad na ḍar gzhis chags khongs bskyod 'thus kyi bka' 'khrol thob gshis/ ldi lir phran gyi dpe cha dpar 'debs kyi las ka 'di dag khe slebs bzang po yod stabs nang shugs byed rogs zer mkhan mang po yod 'dug pa ma zad/ gzhan dag la sprad na rin dngul lag 'bab kyang che tsam yong nges 'dug rung dpar 'debs kyi las ka mjug skyong bya rgyu khyed kyis gnang na dngul bun khag bde blag ngang myur sprod thub rgyu blos 'gel chog gi red ’’ces gsungs byung bar/ gus nas ‘‘khyed kyis dga' nye'i slad lar dgongs bzhes bla med gnang ba thugs rje che/ 'on kyang nga dge slong zhig gi ngos nas dpe tshong gi las ka mi chog pa ma zad/ dngul 'bor chen po de 'dra 'bul gra 'grigs thabs med rimilugs bshad par/ khong gis ‘‘dge slong gis dpe cha'i las ka byas mi chog pa gang nas yong / dngul 'bab tho gsal gyi 'bor khongs nas brgya cha nyi shu tham pa bcags chog pa dang / de byings dngul 'bor nas gsum zur te sgor chig khri tham pa lag thog sprod thub pa gnang na de 'phros khyed nas dpe cha brin mtshams rim sprod byas 'thus ’’zhes kha zhe med pa'i phan grogs gnang bar brten 'di skor khri byang rin po cher snyan seng zhusabyupar khri byang rin po che nas ‘‘khyed rang dge slong rnam dag gis kyang 'khyams ra'i sgo 'phyor 'og cod dzon tshong mkhan gras byed kyi yin nam/ma byed/ las ka de gzhan zhig la sbrad di dngul bun sprod thub pa byas na 191

legs ’’zhes bka' slob gnang ba bzhin de 'phral lam seng la je pa ti na gar stag lung brag dbu mdzad ngag dbang bzod pa dpe cha dpar 'debs kyi las ka byed mus yin stabs khong gi sar bskyod de/ sku zhabs ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyi yig cha rnams mig ston gyis gnas lugs drang bden bshad nas ‘‘las ka 'di dag khe bzang kha yod lag yod cig yin rung / nga rang rlung 'phrin gyi las kas khom lcogs med gshis/ khyed rang nas dngul sgor chig khri tham pa lag thog sprad chog yod na khyed rang phyag las gnang mus yin stabs rang re mnyam las gnyis phan yong gnas snyam pas/ gang 'dra 'dug gam ’’zhes brjod par/ ngag dbang bzod pa nas dga' mgu'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas ‘‘sku zhabs ngag dbang rgyal mtshan lags kyis khyed rang dngos 'brel gyi rogs ram gnang bzhag yag po zhe drag 'dug ste deng sang nga la dngul de tsam sprad chog med/ 'on kyang ngas rje pha bong kha'i gsung 'bum pod bcu gcig dpar brko zin grabs yod pa de dag spyi thog tu bzhag ste dngul sgor chig khri spyi thog nas gzhan g.yar gyis sku zhabs ngag rgyan lags su 'bul rgyu zhus na gang 'dra 'dug gam ’’zhes bshad byung bar/ phran gyis ‘‘de don byas 'thus dang / da dung dbu can 'bri mi bcu gsum dang / ma byan gcig bcas la zla 'di'i gla phogs dang / khang gla/ glog rin sogs la'ang sgor nyis stong tsam dgos pa gra sgrig gnang dgos zhes bshad/ de min khang pa dang / dgos mkho yo chas 'khyags sgam dang bcas pa cha tshang bsdad chog chog yod pas gnangs nyin tshes cha bzang bstun rtsis sprod len gyis drung yig tsho dang / ma byan bcas la ngo sprod bya rgyur thag bcad/ gnangs nyin ldi li'i grong khyer nub phyogs dpar las bya yul du mnyam bskyod kyis sku zhabs ngag dbang rgyal mtshan steng zhal dang / bu gnyis/ drung yig tsho dang bcas tshang mar gsol ja zhal tog dang / dgong dro'i gsol ston legs par bshams/ gsol ston 192

sar phran nas ‘‘drung yig tsho dang / ma byan rnam par zhu rgyur/ ngag dbang rgyal mtshan lags nas nga la 'di ga'i dpar las kyi mjug skyong bya rgyu skyabs 'jug gnang yang / nga ni rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi las kas khom lcogs rtsa ba nas yong min la brten dbu mdzad ngag dbang bzod pa lags phyag las nyams myong yod la mkhyen rlabs ldan par song 'di ga'i las don che phra mtha' dag brgya cha brgya tham pa'i 'gan dbang dbu mdzad lags su phul te phyag bzhes bstar rgyu yin gshis/ des na khyed rnam pas ngag dbang rgyal mtshan lags kyi skabs su las don bsgrub pa ji bzhin hur brtson cher bskyed yod pa zhu rgyu dang / khyed rnam pa'i zla re'i gla phogs sogs 'char can dus thog tu 'bul rgyu yin pas dbu mdzad lags nas kyang de don dgongs 'jags kyis khong tshor gang ci'i slob ston dang 'brel thugs brtses mi 'dor ba gnang rogs ’’zhes bshad/ dbu mdzad lags nas gsungs gsal la/ ‘‘las ka'i thad rang don rang gces hur bskyed zhus chog 'on kyang las don skor yig 'brel mang tsam byed dgos yod gshis de tsho khyed nas rogs ram ma gnang thabs med la skabs mtshams so sor gnas lugs zhus chog pa zhes ’ribashad pa de don khas len byas/ ngag dbang rgyal mtshan lags khad na ḍar phebs ran la brten de'i sang nyin dngul g.yar khungs bltas te ngag dbang rgyal mtshan lags su hin sgor chig khri tham pa lag thog phul ba dang / de byings rim 'bul zhu rgyu'i 'dzin yig dbu mdzad lags dang / phran gnyis ka'i ming 'khod rtags 'byar zhig kyang sprad/ dpar 'debs las mjug lo gnyis tshun nges par 'gril thub pa bya rgyu'i kha dan yod kyang / lo gsum hril po brgal nas zla shas song yang mjug ma 'gril bar lus gshis/ wa ra na si rgya garagazhung gi mtho rim slob grwa chen mo'i dpe mdzod khang gi dgos mkho yin zhes slob che'i dge rgan chen mo'i ming 'dzin bla ma sham thabs dkar po rig 193

'dzin rnam rgyal nas dpe cha sne 'dzoms khyer rin sgor sum stong lhag tsam ma sprad par lo gnyis tsam song 'dug pa phran wa ra na sir ched bskyod skabs khong ka li ka tar kha sa phyin song ba nyin shas 'gor gyi yod lugs zer zhing / mtho rim slob grwa'i 'go 'dzin sar phyin nas gnas lugs brjod par slob grwa nas dpe rin skabs de gar sprad zin pas rig rnam rang la 'ded dgos zer don ltar rjes su dbu mdzad lags nas 'ded len bya rgyu byas/ dpe cha blu yon btang ma thub par lus pa rnams bgo sha brgyab ste las mjug bsdus/ rang skal dpe cha'i khongs nas tā la'i bla ma dang / yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis/dge bshes thub bstan tshe ring / gcung po rgyal mtshan chos ldan/ gzhan yang bla sprul dge bshes/ ngo shes re zung bcas la gang 'tshams phul 'phros pod deb brgya tsam zhig nyar tshags kyis rda ram sa lar phran gyi las shag tu yod pa rnams spyi lo 1980lor phran bal yul nas bod du gnyen 'phrad la bskyod par rgya gar du yod pa'i ‘‘rang dbang gsar shog khang ’’zhes pa nas dkrog gtam ched bzos kyis phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin bod du bskyod nas bod kyi yul gyar gzhung la ngan dmas sogs ma 'os ma 'tshams pa'i bya las mang po kun khyab rlung 'phrin nang khyab bsgrags byas tshul sogs kyi tshags dpar 'grems spel byas pa dang / rda sar 'brel yod ‘‘khang pa'i las khungs ’rizhes pa nas kyang phran blo bstan la phogs med rgas gso'i sdod khang zhig yod pa de yang 'phral du phyir 'bul dgos lugs bshad thog nyin gcig dza drag chen pos da lta rang nang chas 'dzin dngos tshang ma phyir 'don bya dgos bshad par brten khyim mtshes dge slong blo don lags dang / spun mched gcung mo skal bzang chos 'dzoms gnyis gros bsdur gyis dpe cha gang yod rnams rnam rgyal grwa tshang dang / mtshan nyid grwa tshang / gnas chung dgon pa/ dga' gdong dgon bcas la mi 'bul mthu med byung 'dug pa bcas don du dpe cha phyogs 194

bgos byas pa rnams blu yon du btang ba yin na dngul bun gtsang sprod thub rgyu smos med thog khe bzang yang gang legs yong nges kyang / shes bzhin khyad gsod kyis chos spong gi las ngan tshabs chen byed ma dgos tsam byung na snyam nas blu yon ma btang bar nyar khul yin te mno bsam zhib btang skabs ‘‘sha ma zas rung sha khur mdzub mo bcug ’’zer ba'i dpe ltar dpe cha'i blu yon gyi dngul 'bab byung steng nas dngul bun sprad pa de gas shugs kyis chos spong gi las su gyur 'dug par 'gyod bshags dang / phyin chad de rigs byed dgos mi yong ba shog cig ces smon lam yang btab pa yin/ gong gsal rgas gso'i khang pa de dag las byed pa don ma go phrag dog can re zung gis bar lag nas gzhung bzhes yin khul dza drag tsha 'ded byas rkyen dpe cha rnams dgon pa khag la 'bul rgyu byung ba de rkyen ngan lam lhongs gang legs byung 'dug khang pa'i nang gi 'dzin dngos dang / gdan lcog mal gos/ thab chas sogs la rin 'bab sne sel tsam la btsong pa dang / rnying song khag 'khyer zhan la ster 'dug pa bcas gang ltar rgya gar rda ram sa lar yod pa'i phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi mkhar dbang gang na ci yod glo bur me shor ba lta bur gyur 'dugaspyi lo 1976lor phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin ldi li rgya gar rlung 'phrin gyi las ka rgan yol dgongs pa zhus 'khrol byung yang / rgya gar rgyal khongs kyi khongs mi min stabs rgya gar gzhung nas rgan yol gyi phogs dang /khang pa'i mthun rkyen sogs thob cha gang yang sprad ma byung / gang lags she na/rgyalakhongs phyi rgyal khag la rnam kun rgyun phogs thog dmigs bsal gyi zla re phogs 'phar sprod lam rim pa bzhi tsam yod cing / nga tshor rim pa gsum pa'i thob cha zla re phogs 'phar hin sgor lnga brgya re yod pas phran gyi phogs 'phar de dag rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi 'go khrid nas nga rang la phan ched 195

‘‘khyed rang la rtsa ba'i rgyun phogs dngul 'bab des zla re'i 'gro gron ldeng nges yod tsang phogs 'phar sdebs zhu bya rgyur gsog 'jog tu bzhag na skyed ka yod gshis phan slebs chen po yod lugs ’’slob ston byas don ltar phogs 'phar zla re ma blangs par sdebs len bya rgyur bzhag pa de rnams rgan yol skabs dngul 'bab ngo bskyed grangs tshang dgos lugs brjod par ‘‘'go khrid 'pho len mang bas ji byas rtsad gcod bya rgyu ’’zhes nyin 'gyangs zhag 'bud kho na byas te ma sprad stabs yig thog tu gong rim la snyan zhu snga rjes phul yang lo yun ring bas 'go khrid 'pho 'gyur mang stabs rgyu ma phu 'ded kyi rtsad gcod byed mus zhes don du lag son ma byung zhing / de ni bzang po blos 'gel byas drags pa'i skyon du zad do/13 yul grur ldi li don gcod khang gi yig cha'i dkar chag bsgrigs pa sogs/ldi lir yul gyarno don gcod 'phreng ring rig 'dzin rnam rgyal nas phran la brjod gsal/ ‘‘ldi li don gcod kyi khang pa spo shugs byed skabs yig cha rnams sdebs spungs 'dres 'dzings kyis las don byed skabs yi ge ma rnyed par sdod dgos pa dang / lar nas yi ge rnams la dkar chag kyang mi 'dug pas yig cha dbye 'byed dang 'brel dkar chag gsar 'god kyi las 'gan de da res ma byas thabs med chags 'dug pas/ rda sa bka' shag la dkar chags 'god mi nyams myong yod pa zhig gtong gnang yod pa zhes snyan zhu phul nas zla ba gcig lhag tsam song rung mi btang ma byung / des na da res khyod rang 'os babs su 'dug pas sku mkhyen zer rgyu yin ’’zhes zer don rogs zla yig 'brir shes rig las byed gyang grong bu bsod nams dpal 'bar 'jog gnang ltar phran gnyis nas 'khur len gyis blta zhib skabs mo hror 'jug 196

yulakhang chen zhig gi nang thal ba dang gad snyigs 'dros r+pā'i yig cha 'ephon 'bor che ba 'dres 'dzings lud spungs pa ltar 'dug pa las ka 'di dag ga dus tshar snyam nas sgyid lug hang sangs dgos pa 'dug cing / 'on kyang phran gnyis kyis dka' ngal 'dzems med kyis dang por thal ba rnams rdab rdab byed kyin byed kyin las khungs khag dang / gzhis chags khag bzo grwa khagaslob grwa khag sman khang khag dgon pa khag lam bzo khag drag slob khagargas gso khang / bu khyim khang khag dpe mdzod khang khag 'grems ston khang khag tshags dpar khang khag rgya gar gzhung gi las khungs khag phyi rgyal 'brel yod khag skyobs gso'i las khungs khag phyi rgyal du yod pa'i don gcod ngo tshab khag gzhan yang tsag tsig sna mang bcas khungs so so sde tshan dbye 'byed kyis gral bstar bsgrigs te ka phreng bkod nas yig chen gyi shog byang re bzhag de nas sde tshan so so'i lo khams gung sgrigs/ de nas yig phel (gsog deb )so so'i nang dkar chag nang gses dang bcas pa zhib 'god kyi las ka nyin ltar nyin re chu tshod bcu tsam re 'bad brtson lhod med byas 'bras su zla ba bzhi tsam las ma 'gor bar yig cha che phra mtha' dag dkar chag rgyas bsdus nang gses snying don gsal ba dang / blta 'tshol bde ba bzos nas 'jog yugolcags kyi bang khri dra mig can gsar bzo'i nang bsgrigs te ang grangs dang kha byang bkod pa yig tshags las byed par mdzub ston slob khrid kyis rtsis sprod byas shing / de nas bzung sdi li don gcod khang gi las don myur khyad thon la stabs bde byung bar don gcod 'phreng ring rig 'dzin rnam rgyal ha cang dga' tshor chen pos 4dge slong lags thugs rje che/da ni nga tsho'i las ka khag bde blag ngang legs 'grub yong rgyu'i nus pa thon song ba snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ khyed rang gi gsol phogs skor sngon du bka' mol byung ba ltar khyed rang gnas lnga pa drung che'i phogs thob 197

dgos nges thob thang yod kyang gnas rim bdun pa'i phogs thob las ma gnang bar skabs der ngos rang nas drang bden bsam 'char zhus kyang /rgyun las khang nas gzhung 'bab sri tshags dgos gal che lugs gsungs te dgongs bzhes ma gnang ba der nga rang yang blo pham byung / 'on kyang khyed kyis de 'dra'i gnas tshul la ma bltas par dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis hur brtson byas 'bras thon pa de tsho snyan la 'khyol ba nga rang gis byed rgyu yin ’’zhes brjod byung bar/ phran nas ‘‘ngas dkar chag gsar 'god kyi las don phran bu zhig byas par khyed kyis gdeng 'jog de tsam gnang ba thugs rje che/ nga la phogs thob rim pa dma' ba ni rang gi bsod nams las ma grub pa yin pas blo pham gang yang med/ deng skabs gus par rgan yol gyi phogs dang / thob cha gang yang med stabs da res zla shas kyi phogs thob gsol ras gnang ba mi zhu mthu med byung sku ngo khyed rang de dag la thugs dogs dang thugs pham ma gnang ang ’’zhes bshad/yul gyar ldi li don gcod khang gi yig cha dkar chag 'god skabs bsam blo 'di 'dra zhig 'khor byung ba ste/ rda ram sa lar log dus sdod yul khang pa med tsang yul gyar gzhung nas gus par rgan yol gyi phogs thob ma sprad rung las byed pa'i rgas gso'i khang pa mang po gsar rgyag byas yod lugs go thos byung ba bzhin khang pa zhig zhus na sprad mi yong ngam bsams nas bka' shag la snyan zhu zhig btang yang lan gsal gang yang ma byung / dga' nye tshos zer na ‘‘khye da rang gis gzhis byes gang sar las don hur bskyed gzengs thon de tsam byas yod gshis rgan phogs dang / sdod khang thob thang med pa de 'dra gang yin nam/ chab dam pa o rgyan sogs mang po zhig la rgan phogs dang khang pa sprad 'dug pa de tshor sprad de khyed rang la mi sprod pa khyad mtshar red/ tā la'i bla mar zhus na tan tan gnang gi red snyan seng zhus dang ’’zhes 198

zer mkhan byung / sgan gyis ‘‘de 'dra ma red/ rgyu mtshan yod pa red/ rgya gar du zhabs zhu bar mtshams ma bzhag par lo bco lnga zhus pa yin na rgan phogs dang khang pa sprod rgyu dang / yang zhabs zhu lo grangs de ltar zhus kyang de'i ring phyi rgyal gyi rogs tshogs nas phogs chen po yod pa tshor thob thang med pa bya rgyur rgyun las tshogs 'dus gtan 'khel bzos yod tshod 'dug der brten nga rang la yang rgya gar rlung 'phrin las khungs nas rgyun phogs gang legs byung stabs snyan bsun zhu rtsis med la mdzad dka' bzo gi min ’mizhes bshad par/ ‘‘mdzad dka' yong don mi 'dug phyi rgyal gyi phogs thob chen po za mkhan re zung la'ang phogs thob gnang ba byung shag rimizer yang / de tsho dang nga rang 'dra gi ma red bsams nas sems thag bcad de bsdad/ rda ram sa lar log rgyu yin yang sdod khang med pa ma zad/ 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen pad shag gcig tsam yang yong 'bab ni med/ gang byas kyang tha zhan nyam thag chags rgyur nges 'dug snyam nayoyid mug skyo snang zhig 'char byung / de 'phral snying stobs bskyed de rang gis rang la sems gso btang ba ste/ da 'grigs shag sngar phan gzhung sger gyi las ka mang po zhig la mgo 'khor nas dka' sdug myang zhing 'bad brtson yod rgu rtsal sprugs byas kyang 'bras bu gang yang byung mi 'dug da ni rkyen ngan lam lhongs kyi chos byed pa'i dus skabs bzang po red 'dug pas/ rda ram sa la'i rgyab rir bsdad nas bya btang pa yag po zhig byed ang snyam pa'i sems dga' lhang lhang ngang gang mgyogs rda ram sa lar 'gro rgyu'i 'dun pa shar/ de'i sang nyin ku lu gal nas gzhis chags 'go 'dzin gcung po rgyal mtshan chos ldan nas yi ge zhig btang 'byor nang ga sal ‘‘gcen po nyid rlung 'phrin phyag las dgongs 'khrol byung yod 'dug pa/des na 'di ga ku lu gal gzhis chags ni sa cha bsil drod snyoms la sdod babs skyid po dang zhal 'don dge sbyor 'aṣ+pel nges yod gshis nges par du 'di gar phebs bzhugs chog par 'phral phebs yod pa ’’zhes gsal bas 199

'gro rgyur blo babs kyis de'i gnangs nyin ri li'i nang bskyod de ma'i sor dang /'beng lor brgyud nyin ma lnga song drug thog tu ku lu gal gzhis chags su 'byor/ku lu gal gezhis chags gnas yul sa cha'i g.yas g.yon gyi ri rnams bod kyi spang ri 'dra ba dang / tsha grang snyoms po dngos 'brel gyi sdod babs skyid po 'dug spyir btang rgya gar khul lhag rlung dkon yang / ku lu gal la ni lhag pa shugs che ba'i skabs khang pa'i rdza thog kyang rlung gis bsgyur lhungs yong gi 'dug gcung po'i bza' zla brtson 'grus bzang mo nas gsungs gsal/‘‘'di gar thugs 'tsher gnang dgos med gshis khyed kyi gzim shag yin dgongs nas lhod bzhugs gnang rogs mi’zhes dang / rgyal chos lags kyi gcen po dga' ldan ban dgon sde pa chos 'dzin yang khong gnyis kyi sar slebs 'dug rgyal chos lags thabs shes gnyis dang / bu phrug gsum/ bu rdzi gcig bcas khyim tshang mi drug gi 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen thad sa skal yod kyang zhing las thub mkhan med stabs mi'i gla cha dang / 'drud 'then 'khor lo'i gla cha/ rdzas lud kyi rin pa/ 'bu sman gyi rin sogs bza' 'then byas 'phros yong 'bab de tsam med pa dang / rgyal chos lags su gzhis 'go spyi 'gre'i dngul phogs phran bu tsam las med par bu phrug gsum yod khongs nas gnyis kyi slob yon sprod dgos bcas 'gro gron dang yong 'bab ri gzor ga 'dzol red 'dug kyang / brtson 'grus bzang mo lags nas tshong pa ngo shes re zung la re bcol 'tshong bskur thabs shes la brten nas 'tsho gos mtha' zhan min tsam gyi bza' btung longs spyod 'jungs pa med pa gang legs 'dug rgyal chos lags sar rnam kun gzhung sger 'brel gtugs byed mkhan gang zhig la brtson 'grus bzang mo lags nas gus zhabs ldan pa'i sne len zhu ba dang /lhag par rgyal chos lags kyi spun mched la de bas kyang gzab gzengs byed kyi yod pa red/ de skabs chos 'dzin lags dang phran gnyis la'ang bkur bsti sri zhu gzabs rgyas phangs med stob pa dang / chos phyogs su gtong phod che ba 200

bcas gang legs su 'dug kyang / skabs der rgyal chos lags khong rang khog pa'i nang rma shu'i nad mnar lci lod du gyur 'dug pa tshang ma blo g.yeng che tsam byung / khong gnyis la ba mo bzhon bzang gnyis 'dug pa las/ nyin gcig ba rgan legs pa de glo bur shi ba/ de nas rgyal chos lags kyi nad gzhi cung zad drag skyed phyin pa lta bu byung song / de rjes ba mo gcig shos de yang glo bur shi song ba khong gnyis kyi gces nor yod do cog ba mo gnyis ka shi ba nga rang yang kha skyengs shing gang drag bsams pa byung / ngos gnyis mgron po gnyis pos snga dgong zho 'o ma dang ja mngar mo chag med btung ba yin/ ba mo gnyis ka shi nas kyang da dung zho 'o ma dang / ja mngar mo sngar rgyun ster byung ba de ni khyim mtshes kyi sa nas 'o ma nyos pa shes tshor byung bas da nas bzung zho 'o ma rtsa ba nas mi dgos nan bshad byas kyang nyan 'jog med par u tshugs kyis nyin ltar 'char can ster gyi yod/ de gar blo bag phebs la kha 'don dge sbyor 'phel ba'i skabs mon go ṭar gsung chos yod thos ltar chos zhur 'gro rtsis byas kyang ku lu gal gzhis chags kyi gzhon nu'i 'go khrid gnyis phran sar yong nas brjod gsal/ ‘‘mdo smad gtam brjod zlos gar de dag nga tsho gzhon nu tshos slob sbyong byas te mang tshogs la 'khrab ston thub na gang legs yong rgyu lags na khyed kyis sku ngal la ma 'dzems par nga tshor slob khrid gnang skyong yong ba ’rizhes zer ba dang / gzhis chags 'go 'dzin rgyal chos nas kyang ‘‘gzhon nu tsho sems shugs ha cang chen po yod pas khong tsho'i zhu mos ltar slob ston nges par gnang rogs mimizhes zer byung bas/ gzhis chags kyi slob grwa'i zlos gar dge rgan chos 'phel klu sgrub 'gugs 'bod kyis ‘‘khyed rang la mdo smad gtam brjod zlos gar gyi 'khrab gzhung yod dam ’mizhes dris par/ khong gis ‘‘nga la 'khrab gzhung gcig kyang med/ zlos gar 'go 'dzin ldum khang lags kyi skabs zlos gar gyi yig cha mang po zhig bor brlag song bas da cha 'khrab 201

gzhung dkon po red ’’ces bshad byung / gzhon nu'i 'go khrid bos nas dris pa yin kyang / 'khrab gzhung med lugs bshad pa dang sbrags/ ‘‘gtam brjod 'khrab gzhung zhig gsar rtsom gnang rogs ’’zer byung bar/ phran nas ‘‘gsar pa 'dra bzo shes na yang phan thogs yod pa ma red/ gang yin zhe na de snga nga tsho ka sbug tu sdod skabs shes rig las khungs nas gtam brjod zlos gar 'khrab gzhung brtsams bsgrigs dgos lugs gsung don ltar khag gsum brtsams te shes rig las khungs brgyud spyan zhur phul bar gnas tshul de tsho sa cha ga par ga par byung ba red dam zhes bka' rtsad phebs 'dug par sa cha sogs dmigs bsal 'di yin zhu rgyu med lugs zhus par/ 'o na rdzun bcos byas pa ma red pas de 'dra 'khrab pa las ma 'khrab pa dga' gi red/ gnas tshul dngos yod cig rang dgos kyi red/ ces bka' phebs te nga tshos gsar du bcoms pa de tsho phan thogs ma byung / de rjes nga tshos dril bsgrags las khungs dang 'brel ba byas te rang rang gi gnas tshul tshig tho phul khongs a mdo snang ra khul nas gnas tshul dngos byung zhig 'dug pa g.yar po zhus te 'di thog nas brtsams sgrig zhus chog pa'i snyan seng zhus par chog mchan bka' 'khrol thob pa las gang byung brtsams na 'grig gi ma red ’’ces bshad par/‘‘de 'dra yin na rnying pa de rang thugs dran gsos pa gnang rogs ’’zhes nan brjod che bar brten mi lo bcu bzhi tsam 'das zin pa'i lo rgyus dran gso ba khag po yod kyang / bsam blo gtong gin gtong gin 'khrab gzhung zin bris shig brgyab cing / sa cha'i ming dang / mi'i ming kha shas dran gso ma thub pa las phal che ba dran gso thub pa lta bu'i zin bris de zlos gar dge rgan la sgrogs sbyangs byas te ‘‘'di nang ma 'grigs pa dang / ma 'khod pa gang 'dug ’’ces dris par/ ‘‘de ga rang red ma 'grigs pa mi 'dug ’’ces zer ba ma zad/ mi ming 'di dang 'di red ces bshad rgyu yang 'dug pa rnams 202

bkod de gtsang bris byas/ de nas gzhon nu'i 'go khrid gnyis bskong ste gzhis chags 'go 'dzin bcas thun mong la sprad par/ khong tshos dga' mgu yi rang dang bcas ‘‘thugs rje che/ nga tshor bslab rogs gnang lam seng 'go 'dzugs zhu gi yin ’’zer yang / phran nas ‘‘nga tshos dang po brel 'tshub hur brtson che mdog kha po dang / nyin bstud de rgyun bsring na sgyid lug gis mtha' skyel mi thub pa de 'dra bya rgyu med cing / de lta bu byas na dka' las khag rogs red/ las don gang yin yang thog ma nas sgrig lam kun spyod yag po dang / 'char gzhi ldan pa zhig dgos pas khyed tsho gros bsdur yag po byas te dka' ngal khyad bsad bya rgyur zhum pa med pa dang rgyun mthud hur brtson bya rgyur tshang mas sems thag bcad pa yin na/ nga rang gzugs khams rgyun gcong yin rung dka' ngal la ma 'dzems par bslab chog ’’ces bshad/de ga'i dgong mo khong tsho tshang 'dzoms gros bsdur byas te phran la brjod gsal/‘‘nyin mo zhing las la 'gro dgos mkhan sha stag yin stabs dgong dro chu tshod drug par 'go 'dzugs kyis chu tshod brgyad pa bar khyed nas slob ston gnang rgyu dang / de nas chu tshod bcu pa bar khong tshos rang sbyong bya rgyu/ slob sbyong du ma 'byor na 'gro khrid yin na nyes chad sgor bcu re dang / byings nas sgor gnyis re bsdu rgyu byas pa ma zad/ tshang mas rtag bcar hur bskyed bya rgyur dga' spro'i ngang khas len byas song / do dargong tshang 'dzoms bya rgyu yin pa de'i thogakhyed kyis bka' slob yod pa ’’zhes zer don ltar phran nas tshang 'dzoms sar bskyod de gnas lugs zhib bshad thog ‘‘khyed tsho'i gros chod nang gsal nyes chad chen po de 'dra byas na mi 'grigs pas 'go khrid ma 'byor na nyes chad sgor gnyis re dang / byings ma 'byor na nyes chad pad shag lnga bcu re byas na 'tshams po yod mimilugs brjod rmodon ltar bya rgyu byas pa dang / slob sbyong dus yun zla ba gnyis kyi nang legs shes thub pa'i 'bad brtson bya rgyu byas/'khrab gzhung nang gsal 'khrab mi 'os 'dems kyis bskos/ khungs so so'i 203

gtam bshad ngag skyor thub pa dgos zhes blo 'dzin bya rgyur bskur/ de'i sang nyin gyi dgong dro khungs so so'i ngag skyor khag rgyug len byas par re zung ma gtogs phal cher gyis rnam 'gyur dang bcas pa'i ngag skyor gang legs thub kyi 'dug 'khrab ston dngos gzhi bslab rgyur thog ma byas na phran blo bstan dus tshod chu tshod gnyis re las sdod ma dgos pa byas kyang de 'dra byas na dus yun ring po 'gor bzor brten dgong ltar chu tshod bcu gcig bcu gnyis bar mnyam sdod byas shing / nga rang mkhal grang gi nad gzhir dro bcos dgos gal yang kha nas bslab pa gcig pus 'grigs thabs mi 'dug pas lus kyi nyams 'gyur dang / ngag gi smra brjod gang ci dngos su 'khrab ste bslab pa dang / mnyam du 'khrab sbyong rngul chu thig thig rgyun bsrings byas/ gzhon nu pho mo de rnams nyin mo zhing las dka' ngal che yang tshabs che'i nad mnar byung na ma gtogs rtag 'byor thog de yang pāl che ba zhing las bya yul nas nang du ma log par thad kar 'khrab sbyong la yong mkhan sha stag la song / dang thog phran blo bstan gyis ja mngar mo dkar yol do re ster ba dang / de'i sang dgong gzhis chags 'go 'dzin rgyal chos nas ja dang / bag leb ster/ de'i sang nyin nas gzhon nu'i 'go khrid byams pa can dang / de nas mu mthud gzhon nu so so'i nang nas ja mu mthud khyer yong ba red/ gzhis chags grong tsho khag nyi shu rtsa gsum kha 'thor du gnas 'khod yod gshis/ dgong mo 'khrab sbyong zin dus nam phyed tsam yin rung sa thag ring por rang rang gi khyim du log 'gro ba las/ thag nye'i grong tsho ngo shes dga' nye'i sar yang sdod kyi med pa red/ de lta bu'i spyod bzang gi sgo nas slob sbyong byed mus kyi skabs der yul gyar ‘‘nang srid las khungs ’’zhes pa nas gzhis chags don gcod khang du bka' rgya zhig btang 'byor du/ tā la'i bla ma ‘‘mon go ṭa gzhis chags su gdan sa dga' 'bras gnyis dang / ser skya mi dmangs la chos 'brel grub 204

'phral de ga ku lu gal du byon rgyu yin gshis des na sngon tshud nas bzhugs sgrig dang / phebs bsu'i zhu sgo ser sbreng bro gzhas sogs gang ci gzab gzengs ang bsar dgos rgyu ’’zhes gsal 'dug pas/ gzhis 'go nas phran la ‘‘mi dmangs nang bro gzhas kyi nyams myong yod pa mi 'dug pas gtam brjod zlos gar slob spyong pa gzhon nu pho mo tshor bropyagazhas shig 'phral du bslab rogs zhes zer byung ba bzhin bu bcu drug la bro 'khrab stangs dang / bu mo bcu drug la gzhas dang zhabs bro bslab rgyu'i 'char gzhi bzos/ bu tshor bro bslab rgyu'i thad slob grwa'i zlos gar dge rgan chos 'phel klu sgrub la 'gan bskur/ bu mo tshor gzhas dang / zhabs bro nga rang gis bslab rgyu byas/gzhon nu'i 'go khrid gnyis dang brgya dpon kha shas nas bro pa'i chas gos dang /rnga bzo mngags bya rgyu las bgos brgyab/ bu mo tshor glu gzhas bslab rgyu'i thad phran blo bstan gyis de snga shes rig zlos gar bar bslab pa'i dbus stod mal gro khul gyi sgor gzhas shig bslabs/ bu mo tsho'i gyon gos zhe mtshungs bzo ba'i cha rkyen med stabs khungs so sos gzab mchor gang legs byed dgos kyi mol khyab byas/ spa phrug dang / dpung gzan sogs nges par du gzhi mtshungs dgos gal che bar brten 'beng lor nas kab cal mu tig nyos te mu tig spa phrug gcig gsar bzo byas pa'i 'dzoms bkag g.yu byur bcos ma shing la bkrag rtsi btang bas 'dra po zhe drag 'dug bab chags byung song / spa gdan bzo rgyu dang / 'tshem sgrog bya rgyu tshang ma phran blo bstan rang gis lag bstar ma byas te lag pa chu lbur yang rdol byung / gzhon nu'i khongs nas bu mo tshems bu shes pa gcig 'dug pa der bslab ste tshems rogs phran bu byed thub pa byung bas phan thogs chen po byung / bro ba'i chas gos dang / rnga bcas bzo bskrun zin 'phral bro gzhas rnams 'khrab sbyong dngos su byas par gzhis chags 'go 'dzin dang / spyi mi/ brgya dpon dang bcu dpon sogs nas ‘‘yag po zhe drag 205

'dug thugs rje che/ da dung yang bskyar snyan bsun zhu rgyur/ phebs sgrig zhu sgo'i thad nga tsho rgyus med zhe cig la brten khyed kyis phebs sgrig spyi khyab gnang ste bka' slob yod pa ’’zhes zer don rang nas dang len gyis brgya dpon a mdo don grub dang mnyam du u krir mar dang / tshal sogs nyo bar 'jib 'khor nang ched bskyod kyis dgong dro u krir 'byor zhing / u kri zhes pa de ni spang ri dbyibs mdzes shin tu mtho ba zhig gi steng du sngar dbyin jis rgya gar dbang bsgyur skabs brgyab pa'i khang pa ku tri dang / tshogs khang / mgron khang sogs spus dag brgyab yod pa'i dbyar kha spro 'cham tsha yol bya yul zhig red 'dug phar tshur dang bcas nyin gsum 'gor/ de nas phyir log skabs gzhis chags 'go 'dzin rgyal chos mon go ṭar phebs bsu snyan seng zhu bar bskyod de tshes cha gtan 'khel gyis phyir log slebs 'dug cing / phebs bsu zhu phyogs gros bsdur gyis gzhis chags 'go 'dzin sogs 'brel yod mi sna khag dang / phran blo bstan/ ser sbreng / dung rgya/ bro gzhas/ slob grwa'i zlos gar bcas nas phebs bsu rim pa zhus/ de'i sang nyin pho brang gi shar lho'i phyogs ri steng mi dmangs thang gshong gi dbu g.yab tu bro gzhas dang /slob grwa'i zlos gar/ yul tsho so so'i glu gar zhabs bro sogs spros/ gus blo bstan dang / gcung po dga' ldan ban dgon sde pa chos 'dzin ngos gnyis kyang ku lu gal nas hon zur rgyud smad grwa tshang dang / se ra dgon gnyis kar chos zhur bskyod de ku lu gal du phyir log byas/ ku lu gal gzhis chags kyi gzhon nu'i 'go khrid zung nas brjod gsal/ ‘‘gzhon nu tshos gtam brjod zlos gar sbyang brtson gang gzab zhus yod lags na khyed kyis thugs zhib kyis dge skyon yo bsrang gi bka' slob yod pa ’’zer don blta zhib bgyis par dngos 'brel gyi sbyang 'bras yag po thon 'dug pa gzhon nu tsho'i sems shugs dang hur brtson la nga rang dga' mgu yi rangs byung bas khong tshor bstod 206

bsngags kyang byas pa yin/ gzhon nu'i 'go khrid kyis bshad don 'khrab chas rnams phal cher bzo tshems dang / gra sgrig zin yod gshis mang tshogs nang nas zlos gar blta 'dod byed mkhan mang po 'dug pas gang mgyogs 'khrab ston byas na 'thus min ’’zer bar/ nga chotshos da dung dgong mo kha shas nang sbyong yag po bya dgos bshad pa bzhin 'khrab sbyong gang gzab byas rjes 'khrab ston gra sgrig byas/ 'khrab yul thad gzhon nu'i tshogs khang rgya khyon chung stabs gzhis chags grong tsho bzhi pa dang lnga pa dbar gyi 'bru mdzod khang chen nang gar stegs gdeng cha rgya khyon che tsam bzos/ mang tshogs sdod yul du tir spar gyi bya g.yab gdan la bting / grong tsho khag nyi shu rtsa gsum yod pa tsho gsum la bgos te dgong mo gsum 'khrab ston byas par ltad mo che la dga' ba skye ba byung zhes shod mkhan mang po 'dug pa ma zad/ 'khrab ston 'ga' shas shes rig zlos gar ba ngo ma las kyang lhag pa 'dug zer ba dang / khams sprul rin po che nas phran la ‘‘da res kyi gtam brjod zlos gar de shes rig zlos gar rang gis 'khrab pa las kyang dngos gnas legs pa byung 'dug pas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin ’’zhes gsungs byung / 'khrab ston mjug rdzogs pa'i dgong mo gzhon nu'i 'go khrid tre+e bo dar dgon brgya shog khongs byams pas gar stegs gdeng cha'i steng nas/ da res kyi gaham brjod zlos gar slob sbyong byas pa'i gnas tshul skor gsal brjod dang 'brel gzhis chags kyi 'go 'dzin dang / slob ston pa phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ 'khrab ston pa gzhon nu pho mo/gzhis chags srid 'dzin khang gi drung che ngo las sogs tshang mar thugs rje che zhu'i gtam bshad kyang byas/ku lu gal gzhis chags khul 'dir rgyud smad grwa tshang gis btang ba'i zhabs brtan pa gtan bzhugs —dge 'dun bzhi gras dbus gnyug mar gnas pa'i grub mtha' ris med kyi dge 'dun bcu phrag lhag trem 'dug pas rnam 207

kun grong chog dang / gzhis chags kyi spyi rim sgrub pa bcas chos phyogs kyi byed sgo mi dman tsam mchis rung / bstan pa'i rtsa ba gzhi gsum gyi cho ga zhig 'dzugs gal che lugs gzhis chags kyi 'go 'dzin la bshad par blo babs byung ba bzhin gzhis chags dbus kyi ri steng pho brang gi tshoms chen nang snga 'phros yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong tshogs rgyur rgyud smad dge bshes mang thos 'dul ba 'dzin pa zhig la mdo 'don slob dpon gnang dgos zhus te thog mar bod zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin dge slong bco lnga dang / dge tshul gcig bcas nas bkra shis gso spyong dang / rten khrus yul khrus bcas gnang nyin phran nas pho brang tshoms chen gyi rten mchog spyan sngar sna lnga'i mchod sprin dang / 'dus tshogs su gsol ja bzhes 'bras/ dge 'dun rer sku 'gyed sgor re bcas phul thog slad phyin yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong chag med thog mi ring bar dbyar zhal bzhes thub pa dgos rgyu'i zhen bskul byas/spyi lo 1976me stag zla ba dgu pa'i nang ku lu gal nas rda ram sa lar log ste yul gyar bka' shag tu snyan zhu sngon song ltar ‘‘rgan yol phogs thob ma stsal rung sdod khang zhig gnang skyong yod pa mi’zhes bshad pas mthar gangs can skyid gshongs nas khang pa gsar pa thog gcig ma mdo sbug gnyis dang /chu khang gsang spyod shag mtshes dang mnyam du byas pa/ lho phyogs nyi g.yab yod pa zhig sprad byung ba der bsdad de khu sim bag phebs dang kha 'don dge sbyor 'phel ba byung / skabs der theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang du tā la'i bla mas lam rim gsung chos gnang ba der chos zhur phyin/ ka sbug nas ngo shes dga' nye gzhis rtse tshogs khang pa'i jo lags pa sangs tshe ring dang / btsun ma bde chen gnyis kyang chos zhur 'byor/ gsung chos nyin gsum pa'i nyin phran blo bstan tshad rim nad mnar gyi tsha ba rgyas te nyin re bzhin je sdug je lod du gyur yang snga dro sman khab brgyab pa dang / mu mthud chos zhur bskyod 208

cing / dgong dro log long dus rang 'gros ma thub par rogs pas g.yas skyor g.yon skyor gyis log nas meg lor ghan jir gzhis rtse tshogs khang pa'i jo lags sar bsdad/ mtshan mo zhig nad gzhi lci lod kyis shi grabs byas te spun mched rgyal mtshan chos ldan gangs can skyid gshongs nas ched 'bod byed dgos byung 'dug 'on kyang sdig sgrib byang slad chos zhur nyin ltar sdug rus kyis phyin pas nyin bcu tsam 'gro dus phran bu drag skyes byung nas gsung chos cha tshang nyan thub pa byung / de'i skabs tshogs khang btsun ma bde chen nas phran la 'bod bskul byas don ‘‘bal yul du gcung mo skal chos bza' 'tsho dang /tshogs khang bu mo sgrol dkar bza' tsho'i mag pa gnyis ka spun mched yin rung /skal chos lags nas sgrol dkar bza' 'tshor 'khrug rtsod bsun gtser ci che byas te bzod ma bde ba bzo bzhin yod 'dug pas/ khyed kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi slob ston gnang ste 'grigs thabs kha ta byed rogs ’mizhes zer byung zhing / phyogs gnyis gcig ni spun mched dang / gcig shos ni dga' nyer song gshis de don khas len gyis bal yul du gcung mo skal chos thabs shes la 'phrin yig 'phral mar btang thog 'gro gron dang dka' ngal la ma 'dzems par rgya gar nas bal yul du mkha' lam brgyud ched bskyod byas shing /bal yul ka ṭa man tu gnam gru 'bab thang du slebs skabs gcung mo skal chos kyi bza' zla tshe phun phran bsu bar 'byor 'dug de nas gcung mo thabs shes gnyis la gzhis rtse tshogs khang pa'i btsun ma bde chen lags nas bshad pa'i lo rgyus gnas tshul zhib brjod byas par gcung mo thabs shes gnyis kyis bshad pa'i gnas tshul nyan skabs phan tshun gnyis kyi skad cha hang zom shin tu che yang ma lan ma 'gyod pa'i bar mol gyi le 'grigs yong ba byed dgos brjod de/ gyod ya tshe phun lags kyi gcung po ngag rgyal dang / bza' zla sgrol dkar gnyis kyi sar ngo bskyod kyis phan tshun spun mched kyi lar rgya bzung nas nang 209

'grigs byas pa dga' lugs sogs zhib tu bshad par de don bya rgyu zer ba ltar mol skabs/ bu rgan pa tshe phun bza' tsho gnyis nas brjod gsal/ a ma mtshams lags rgya gar du bskyod skabs lha sa'i mkhar dbang gser chas/dngul chas/ kha gdan rgya rum dang / bod rum/ tshong zog gos chen gru'u tse sogs hin sgor drug 'bum brgal ba'i ca dngos rnams gcung po ngag rgyal bza' tsho gnyis la byung yod pas de rnams phyir sprod dgos lugs dang / ngag rgyal bza' tsho gnyis nas zer na a ma lags kyi ca dngos nas kha gdan re gnyis byung ba las de min gang yang ma byung zhes zer bas ri zor ga 'dzol che ba dang / yang de snga'i dga' nye bal yul tha ka li'i tshong khang zer ba dang dngul sprod len skor 'khrugs rtsod kyis khrims la gyar gtan 'khel 'dug pa phran nas bar mol gyis tha ka li phyogs nas ngas bar 'dum byas par mos mthun cha 'jog byung yang / gcung mo bza' tsho gnyis nas go shes nyan 'jog ma byung stabs ngal ba don med kyis rgya gar du phyir log byas/ rgya gar du thon khar phan tshun gnyis kar da res ngas drang 'brel gyi bar mol byas pa der slar yang dgongs pa che bzhes kyi nang 'grigs yong ba gnang rogs zhes nan mngags byas pa ltar rjes sor tha ka li'i sa nas dngul yong rgyu'i skor nang mol byas nas phran gyis skad cha byas pa'i dngul 'bor nas bskyed cha sgor bzhi stong chag yangs btang ste 'grig 'dugaspyi lo 1977lor rda ram sa la nas ldi li bar rlangs 'khor nang bskyod/ldi li nas 'beng lor bar mkha' lam brgyud ku lu gal du 'byor/ bal yul nas gcung mo skal chos nas rgya gar du yod pa'i phru gu rgan pa bu gsum gyi slob yon sprod dmigs hin sgor nyis khri tham pa de sngon phran la mngags bcol de dag dngul khang du bcol/ nyin shas ngal gso byas rjes spun mched rgyal chos kyi las shag dang rgyang thag gang 'tshams yod pa'i pho brang gi ri 'dab tu khang 210

sna chu mig gnyis kher rkyang yod pa der ldapal ldatshwashā de mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi bsnyen mtshams shig tu bsdad/ gyon chas kyi snod lcags sgam de'i nang rgyal chos kyi khyim du dgos mkho ba mo zhig nyo rgyu snga lo ngo shes pa gcig la mngags gtam byas zin pa'i rin dngul hin sgor nyis stong tham pa zur bcad kyis nyar ba de sprod rgyu brjed 'dug pas/ sdod gnas grong gcig ma yin tsang rkun ma yong nyen che gshis/ sngas shub nang sbas na cung legs pa mi yong ngam snyam yang mno bsam zhib gtong skabs las ma byas pa dang mi phrad byas pa chud mi 'dza' bas/ las bsags med na nyin mtshan kun tu sgo phye ste bzhag kyang bor brlag yong gi ma red bsams 'bad brtson med par bzhag de bas tshe 'di'i snang shas bzlog khul gyis lhag lha'i bsnyen mtshams bca' rgyu byung ba 'di skal pa bzang snyam nas thun bzhir byas pa'i srod thun de yun ring tsam 'gor nas mātshan mo'i chu tshod bcu gcig dang skar ma lnga bcu tsam bar bsdad cing / de nas nyal te tho rengs chu tshod gsum par langs nas gad 'phyis gtsang sbra dang / mchod me yon chab sogs phul zhing thor thun gyi 'go btsugs/de bzhin du snga thun dang / dgong thun sogs cha tshod krig car bgos te ༄bsnyen mtshams dam la yid 'khul lus bde spro ba 'phel ba bcas lus sems dben pa gang legs byung yang / nyin bdun phrag 'gro ba'i mtshan mo gnyid du yur skabs rkun mas sge'u khung nas 'dzul te lcags sgam dang / grwa chas/ chu tshod/ rdor dril/ dpe cha/ 'phreng ba/ mig shel sogs gang na ci yod 'khyer nas 'char can gnyid sad pa'i skabs grwa chas kyang gyon yas med pa bzos 'dug tir spar 'bog 'jo rnying pa gcig yod pa de bzhag 'dug pa de'i nang ras kyi gzan sham rnying hrulatshuzhig yod pa snga lo gso sbyong byed skabs dge slong grwa chas med pa zhig yod pa der ster rgyu'i ched 'khyer yong yang khong sdod mkhan med pas sprod sa ma byung bar lus pa de dag rkun mas khyer mi 211

'dug pas dga' po'i ngang gyon nas dkon mchog gi thugs rjes srog skyon ma byung ba legs ang snyam/ dngos nor rku shor la phangs sems cher ma byung ba'i mus su sngar rgyun bzhin thor thun 'go btsugs te sgom bzlas byas/ tho rengs yol tsam skya rengs shar dus gzhis chags bod mi zhing las la 'gro dus lam bar dpe cha mang po rlung gis 'khyer ba dang / byang chub sems zhwa ser po zhig lam du bskyur yod pa bcas zhing las pas sgrug ste don gcod rgyal chos kyi shag tu bskyal nas ‘‘dge 'dun pa zhig la rku shor byung ba min nam/ dpe cha dang /dbu zhwa 'di 'dra lam du bskyur 'dug la/ gzhon nu'i gling kha'i nang lcags sgam zhig kyang kha phye nas bzhag 'dug pas nga tsho nye 'gram la 'gro nus ma byung ’’zhes bshad 'dug par don gcod rgyal chos kyis las khungs kyi khang gnyer skad 'bod thog ‘‘khyod tsho mnyam bskyod kyis lcags sgam dang / dngos rigs sogs las khungs nang la skyol cig ’’ces bshad 'dug skabs der rgyal chos kyi bza' zla brtson 'grus bzang mo nas ‘‘o ho sku zhabs dge slong lags la rkun ma shor med dam/ khyed rang da lta lam seng gzigs par phebs na dga' ’’zhes zhus don rgyal chos phran sar slebs te sgo brdung byung bas nga rang ngag bcad gzungs sngags bgrang mus su yar langs te sgo phye bas rgyal chos ni lag g.yon 'phreng ba zhig dang / g.yas pas nga la thal sbyar gnang byung bas ngas kyang ngag ma glod par lag g.yas kyis thal sbyar byas pas khong mgo gug tsam byas nas log song /de rjes nyi ma ma shar tsam la 'char can thun grol te zhogs ja zhogs zas bskyel bar rgyal chos kyi zhabs zhu rmo'o zer ba slebs byung zhing / khong gis ‘‘sku zhabs brtson 'grus bzang mo lags kyis sku zhabs dge slong lags kyi bzhugs sa'i g.yon phyogs lcags sgam de 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos ang gsungs byung / a tsi lcags sgam mi 'dug pas da nang tho rengs zhing las 212

'gro mkhan tshos gnas tshul zhus pa de/ da byed dus sku zhabs dge slong lags kyi sku chas red 'dug 7ces zhib brjod byas byung / rmo'o phyir log zin 'phral rgyal chos stangs dpyal gnyis ka phran sar yong ste brtson 'grus bzang mo nas ‘‘a tsi/ da gin khyed sar sku ngo gzigs par phebs dus sngar rgyun gzungs sngags 'dren bzhin pa las/ skyon byung mi 'dug gsungs byung yang / dpe bsags grabs red/ lcags sgam stong pa bzos/ de'i 'gram la rkun ma'i sta gri rnon po zhig lus 'dug pa sku srog la nyes skyon ma byung ba ha cang yag po red/na bza' zan sham rnying hrul 'di 'dras rtsa ba nas yong ba mi 'dug ngas khrom la phyin nas gsar pa zhig lam seng bzo mngags byas chog brjod byung yang /phran gyis ‘‘gnas skabs zan sham 'di gas 'grig gi red/ rda ram sa lar zan sham 'thol pa cha tshang yod/ ma gzigs ang mimizhes bshad pa yin/ da ga'i dgong dro grong gseb tshong khang chung chung zhig yod pa de nas ras kyi zan sham ldeng tsam nyo sa byung ste gsar btsems kyis bskyal byung / rgyal chos kyis ‘‘dngul ni kha sang dngul khang la bcol pa red pā/ gzhan dag gnad che ba gang brlag song ngam ’’zhes brjod byung bar/ ngas ba mo gcig brlag song ba las/ gzhan dag de tsam gnad che ba rang med ’’ces brjod pas/ ‘‘nga la ba phyugs nyo ma dgos zhes snga lo nas zhus zin pas de 'odra'i sdug pa la ang / da 'brel yod las khungs la rkun tho zhig phul ba dga' gi red ’’ces zer byung yang / phran gyis rkun tho 'bul gyi min/ bod kyi gtam dper ‘‘rkun ma ma shor na dga'/ rkun brtsad ma chod pa dga' mi’zhes pa'i dpe dang / rgya gar gyi khrims lugs 'di yang phran la rgyus mnga' yod/ rkun ma brtsad chod de dngos po ra 'phrod gsal po byung yang / khyod rang la dngos po de dag dang thog gang nas byung / 'byung khungs dang / lo dus/ zla tshes sogs gsal po bshad dgos zhes 'dri brtsad byed cing / lo mang song bas lo dus zla tshes gsal po bshad rgyu med na khyod rang gis kyang ma rkus pa'i nges pa mi 'dug 213

zer ba sogs bsnyad 'tshol za bed byas pa kha shas dngos su mthong myong / de bas gun khyer te tshe phyi ma'i bu lon dag par shog cig ces smon lam brgyab ste bsdad pa dga' gi red ’’ces bshad/ bsnyen mtshams dam por bsdad de bzlas sngags sgra dag gsal gsum gyi lhag chad mi 'byung ba dam 'dzin gyis zla gsum zhag bcu bzhi yun 'gor byung song yang de'i ring gzugs khams bde thang gang legs byung thog kha skong sbyin bsregs bcas sbyor dngos rjes gtsang blo yid tshims pa bya rgyu byung / sbyin pa'i bdag po gcung po rgyal chos stangs dpyal gnyis nas bza' btung 'tsho ba gzab gzengs 'jungs pa med par lo ngo gnyis ring bstab pa brdabs bsigs che tsam byas song / khong gnyis la dgos mkho 'o ma'i dmigs sgor ba mo gcig nyo rgyuswā blo thag bcad kyang ba rin hin sgor nyis stong tham pa zur nyar de dag rkun mas 'khyer stabs bsam don ma 'grub/ 'on kyang rjes su sku drin gsol rgyu yid la brnags/14 slar yang zlos gar 'go 'dzin byas pa/rda ram sa la nas shes rig zlos gar 'go dge las slob spyi mgrin gyi yi ge zhig 'byor gsal/ ‘‘lugs zung dpal mnga' bka' drin mtshungs med sku ngo dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin lags mchog gi zhabs drung du/gus 'bul/ mchog nyid bgres yol dge sbyor zhal 'don la gzhol bzhin par rjes su yi rangs zhu rgyu dang / gus tsho zlos gar tshogs pa 'di dag bar skabs nas bzung gang cir nyam rgud byung ste pho mo rgan gzhon tshang mar yon tan slob sbyong gzhan dag lta ci/ bod yig slob pa'i go skabs kyang med par glu gzhas 'khrab sbyong nyi ma gang 'khyol gyis dus 'da' zhing / sgrig lam kunaspyod je zhan je sdug tu gyur pa dang / gong rim nas do 'khur chung thogamang tshogs nas kyang mthong chung byed pa bcas da cha gtam don gnyis med kyi 214

gnas su gyar ba 'di mur sdod thabs med stabs gus tsho 'go khrid dang /dge rgan/ zlos gar ba pho mo rgan gzhon/ las byed pa dang bcas tshang 'dzoms gang dga' ci legs kyi bya thabs gros mol byed skabs zlos gar rnying khungs rgan gras nas brjod gsal/ zlos gar thog mar gsar 'dzugs mdzad po khyed rang dang phyag rogs rnams kyi dus skabs su dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen shin tu zhan na'ang tshang ma mdza' mthun dang sems shugs chen pos sgrig lam kun spyod legs la/ yon tan slob sbyong legs pa/ 'tsho ba'i blta skyong sogs gang cir phun sum tshogs po byung yod stabs gtso cher mi smon rang skyid kyi dus skabs bzang po zhig byung 'dug pas/ da lta tshang mas de lta bu zhing byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i 'dun pa skom pa chu 'dod ltar yod lags na/ de don slar gso 'byung ched gang nyid thugs rgyus bab kyis nga tshor gang ci'i bka' slob mdzad por phebs gnang yod pa dang / 'di gar bzhugs gnas thad sngar dang mi 'dra bar gang legs yod lags na nges phebs skyabs 'jug ci nas yod pa zhu rgyu dang / gang ci'i zhu sgo khyed kyi dgongs mthun zhus chog pa mkhyen/ mkhyen/ bzhugs sgar rda ram sa la nas/ shes rig zlos gar tshogs pa'i 'go byings dge slob las byed spyi mgrin nas gus 'dud bcas/1977lo'i zla 12tshes 15la phul mi’zhes 'byor par yig lan btang ba gsham gabasdo95/ ‘‘thugs brtse mtshungs med shes rig zlos gar tshogs pa'i dbu 'dzin dang / dge slob/ las byed bcas lhan drung du/ stabs zhu/ de nas btang gnas nges 'byor byung gsal rang re'i zlos gar tshogs pa 'di'i sgrig lam kun spyod dang / yon tan slob sbyong sogs nyam pa gsor chud 'byung ched phran gyi bslab bya byas na phan res slob ston du yong dgos re 'dun gnang yang /deng dus sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i 'gyur ba che stabs sngar gyi byed stangs kyis deng 215

skabs phan nus thon pa shin tu dka' zhing / phran yang lo na mtho li gzugs po rgyun gcong stabs khyed tsho'i re ba bskong thabs gral gshis dgongs 'gal med pa dang / de bas khyed rnam pa mthun sgril dam zab kyis sgrig lam la srung brtsi dang / kun spyod bzang po'i sgo nas gtso cher gang cir hur brtson 'bad sgrub kyis zlos gar ba mang tshogs nas dbu khrid dang / dge rgan la gus zhabs bka' brtsi dang / 'go khrid dang dge rgan tshos mang tshogs la byams brtse'i gces skyong dam zab bcas kyi sgo nas las don sgrub na rim bzhin yar rgyas gong 'phel yong rgyu gdon mi za bas/ des na tshang mas sems shugs ma chag par phywar ba gru 'degs kyis dka' spyad 'bad brtson cis kyang gnang skyong yod pa dgongs 'jags zhu/ ku lu gal nas/ dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis/ 1977lo'i zla 12tshes 21la phul ’’zhes pa'i yig lan btang /spyi lo 1978lor bal yul nas gcung mo skal chos lags stangs dpyal nas yi ge 'byor don/ bu 'bring ba blo bzang bstan pa rda ram sa la'i rnam rgyal grwa tshang la chos 'jug thabs shes byed dgos kyi re 'dun byung bar rten ku lu gal nas thon te 'beng lor nas rlangs 'khor thog bskyod/ 'beng lor du bsam gtan lags sar nyin shas bsdad/ 'beng lor slob grwa chen mor slob sbyong du yod pa'i gcung mo skal chos kyi bu rgan pa tshul khrims zla ba dang / gyang grongagi bu chung ba bcas khong gnyis thug 'phrad dang 'brel slob sbyong la hur brtson dgos pa'i bslab bya dang lag dngul brngan pa ster/ nyin gcig yul gyar nang srid las khungs kyi shing gi bzo grwa dang / rgun 'brum dkar po'i shing 'bras ldum rwa'i 'go khrid gcig lcogs bsam gtan gyi grogs po zla ba bsam gtan sar ched 'bod ltar phyin/ de'i sang nyin 'beng lor nas ldi li bar ri li'i nang bskyod/ ldi li nas rda ram sa lar rlangs 'khor nang bskyod 'byor thog rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi 'go khrid las sne tshor bu blo bzang bstan pa 216

grwa tshang sgrig khongs su 'dzul zhugs chog pa zhes bshad par khas len thob pas bal yul du yi ge btang stetshonyin bcu phrag song mtshams bu blo bzang bstan pa rda ram sa lar 'byor pa bzhin bu'i dge rgan dbu mdzad skal bzang nas gnang / gzan sham sogs grwa chas gsar bzo dang 'brel tshes cha bzang ba dang bstun rnam rgyal grwa tshang du sgrig zhugs kyis rten mchog spyan sngar sna lnga'i mchod sprin dang / —'dus tshogs su bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed phul/nyin gcig shes rig drung che ri dga' blo bzang bstan 'a dzin phran sar yong ste 4zlos gar tshogs pa 'go byings spyi mgrin nas zhu mos ltar thugs rgyus bab kyis khyed nyid lo gcig lo gnyis ring zlos gar tshogs par gang ci'i bka' slob gnang mkhan du phebs bzhugs gnang rgyu yong ba zhes shes rig las khungs su nan zhu che bar brten shes rig bka' blon thub nyin lags nas snyan seng zhus te bka' 'khrol byung song bas de don ko nem zlos gar du gang mgyogs phebs gnang yod pa ’’zhes zer byung bar/ nga ni gzugs po rgyun gcong thog lhag par du grang rlung gi nad bab lci bas 'grub thabs bral gshis dgongs 'khrol yong ba'i snyan seng gnang skyong yod pa zhes bshad par drung ches ‘‘ngas bka' blon la zhus chog ste khyed rang gis kyang bka' blon ngo mjal gnang rogs ’’zer ba bzhin thub nyin sar phyin te dgongs pa gnang rogs zhes bshad par/ ‘‘de 'dras ma gsung khyed tshos sngar dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis sgrig 'dzugs byas pa'i zlos gar 'di nyid da res khyed kyis blta rtogs legs slob cig ma byas na thor gyar 'gro nyen che bar brten khyed rang zlos gar tshogs pa spyi mgrin nas re 'dunacho byas pa ltar de don byung na yag po yong rgyu ’’zhesari sdor byung bas ga zhu 'di zhu med par gang mtshams lus/ mno bsam zhib btangagis ‘‘rtsa ba'i las 'gan thad 'go 'dzin dang / drung che sogs kyis rī 'khyer dgoso pā las ngas mi yong / slob ston bya rgyu gang yong zhus chog 'on 217

kyang dgun thog ring ldi lir las mjug skyel rgyu yod pas sa drod slebs mtshams bcar chog pa ’’zhes bshad/ de nas ldi lir thon te rlung 'phrin las khungs nas phogs 'phar dngul 'bab len rgyu bsdad pa bskul lcag zhu mus su zla ba 'khor tsam la yul gyar shes rig las khungs zhes pa nas yig chung zhig btang 'byor nang / ‘‘zlos gar 'go 'dzin ngag dbang grags pa glo bur 'das grong la brten khyed nyid 'phral phebs ci nas kyang yod pa ’’zhes 'khod pa ltar nyin shas mtshams rda ram sa lar 'gro dgos byung zhing / rda sar 'byor nas shes las su bskyod skabs bka' blon thub nyin nas brjod don/‘‘da res zlos gar 'go 'dzin ngag dbang grags pa glo bur 'das grong song gshis snga 'phros khyed kyis slob ston dang 'go 'dzin gcig lcogs gnang rogs mi zhu mthu med byung bas sku mkhyen/ min ma gsung rogs gnang ’zhes zer bar/ ‘‘ngas slob ston bya rgyu las las 'gan 'khur rgyu mi yong zhes dang po nas zhus zin pas de 'dra yong ba mi 'dug ’’ces bshad/ khong gis ‘‘de ltar yin te da res 'go 'dzin 'das stabs re 'dun mi zhu mthu med byung / sku mkhyen/ sku mkhyen mi’zhes nan brjod la brten ‘‘'o na snga 'khros gang 'khyol zhus chog 'go 'dzin las rogs gcig nges par du bsko gzhag gnang dgos ’’zhes bshad par zlos gar ba rnying khungs phur bu tshe ring la las rogs bsko gzhag byas te mnyam du las 'khur byas/ shes rig bka' blon thub nyin nas nang don mngags byar zlos gar bro gzhas dge rgan brag g.yab chos mdzad zer ba des 'go khrid la brtsi bkur med pa dang / byings la mthun lam zhan pa bcas ru gyong po zhig yod pas kho pa zlos gar nas 'bud thabs byas pa legs lugs zer byung bar/ brtag dpyad skabs gzhi rkang spyod pa gyong tsam 'dug rung / rang 'khri'i las 'gan hur bskyed che la rgyal rabs dang / gtam brjod zlos gar sogs gang thad la 'khrab ston go 'pher zhig 218

'dug pas kho par 'jam mkhas slob gso thengs kha shas byas par phran bu'i sgyur bcos byung song bar brten zlos gar nas phyir 'bud byed ma dgos tsam byung / zlos gar tshogs pa 'di nyid ma gzhi sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i mgo mjug med cing / sgrig 'chal lang shor du gyur 'dug pa de dag phag pa dbyar lam du 'jug rgyu shin tu dka' ba'i gnas su gyur 'dug pa dper na/ zlos gar yig tshang las khungs nang gi 'go khrid drung che dang / rtsis pa/ dngul gnyer/dge rgan khag bcas nas kyang sgrig khrims ma 'khur bar rang 'dod khrom bskyod dang / dgong mo yang zlos gar du ma log par gangs can skyid gshong dang / meg lor ghan je/ bu gso khang sogs la 'khyams nas zhag sdod byed pa/ za khang dang / chang khang nang rtsed mo mā cwang rgyag pa sogs byas tsang /zlos gar ba pho mo byings phal che bas mig ltos ngan 'gran byed pa dang / 'go byed dge rgan phan tshun lta spyod mi mthun zhing / dge skyon yo bsrang byed res lta zhog gcig 'og gcig tu mi 'dus pa'i khengs dregs kyis gnod skyon ha cang chen po 'dug pas zlos gar tshogs pa 'di dag nyams pa gsor chud dang /mi nyams gong 'phel 'byung thabs ji ltar byas legs kyi bsam gzhig gang yong byas te nyin re'i bya rim zhogs pa langs pa nas/ dgong mo ma nyal bar gyi byed sgo sngar gyi lam srol cha tshang ba yong thabs med kyang / yar rgyas gang 'tshams pa zhig gtong thub pa byung / gzhi rtsa'i 'tsho gos dang / mdun lam/slob sbyong byed sgo sogs kyi gnas tshul la brtag dpyad dang / 'dri zhib nan tan bgyis par/ zlos gar tshogs par yul gyar shes rig las khungs zhes pa nas thog ma'i rtsa 'dzugs skabs kyi spyi'i 'tsho snon sprod lam ltar phran bu zhig sprad pa las/ rtsa ba'i 'tsho thabs— zlos gar tshogs —pa rang nas rang kha rang gso dgos rgyu'i 'gan dkri byas 'dug par brten 'khrab ston byas pa'i tri ka si'i rin 'bab nas tshogs pa spyi'i zla re'i zas gron dang phogs snon phran bu re 219

sprod lam ltar sprod dgos/ de yang mi ldeng ba'i dka' ngal che yang shes rig las khungs nas mgo 'don 'tsho skyong gi do 'khur ma byas pa'i gnas lugs mang po zhig bshad rgyu 'dug pa dang / khong tshos brjod gsal ‘‘zlos gar tshogs pa thog mar rtsa 'dzugs skabs zlos gar ba rnams la phugs kyi mdun lam ched nyin ltar snga dro'i ring pho mo rgan dar gzhon gsum tshang mar skad yig sna tshogs slob sbyong gi go skabs bzang po byung ba'i mthu las thog ma'i slob phrug khongs nas rim bzhin 'go 'dzin las rogs su gyur pa phur bu tshe ring dang /drung che thub bstan bsam 'grub gnyis po yon tan yig rtsis 'dzoms shing shes yon can drag gras dang do mnyam pa yod pa dang / 'on kyang bar skabs shig nas yon tan slob sbyong la do 'khur byed mi ma byung rkyen da cha nga tsho mi thog 'di shes rmongs zhe gcig tu gyur yod/ nga tsho na gzhon lang tsho dar ba'i dus tshod de zlos gar 'khrab ston gyi lam nas sri zhu sgrub rgyu kho nar mi tshe bskyal ba yin/ da cha na rgas rdzi brdibs kyi dus su zlos gar tshogs pa rang nas 'tsho skyong gnang rogs zhu rgyu las gzhan la 'gro sa med la/ gal te zlos gar nas kha bral dgos byung na sprang po bya rgyu las med mimices 'u thug smre ngag 'don gyi 'dug pa de tsho dngos gnas khag mi 'dug snyam pa byung / khong tshor sems gso dang 'brel ‘‘de tsho'i skor dka' ngal sel thabs gang yod byas chog gi red/ blo pham ma byed/ nga rang tsho tshang ma mnyam mthun ngang blo gcig sems gcig gis sgrig lam kun spyod bzang po'i thog nas 'bad brtson byas na tha zhan du 'gyur srid kyi ma red/ shes rig las khungs la'ang gnas lugs babs zhu byas 'thus dang / da phyin nga rang tsho'i ngos nas kyang 'go byed dge rgan gyi gtsos tshang mas rang rang 'gan 'khur ya rabs spyod bzang gi sgrig lam yag po srung thub pa byed dgos ’’lugs sogs bshad pa dang / 'tsho ba'i thad de snga nyin ltar ja mngar mo bzo ba'i 'o rtsam rnying pa lcags krin che ba mang 220

po zhig 'dug kyang / 'o rtsam ha cang rnying song des gzugs khams la gnod skyonasgong rgyur brten khri byang bla brang nas ba mo spus legs gsum spus ka zhus te mngar ja 'o ma sos pa rang yong thabs byas pa dang / rnam kun gyi kha lag sngar yod thog bdun phrag re'i nang sha 'phar ma thengs gnyis re ster rgyu bzos/tshang mar bod yig dang / dbyin yig hin rdu'i skad yig bcas slob rgyur dge rgan gtong gnang yod pa zhes shes rig las khungs su zhus/ zlos gar 'khrab ston sngar yod sbyong brdar thog gsar du gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i gzigs mo chen mo'i 'cham sna legs pa brgyad ched slob bya phyir bkra shis lhun po'i mgon khang pa sku zhabs pa sangs lags dge rgan du ched mngags rdo rje gling nas gdan zhus kyis slob sbyong zla ba gnyis ring byas pa'i sbyangs 'bras rgyugs len dang / bu dang bu mo'i khongs nas 'khrab ston legs shos re dge rgan chen mo sku zhabs pa sangs lags nas 'os 'dems gnang rogs zhus te rkang 'dzin dge rgan du bskos par dge rgan spyi 'gre'i thob thang sprad/ dge slob yongasabyunas dka' ngal 'dzems med kyis 'cham sbyong hur bskyed byas par legs bzo'i ched zlos gar tshogs pa yongs la spro skyid gsol ston nyin 'khyongs gzab rgyas bshams/ dge rgan chen mo sku zhabs mgon khang pa pa sangs lags kyi dge rgan dgung grangs brgyad bcur phebs pa de'i zhabs zhu pa sangs lags kho rang las med stabs dang thog zhal bzhes ma gnang ba'i dka' ngal byung yang ngang rgyud ring so'itshogs4'debs re bskul mu mthud nan zhus la brten de don dgongs bzhes kyis phebs/ sku zhabs pa sangs lags nas gsung don ‘‘bdag gis spum seng khas len mi zhu ba'i rgyu mtshan gnyis yod/ gcig ni nga rang mgon khang pa 'cham pa'i gras shig yin na'ang bar skabs lo mang ring 'cham ma 'khrib pa'i khaṃr/ lo na rgas te lus gzugs kyang gog por gyur yod pa dang / gnyisanas deng sang gi gzhon nu tshos 221

dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis sbyang brtson byed kyi ma red snyam byung / 'on kyang zlosagar gzhon nu pho mo 'di tsho sems shugs che ba dang dka' ngal 'dzems med thog dge rgan gyi ngag la nyan zhing / sgrig khrims yag po zhe gcig la brten nga rang la'ang bcos min brtse sems kyi sems shugs bskyed nas dka' ngal la mi skrag pa zhig tu gyur te hur brtson zhu thub pa byung / da res kyi 'cham sne khag brgyad po 'di dag sngar gzigs mo chen mo'i 'cham khongs nas legs gras yin la 'gyings stabs dang / 'khrab stangs/ sbub rol/ dung chen sogs kyang zlos gar gzhon nu tshos rtser son legs shes byung song bar nga rang yang zhe drag dga' po byung ri’zhes gsungs byung / sku zhabs pa sangs lags zlos gar du bzhugs yun ring khong la zhabs zhu ba mi gcig ched 'dzugs thog gsol chas dwang dod dang ldan pa phul/ phebs khar legs 'bul sku yon gya nom dang / mjal dar bcas phul te bste gnas rdo rje gling du ched mngags phebs skyel ba hin skad legs shes zhabs zhu go 'pher zhig dang sbrags dga' skyel zhus/ 'cham gyi 'bag chas dang / 'cham gos sogs lam seng bzo 'go btsugs/spyi lo 1979lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes shar la lo ltar 'char can rda ram sa lar lo 'khor tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms bya srol ltar tshogs drung nas brda tho btang 'byor bzhin phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin tshogs 'dur bskyod par/ zlos gar 'go 'dzin zhes pa'i skub stegs shig gnas rim brgyad pa rgan drung gi gral mjug der 'dug pa las phran gyi sdod gnas rim pa dang mthun pa'i rkub stegs byung mi 'dug stabs tshogs drung byang bkras phun rnam la ra sprag gis tshogs gtsor gnas lugs zhu dgos bshad nas rgan drung gi gral gsham de rang la bsdad/ de'i sang nyin lugs mthun sdod gnas bzo bcos byas yod shag yin te rkub stegs zhib bsher skabs bsgyur bcos byas 222

mi 'dug phran la gnas rim lnga pa drung che'i gdan thob yod bzhin du dgos dbang dma' 'bebs byas pa zhig yin tsang tshogs 'dur ma bsdad par log grabs byas kyang / bsam blo zhib gtong skabs sdod gnas rim pa mtho dma' tsam la khyad par mi 'dug snyam ste mu mthud bsdad/ gral mtshes pa tshos ‘‘a tsi drung che'i gnas rim la ma bzhugs par 'dir bzhugs na yag po mi 'dug ’’ces shod kyi 'dug ngas kho tshor ‘‘nga da res zlos gar 'go 'dzin gyi tshab yin tsang 'di gar bsdad na 'grig gi red ’’ces bshad/ don snying de tsho'i byed phyogs gang la bltas kyang shes rig bka' blon thub nyin nas dgos dbang gis ched mngags dma' 'bebs mthong chung byas pa dngos shugs gang nas ra 'phrod kyi 'dug 'on kya nga mi ngan re zung gi phrag dog byed ngan la ma dga' bar las don la gnod skyon 'thus shor btang na mi 'grigs snyam ste zlos gar gyi byed sgo mu mthud lhod med byas/ spyi zla 3tshes 10dgong dro tshogs 'du ba rnams la 'char can zlos gar ltad mo 'khrab ston byas/ tshes 12nyin lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung 〈chos rgyal nor bzang 〉dang / tshes 13nyin 〈gzugs kyi nyi ma 〉'khrab ston byas/ 'khrab ston skabs rlung 'phrin rgyang bsgrags nang lha mo'i nang don ngo sprod byed sgo phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin nas nyin bstud bya dgos byung stabs 'khyags 'khrugs sne 'doms kyi rkyen pas grang ba'i nad gzhi 'phar ldang lci lod kyis mal sar lus shing / bu gso khang gi phyi rgyal em rje mkhas pa bsten mus ltar khong gdan drangs nas brtag dpyad byas te sman khab brgyab ma thag khrag dung ban phyed ka tsam skyug song bar brten 'gan ha cang che ba'i sman khang legs pa zhig la 'phral du 'gro dgos zer don ltar/ zlos gar 'go 'dzin las rogs dang / drung che sogs go bsdur gyis yul gyar shes rig la4khungs la snyan seng dang 'brel lu ri ha na sman khang chen mor bskyod rgyur 'grul 'khor zhig gtong gnang yod pa bshad 'dug 223

kyang / shes rig bka' blon thub nyin nas ‘‘nga tsho'i las khungs kyi 'jib 'khor bsdad med/ bka' shag nas g.yar po zhu dgos ’’brjod don bzhin bka' drung yig tshang la bshad de 'jib 'khor zhig btang 'dug kyang /'khor gla sgor brgya tham pa lam seng sprod dgos brjod pa shes rig las khungs nas sprod dgos lugs bshad 'dug par/ thub nyin nas 'khor gla zlos gar rang khongs nas sprod dgos zhes bshad 'dug zlos gar tshogs par sprod dmigs med la/ phran rang la ni sgor brgya tsam las med gshis ci bya brtol med du gyar skabs stabs legs pa zhig la phran gyi spun mched de snga yul gyar nang srid las khungs kyi drung che gzhon pa byed myong ba'i sgrol ma g.yu sgron a ri nas rda ram sa lar 'byor yod pas/ khong gis shes nas 'khor gla lam seng khong gis sprad 'dug phran rang nad bab lci bas dran pa mi gsal bar lag ngar rtsa chen dang / sna khung brgyud 'gyig gi rgyu thag nang sman chu blug ste ko nem nas 'ba' su na lam chen bar nyal khri'i steng bsnyal nas mis dbor ba dang /de nas 'jib 'khor nang lu ti ha na'i sman khang du skyel bar khyim mtshes dge slong blo don dang / gcung mo sgrol ma g.yu sgron/ nad g.yog tu zlos gar tshems bzo blo bzang bcas nga tsho tshes 15dgong dro'i chu tshod drug par rda ram sa la nas thon te mtshan mo'i chu tshod dang por lu ti ha na sman khang du 'byor 'dug pa dang / dza drag sman bcos pas lam seng brtag dpyad kyis glog dpar dang sman khab brgyab thog chu tshod re'i mtshams brtag dpyad byed mkhan sman pa mi 'dra ba tsho khag re 'byor nas brtag dpyad dang 'brel sman ster ba dang / sman khab brgyab par brten dran pa gsal du phyin/ de'i phyi nyin zhogs pa nyi ma shar tsam la 'bras thug sla po zhig dang / ru kri (bag leb )ja mngar mo bcas ster byung zhing / na zug kyang chung du phyin 'duga'on kyang em rjes bshags bcos ma byas par na tsha drag skyes yong thabs mi 224
