'dug zer yang / bshags bcos bya rgyu mo brtag ma bab rkyen byed 'dod med pas gang drag snyam pa byung / nyal khri stong pa med stabs brtag dpyad khang pa nas nyin gsum pa'i nyin slob grwa chen mo'i bod rigs slob phrug ngo shes pa zhig gis kho rang gi nyal khang du bsdad na legs lugs zer ba ltar phyin nas bsdad/nyin bzhi pa'i snga dro rda ram sa la nas dge slong blo don dang / gcung po rgyal chos/ gcung mo sgrol g.yu bcas phran la lta bar slebs nas sman khang nas rtsad gcod skabs ma rnyed par brten sman khang bkag sdom byed khul khang pa so so'i nang sgo srung par kha rtsod rgyag bzhin par nang du 'dzul nas bltas kyang btsal rnyed ma thub stabs 'chi 'das zin pa min nam bsam pa'i blo g.yeng ngang sman khang khor yug tu phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed mi tshang mar dri rtsad byed bzhin skabs bod rigs slob grwa ba gcig thug pa des khong tsho slob grwa chen mor 'khrid slebs byung / khong tshos nga rang nyal khri'i steng kha 'don dpe cha bltas nas btsog phur bsdad pa mthong bas/ kho tsho ha cang dga' spro'i ngang dpral ba gtugs pa dang / dga' 'dzum ngang ‘‘stabs yag ’’zer zhing / da gin sman khang nang kha rtsod byas tshul sogs bzhad gad di ri ba byung / khong tshos bza' bcas dgos mkho gang mang 'khyer 'dug sman khang nas bshags bcos ma byas par 'grig gi ma red/ bdun phrag gcig gnyis nang tshun nyal khri stong pa thon rgyur de 'phral bshags bcos bya rgyu yin zer lugs bshad par khong tshos kyang bshags bcos byas pa yag gi red zer zhing / lhag par sgrol ma g.yu sgron nas ‘‘jo lags bshags bcos gnang ba rang dga' gi red/ sman yon sogs ji tsam thob kyang nga rang gis phul chog thugs g.yengs ma dgos ’’zhes bshad byung bar spun mched kyi brtse ba kha zhe med pa de la dga' spro chen po byung /nye sngon 'khor gla sgor brgyad brgya dang / da lan yang khong tsho'i 'khor gla de bzhin gnas yod pa/ da dung sman yon sogs gtong phod la ha las byung /225

de nas khong tshor slob grwa chen mo'i za khang nas nyin dgung zhal lag nyos 'bul gyis blo bde'i ngang phyir log byas/ bdun gcig song mtshams nyal khri ga dus thon min dri rtsad bgyis par da dung bdun phrag gnyis tsam thon pa mi 'dug zer bas/ ‘‘byas na snga 'phros rda ram sa lar log chog pa zhig dang / nyal khri thon mtshams tar gtong gnang yod pa de 'phral bcar chog pa ’’zhes bshad de rda ram sa lar phyir log byas/ rda ram sa la ko nem du 'byor skabs zlos gar 'go 'dzin las rogs dang / drung che/ las bya/ dge slob/ las byed dang bcas tshang mas dga' spro'i rnam pas 'tshams 'dri sne len gang gzab byas byung zhing / 'go 'dzin las rogs phur bu tshe ring nas ‘‘snga 'phros gzim shag tu lhod bzhugs kyis sman bcos dang 'brel sku ngal gso rgyu gal che ba dang / yig tshang nang gi las don che khag dgongs skor zhus chog pa las de min 'thus shor med pa zhus 'thus thugs g.yeng mdzad ma dgos ’’zhes zer ba ltar rang shag tu ngal sos te sman bcos kyi rgyun mthud/ de sngon spyi lo 1973lo ldi lir sdod skabs nad gzhi 'phar ldang skabs phyi rgyal sman pa mkhas pa bsten te brtag dpyad byas par ‘‘khyed kyi na tsha 'di bshags bcos ma byas na zla ba drug lhag tsam las 'tsho sdod mi thub ’’lugs bshad par brten bod kyi em rje bla sman ye shes don ldan la gnas lugs bshad de ‘‘bshags bcos bya rgyu mo brtag nas ma phebs pa ma zad/ nga rang yang bshags bcos byed 'dod mi 'dug pas khyed kyi bshags bcos ma dgos par sman bcos gnang dgos ’mizhes zhus par/ khong gis brtag dpyad nan tan bgyis te nyin re sman thun gsum re chag med btang thog ‘‘zas spyod 'di dang 'di zhes 'dzems bya byas na lo gsum ring mi 'chi ba'i 'gan len nga rang gis byas chog ’’gsungs pa ltar khong gis bshad pa dang len byas pas na tsha seng drag ma byung yang 'di lo (1979)lo drug tsam gyi ring nad bab sdug tu ma phyin pa red/ 'on kyang khong 226

gis gsung na dus gtan du dro bcos dang / zas spyod 'dzems bya lhod med/sman dus thog so sor chad med gtong dgos bcas gsungs yod kyang bar lam nad gzhi cung drag tu song stabs lhod g.yeng du song rkyen nye sngon nad bab lci lod du gyur pa de ltar lags/ der brten bla sman ye shes don ldan slar yang bsten te sman khab brgyab pa dang / nyin re sman thengs gsum re chag med btang / spyod lam gang gzab ngang zlos gar gyi las don la sems 'khur sngar bzhin che bskyed byas/ zlos gar 'go byed dang / dge slob las byed tshang ma bar skabs dang mi 'dra ba'i mthun sgril dang / slob sbyong / las rtsol gang sar sgrig khrims brtsi bkur dang / spyod bzang gi rnam pa'i 'gyur ldog 'gro bzhin pa der ngos rang yang blo bag phebs cing dka' ngal 'dzems med bya rgyu'i sems shugs che ru song ste ‘‘khyi mthong ri 'khur ’’gyis sngar bzhin 'bad brtson yod rgu rtsal sprugs byas/ zlos gar tshogs pa (1959)lor btsugs pa nas bzung tā la'i sku sger gzim chung ’’zhes pa nas gser zangs dang / li ma'i sku brnyan/ zhal thang / dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dang / chu ting /mchod kong / dar gos kyi gyon chas/ gser gyi mu tig sog byil/ g.yu byur spa phrug sbub rol/ dung rgya/ gzhan yang bsngo rten gyi gyon chas dang dngos rigs sogs snga rjes su sprad byung ba rnams de sngon rten deb dngos tho'i deb gzhi kha gsal bkod yod pa rtsad gcod skabs zlos gar 'go 'dzin ldum khang phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi dus skabs su yig cha mang po bor brlag song ba dang /yig cha 'ga' zhig dgos pa med lugs kyis mer bsregs btang lugs bcas gang ltar zlos gar tshogs pa'i yig cha rtsa 'thor gyur te mdor na deng sang 'khrab ston gyi 'khrab gzhung re zung yod pa de tsho'ang zlos gar ba sger gyi donaganyer nyar tshags byas pa khag khu rub nas byung ba yin lugs bcas rtsa 'dzin yig cha dang 'dzin dngos/ 'khrab chas sogs zhib bsher bya yul med 227

pa hang sangs dgos pa'i gnas tshul thos dus yul gyar shes rig las khungs zhes pa dang zlos gar 'go 'dzin gong rim re zung nas spyi don la 'khur sems bor ba'i tshul min gyi bya spyod bgyis pa dngos ra 'phrod kyi 'dug gzhan yang nga rang gi shes gsal la de snga spyi lo 1961lo ku lu khul nas bal nyo bar mi 'gro ched btang gis bal ma bud med bzhi nyar te gdan rgyu spun dog 'khal ba dang / rum 'thag dge rgan bud med gcig dang / bu mo gnyis gtan 'jags nyar te gla phogs gtan 'khel dang bcas 'thag khri che chung kha shas gsar bzos kyis rim bzhin rgya bskyed btang ste 'phral phugs sman pa'i rum 'thag bzo grwa zhig 'go 'dzugs byas/ thog mar zlos gar tshogs chen la dgos mkho grum ze'i kha gdan sngo dmar sho bsgrigs dang / rkyong ring bcas lo gsar sogs dus chen khag la 'ding byed tshogs pa yongs rdzogs la ldeng nges btags yod pa de tsho'i khongs nas kyang kha shas las bsdad mi 'dug de dang 'dra ba'i rten mchod chas sogs ji snyed cig bor brlag gyur yod tshod 'dug cing / lag bsdad rnams gzhi nas tho 'god bya gal yid la brnags kyang /phral sel las don mang khar/ lhag par zlos gar tshogs pa btsugs nas lo ngo nyi shu 'khor ba'i dran gso'i byed sgo gra sgrig bya rgyu'i brel zing gis rkyen pas tho 'god bya rgyu'i thad gnas skabs ngang 'then mi bya mthu med dang / zlos gar tshogs pa btsugs nas lo ngo nyi shu 'khor ba'i dran gso'i tshogs 'du cung rgyas tsam zhig ring min 'tshog ran dus gtugs la brten lo nyi shu'i ring gi byed sgo khag dang / grub 'bras sogs las bsdoms bzo rgyu'i thad yig cha med pas lo rgyus cha tshang ba dran gso dka' yang snying don gal che'i rigs gus nas bsam zhibablo ngor nges pa gang dran 'god bris byas/ dran gso'i tshogs 'du'i gra sgrig tshogs chung zur du bsko gzhag byas pa ltar tshogs chung des mdzad rim 'char gzhi bkod 'bul byung bar snon 'khri byed 'os bgyis te gtan 'khel 228

byas/ 'char gzhi'i khongs tshogs 'du'i skabs 'khrab ston ltad mo bstan rgyu'i skor dge slob dang bcas tshogs 'du 'tshogs te zlos gar spyi gzhung gi ltad mo smos med thog tshogs chung khag bgos kyis tshogs chung so sos 'khrab tshan bzhi re gsar rtsom bya rgyu dang / de'i khongs nas 'khrab tshan re bzhad gad dgod bro'i 'khrab ston bya rgyu bcas khungs so sos sbyang brtson bya rgyur gros 'chams kyis thag bcad/ gzhan yang / rkang rtsed spo lo dang / lag sor spo lo/ bang rtsal/ mi rgyug mchong rgyag sogs lus rtsal dang / rtsed sna 'dra min sna tshogs kyi 'gran bsdur ltad mo gra sgrig dgos pa'i bkod khyab byas shing /khungs so sos brtsams sbyang gi 'go tshugs te tsho khag phan tshun mthong res med par lkog tu sbyang skad 'dug dran gso'i tshogs 'dur sngar gyi zlos gar 'go 'dzin rnying pa khag dang / slob grwa khag gi zlos gar dge rgan khag de min zlos gar nas dgongs pa zhus zin pa khag sogs tshang mar tshogs 'dur phebs gnang yod pa zhes gdan zhu'i mgron shog zla gcig sngon tshud nas 'grems gtong byas/ sku mgron phyogs mtha' nas yong mkhan khag gi sdod yul dang sne len sogs gra sgrig ang bsar byas/spyi lo 1979lo'i zla 8tshes 15nyin/ ring min 'tshog rgyu'i shes rig zlos gar tshogs pa btsugs nas lo nyi shu 'khor ba'i dran gso'i byed sgo'i tshogs 'du'i mgron shog btang gras su rta sar yul gyar bka' shag gi bka' blon rnam pa dang / bka' blon las rogs/ sku sger drung che/ spyi 'thus/ drung che khag dang / drung che las rogs/ drung che gzhon pa/ rgan drung dang gzhon drung sogs dang / rgan yol khag sku sner yig tshang gi las bya dang / sku srung 'go dmag gnas chung dang dga' gdong sku rten gnyis/ ldi li don gcod pa/ ldi li bod khang / gangs can skyid gshong dpe mdzod khang / wa ra na si bod kyi mtho rim slob grwa chen mo/ rda ram sa la bu khyim khang / ma su ri bu khyim 229

khang sogs kyi 'go khrid khag dang / a ri dang / su'e tser/ kha na ta/'jar pan/ ing lan/ ne pa la/ 'brug yul/ 'bras ljongs sogs la yod pa'i yul gyar don gcod sku tshab khag chos lugs khag gi 'go khrid/slob grwa khag gi 'go 'dzin/ sman rtsis khang gi 'go 'dzin/ ḍas ra ḍon drag slob 'go 'dzin khag ka li ka ta yid rton dngul khang gi 'go 'dzin/ dge sde lcags mdong bzo grwa'i 'go 'dzin/ gzhis chags khag gi 'go 'dzin/bzo grwa khag gi 'go 'dzin/ mdo smad tshogs pa dang / mdo stod tshogs pa/dbus gtsang tshogs pa/ gzhon nu'i tshogs pa/ bud med tshogs pa/ chu sgang tshogs pa/ chig bsgril tshogs pa/ a mdo zlos gar tshogs pa sogs tshogs pa khag gi dbu khrid/ gsar 'gyur 'god po ‘‘ldi li tri sbe tri ri sbi'u ’’dang / ‘‘ma 'khyog drang thig ’rirda ram sa la'i shes bya/ rdo rje gling ‘‘rang dbang gsar shog ri sogs gsar shog khag gi 'go 'dzin/ rda ram pa shes rig dpar khang dang / mnyam las khag gi 'go 'dzin/ rgya gar gzhung gi ched 'dzugs sku srung gtan sdod srung dmag gi 'go khrid/ gsang ba'i su li si'i 'go khrid/skyob gso phogs khang gi 'go 'dzin sogs sku mgron rnams yod pa red/mgron shog btang ba'i brjod don du ‘‘spyi lo 1979lo'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer gsum nyin/ bzhugs sgar shes rig zlos gar tshogs pa dbu brnyes nas lo nyi shu 'khor ba'i dran gso'i tshogs 'du dang sbrags gzigs mo gsol ston 'bul lam zhu rgyu lags na/ gong tshes nyer gsum nyin gyi snga dro'i chu tshod dgu par zlos gar tshogs pa'i bsti gnas rda steng ko nem du nges phebs yod pa ’’zhes 'khod pa 'grems gtong byas thog gang ci'i gra sgrig la zhib bsher 'thus tshang yong ba byas/ dngos gzhi spyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer gsum nam langs snga char rnam rgyal grwa tshang sku zhabs gnyis nas lha bsang 〈dgra lha dpang bstod 〉sogs rten gsol dang / zlos gar 'go byings las byed dang bcas 230

pa tshang ma gyon gos gzab mchor spras shing / gro so phye mar dang bcas bsangs gsol dar 'dzugs byas/ de nas sku mgron rim phebs la'ang gro so phye mar dang / chang phud/ gsol ja/ 'bras bsil/ tshogs 'du'i mdzad rim dang / gzigs mo'i le'u sogs kyi shog lho bcas sku mgron re re bzhin la sprad/ chu tshod bcu par mgron 'bod rnams tshogs khang nang rkub stegs thog gral la 'khod bstun/ zlos gar 'go 'dzin las rogs phur bu tshe ring dang / zlos gar tshogs pa'i drung che thub bstan bsam grub gnyis kyis tshogs 'du gtso skyong byas/ gus pa blo bstan nas gtam bshad stegs sgrom thog bskyod de tshang mar gus 'dud zhus rjes gtam bshad byas shing / (nang don rags rim gsham gsal )'dir phebs dbu khrid rnam pa dang / rgya gar gzhung gi zhi drag dbu khrid/ las rigs khag gi dbu khrid/ gzhan yang mched grogs rnam pa bcas la dga' gus kyi ngang nas bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu/de ring shes rig zlos gar tshogs pa dbu brnyes nas lo nyi shu 'khor ba'i dran gso'i tshogs 'dur phebs pa'i sku mgron lhan rgyas la dga' spro chen pos thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin zhes sogs dang / sbyi lo 1959lo'i zla bdun pa'i nang ma su ri yul gyar bka' shag nas de snga'i shod drung nor nang ngag dbang nor bus gtsos gus tsho de snga'i gzhung zhabs rnying pa mi drug 'gugs 'bod kyis khyod tshos zlos gar zhig 'dzugs thabs byed phyir ka sbug tu 'phral thon gyis gsang ba gang che'i sgo nas 'bad 'thab bya dkos lugs kyi bkod mngags dang len gyis ka sbug tu bskyod de 'bad brtson byas lugs sogs mdor na zlos gar tshogs pa btsugs pa nas bzung lo nyi shu'i ring gi brgyud rim byed sgo rnams rags rim gtam bshad dang 'brel zlos gar ba tshor tshe mjug tu bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba mi smon rang skyid zer ba zhig gnang 'os che yang / de ltar ma byung rung khong tsho'i 'tsho ba'i mdun lam thad blo pham pa dang mtshan shas mi 231

'byung ba zhig dgongs bzhes dgos skor nan tan gyis bshad pa yin/ de nas zlos gar mang tshogs kyi ngo tshab bkra shis don grub dang / yul gyar nang srid bka' blon dbang rdor/ zlos gar 'go 'dzin las rogs phur bu tshe ring bcas so so nas kyang gtam bshad byas/ de nas gung zas grub rjes rtsed thang du rig rtsal 'gran bsdur gyi ltad mo dang / de rjes slar yang tshogs khang chen mor zlos gar khag la ang rim gyi bya dga' sprad pa bcas so/de ltar byed sgo gra sgrig gang legs kyis blo bde bag phebs byung yang /phran rang rgyun gcong khar byed sgo spel ring las don mang por mgo 'khor dro bcos sogs lhod g.yeng song ba'i rkyen gyis nyin re bzhin nad gzhi je zhan je sdug tu gyur te mal sar lus/ zas ma 'ju ba'i thog khrag yang skyugs par em rjes bshags bcos 'phral mar ma byas na nyen kha che lugs brjod stabs/shes rig bka' blon thub nyin la zlos gar gyi las don bya rgyu dgongs pa rtsa 'khrol yong ba bshad de/ spyi lo 1979lo'i zla dgu pa'i tshes gnyis nyin rda ram sa la nas ne+e'u ldi lir thon/ ldi lir rlung 'phrin las byed gong dkar rgya mtsho'i las shag tu bsdad/ sngar gyi las rogs tshang mas sems 'khur rogs ram gnang byung ba dang / lhag par du 'phreng ring lcam chung tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms lags nas 'khur 'gan rkang len gyis ho le phan ma le zhes pa'i phyi rgyal gyi sman khang skad grags che shos der nyal khang ang dang po khe gtsang zhig thob ste brtag dpyad kyi glog dpar dang / sman khab brgyab/ nyin gsum song mtshams bshags bcos bya rgyu yin lugs bshad stabs nyin de gar rda ram sa lar ‘‘sku sger yig tshang ’ gi drung che gzhon pa bshad zur dge dar la glog tar btang ste/ ‘‘gus rang bshags bcos byed gtan 'khel song bas skyabs zhu dang / rnam rgyal grwa tshang nas sman bla'i cho ga dang / sgrol chog bcas sang nyin rang gnang skyong yod pa ’ zhes bshad/ de 'brel rdo rje gdan du yongs 'dzin 232

dga' khri gling tshang sprul sku dang / wa ra na sir khri byang rin po che rnam gnyis so sor ‘‘thugs smon skyabs 'jug yong ba mimizhes pa'i tar 'phrin phul/ de bzhin shes rig zlos gar tshogs par yang yi ge btang / de nas sman khang gi bshags bcos khang par 'khor lo can gyi nyal khri'i nang bskyal te dpung pa g.yas g.yon la sman khab re brgyab 'phral gnyid la song 'dug snga dro'i chu tshod dgu par bshags bcos byas te nyin dgung chu tshod gsum par gnyid sad dus dran pa gsal po rang med pa dang / kha dang lce skam nas skad cha ldab ldib las mi thon zhing / nad g.yog nas chu skol grang thur ma do tsam ster rjes sngar rgyun ltar dran gsos/ lhag par sman pa lag rtsal mkhasapa dang yo byad cha rkyen legs pa bcas kyis bshags bcos byas par tsha zugs sogs dka' ngal gtan nas ma byung / nyin bcu bzhi song mtshams rma kha btsems pa'i skud pa bcad 'then byas song / de nas nyin ltar khang pa'i nang cham cham yang yang byed du bcug bdun phrag gsum par rang gi khyim du log chog pa dang /snga 'khros skas babs 'dzegs dang / dngos po ljid can 'degs pa sogs byed rgyu med lugs dang / da dung zla ba gcig tsam ring ngal gso rgyag dgos sogs em rjes bshad pa bzhin yid 'jags byas/ sman khang nang khyon nyin nyer gcig bsdad par nyin re khang gla sgor brgya re dang / de min sman bcos gla yon sman rin lho dod sogs khyon bsdoms hin sgor sum stong drug brgya tham pa thob shog sprad byung zhing / 'phreng ring lcam chung gis sman pa chen mo'i sar phebs te dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin la rgya gar gzhung sogs nas rgan phogs med nges drang bden gsal bshad gnang 'dug par bsam gzhigs byas te khang gla sman yon bsdoms nyin sgor chig stong sum brgya tham pa sprad nas 'thus pa byung zhing / dngul 'bab de yang 'phreng ring lcam chung kho rang nas gnang ste skyin tshab mi dgos gsungs/ bdun phrag gsum song ba'i dgong 233

dror sman khang nas phyir log gis zla ba gcig tsam ngal gso byas/ spyi lo 1979lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes shar la rda ram sa lar log nas khri byang rin po che'i mjal khar phyin te nye sngon bshags bcos byas pa gegs med lam lhongs phan 'bras bzang po byung zhing / da ni zlos gar gyi las ka'ang rtsa dgongs zhus zin pas kha 'don dge sbyor la gzhol rgyu lags na rda ram sa la dang / ku lu gal/ bal yul bcas gang la bsdad legs bka' slob yod pa zhus par lam seng mo brtag gis ‘‘gsum car bzang po 'dug de'i nang nas kyang bal yul bzang ba shar ’’zhes phebs pa ltar bal yul du 'gro rgyur blo thag bcad de shag mtshes dge slong blo don la nang don bshad pas/ khong gis nga yang bal yul gnas skor la 'gro 'dod yod/ da res lhan du byung na yag po yong lugs brjod byung bas ‘‘de don gang legs yong rgyur phebs shigakhyed la rgan phogs phyed ka las med pas 'gro gron nga rang gis btang chog ’’ces bshad de ngos gnyis mnyam du 'gro rgyu byas/15 bal yul du gnas mjal bsnyen sgrub bskyod pa/spyi lo 1979lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nang shag mtshes dge slong blo don nged gnyis bal yul du bskyod phyir rda ram sa la nas ldi li bar rlangs 'khor nang bskyod/ ldi li nas/ spa tra na bar me 'khor nang dang / pa tra na nas mkha' lam gnam gru'i thog bal yul gnam gru bab thang du 'byor/ de nas rlangs 'khor nang ka ṭa man tur cha dar pa tri zhes par gcung mo skal chos kyi sar phyin pa yin/ khong gi bza' zla bu tshe phun bsdad 'dug cing / gcung mo skal chos nyid nye char lha sa nas bal yul du phyir log skabs de snga'i tshong rtsa lhag bsdad gla rtsi phran bu yod pa rnams 'khyer yong pa de dag 'gag sgo nas gzhung bzhes btang ba dang mnyam du 'khyer ba'i dngos po gang yod dang 234

bcas/ gcung mo yang re zhig bkag nyar byas pa'i gnas tshul thabs sdug byung ste tshe phun dang / bu phrug rnams yid skyo'i ngang gnas 'dug pa nga rang yang blo pham dang / sems ma skyid pa byung rung tshe phun la ‘‘da res kyi byus nyes des gegs bar bzlog nas tshe srog la nyes skyon yong gi ma red ’’ces sems gso yang btang / de nas phran dang / dge slong blo don bal yul mchod rten rnam gsum gyis gtsos gnas mchog khag la mjal mchod du phyin/ gnas skor nas 'khor rjes ka ṭa man tu'i lho smad phyogs pham thing ri khrod du gnas g.yar gyis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i las bsnyen bzhi 'bum gtong rgyu'i bsnyen mtshams su bsdad par gang ci'i nyer mkho bu tshe phun nas gzab rgyas gnang byung ba ma zad/ nyin lnga drug re'i mtshams sha mar tshal sogs skyel mi btang bar brten 'tsho ba 'bel lhug yod pas sems khral ma dgos pa byung /skabs der bod du krung dbyang nas srid jus lhug gtong gis phan tshun gnyen 'phrad 'gro 'ongs byed 'dug stabs lha sar yod pa'i phran gyi bu mo 'bring ba dang / bu 'bring gzhon gnyis so sor ‘‘pha rgan bal yul du 'byor yod cing /deng sang srid jus lhug gtong gis lha sa nas 'di phyogs gnyen 'phrad du 'byor mi byung song bas khyed tsho pha rgan thug 'phrad ched bal yul du yong thub na dga' po zhe drag yong nges ’’zhes pa'i yi ge re btang bar bu mo'i yig lan du ‘‘deng sang nad mnar la brten da lam gcung po gnyis mnyam du yong thub min yang / nad gzhi drag skyes byung mtshams dgongs zhus kyis nges bcar zhu rgyu mimizhes dang / bu gnyis kyi yig lan la ‘‘ngos gnyis slob grwa so so nas dgongs pa zhus khrol byung zhing / gong rim la snyan seng zhus yod pas gang mgyogs yong gi yin ’’lugs 'khod 'byor ltar gzungs sngags om gsum 'bum gcig long mtshams phran rang ka ṭa man tur phyir log gis bu gnyis bsu sgug 'on seng du bsdad kyang bu gnyis yong mkhan med mur/ chos grogs 235

blo don gzungs sngags 'bum bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa bsags thub nas ngos gnyis mnyam du kha skong sbyin bsregs gzab rgyas gnad smin phul te ka ṭa man tur phyir log cing / phran rang bal yul du kha 'don dge sbyor byas nas sdod rtsis kyis 'phags pa shing kun gyi sku rgyab ri ldebs spre'us khengs pa'i nags tshal gseb kyi dkyil du ri khrod shin tu dben pa zhig g.yar yod pa der dge slong blo don yang phar tsam mnyam du bzhugs pa legs zhus kyang khong nyin ma bdun tsam las ma bzhugs par rgya gar du phyir log song / phran ni bu gnyis re sgug gis zla shas song yang khong gnyis yong mkhan med stabs rgya gar du log rgyu'i 'dun pa zhig shar te 'gro rtsis skabs/ rgya gar nas sprad pa'i 'gro 'ongs lag 'khyer gyi dus tshod rdzogs 'dug pa bal yul du yod pa'i yul gyar don gcod khang du phyin te ‘‘rgya gar gzhung nas lag 'khyer dus tshod bskyar zhu gnang rogs ’’zhes bshad par de don yi ge phul chog 'on kyang nyin bzhi bcu zhe lnga tsam 'gor lugs zer bas ‘‘gang mgyogs yong thabs gnang rogs ’’zhes bshad/ de skabs 'phags pa shing kun mchod rten chen mo'i nub byang ngos kyi ri khrod du bsdad de dge sbyor 'phel ba zhig byung ba bcas so/236

bcu/ b.layul nas bod du bskyod 'byor skor/1 lam bar dang bod 'byor gnas tshul/nyin gcig lha sde khul nas yong ba'i 'grul pa khag gcig 'byor song zer ba thos te ka ṭa man tur bskyod par lha sa shag lho'i bu bkra shis nor bu dang / bu gzhon pa thub bstan gnyis bal yul du 'byor te phran thug par phebs byung bas khong gnyis nas phran gyi bu bstan 'dzin phun tshogs dang /skal bzang rdo rje gnyis ring min 'byor rgyu yi na lugs gsungs don ltar de nas nyin bcu tsam song mtshams bu gnyis kyis btang ba'i yi ge zhig 'byor gsal/ spyi zla 5tshes 3nyin bal bod sa mtshams 'gram du 'byor pa yong rgyu zhes 'khod 'dug pa bzhin spyi lo 1980lo'i zla 5tshes 3nyin shag lho'i bu bkra shis nor bu nged gnyis bu gnyis bsu bar bskyod cing / mdza' grogs zam pa'i nub phyogs bal khongs tā cha pā ni zhes pa'i grong tsho chung ngu zhig tu zhag sdodakhyas/ de khul 'dri rtsad byas par gnangs nyin bod nas 'grul pa khag gcig 'byor rgyu yin lugs zer zhing tshes 5nyin gyi snga dro mdza' grogs zam sner bskyod par nyin dgung tsam la zam pa'i shar phyogs bod sar rlangs 'khor gcig 'byor song ba de'i nang bu 'bring ba bstan 'dzin phun tshogs dang / bu gzhon pa skal bzang rdo rje gnyis 'dug pa mi lo nyer gnyis ring thug 'phrad ma byung ba'i pha bu ngo 'dzoms byung bar ha cang gi dga' spro chen po byung / zam sne'i bal po'i 'gag sgo nas zhib bsher byed par chu tshod bzhi 237

tsam 'gor song bas nga tshos nyin dgung kha lag de gar zas/ de nas bal po'i spyi spyod rlangs 'khor sba se'i nang ka ṭa man tur bskyod/ gnas tshang tshe phun lags nas bza' btung sne len gzab rgyas gra sgrig byas 'dug dgong dro'i kha lag zas rjes bu bstan 'dzin phun tshogs shag lho'i pā bkras nor lags dang lhan du gcen mo rdo rje lags kyi nang du bsdad pa dang / nyin mo phran gyi sar yong / bu gnyis nas bod kyi snga phyi'i 'pho 'gyur lo rgyus zhib tu brjod byung / phran gyis kyang spyi lo 1959lo nas bzung rgya gar du sdod ring gi lo rgyus zhib par bshad pa sogs bag phebs kyi gleng mol byas/ bu gnyis kyis brjod gsal/ deng sang bar skabs dang mi 'dra ba'i bod la krung dbyang gis srid jus lhug gtong gnang stabs nyo tshong stabs bde'i 'tsho ba yar rgyas 'gro dang 'gro bzhin gyi gnas babs gang legs su yod pa dang / spun mched gcen gcung tshang ma'i re 'dun la pā lags bod la phebs thub pa'i dgongs bzhes yod pa zhes dang / lhag par bu phrug chung shos bu mo mtshe ma gsum nas nan tan gyis mngags don ‘‘sku mkhyen/ sku mkhyen/ da res gcen po gnyis kyis pā lags bod la gdan 'dren zhu thub pa'i 'bad brtson shugs bskyed byed rogs ri’zhes smre ngag 'don bzhin du bshad byung bas ‘‘da res pā lags khyed rang ngos gnyis dang mnyam du bod la nges phebs gnang rogs ’’zhes nan gyis brjod byung / ngos rang thog ma'i char bod du 'gro rgyu'i bsam pa med kyang / nye char gtam bzang go thos su rgya bod zhi mthun bka' mol byung ste rgya gar nas bod rigs dbyin ji'i skad yig legs shes mi grangs nyis stong tham pa bod du gtong rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang lugs thos pa dang / bu gnyis nas kyang khungs dag yin min ma shes lha sar yang de lta'i sbir grags byas lugs dang / bod du 'gyur ldog byung tshul/ phru gu tshang ma'i re 'bod nan che bcas la brten bod du gnyen 'phrad la 'gro rgyu'i 'dun pa 'char zhing / 'on 238

kyang bod du 'gro bar lag dngul dang / bu phrug rnams la brngan pa/ spun mched dga' nyer lag rtags sprod byed sogs dgos gal la brten rgya gar du bskyod de ldi li rlung 'phrin las khungs nas phran gyi phogs 'phar gsog dngul len rgyu bsdad pa rnams len par 'gro rtsis kyis bal yul du yod pa'i yul gyar gzhung gi ngo tshab don gcod khang du phyin te ‘‘kha sngon skyabs zhus phran rgya gar du bskyod rgyu'i spa se lag 'khyer la dus tshod bskyar zhungabyas pa de dag gnang rogs ’’zhes bshad par/ ngo tshab don gcod ngo mas las bya skal bzang zer bar ‘‘kha sngon bka' mngags gnang ba'i phyag 'khyer 'bul dgos ’’zhes bshad song bas/ kho pas las khang du bskyod de gang 'tsham zhig nas tshur yong ste/ ‘‘da lta rgya gar gzhung la 'bul rgyu byung mi 'dug de ring rang phul chog pa dgongs 'gal med pa ’’zhes zer bar/ don gcod ngo mas kho par gshe gshe mang po btang song ba las gzhan gyi bya thabs zad/ ngos rang yang kho tsho'i las ka'i byed stangs der hang sangs byung / des na lag 'khyer med kyang —nyin bal sa mtshams 'gag sgo phan tshun la brngan pa dngul mang tsam sprad nas 'gro rgyu las ma 'das shing / bu gnyis kyang da lam rgya gar gnas mjal sogs la mnyam du bskyod gal che lugs bshad par/ bu gnyis nas ‘‘ngos gnyis rgya gar du 'gro bar dgongs zhag dus tshod mang po med pa dang / pā lags kyang rgya gar du ma phebs par da res ngos gnyis dang mnyam du bod la phebs na legs pa ma zad/ phru gu'i nang nas bu mo bkra bzang ma gtogs gzhan tshang mar las phogs yod gshis rngan pa gang yang bsnam mi dgos/ pā lags phebs thub pa de rang rngan pa bzang shos yin la/ ngos gnyis 'phrad nas rgya gar du phebs na krung go'i phyogs nas kyang dogs 'char yong rgyu ’’zhes zer zhing / phran nas/ slokhyod gnyis nas krung go'i srid jus legs lugs mang po zhig bshad byung ba de 'drar dogs 'char ga la 'ong / 'on kyang bal 239

yul du yod pa'i krung go'i gzhung tshab khang la khyod gnyis bskyod de ji legs bka' slob zhu dgos ririzhes bshad don ltar phyin song bas rang rgyal gyi gzhung tshab pas/ krung dbyang gi srid jus la 'gro 'ong rang mos yin pas gang byas kyang 'thus rung / nga rang sger gyi bsam 'char byas na rgya gar la ma phebs na legs lugs gsungs 'dug pa de ltar brjod babs dang / rgya gar du 'gro ba'i lag 'khyer med pa'i dka' ngal la bsams bu gnyis dang mnyam du bod la 'gro rgyur thag bcad de shag lho'i bu bkra shis nor bu lags dang / ngos pha bu gsum bcas bal bzhugs rang rgyal gyi gzhung tshab khang la bskyod de phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin bod du gnyen 'phrad du bskyod rgyur dus tshod zla ba drug bsdad chog pa'i lag 'khyer zhig gnang skyong yod pa zhes zhus par/gzhung tshab pas ‘‘khyed rang gi bu phrug tshang ma bod la yod tsang bod du gtan bzhugs gzhis chags gnang rgyu byas na 'di ga gzhung tshab khang nas lag 'khyer lam seng phul chog de min lha sar dgongs skor zhu dgos pas khyed rang gi lo rgyus shig dgos lugs ’’zhes dri ba byas te tho bkod nas bdun phrag kha shas 'gor rgyu zer zhing / phran gyis ‘‘snga 'phros bod du gnyen 'phrad bskyod rjes rgya gar du thengs gcig phyir log mi byed mthu med yin gshis/ des na dgongs skor snyan seng dang 'brel lag 'khyer thad bu gnyis dang mnyam bskyod thub thabs gnang rogs ’’zhes zhus/ bu gnyis la lag sne'i dmigs sgo bod kyi bal 'thag kha gdan khred shol rnying pa ya re 'khyer 'dug pa gcig la bal sgor lnga stong dang / gcig la bal sgor sum stong byas te btsongs/bod la 'khyer rgyu'i mkho byed nyos/ phran blo bstan gyi dga' nye ka sbug gzhis rtse tshogs khang pa'i jo lags pa sangs lags bal yul du phebs 'dug pa khong gi sar phyin te/ ‘‘da res ngos la lag sne dgos gal che bas sngon du bskyed 'khrir bcol zhus hin sgor drug stong tham pa de dag phyag thon e yod/ thon 240

na da res phan thogs chen po yong nges ’’zhus par lam seng grangs tshang gnang byung ba dang / yang rgya gar ne'u ldi lir bzhugs pa'i gong dkar rgya mtsho nas hin sgor drug stong tham pa len rgyu yod pa de dag gatshe phun lags nas snga 'don gnang rogs zhus nas gong rgya'i 'dzin ngo phul te phru gu dgu la rngan pa sprod byed chu tshod wa si trin dgu dang / ngos rang la wa si trin gcig dang /kri'i r+pā kri mtha' gser can spus legs gcig bcas nyos/ gzhan yang lag rtags sprod byed ther ma gyon ldeng bcu phrag dang / kre ra lan tshos tshogs yug kha shas/ ri pin gru rtsi sna tshogs tha na/ 'ba' ci/ rgya gar a sam nas thon pa'i 'bu ras dang / 'brug yul nas thon pa'i smyug slom tshon khra/ rgya gar las thon kha btags a she dang / zub phyi/ bud med kyi rna rgyan khra sna tshogs/spos dkar lag gdub sogs nyos te bod du 'gro chas bsgrigs/ gnas tshang gcung mo skal chos khyim tshang gi khang pa rgyag rgyu'i sa cha nye sngon tshe phun lags nas nyos zin pa ltar khang pa'i sa bkra phran blo bstan gyis bkod bris byas/rtsig rmang 'dru bar tshe phun lags kyi bu rgan pa tshul khrims zla ba dang / phran gyi bu bstan 'dzin phun tshogs dang skal bzang rdo rje bcas la 'jor sbyag bskur te rtsig rmang brko 'dru byed par btang / de nas nyin gcig rang rgyal gyi gzhung tshab khang nas lag 'khyer thon zhing / bal po'i phyi 'brel las khungs su chog mchan zhu bar btang bar/ phyi las nas ‘‘lag 'khyer 'di gar zhogs/nyin shas mtshams yong dgos ’’zhes bshad/ nyin gsum 'gro nyin len du btang bas bu gnyis kyi lag 'khyer sprad nas/ ‘‘phran blo bstan gyi lag 'khyer sang gnangs thon rgyur 'on seng byed dgos mimizhes brjod 'dug de nas 1980lo'i zla 6tshes 17nyin bod phyogs su 'gro mkhan tsho khag gcig dang mnyam du thon rgyu'i spyi spyod rlangs 'khor sba se'i kri ka tri lag 'khyer nga tsho gsum car mnyam du nyos zin kyang / bal po'i phyi las nas phran blo bstan gyi 241

lag 'khyer thon med pas bu gnyis tshes 17nyin bod phyogs su bskyod pa dang /phran rang ma bsdad thabs med byung / tshes 18nyin snga dro bal po'i phyi 'brel las khungs su skad sgyur bu tshul khrims zla ba 'khrid de phyin/ gtso bo'i 'go khrid der ‘‘nga'i rogs pa kha sa thon tshar song bas lag 'khyer da lta gnang rogs ’’zhes bshad par ‘‘de ring ri 'dzeg tu 'gro mkhan phyi rgyal ba mang bas sang nyin yong dgos ’’zer zhing / ‘‘thugs rjes gzigs ngos rang na rgas 'gro rogs gzhan med pas de ring thon pa gnang rogs ’’bshad par/ ‘‘'o na dgong dro shog ’rizer nas khong khro 'tshub 'tshub byed kyi 'dug pa phran rang phyir thon nas ngang tsam bsdad mno bsam zhig btang ste 'go khrid der chang rin sprod thabs byas pa legs snyam nas bu tshul khrims zla bar bal sgor brgya lor gcig bskur te ‘‘'go khrid der u tshugs brgyab nas snang med kyis brgya lor de lag pa'i nang sprod dgos ’’zhes labs par kho'i sar mi mang bas sprod shes pa mi 'dug zer/ phran gyis ‘‘gang yang byed kyi ma red/ sgo 'gram der bsdad de mi gzhan med pa'i bar seng go skabs dang bstun nas sprod dgos ’’zhes bslab pa ltar skyod song bas brgya lor der mig blta tsam byas nas blangs te ‘‘tog tsam sgug ang / da lta sprad chog ’ces bshad 'dug pa ltar ngang tsam nas tshul khrims zla ba yar shog ces ming 'bod kyis lag 'khyer sprad 'dug pas de 'phral gnas tshang du phyir log gis 'grul 'khor chung ba zhig glas te skyel rogs tshe phun lags dang mnyam du thon/ bal po'i 'gag sgo nas dpe cha sogs sngog bsher ka kor gyis tog tsam 'gor/ mdza' grogs zam pa'i shar phyogs su bu gnyis yod pa'i 'grul 'khor de thon grabs byed pa mthong nas zam steng rgyugs shar glod de phyin pas rjes zin tsam byung / de nas dus tshod skar cha bcu tsam la krung go'i 'gag sgo las khungs der 'byor/ dpe cha sngog pa sogs dngos por zhib bsher nan pos dgong dro bar 'gor/ lag 242

'dogs chu tshod re las 'khyer mi chog cing / der sgo khral krung sgor brgya tham pa dgos lugs zer bar chu tshod rnams bu phrug la lag rtags sprod byed yin pa las tshong bya gtan nas med nges bshad kyang nyan 'jog ma byas stabs/ 'o na chu tshod rnams 'di gar nyar rogs gnang zla ba drug gi gong phyir log skabs rgya gar du rang 'jags 'khyer chog pa zhus kyang de yang 'grigs min zhes ka kor thog chu tshod tshang ma'i ang ki dang / yi ge rnams zhib tu tho 'god kyis lha sar 'gag sgo las khungs su yi ge 'bul rgyur chu tshod khyod rang tshos khyer te lha sar 'byor 'phral 'gag sgo las khungs su lam seng 'bul dgos pa las nyin 'gyangs zhags 'gyangs mi chog zer/ de'i dgong mo 'grama'agag sgo'i mgron khang du bsdad/ sang nyin slang yang 'gag sgos zhib bsher zin rjes nyin dgung yol tsam la thon/ de nub gnya' nang shang du bsdad/ tshes 20nyin gnya' nas thon te gnya' nang mthongs la brgal nas de'i nub mo ri thang mtshams shig tu bcings 'grol dmag gi mgron khang zhig 'dug pa der zhag sdod byas/ tshes 21nyin snga dro thon te gzhis rtser chu tshod gcig tsam ring bsdad de de'i ring dga' nye stobs lags sar bskyod de kha lag zas nas rgyal rtser thon/ tshes 22zhogs pa rgyal rtse nas thon te chu tshod bzhi par lha sa'i 'khar rnga gdong rlangs 'khor 'bab tshugs su 'byor/lha sar 'byor rjes rlangs 'khor 'bab tshugs nas 'grul rogs gzhan dag rang rang bste gnas su song zhing / pha yul khams phyogs nas yin pa grwa rigs gnyis dang / mi skya gnyis 'dug pa khong tsho bod ljongs sne len las khungs nas 'jib 'khor gyis bsu bar 'byor 'dug pa khong tsho bod la gzhis chags sdod rgyu'i khas len byas yod pa 'dra/ nga rang dngos rigs rnams srung zhing bsdad/ bu bstan phun gnas tshang zhig 'tshol bar btang / bu skal rdor mi 'drud ther chung gla bar phyin/ khong gnyis ma 'byor bar nga rang gcig pur 243

bsdad pa sne len khang gi mi (bag gro lags zer )ba des mthong nas/ ‘‘khyod rang sdod gnas ga par yod dam ’’zhes dris byung / ngas nga'i sngar gyi rang khyim khang pa zhol don po yin/ de ni gzhung bzhes gnang 'dug spun mched gcig bar skor nang yod pa de'i sar 'gro rtsis yin yang / der yang sgo thel phog 'dug byas tsang nga'i bu gnas tshang 'tshol bar btang bas da lta 'byor ma byung sgug bsdad yod ’’ces brjod par/ bag gro lags nas/ 'o na nga tsho'i sne len khang gnyis pa thag nye por yod khong tsho'i mnyam du phebs shig zer/de 'phral bu skal rdor lags ther chung zhig 'khrid nas 'byor byung bas sne len khang du bskyod/ de nas shag lho'i pā lags kyi bzhugs khang g.yar po byung 'dug pas sne len khang nas thon skabs sgo 'gram nas mi mang po zhig gis phyag dbang dgos lugs zer bar nga ni bla ma dang dge bshes gang yang min/ phyag dbang mi yong byas kyang ma nyan par 'tshang ga brgyab nas dpral ba gtugs mkhan mang du mang du phyin nas ma thar stabs bu gnyis ther chung mnyam du btang / sne len las byed pas ‘‘khyed rang tog tsam bzhugs na dga'/ da lta mo ṭa btang chog ’’zer ba bzhin sne len khang du bskyar log gis sdod ring bu bstan phun gyi bza' zla shag lho'i bu mo rig 'dzin tshe skyid dang / phran gyi bu mo chung shos mtshe ma gsum gyi 'bring po phur bu chos sgron/ gcung mo skal chos bcas ja dang zhal tog 'khyer nas 'byor/ bu mo phur bu nas 'phrad ma thag pā lags zhes ngu 'bod 'thams 'khyud kyis ngang tsam ring ngu thag ma chod par lus shing / ngos rang yang dga' skyo zung 'brel gyi mig la mchi zhag 'khor/gcung mo khong gnyis kyang mig chu gtong gi 'dug sne len khang de khang pa dang 'dzin chas sogs 'grigs tsam 'dug kyang nga tshor chu 'khol tsam yang ster yas mi 'dug la chu khang dang gsang spyod la chu yang mi 'dug pas/ nga rang kha gsangs drags nas sne len byed phyogs la bsam 'char zol med shod par 244

thal song / de nas sne len khang gi 'jib 'khor nang bsdad de gnas tshang shag lho'i ma khang bar ched skyel byas byung / de'i sang nyin snga dro phran gyi bu mo 'bring ba tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms dang / bu chung ba/ zla grogs skyid sbug bsod nams dbang 'dus/ bu rdzi phran gyi bu mo mtshe ma gsum gyi dang po skra bzang bcas nas bza' btung sogs dgos mkho sna tshogs khyer te thug 'phrad la slebs byung / dga' snang chen pos 'tshams 'dri dang / gleng mol byas/ de nyin lha sa grong khyer 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs nas btang gnang byung zhes bsod stobs lags dang / g.yu sgron lags gnyis phebs 'byor gyis gsungs gsal/ ‘‘khyed la rogs ram zhu dgos gang yod zhu rgyu dang / sang gnangs sku ngal gsos rjes se 'bras sogs la mchod mjal la phebs dus mo ṭa ched gtong zhu rgyur skabs mtshams so sor ngos gnyis la gsungs rogs ’’zhes gsungs byung bar/ phran nas ‘‘thugs rje che khyed gnyis brgyud rim bzhin zhus chog pa dang / gnangs nyin lha ldan gtsug lag khang du mchod mjal la 'gro rgyu yin yang thag nyer song mo ṭa gtong gnang mi dgos ’’zhes zhus kyang sne shan gnyis de'i gnangs nyin nyi shar snga char mo ṭa zhig dang bcas bsu bar phebs byung zhing / mchod me snyan shal dang / khrus bum 'bab gzhong / 'thor nas sogs mdang nub nas gra sgrig zin pas phran rang chos gos snam sbyar gyon te bu mo mtshe ma 'bring po phur chos dang / gnas tshang shag lho'i bu mo tshe g.yang / sne shan gnyis bcas nga tsho mchod mjal du bskyod par mchod mjal zhu mkhan mang po zhig sgrol ma lha khang brgyud kyi bar skor byang phyogs khul du'ang gral bstar bsgrigs 'dug pa phran tsho gral bstar nang sdod ma dgos par dmigs bsal gyi shar gtong gnang byung yang / mang tshogs 'gor 'gyings mi 'byung ched thugs rje chen po dang / jo bo shākya mu ne rnam gnyis kyi mchod khang sbug tu bcar ba ma gtogs mchod khang gzhan khag 245

gzim sgo'i 'gram nas zhal mjal zhus te dkyil 'khor mthil gyi lcags khri nang jo bo rin po che'i thad ka'i spyan sngar bsdad de spyan 'dren khrus gsol dang 'brel smon lam gyi rim pa khag dang / jo bo'i bstod pa/ 'phags bstod sogs kha 'don chu tshod bzhi tsam ring smin rgyas dang / bar skabs nas bzung khrus gsol rab gnas rtsa ba nas ma byung 'dug pas rab gnas bsdus pa zhig kyang zhus pa bcas shin tu skal bzang gi go skabs thos pas blo bde bag phebs gang legs byung / bar skabs bod du lo mang ring grwa chas gyon pa ha lam mthong rgyu med 'dra bas da res blo bur du chos gos snam sbyar gyon pa'i dge slong zhig mthong bar brten mchod mjal zhu mkhan rnams ha las dga' dad chen pos lcags khra'i 'gram du phran la blta bar 'ong nas 'tshang ga brgyab par dkon gnyer tshos ji ltar bkag kyang lcags khra'i gseb nas shog dngul dang /kha btags dbyugs te smon lam 'debs kyin 'dug mchod mjal zhu mkhan gyi nang de snga'i gar dpon pa sangs tshe ring lags rgyang nas ngo shes byung yang bka' mol zhu thabs ma byung / de'i sang nyin po ta la dang / de rjes se 'bras dgon pa bcas la gong bzhin chos gos snam sbyar gyon nas mchod mjal la bcar te khrus gsol rab gnas dang 'brel bstan pa rgyas pa dang / 'gro ba bde ba sogs kyi smon 'dun gang shes zhus/'gram 'gag sgo nas bshad pa bzhin lha sar 'byor pa'i sang nyin de rang chu tshod rnams bskur te bu skal rdor lha sa'i 'gag sgo las khungs su btang bar ‘‘'go khrid gtso bo chab mdor phebs te bzhugs med/ nga tshos thag chod pa mi 'dug lar nas sgo khral chag yang yong gi ma red/ 'on kyang 'go khrid nyin shas nang 'gyangs med phebs 'byor yong rgyu ’’zhes bshad 'dug de rjes nyin kha shas song mtshams 'go khrid gtso bo thug 'phrad byung zhing / gnas lugs zhib phra zhus pas ‘‘chu tshod rnams phru gu rnams kyi rngan par sprod byed la 246

bsam da lam dmigs bsal gyis sgo khral chag yang btang ba yin ri’ces ngo so dang bcas don smin thob byung / bla phyag phyag drung lcang can lho sgo tshe brtan nor rgyas lags nas zhal tog skyel bar mi gcig gtong gnang gis ‘‘lo mang ma mjal bas mjal 'dod ha cang che gshis sang gnangs 'gyangs med ngo 'phrad la yong dgos ’’zhes lan btang gnang 'dug pas don ltar de'i sang nyin rang lag rtags stong min 'ba' ci slo ma sgor mo kha gsar rang 'grigs dang / 'bu ras yug chung gcig khyer te lcang can lho sgo'i gzim shag tu bskyod cing / lcang lho'i mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes su gyur nas phyag drung bzhugs yul ka gcig ma mun nag du ba ral pa zag la khad pa thigs pa dzar dzar zhig gi nang lo mang gzim gzim par bzhugs par snang / bzhugs mal 'gram du lcags thab gog po zhig gi steng ha yang khog ldir dreg can rnying pa gcig gi nang ja thang sla po zhig las mi 'dug phyag drung ni zhal ras thal 'tshub can gnyer mas khengs pa spre'u lta bu ya nga ba mthong dus yid skyo nas 'khor ba'i bde skyid kyi 'gyur ldog de lta bu ang snyam pa byung / phran slebs pa dang khong rang bzhugs sa'i sku rgyab nas shing shog sbar gang lcags thabs der blug ste me spar nas ja thang tsha po bzos/ gzim sa'i 'khris kyi ka ba'i logs nas ja mdong nag po dreg can chung ngu zhig 'dug pa de phyag brkyangs nas blangs te bzhugs bzhugs par ja bsrub pa gnang song / ‘‘ngas bsrub chog ’’zhus par ‘‘mi dgos nga rang gis bsrub chog khyed rang lhod lhod byas nas bzhugs shig ri’gsungs/ der phano tshun snga phyi'i lo rgyus gyi gleng mol byung zhing /phran gyis spyi lo 1958lo mtsho sna 'bras sgrub par phyin pa nas bzung 1980lo rang yul lha sar ma 'byor bar gyi gnas tshul rnams sgro bkur med pa zhus par phyag drung phyag thal mo sbyar nas 'grigs 'dug khyed bsod nams che gsung zhing yid dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas de ring lhod lhod byas nas 247

bzhugs dang zhes khyim mtshes kyi bu mo zhig za khang nas bod thug nyo bar btang song ba de 'dra mi dgos zhus kyang ma gsan par nyin dgung kha lag phyag drung sar zas/ dgong dro log khar ‘‘sku mkhyen nga'i sar yang yang phebs shog ang ’’gsungs par de don khas len zhus/ de'i sang nyin bu rgan pa ye shes brtson 'grus dang / bu bstan phun dang / skal rdor gnyis kyi zla grogs bcas nas ja dang / kha tog khyer te thug 'phrad du 'byor/ phru gu dgu yod khongs nas bu mo rgan pa bde chos zhan yang slob grwa'i dge rgan dang / bu chung shos tshe brtan dge legs pe cin mi rigs slob grwa chen mor slob sbyong / bu mo chud shos mtshams lags smin gling rdzong khul du lam bzo'i las kar phyin 'dug pa bcas khong tsho gsum da lam thug 'phrad ma byung yang / de byings phru gu rnams kyi bza' zla bu phrug dang bcas dga' 'dzoms kyis dran rten 'dra par yang brgyab/ sngar gyi dga' nye dang / spun mched mang po zhig nyin bstud de thug 'phrad du 'byor bar 'tshams 'dri dang / phyag rtags stong min tsam re phul/ gzhan yang / pha ma spun mched rgya gar phyogs su yod pa'i nang mi mang po zhig gis gnas tshul dri rtsad byed du slebs byung bar kha shas ma shes pa 'dug kyang mang po zhig ra 'phrod de gnas tshul gsal bshad byas par blo yid tshims pos ‘‘thugs rje che/ 'das log la phebs pa lta bu yag po byung ’’zhes zer zhing / dga' mos chen po byed kyi 'dug 'ga' zhig la rgya gar du sdod yul gyi sa gnas kha byang dbyin yig bris sprod byas/ de ltar skad cha dri mkhan mang ba'i rkyen gyis dpe cha blta klog dang kha 'don bya rgyu nam phyed yol te chu tshod gnyis pa gsum pa bar ma tshar ba gnyid lcog thib thib byed par brten phru gu tshos ‘‘da phyin skad cha dri mkhan slebs na pā lags bzhugs med lab pa dga'/ 'di 'dra'i bsun po de 'dra kha ya ma gnang bar bskyur zhog ’’zer yang / ‘‘pha ma srun mched lo mang thugs 'phrad ma byung ba rnams kyi gnas 248

tshul thos na snyam ste skom pa chu 'dod ltar 'ong ba zhe cig yin pas su dang su slebs kyang bkag med thongs shog ’ ces bshad de tshang ma'i re 'dod bskangs/sne shan gnyis nas ‘‘gong rim gyis khyed kyi re 'dun ji yod thugs 'khur che bzhes gnang rgyu yin lugs dang / khyed kyi lo rgyus shig yig thog gsal 'god dang chabs cig re 'dun gsal zhu gnang dgos bka' phebs byung bas de don 'phral 'bul dgos rgyu gsungs pa ltar/ spyi lo 1980lo'i zla 6tshes 26nyin bris 'bul zhus pa gsham gsal/‘‘spyi lo 1980lcags sprel phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin rang yul lha sar 'byor bar lha sa grong khyer 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs nas ched 'dzugs gnang ba'i sne shan bsod stobs lags dang / g.yu sgron lags gnyis brgyud bka' phebs ltar phran gyi lo rgyus dang / re 'dun snyan shog chabs cig tu 'god 'bul zhus par/ dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin bdag gi de snga'i skya ming la phyag nang lha dbang tshe ring zer zhing / rang lo drug cu re lnga yin/ skyes yul lha sa/ rang lo bcu gcig bar pha ma'i sar bsdad de yi ge 'bri klog bslabs/ rang lo bcu gcig nas bco lnga bar lha sa'i sger gyi slob grwa go bo khang ser la slob sbyong byas/ lo bco lnga nas bcu bdun bar lha sar dpon khungs mi bdag sger lha sding pa'i g.yog po byas nas bsdad/ lo bcu bdun nas bco brgyad bar lha sa sman rtsis khang du sum rtags slob sbyong byas/ rang lo bco brgyad la chang sa brgyab pa dang / lo der bla phyag las khungs kyi las bya zha'u li zhus stsal gyis rang lo sum cu bar zha'u li byas/ rang lo sum cu par phyag nang ngo ma bsko gzhag gis las ka byed mus su spyi lo 1954lo mes rgyal du tā la'i bla ma'i chibs zhabs su bcar/ spyi lo 1956lo bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas rang skyong ljongs lha sa slob grwa 'bring ba'i bod yig dge rgan la btang ste/ spyi lo 1958bar bsdad/ spyi lo 1958lor bod sa 249

gnas srid gzhung gis mtsho sna 'bras sgrub kyi mi 'gror btang ba ltar 'gro dgos byung / spyi lo 1959lor mtsho sna nas lha sar phyir log tu yong skabs lho kha khul du slebs dus lha sar zing 'khrugs langs nas chu sgang khams pas lam bkag ste 'gro sa ma rnyed pa'i skabs tā la'i bla ma ston 'khor grwa nang du phebs 'byor skabs bka' shag tu mtsho sna'i las don snyan seng zhu bar bcar dus bka' drung bsko gzhag byas te chibs zhabs su bskyod dgos byung / rang lo bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ spyi lo 1959lo nas 1960lo'i bar rgya gar ka lon sbug tu bod kyi shes rig zlos gar sgrig 'dzugs nang bsdad/ rang lo bzhi bcu zhe bdun nas zhe brgyad (spyi lo 1961lo nas 1962lo )bar rda ram sa lar bod kyi zlos gar tshogs pa'i 'go khrid las rogs byas/ rang lo zhe brgyad (spyi lo1962)lo rab byung dang dge slong sgrub/ rang lo zhe brgyad nas rang lo nga gcig bar (spyi lo 1962nas 1965)bar rda ram sa lar bod kyi shes rig spyi khyab las khungs kyi drung che byas/ rang lo nga gcig nas re gnyis (spyi lo 1965nas 1976)bar rgya gar ldi li gsar pa'i rlung 'phrin rgyang bsgrags khang du bod skad rgyang bsgrags shod mkhan byas/ rang lo re gsum (spyi lo 1977)lo rlung 'phrin las 'khur dgongs pa zhus te rgya gar lho phyogs ma'i sor khul kha 'don dge sbyor byas nas bsdad/ rang lo re bzhi nas re lnga (spyi lo 1978nas 1979)lo'i zla ba 6bar bal yul du mtshams bsnyen sgrub byas nas bsdad/bod du yod pa'i phru gu bu bzhi dang / bu mo lnga yod pa la bal yul nas yi ge btang ste khyed rnams pha rgan thug 'phrad du bal yul la yong thub na dga' po yong nges zhes sbrag yig btang bas/ bu 'bring ba lha sa slob 'bring gnyis pa'i dge rgan bstan 'dzin phun tshogs dang / bu gzhon pa lha sa slob 'bring dge rgan skal rdor gnyis 1980lo'i zla 5par bal yul du 'byor nas bod nang gi gnas tshul dngos yod zhib brjod byung ba ma zad/ lhag par nga'i phru gu bu mo 250

chung shos de ma gtogs de min phru gu rgan gzhon tshang mar mi dmangs srid gzhung nas gzigs bskyangs kyis las ka dang / slob sbyong gi go skabs bzang po thob 'dug pa bcas la nga rang ha cang gi dga' po byung ba dang / sems 'gul chen po thebs nas rang yul la log 'dod kyi bsam pa shugs che bskyed de da res bcar thub pa ni dga' spro chen po byung / 'on kyang de snga'i sdod khang zhol don po ni gzhung bzhes khongs tshud de da lam lha sar 'byor nyin 'gro yul sdod gnas rtsa ba nas med par rlangs 'khor 'bab tshugs der mno bsam mang po 'khor te dga' skyo gnyis ka byung / da cha nga'i re 'dun kha tsha ba don tshan gsum zhu rgyur/1 sdod khang 'os 'tshams shig gsol ras yong ba dang / de yang phru gu mang po gung seng la 'dzoms yul bya dgos stabs rgya khyon ma chung ba zhig gnang skyong zhu rgyu/ 2 bu mo chung ba skra bzang lho kha gra nang rdzong khongs nas lha sar pa pha'i sar bsdad 'thus kyis them tho brje bsgyur yong ba zhu rgyu/ 3 nye char bal yul nas bod la log rgyu gtan 'khel stabs phran sdod gnas rgya gar la yod pa'i dngul dngos dang / lhag par rgya gar gzhung nas rlung 'phrin las ka byas pa'i phogs 'phar sgor lnga khri brgyad stong nyis brgya tham pa zhu rgyur bsdad pa len phyir rgya gar du 'gro rgyu yin kyang / bal yul du bzhugs pa'i krung go'i gzhung tshab chen mos rgya gar la ma phyin pa legs zhes bka' phebs pa ltar bal yul nas glo bur thad kar bod la yong dgos byung ste 'tsho gos kyi mthun rkyen gang yang med lags na/ gus pa spyi lo 1958lo la mtsho snar bskyod de zing 'khrugs nang the byus rtsa ba nas med nges dngos 'brel la brten mkhar dngos gzhung bzhes rnams phyir slog gsol ras yod pa zhes mi zhu mthu med la don smin skyabs 'jug gis bka' gsal 'phral stsol yod pa zhu rgyu'i snyan shog tu/dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis 1980lo'i zla 6tshes 16la phul ’’zhes 'bul lam zhus/ de nas nyin gcig lha sa grong khyer 'thab phyogs gcig 251

gyur las khungs su ja ston la mgron 'bod gnang ba ltar bcar/ der rgya gar dang bal yul khul nas yong ba'i bod mi nyi shu tsam zhig slebs 'dug sne len gtso skyong gnang mkhan rang skyong ljongs chab gros kyi kru'u zhi sku gzhon chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs nas dga' bsu dang 'brel bod kyi snga phyi'i lo rgyus gsal bshad gnang ba dang / grong khyer 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'i pu'u krang lha sa rgya mthong gi bu zha'u li lags nas kyang mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang mi rigs thams cad 'dra mnyam dang / rgyal gces pa khyim tshang gcig pa/ rgyal gces byed par snga phyi med pa/ 'gro 'ong rang mos sogs yin pas de ring tshang mas gsung mol lhug por gnang ste bag phebs spro skyid gnang rogs zhu rgyu ’’zhes gsungs pa dang / grong khyer zlos gar gyi rol cha mkhas pa lung rigs lags nas sgra snyan btang zhing / zlos gar gyi phul byung gzhas ma skad grags can zla sgron lags nas glu gzhas zhabs bro dang / tshang mar mchod chang btegs nas chang gzhas snyan 'jebs ldan pa btang / sku mgron rnam pas kyang dga' dga' spro spro'i zhabs gzhas gnang dgos zhes 'bod bskul gnang zhing / phran la'ang ‘‘khyed nyid rgya gar du zlos gar dbu 'dzin gnang bar song glu gzhas zhabs bro mkhas can yin nges pas gtong gnang yod pa ri’zhes gsungs byung bar/ ‘‘phran gyis gzhas dang zhabs bro/ rol cha sgra snyan bcas phran tsam shes kyang da ni dge slong gi sdom pa blangs zin pas de rigs mi chog par song dgongs 'gal med pa ’’zhes zhus/ ngang tsam nas sku mgron tshang mas so so'i dgongs 'char gsung rogs zhes thog mar phran la 'bod bskul gnang ba ltar rang gi lo rgyus mdor bsdus dang / da lam rang yul du 'byor skabs thag ring gi gtam dang mi 'dra ba bod la 'gyur ldog byung tshul dang /bar skabs dang mi 'dra ba krung dbyang nas srid jus lhug tu gtong gnang mdzad par brten rang nyid kyang bod la gnyen 'phrad kyi go skabs thob pa 252

sogs gtam bshad mdor bsdus zhus/ de rjes tshang mas gsung bshad rim bzhin gnang rjes zhu'i pu'u krang nas tshang mas mnyes tshor chen po'i gsung bshad lhug por gnang bar thugs rje che/ khyed rnam pas gsung 'os gang yod kyang nga tshor gsung gnang yod pa dang / rjes su rim pas mjal rgyu gsung ste ja ston grol/de rjes zhu'i pu'u krang shag lho ma khang du phran sdod sar ched phebs kyis ‘‘srid gzhung nas thugs 'khur che bzhes gnang ste khyed kyis phyag las shig gnang na gang legs yong rgyur chab gros nang ngam chos don las khungs gang dga' thugs 'dod ltar gyi las phogs 'bul rgyu bka' phebs pa bzhin gang dge gsal por gsung na legs mi’zhes gsungs par/ phran gyis ‘‘srid gzhung nas phran la bong ba gser gzigs kyi bka' drin de lhag che thabs med mod/'on kyang gcig tu rang nyid lo na rgas pa dang / gnyis nas gzugs po rgyun gcong gi rkyen pas khog pa bshags bcos byas nas yun ring ma song bas em rjes lo shas ngal gso yag po rgyag dgos gsungs byung bas des na las phogs gang yang zhu ma dgos pa ’’zhes zhus par/ ‘‘gang yang byed kyi ma red/ ngal gso gnang chog gi red/ da dung dgongs pa bzhes dgos/ snga 'phros khyed kyi phyag sne gnang rogs gsung gi 'dug ’’ces gsungs nas sgor sum brgya tham pa yod pa'i shog 'thum gcig gnang byung yang / ‘‘nga la lag sne dgos mkho gang ci phru gu tshos ci 'dod sprod bzhin la brten gsol ras zhu dgos med gshis 'di 'dra rtsa ba nas zhu gi min ’’zhes phyir 'bul zhus par/ ‘‘'di ni gzhung gis thag gcod gnang grub pas cis kyang len dgos ’’gsungs te dngul shog 'thum de phran gyi mdun lcog steng bzhag nas lam seng phyir thon mdzad song bar de 'phral shog 'thum de dag 'khyer te phebs rjes bcar yang /khong brel stabs kyis rdo skas babs te phebs rjes zin ma byung / 'on kyang rjes ma phyir 'bul zhu dgos bsam mur skabs shig zhu'i pu'u krang phran sar 253

phebs shing / de dus sngon bstsal dngul phyir 'bul zhus par ‘‘de 'dra rtsa ba nas gnang rgyu yod pa ma red/ chen po med kyang srid gzhung gis gnang ba yin pas nges par du bzhes dgos/ khyed rang dgung lo mtho yang rtsa ba'i skyon cher med pa dang / nyams myong yod pas phyag las shig nges par du gnang na yag po 'dug ’’gsungs byung bar/ ngas ‘‘gzugs po rgyun gcong gi rkyen pas khog pa bshags bcos byas kyang da lta'ang bde thang rang mi 'dug pas snga 'phros sman bcos dang / chu tshan sogs 'phrod bsten byas nas kha 'don dge sbyor la bsdad chog pa zhig dang / da lta'i gnas tshang gang legs yod kyang rgya gar khul pha ma spun mched yod mkhan mang pos skad cha 'dri bar yong nas bsun gtser che tsam 'dug pas se ra chos sding sgang rtse thog der sgo dang sge'u khung bzos chog kyang / glog bzhu mi 'dug pas glog bzhu zhig 'dzugs thabs skyabs 'jug gnang rogs ’’zhes zhus par zhal bzhes gnang ste se ra dgon par sgo sge'u bzo rgyu dang / glog bzhu 'dzugs rgyu bka' mngags dang 'brel rjes su chos sding rtse thog gi khang mig rnams phran gyi sdod shag tu gsol ras gnang byung ba/ sge'u khung la ras yol las mi 'dug stabs shel khra gsar bzo byas te khu sim sdod bag phebs pa byung / yang nyin gcig rang skyong ljongs phyir log bod rigs spun zla'i sne len khang nas mgron 'bod gnang ba bzhin bcar bas/ de mo bla brang gi gzim chung tshoms chen du phyi rgyal nas yong ba'i bod mi bcu phrag lhag tsam mnyam du 'dzoms shing / der rang skyong ljongs srid gzhung gi sku tshab tu rgyal yongs srid gros kyi kru'u zhi sku gzhon 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal mchog dang / ljongs srid gros kyi kru'u zhi sku gzhon sde dge skal bzang dbang 'dus/ ljongs srid gros kru'u zhi sku gzhon bsam sding rdo rje phag mo/ ljongs mi rigs don gcod khang gi kru'u ren yar 'phel lags/ljongs bud med mnyam 'brel tshogs pa'i ram pa dbyangs can lags/254

ljongs sne len khang gi kru'u ren phur bu don grub lags bcas phebs 'dug cing / tshang mas phran la phyag btang gnang ste dga' bsu gnang zhing stan la 'khod/ tshoms chen nang gro so phye mar dang / chang phud dngul rkyan/ dngul phor/ dkar spro mtho brtsegs/ shing 'bras sos pa sne 'dzoms/ byi ril sne 'dzoms/ srang gang bag leb/ sbu lug kong chen sogs dkar sder che ba mang po byur khengs bcas bod kyi lo gsar lta bu'i gra sgrig gnang 'dug thog mar zhal dkar nang gsol ja btegs/ de nas phye mar chang phud 'degs 'bul dang / gsol ja gnyis pa btegs rjes sne len khang gi kru'u ren phur bu don grub lags dang / ljongs mi rigs don gcod khang gi kru'u ren yar 'phel lags gnyis nas rim bzhin dga' bsu'i gsung bshad dang 'brel de ring tshang ma dga' dga' spro spro gnang ste lhod bzhugs gnang rogs gsungs/lha sa grong khyer zlos gar gyi rol cha mkhas pa lung rig lags nas sgra snyan btang / grong khyer zlos gar gyi phul byung gzhas ma zla sgron lags nas bod gzhas rnying pa snyan 'jebs 'gyur khug legs pa dang / yang sha dod la rnam 'gyur ldan pa'i stod gzhas dang nang ma'i zhabs bro yid dbang 'phrog pa'i gzigs 'bul zhus par dga' bsu'i thal mo 'brug sgra ltar grags/ slar yang zla sgron lags nas mchod chang btegs te chang gzhas tshig don phun sum tshogs pa snyan 'jebs gus zhabs rnam 'gyur la ngo ma bzlog pa lta bus phran ma gtogs tshang mas mchod chang gtsang bzhes gnang / ngang tsam nas sne len khang gi kru'u ren phur don lags nas lhan rgyas tshang mas gsan rogs gnang /nye char phyi rgyal nas phyir log phebs pa'i dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin lags nas da lta gsung bshad gnang rgyu zhes tshogs 'du yongs la snyan sgron gnang ste phran sar phebs nas khyod kyis gsung bshad gnang dgos gsungs pa bzhin dang len mi zhu mthu med kyis gtam bshad byas don/ dbu khrid rnam 255

pa dang / blo mthun rnam pa/ grogs po rnam pa bcas la dga' zhing gus pa'i bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu/ da lta sne len khang gi kru'u ren mchog nas 'bod bskul gnang ba ltar gnas lugs mdor bsdus zhu rgyur/ phran rang spyi lo 1958lo de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas mtsho sna 'bras sgrub gzhung 'dzin mi 'gror gtong gnang ltar bskyod de lhun rtser 'byor skabs bstan srung dang blang dmag ces pa chu bzhi sgang drug gi khams rigs nas khyod rang bod gzhung gi gzhung zhabs yin bzhin du rgya mi'i ṭ+wā yang la dga' nas slob grwa'i dge rgan byas pa gang min zhes sdang zugs bkag nyar gyis lo der lha sar phyir log ma thub par lus shing / spyi lo 1959lo lha sar zing 'khrug langs rkyen yul byol du 'gro mkhan dang mnyam du lho kha nas rgya gar du bskyod de mi lo nyi shu lhag tsam mi yul phyi rgyal du sdod dgos byung ba'i ring gi gnas tshul lam rob dang / spyi lo 1980lo krung dbyang nas srid jus lhug gtong gnang ba'i go skabs dang bstun/ da lam spyi zla drug pa'i nang bal yul brgyud bod du gnyen 'phrad la yong thub pa sogs gnas tshul sba gsang med pa drang bden gsal zhu dang 'brel srid gzhung nas thugs 'khur chen pos da lam sne len gzab rgyas gnang bar thugs rje che zhu rgyu ma zad/ tshang ma sku tshe brtan cing thugs bzhed 'grub pa'i smon 'dun zhu rgyu yin zhes zhus par tshang mas bcos min gyi dgyes tshor chen pos thal mo brdabs te dga' bsu thob/ lhag par mi rigs don gcod las khungs kyi kru'u ren yar 'phel lags nas khyed rang zing 'khrugs nang med pa dang / bod du yod pa'i bu phrug tshang ma bde thang gis dga' 'dzoms dang / khong tshor srid gzhung gis las phogs gnang ste las bzo pa yin pa/ bar skabs dang mi 'dra ba krung dbyang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus la brten nas bod 'di yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro bzhin pa'i bde skyid ldan pa'i dus skabs bzang po 'dir phebs thub pa ni skal pa bzang zhing dga' spro skye 256

'os pa zhig yin gshis/ da cha khyed nyid bod la gzhis chags gtan bzhugs gnang na legs shing / srid gzhung nas kyang khyed la gang ci'i thugs 'khur che bzhes yong rgyu gdon mi za bar blos 'gel chog rgyu dang / khyed rang srid gzhung rnying pa'i skabs nas gzhung zhabs yin pa dang / phyi rgyal du mi lo nyi shu skor bzhugs pa'i nyams myong mang po byung yod gshis/ des na khyed kyi lo rgyus rnam thar zhig nges par 'bri dgos gsung byung bar/ phran gyis ‘‘lo rgyus rnam thar zhes pa sngar phan rgyal ba yab sras dang / bla chen mi chen mkhas dbang khag gi rnam thar 'bri srol yod pa ma zad/ dgos don phan thogs kyang yod mod/ bdag lta bu'i skyes sbyang gi yon tan gang yang med pa'i rnam thar bris pas phan thogs gang yang med pas 'bri ma dgos pa mimizhes zhus/ de nas nyin dgung gsol tshigs bod lugs sha mog dang / sha bag leb/ kring mogabazhes 'bras/ lug sha btsos pa/ rgyu glo brngod pa/ bzhes tshal zhog lab se sha bcas kyi tsha tshal dang / grang tshal sne 'dzoms bcas rgyag spros phun sum tshogs pa 'bul bshams dang 'brel gsol rgyab mchod chang dngul phor btegs/ phan tshun (kam pi'i )mchod chang 'degs res mdzad/ tshang mas dga' spro'i zhabs gzhas gnang dgos zhes yar 'phel lags nas phran la'ang zhabs bro rgyag rogs gsung yang dge slong gi bslab khrims 'gal zhes dgongs pa zhus/ 'iphags pa lha mchog la'ang zlos gar gar mkhan ma zla sgron lags nas 'bod bskul zhus te zhabs gzhas gnang song ba stod gzhas 'khrugs po yang sha dod la ha las pa zhig 'dug phran sngon tsam log chog pa zhus par mgron gyi gtso bo khyed rang yin pas lhod bzhugs gnang dgos gsungs stabs gsol ston mjug mgril nas kyang yun ring po'i bar dga' spro'i gtam gleng byas/ glu gzhas zhabs bros dus 'da' nas mchod chang mchod mkhan mang che ba sku ra bad 'dug gsol ston grol 'phral khungs so 257

sor mo ṭa'i nang ched skyel gnang byung / blo pham pa zhig la gnas tshang skyes byed shag lho'i mi ngo bu bgres pa bkra shis nor bu kha sngon rgya bal khul gnyen 'phrad du dgongs zhus kyis phebs pa rgya gar gyi chog mchan ma thob par zla shas song ste bal yul la bzhugs mus su nye char glo bur sku tshe zin ma song zhes rna bar mi snyan pa'i gnas tshul 'byor par gnas tshang bu mo tshe g.yang ha cang gi sems sdug chen po'i mya ngan gyis non par sems gso thabs shes gang yod byas pa dang / bsngo rten 'bul rgyus mtshon pas mchod 'bul gyi rim pa khag dang / bdun tshigs so sor mchod 'bul dang / bdag 'jug dang 'brel ba'i byang ba zhu rgyu sogs 'das po'i dge 'jug zhu sgo 'thus shor ma song ba rgyus bab 'gan 'khur lhur len bgyis shing / gnas tshang shag lho'i bu mo tshe g.yang bza' 'tsho nas phran la rang gi pha bzhin gus bkur dang / 'gro gron 'dzems med kyis za 'thung longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa bstab cing / phran gyi phru gu bza' tsho bu phrug dang / spun mched/ ngo shes bcas phran thug 'phrad du yong mkhan ha cang mang por skyo bsun dang / 'jung pa med pa'i sne len gzab rgyas gnang ba bcas phran lo 'khor gcig tsam gtan sdod byed ring brdabs bsigs ci che byung song ba khong ni bka' drin gzhal thabs ma mchis pa yin/rang skyong ljongs rgyang bsgrags rlung 'phrin khang sogs gsar 'gyur 'god po mang po zhig snga rjes su phran sar bcar 'dri byed par phebs byung bar rang gi lo rgyus mthong thos byung ba'i dngos yod gnas tshul khag drang bden bshad kyang rgyang bsring dril bsgrags dang / tshags par 'grems spel byed skabs tshig bcos ji byas gang ltar bod mi mang tshogs nang nas phran la ‘‘mar khe se'i dge slong dang mgo gnyis ma/ ’ ‘‘zhabs 'dren pa ’’zer ba sogs mi 'dod rnam 'gyur gyi tshig mtshon 'debs pa dang / ha cang sdang zugs che ba 258

srog mgo mi thon pa'i gnas gyar la brten phran gyis ma bshad pa bshad tshul dang / bshad pa sbas bzung sogs kyi gnas tshul byung yod med rtsad gcod byas par phar khag tshur dkri kho nas ngos len byed mkhan ma byung bas ma nyes khag g.yogs blo pham che yang bya thabs dben pa de ni tshe sngon las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bu zhig yin par gor ma chag bsam byung /spyi lo 1981bod lcags bya gnam lo gsar tshes dang / dpyid gsar dus chen la rang skyong ljongs nas mgron 'bod kyi mgron shog sngon stsal bzhin mo ṭa bsu phebs ltar bcar bas dpa' ri'i khug tu tshogs khang chen mor gra sgrig phun sum tshogs pa gnang 'dug cing / thog mar tshogs khang sgo 'gram nas gzhon nu pho mo bod chas gzab mchor spras pa 'gas gro so phye mar dang /chang phud btegs sar phud stor zhus/ gsol ston sgrog tse khag gi zhabs stegs ming byang 'khod pa ltar bsdad/ gsol sgor du bzhugs pa rnams dang /g.yas g.yon tshang mas phyag btang ste bkra shis bde legs gsungs/ gsol ja dang zhal tog mchod chang sogs btegs/ de nas gsol tshigs rim bzhin bshams/ rang skyong ljongs hru'u ci dbyin h+pha thang nas bkra shis bde legs kyi gsung bshad dang 'brel sgrog khag so sor ngo phebs kyis tshang mar bzhes rag khrung dag btegs pa gnang / ljongs srid gros u yon de snga'i skyor mo lung lha mo ba rnying pa a ma ser ril nas rnam thar btang / ljongs srid gros kyi u yon bod kyi glu gzhas mkhas can tshe brtan sgrol ma lags nas kyang rnam thar dang glu gzhas btang / rang skyong ljongs zlos gar tshogs pa'i rol cha ba rnams nas stod gzhas dang nang ma sogs snyan 'jebs ldan pa btang / dbu khrid rnam pa'i khongs nas rang skyong ljongs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi sku gzhon skyid sbug phun tshogs tshe brtan lags dang/ zhol khang rje drung lags rnam gnyis nas kyang stod gzhas kyi zhabs bro bskyon/ phyi rgyal nas yong ba'i bod rigs 259

spun zla'i spyi 'thus spyi lcags bkra shis rdo rje lags nas bkra shis bde legs kyi gsung bshad gnang / tshang mas 'bod bskul gnang ba ltar bkra shis rdo rje lags nas nang ma dang / stod gzhas kyi sgra snyan btang / phran la'ang klu gzhas dang rol cha gtong dgos zhes 'bod bskul gnang byung yang / phran gyis glu gzhas rol cha phran tsam shes kyi yod kyang da cha dge slong gi sdom pa blangs pas de dag mi chog par brten dgongs 'gal mi bzhes par dgongs pa gnang rogs zhes zhus/ gsol ston grub 'phral mo ṭa ched gtong gis rang gi sdod gnas su bskyal gnang byung /spyi lo 1981zla 3nang phran se ra chos sding sgang du yod skabs rang skyong ljongs rlung 'phrin las byed pa mi gsum ched phebs kyis gsung gsal/‘‘khyed lha sar phebs nas zla ba mang po song yang khyed tshos 'tshams 'dri ma zhus pa zhes gong rim nas nga tshor bka' nan che phebs la brten/ de ring 'tshams 'dri zhu bar bcar zhing / khyed kyi lo rgyus dang / bod du phebs nas gzigs tshul dang dgongs tshul/ bod la yar rgyas gong 'phel byung yod pa rnams gsal bshad gnang rogs ’’zhes gsungs byung bas/ phran gyis ‘‘khyed tshos skad cha snon 'phri sba skung bzo bcos byas te dril bsgrags byas tshe ngas skad cha bshad yag mi yong ’’zhes lab par/ ‘‘nga tshos de rigs rtsa ba nas zhus mi yong de 'dra byas pas ga la 'grigs/ khyed rgya gar du phyir log phebs mkhan yin pas khyed kyis gang gsungs pa de rang sor bzhag byas chog pa ’’ces nan brjod la brten rang gi lo rgyus dang / mthong thos bsam tshul bshad pa gsham gabasdo95/dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin bdag gi lo rgyus gnas tshul mdor bsdus bshad na/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs phyag nang yin/ ming la jo lags lha dbang tshe ring zer gyi yod/ spyi lo 1958lo mtsho sna 'bras sgrub par phyin te lha sar phyir log skabs khams rigs nas 'gro lam bkag ste thar ma byung /260

1959lo lha sar log yong dus tā la'i bla ma ston 'khor lho khar phebs 'dug pa snga lo bcar ma thub pa'i gnas lugs zhu bar bka' shag tu bcar skabs bka' drung bsko gzhag byas te chibs zhabs su mnyam skyod byas/ de nas rgya gar du zlos gar nang lo bzhi dang / de rjes shes rig drung che lo bzhi/ rgya gar ldi li rlung 'phrin las byed lo bcu gnyis bcas byas pa yin/ 1976lo rgan yol byas te sdod skabs zlos gar mang tshogs dang / shes rig las khungs nas re 'dun nan brjod la brten/ 1978lor slar yang zlos gar 'go 'dzin slob ston lo gcig bya rgyu'i khas len byas kyang grang rlung nad gzhi 'phar ldang gis ldi lir khog pa bshags bcos bya dgos byung / nad babs cung drag tu phyin pa dang bal yul la gnas mjal dang sbrags bsnyen mtshams su sdod skabs bod nas bu chung 'bring gnyis thug 'phrad du 'byor te krung dbyang gi srid jus gu yang skor zhib brjod byung ba ma zad/ bod mi mang po gnyen 'phrad du 'gro bzhin pa dang / bu phrug dang spun mched tshang mas lan yig btang 'byor bcas la brten gnyen 'phrad dang sbrags rang yul gyi gnas stangs mthong 'dod kyis snga lo spyi zla drug pa'i nang bu gnyis dang mnyam du lha sar yong pa yin/ thog mar bal bod sa mtshams mdza' grogs zam pa grol ba dang ri ldebs der khang pa mang po gsar rgyag bcas yar rgyas kyi rnam pa gsal po dang / de nas 'grul 'khor nang zhugs te lam bar gzhis ka rtse dang /rgyal rtse sogs la khang pa gsar rgyag mang po dang / 'khor lam g.yas g.yon du lcang ma gsar 'dzugs star sgrig bcas dang / lha sar de bas kyang khang pa dang / ljon shing / 'gro lam sogs ha las pa'i yar rgyas thog lha sa'i grong khyer gyi dbus su pho brang chen po po ta lar gser zangs kyi rgya phibs dang /rgyal mtshan/ ghan ji ra sogs nyams chag med par gzi byin 'bar ba mthong nas smra mi shes pa'i dga' spro chen po byung / lha sar 'byor nyin lam rogs 261

rnams rang rang gi nang dang / gnas tshang so sor phyin song zhing / gus pa'i khyim ni gzhung bzhes khongs tshud 'dug pa spun mched gcig yod pa der 'gro rtsis byas pa dang / de yang sgo thel phogs ste gnas tshang 'gro yul med par 'grul 'khor 'bab tshugs der sems pa ha cang skyo po bcas dga' skyo gnyis ka byung / ngang tsam song nas lha sa grong khyer sne len las khungs nas las byed mi gnyis phebs nas gnas tshang shag lho bar mo ṭa'i nang bskyal thog rogs ram gang dgos ngos gnyis nas byas 'thus gsungs te mthun 'gyur gang legs gnang byung / nyin shas ngal gso byas rjes sne len las byed gnyis nas rogs ram gnang ste lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang / se 'bras gnyis bcas su chos gos snam sbyar gyon te mchod mjal la bcar nas khrus gsol rab gnas zhu rgyu byung / lhag par lha sa'i gtsug lag khang nang jo bo rin po che'i spyan sngar chu tshod bzhi tsam ring kha 'don byas te dal dal lhod lhod byed rgyu byung ba bcas skal pa bzang po'i go skabs thob gshis/ chos dad rang mos dngos gnas 'dug snyam nas dga' spro chen po byung zhes yod de sngon sne len las byed gnyis kyi gsung don la/ re 'dun zhu 'os zhus na gzhung nas thugs 'khur bzhes kyi red gsungs pa ltar bu mo chung ba lho kha nas lha sar them tho bsgyur rgyu dang gcig phru gu tshor sdod khang med stabs rang khyim khang pa phyir slog yong ba dang gnyis/ srid jus don 'khyol gyi mkhar dbang rnams phyir slog gsol ras yong ba zhu rgyu dang gsum bcas de sngon snyan seng zhus par them tho chog mchan thob pa gang legs byung zhing / don tshan gzhan gnyis rim bzhin thugs 'khur bzhes rgyur yid ches byed kyi yod/ nga'i bu phrug pho mo dgu yod pa nas bu mo chung shos gcig ma gtogs de byings phru gu tshang ma mi dmangs srid gzhung nas gso skyong gnang ste slob grwa'i dge rgan dang / tshags par las byed sogs rang rang 'khos dpag gi las ka thob 'dug pa 'di ni ha cang gi 262

bka' drin chen po yin par yid ches nges rnyed kyis dga' spro tshad med skyes byung / gzhan yang skye bo pho mo mang po zhig la las ka thob ste rkang 'khor bzhon nas 'tshang ka shig shig gis nyin ltar 'gro 'ong byed pa mthong dus de tsho dngos gnas yag po byung shag snyam pa'i bsam blo 'khor byung / da dung ngas sprel lad dang sgro btags min pa'i mthong thos kyi gnas tshul kha shas zhu gi yin/bod mis rtsa cher 'dzin pa'i gtsug lag khang khas/ dang / sku gsung thugs rten yongs rdzogs rtsa med btang yod pa'i gnas tshul phyi rgyal la go thos byung / da lam brtag zhib skabs ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje ’’zhes pa krung go yongs la khyab gsal gyi gnod skyon byung ba dngos 'brel red 'dug pa blo pham yid skyo'i rang bzhin yang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang / rtse pho brang po ta la/ gdan sa 'bras spungs dang / se ra/ bkra shis lhun po bcas la nyes skyon cher med pa dang / lhag par rtse pho brang po ta la'i gzim chung dang / gser gdung khag sogs rten dang brten par bcas la gnod skyon gang yang med pa dang / da dung glog bzhu gsar 'dzugs sogs sri zhu bdag gces sngar las lhag pa dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba dga' spro yi rangs byung / blo pham che shos shig la gdan sa ri bo dga' ldan rten dang brten pa bcas pa rtsa brlag gyang ro zing nger gyur 'dug pa shin tu blo pham chen po byung yang / da cha krung dbyang nas nyams gso 'go 'dzugs gnang ste mthun rkyen dngul gnang yod lugs thos pa yag po zhe drag red/ de 'brel 'grul lam khag yag po yod pa dang / lhag par lha sa grong khyer gyi lam chen de tsho zheng che la dkyus ring ba dang / g.yas g.yon du ljon shing dbyibs legs bstar bsgrigs dang / lcags ri phan tshun gyi nang las khungs khag dang / tshong khang / sbrag tar khang / 'grems ston khang / sman khang / slob grwa/ bzo grwa/ las byed pa'i sdod khang sogs bkod mdzes khang pa rgya khyon shin tu che ba mang po gsar rgyag gis lha sa grong khyer gyi rgya 263

khyon ni shar phyogs sgang stod dang / tshal gung thang nas nub phyogs mnyes thang lha chen po dang / shun gdong dkar yan dang / lho phyogs gyi grib tshe mchog gling nas byang dog sde dang nyang bran/ se ra'i dgon gsham bar bcas la grong sde gsar pas khengs shing grong khyer nang gi lam chen de tshor 'khor lo'i 'grul bzhud nyin mtshan zam ma chad par 'gro 'ong dang / mtshan mo glog bzhu'i 'od mdangs ri rgyud phan tshun la'ang khyab pa bcas lha sa ni sngar las lhag pa'i mdzes sdug ldan pa'i grong khyer zhig dngos 'brel rang chags 'dug phyogs mtshungs mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi sdod khang yang bod bzo bkod mdzes zhe mtshungs lam chen gyi g.yas g.yon du gsar rgyag byas dang byed bzhin pa de tsho'ang yul gyi mdzes sdug lta bu byung 'dug chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus phyag len gnang bas deng sang mdo khams dang / byang 'brog gtsang stod sogs phyogs gang sa nas 'byor pa'i phyogs 'grul bar skor rgyag mkhan sngar lha sa smon lam skabs kyi mi tshogs ltar dus gtan du nyin mtshan bar med dang / gtsug lag khang du mchod mjal ba zhogs pa snga po nas gral star sgrig ste nyin dgung slebs dus su'ang gral star bar skor phyi ma nas mjug ma 'gril ba 'tshang ga chen po dang / bar skor 'khor mo yug g.yas g.yon dang / khrom gzigs khang khrom rwa bcas par sha mar sngo tshal gyis mtshon pa'i bza' bca' dang / gzhan yang mkho dngos sna tshogs pa nyo tshong 'khrug po ha las dgos pa/mi tshogs 'du 'dzoms shin tu che zhing bskor bya ba dngos su mthong rgyu med kyang 'khrugs 'dzing byed pa ni ngos rang bar skor thengs mang phyin pa yin te mthong rigs ma byung / bar skabs chang rag btung ches pa'i rkyen gyis khams rigs kha shas nas chang 'thung ra ros kyis 'khrugs 'dzing gri 'dzugs byas lugs go thos tsam las deng sang ni khu sim zhod 'jags blo bag phebs pa 'dug lhag par lha ldan gtsug lag khang du zla ba yar ngo mar ngo gso sbyong dang / se 'bras 264

gnyis su'ang gso sbyong la phebs mkhan dge 'dun brgya phrag re tsam chag med dang / snga lo dbyar zhal bzhes kyang gnang thub byung song zhing / phran rang yang se ra tshogs chen du yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong la bcar mus dang / nye char gnas chung lcog kyang nyams gso gnang ste 'bras spungs bla ma dge 'dun dang / gnas grwa rnams gnas chung du lhan 'dzoms kyis mchod 'bul dang /bskang 'phrin gzab gsol gnang sar mang tshogs bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed dang bzhes thug ming btags sogs gra rten legs 'grigs byung lugs thos pa bcas rgyal bstan slar gso'i cha rkyen gang sa nas yar rgyas 'gro bzhin ma zad/ ring min chos phyogs kyi las don shugs bskyed kyis dbus gtsang gi gdan sa bzhi la dge 'dun gsar 'jug gis cha rkyen krung dbyang gzhung nas gnang rgyu yin lugs go thos byung ba phyag bzhes de tsho ni 'gro ba sems can thams cad la phan pa'i rlabs chen gyi mdzad pa bzang po zhig red/ mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba bar skabs lo mang ring dka' ngal ci che byung 'dug kyang /snga lo nas bzung dgos mkho gang ci rang 'dod ltar nyo tshong chog pa dang /lhag par rgyal khab kyi dpya khral dmigs bsal gyi chag yang gnang ba'i thugs rjes skye bo thams cad bde skyid kyi 'go tshugs pa lta bu byung 'dug pa bde skyid yun du gnas pa'i smon 'dun zhu rgyu yin/ shes yon slob sbyong gi thad/ bar skabs lo bcu phrag ring rgyal yongs la byus nyes kyis rkyen pas na gzhon rnams la slob sbyong 'thus shor chen po byung ste shes yon chu tshad je zhan du gyur kyang /deng skabs srid gzhung nas thugs 'khur che bzhes kyis yar rgyas 'gro bzhin pa 'dra/ thon skyed skor yang yar rgyas che shos shig ni se 'bras dgon gsham so sor shing tog ku shu'i sdong po stong phrag mang po btsugs pa rnams nas lo ltar 'bras bu tshong bsgyur gyis 'bab yong ha cang chen po byung 'dug de 'brel kong po'i nang nas shing 'bras ku shu mi 'dra ba mang po thon 'dug pa de 265

tsho ha las pa'i ro bcud ldan pa 'dug gzhan yang slob grwa 'bring ba dang /chung ba/ sman khang / zlos gar tshogs pa sogs khag mang po dang / kong po'i nang bzo grwa rgya che yod skad dang / thon skyed kyang yag po yod pa 'dra/ gus rang lha sa dang / se rar bsdad pa ma gtogs phyogs gzhan la ma phyin stabs da bar mthong thos byung ba de tsam zhig yin/ ngos rang zla drug tsam nas phyir log bya rgyu yin kyang re 'dun snyan seng zhus pa'i khongs nas don tshan gnyis kyi bka' gsal sgug sdod dang / phyogs gcig nas rgya gar dang / bal yul khul nas phrag dog can gyi mi re zung nas dkrog gtam ched bzos kyis tshags par bkram rkyen phru gu tshang ma blo pham yid skyo'i gnas gyar gyis pā lags khyed rang rang yul la bzhugs pa legs gnas zhes nan brjod byed pa dang / deng dus chos dad rang mos dngos 'brel lag bstar chog pa dang / 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen bu phrug rnams nas ma chad pa gso skyong gis deng sang se ra chos sding du sdod mus su sa chu 'phrod cing / dge sbyor 'phel ba gang legs su yod/deng skabs krung dbyang gi srid jus sngar bas kyang yang dag pa bden pa bden thub yod pa ma zad/ lhag par 'gro 'ong rang mos yin tsang / rgya gar rlung 'phrin las khungs nas gus pa'i phogs dngul zhu bsdad rnams len par gus rang rgya gar du lan gcig phyir log ma byas thabs med bcas kyi gnas tshul mdor bsdus su/ dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis 1981lo'i zla 3tshes la phul ’’zhes so/2 se na chos sding sgang gzim khang ser po nyams gso gsan rgyag byas pa/kha sngon phran blo bstan shag lho nas chos sding sgang du spos te nyin shas song rjes chos sding rgyud khang dkon gnyer bgres song dgung lo brgyad cur phebs 266

pa'i 'bras sgo mang dge bshes sog po ye shes sbyin pa lags (tshe ring rnam rgyal yang zer )nas phran la gsung gsal/ ‘‘chos sding rje'i sgrub khang zhig ral du gyur pa'i gyang gog de'i nang nga rang gis rnam rgyal mchod rten zhig gsar bzhengs byas chog pa zhes se ra'i kru'u ren la zhus te lo gnyis tsam song yang gong rim la snyan seng zhus chog ces bshad pa las chog mchan bka' 'khrol ma byung bas khyed kyis bka' 'khrol yong thabs kyi rogs ram byed dgos ’’gsungs par/ phran gyis ‘‘mchod rten bzhengs rgyu yag po red de sgrub khang rang nyams gso byas pa legs ’’lugs zhus par ‘‘de 'dra'i nyams gso zhu ba'i dpal 'byor nga rang la mi 'dug ’’zer/ mchod rten bzhengs rgyu'i dngul rang sger nas go sgrig thog dad sbyin khag la dge bskul zhus nas nyams gso thub na dge mtshan che lugs zhus kyang / ‘‘mchod rten rang bzhengs thub pa dgos shing / dge bshes seng ge lags kyis kyang khyed rang gis srid gzhung la snyan seng zhus na bka' 'khrol yong gi red gsungs byung bas sku mkhyen ’’zhes gsung gi 'dug pas/ phran rang dge bshes seng ge lags sku mdun du bcar te gnas lugs zhus par dge bshes lags kyis ‘‘khyed kyi gsungs pa de rang red/ sgrub khang sngar yod ji bzhin nyams gso thub na ha cang yag po yong nges red/ khyed rang gis srid gzhung la snyan seng zhus na bka' 'khrol thob kyi red ’’ces gsungs byung / ngos rang la nyams gso zhu dmigs gang yang med na'ang / rje tsong kha pa chen pos phyag btab ste lo mang gtan bzhugs mdzad pa'i sgrub khang rtsa chen de lta bu nyams gso gsar rgyag zhu thub na rang gzhan tshang mar legs tshogs dge mtshan che nges snyam ste lha sa grong khyer 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs brgyud snyan seng zhus par/ zhu'i pu'u krang gis ‘‘chos dad rang mos la song de don nyams gso byas 'thus kyang / khyed rang la 'gro gron gtong dmigs yod dam ’’zhes dris byung bas/ nga rang la 'gro gron 267

gtong dmigs med kyang phru gu tsho dang / dad sbyin khag la dge bskul byas na 'grig rgyu zhus par/ khong gis ‘‘ma gzhi dge bskul byas na'ang sbyin bdag gi 'tsho bar mi gnod pa zhig dgos gal che zhing / dad sbyin 'ga' zhig gis rang la dngul ji yod dgon pa sogs kyi zhal 'debs la phul te rang nyid sprang po chags 'dug pa de rigs mi 'byung ba dgos rgyu dang / se ra dgon par krung dbyang gis mthun rkyen rogs dngul gnang yod gshis de khongs nas rogs ram gang yong byed rgyu'i mngags gtam byas chog ri’gsungs par thugs rje che zhus/ spyi lo 1981lo'i zla 2tshes 24bod lcags bya zla dang po'i tshes nyi shu nyis brtsegs nyin zhu'i pu'u krang dang / las byed pa gsum/ se ra'i kru'u ren dkon mchog dar rgyas lags bcas chos sding sgang du ched phebs kyis sgrub khang sa shul la gzigs skor gnang ste zhu'i pu'u krang gis dgon pa'i 'ul mi tshos sa bshang 'go 'dzugs 'phral du rogs ram gnang dgos gsungs song bar kru'u ren lags nas nyin lnga drug 'gyangs med byas 'thus gsungs pa bcas bsam don 'grub rgyu'i dga' tshor gyis tshang mar thugs rje che zhes zhus/ de rjes se ra'i kru'u ren lags kyis dmangs 'ul gnangs gzhes gang rung la btang 'thus gsungs par sang nyin tshes cha bzang bas gtong thabs e yod zhus par de don 'grig rgyu zhes gsungs don/ 1981lo'i zla 3tshes 1lcags bya zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga nyin gyi snga dro se ra dgon gyi las byed pho mo mi grangs sum cu so lnga chos sding du 'byor par rten 'byung ched tshang mar gsol ja dang / 'bras sil tshal skyogs gang re bstab ste sa bshang las 'go btsugs/nyin dgung zhal lag sha 'bras btang / mi rer legs skyes sgor re phul/268

dkon gnyer dge bshes sbyin pa lags nas kyang mi rer sgor re gnang song /dge bshes seng ge lags nas gsol ja gsol mar dang / dngul sgor brgya tham pa zhal 'debs gsol ras stsal cing dgyes mnyes chen pos dge bskul rogs ram gang thub zhus chog ces zhal bzhes bzang po thob/ de'i sang nyin mi grangs gong gsal nas mu mthud bshang brgyab/ de'i sang nyin nas ser dgon grwa shag nyams gso zhu bya mang bas 'ul mi rnams khom lcogs ma byung stabs nga rang blo bstan dang / dge gzhon spun bstan 'dzin/ lho kha ba rdo bzo bstan rdor/ lto skor gnas skor ba nag chu o rog dman bsod nams lha mo ma mas gnyis bcas nas nyin bstud de sa bshang byas/ se rar chos mjal du yong mkhan khongs nas kha shas kyis kyang zhal 'debs lta bur nyin re zung las kar yong mkhan yang byung / de nas rtsigs rdo gra sgrig dang bcas grong khyer lha sa'i 'dzugs skrun ru khag khongs rdo gshags pa tshe ring nor bu dang /lhag pa tshe ring / nyang bran ru khag gsum pa'i nyi ma tshe ring dang / bkra shis chos dar/ tshe ring don grub/ bstan pa rab rgyas bcas nas rtsigs rdo gshags las kyi las 'go btsugs pa dang / sa bshangs kyang lam tsam zin nas lcags ri rgyag byed sa phag rgyag 'go btsugs te rdo bzo lho kha ba rdor bstan gyis 'go khrid de yangs pa can chus zam gsar ru khag khongs rdor nor can mi bcu ched glas kyis sa phag brgyab/ shing bzo bstan 'dzin don grub dang / bsod nams/ dge slong / pad rdor bcas nas sgo sge'u khung sogs bzo 'go btsugs te sa rdo shing gsum legs par gra sgrig zin pa dang se ra dgon pa nas las rogs gtong gnang yod pa zhus te sngon ma'i mi grangs 269
