35las 'byor dang bcas pa nas dngos gzhi'i ar las tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyis byas te nyin nyi shu'i nang mchod khang mdo sbug dang / rje'i gzims spyod bcas sngar yod ji ma ji bzhin sor bzhag gsar bzhengs zhu thub pa byung bas rdo shing 'ul mi bcas par ar ston legs skyes kyang mi dman pa bstab/ rje'i sgrub khang gi nang rten rnams sngar bzhin ldebs bris bzhengs rgyur brten bod lugs ldebs zhal dgos stabs sngar gyi lag rgyun ldan pa'i zhal dpon lha sa ba mtshams lags dang / nyi ma lags gnyis dang / lag g.yog pad+ma tshe ring /mtshams/ sgrol dkar/ dpal ldan/ bstan 'dzin/ tshe 'dzin/ 'chi med sgrol dkar/ rdo rje sgrol dkar/ dbyangs can/ a ma sgrol dkar/ tshe ring sgrol dkar/ zla ba lags/ a cag pad+ma/ rdo rje g.yu sgron/ rdo rje mgon po bcas nas dang bas kun blangs kyis ldebs zhal spus dag byung zhing / khong tshos zhabs gla zhu ma dgos gsungs par ja chang / gsol tshigs gzab rgyas bshams te tshang mar legs skyes kyi dngul dang kha btags re phul/ de nas zhal ba skam thag chod mtshams ldebs bris kyi gra sgrig zhu phyir lha bris mkhas pa dbu che rig 'dzin dpal 'byor lags su skyabs 'jug zhus par khong gis gsungs gsal la/ nga rang gzugs gzhi rgyun gcong la brten sman bcos dang / gnyen 'phrad chabs cig rgya gar du 'gro rgyu'i lag 'khyer zhus thon zin pas lo rjes mar phan thogs yod na bcar 'thus dang / de min gzhan dag la gsung na legs lugs gsungs byung bar khyed nyid rgya gar nas phyir phebs ma byung bar sgug sdod zhu rgyur dgongs 'jags yod pa zhus kyang / stes dbang gis skabs der bal bod dbar gyi mdza' grogs zam chen chus khyer te phar 270

tshur 'gro 'ong chad stabs lha bris dbu che rig 'dzin dpal 'byor lags nas ldebs bris dbu 'dzugs gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes thob pa ltar lam seng gra sgrig byas nas dbu che rig 'dzin dpal 'byor lags dang / dbu che bkra shis tshe ring lags/ de min snyan grags dang / blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ rig dpal lags kyi bu rgan pa 'a jigs med/ bu gzhon pa bkra shis rdo rje/ gzhan yang thub bstan/ byams pa skal bzang / thub bstan ye shes/ kun bzang rnam rgyal/ lhags pa/ byams pa ye shes/ bsod nams mig dmar/ tshe ring dgra 'dul/ pad+ma lhun grub/ mtshams lags bcas nas las rgyun nyin nyer bzhi la legs grub byung zhing / nyin re'i gsol chas phran dge slong blo bstan nas gzab 'bul zhus pa dang / nyin re'i gla cha ji thob se ra dgon pa nas gnang / tshang mar thugs rje legs 'bul gyi gsol ston dang legs skyes dar dngul phul bar dgyes mnyes byung song / dbu che rig dpal lags nas da res kyi ldebs bris zhib tshags zhal thang dbyer med zhus yod gsungs/ sngar sgrubakhang la lcags ri med kyang da lam 'og gzhi gang 'tsham bar rdo brtsigs dang / de'i steng sa phag bzhi brtsegs kyi dpangs la mtho tshad kung khre 3nas/dma' tshad kung khre 1 50byas pa/ lho phyogs su nub nas shar bar kung khre 12dang / nub phyogs su lho nas byang bar kung khre 12 byang phyogs su nub nas shar bar kung khre 3 50bcas yod pa gsar rgyag zhus/ sgrub khang gi thog ras dang / dbu thod bla bred sman brtse'i gsham bu byas pa gnyis gsar btsems byas/ dgon pa nas rtsal ba mdun bsgrig cha sgam gser shog ma kha rnying gcig dang / khri ma lcog gcig lcog tse hang dkrol rag shog rtsi ser 271

nar mo gcig rag gi mchod kong rgyun 'dzugs dpangs la mtho gang tsam yod pa gcig khro'i mchod kong dpangs la mtho gang tsam byas pa gcigagasung rten brgyad stong pa pod gcig sge'u khung khag gi khra yol dang / sgo sge'i gsham bu/ thog steng rgyal mtshan ser po rag tog 'byar ba gcig bcas kru'u ren dkon mchog dar rgyas lags nas thugs 'khur che bzhes kyis skyabs 'jug thob/ phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin nas gsang 'dus dang / bde mchog gtso bor bzhugs pa'i sku thang gong gsham rnying song gcig dang / zangs dmar gyi chu ring kha zheng la sor bzhi tsam byas pa ngo grangs bcu gcig dang / mkhar gsil gcig rang gi me kong bcu/ rtsa 'bol ras sngon 'thum ldan lcags ri ras dmar byas pa kha gsar cha gnyis/ glog mchod shel tog bcu gnyis thag bcas rang 'grigs/ phyag drung dge bsnyen lcang lho tshe brtan nor rgyas lags nas phul ba lcags kyi lhung bzed gcig smar khams dbang phyug nas phul ba rdza'i 'khor yug rgyun 'dzugs g.yu rtsi ser po che ba gcig bcas de ltar rje'i grub khang rten dang brten par khor yug lcags ri dang bcas pa gsar bzhengs gegs med legs 'grub byung zhing / gza' tshes dge bar mang thos 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po dge ba'i bshes gnyen seng ge rin po che gdan zhus kyis gus blo bstan chog grwa bcas nas khrus gsol rab gnas dang 'brel bla mchod tshogs 'bul dang / mkhas grub bye ba'i 'byung gnas se ra theg chen gling tshogs chen rten mchog spyan sngar sna lnga'i mchod sprin dang / dge 'dun 'dus tshogs su bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed 'bul lam zhus pa dang 'brel dad ldan sbyin bdag 'brel thogs las mi dang bcas pa'i 272

mtshan tho tshogs gzhung du snyan sgron zhus te de rnams kyis gtsos mar gyur sems can thams cad gyi nyes ltung sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang zhing dag nas rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phangs rin po che myur du thob pa sogs kyi thugs smon skyabs 'jug zhus pa dang / rang nyid nas kyang dge rtsa ci mchis 'gro kun don du byang chub thob phyir bsngos pa bcas sbyor dngos rjes gtsang bsam don lhun grub dga' bde smra brjod las 'das pa thob cing / thog ma'i bsam par rje'i sgrub khang du rang nyid khu sim ngang mtshams bsnyen sgrub tu sdod rgyu'i 'dun pa yod kyang mchod mjal du yong mi mang bas kha ya bya rgyu kho nas kha 'don byed khoms med pa lta bu dang / sger gyis mchod khang 'dzin rgyu deng gi srid jus dang mi mthun pa'i gnas tshul la bsams sgrub khang rten dang brten par bcas pa ser dgon pa rang nas 'dzin skyong gis dkon gnyer ched 'dzugs gnang rogs zhus par/ kru'u ren dkon mchog dar rgyas lags nas de don zhal bzhes gnang yang zla ba kha shas ring ngos rang nas dkon gnyer mi byed thabs med byung / rjes sor dga' ldan dgon gyi gtsang tog lung khrang nas se ra dgon par btang 'byor khongs nas dge blo bzang dbang phyug la rgyud khang dkon gnyer gcig lcogs bsko gzhag gnang bas nga rang rgyud khang yang steng du blo bde bag phebs kyi kha 'don byas nas sdod rgyu'i go skabs thob/3 rje'i sgrub khang nyams gsor zhal 'debs 'bul mi khag gi mtshan tho dang / se ra tshogs chen du bsnyen bkur zhus pa'i skyabs tho sogs gsham gsal/spyi lo 1981zla 2tshes 24bod rab byung bcu drug pa lcags bya zla 1tshes 273
ṭ+wāṃṅgi n+ti~X shāṭā spyibye py-i pro/sa kānyizlo/
ṭ+wāṃ ṭaṃ twe /༷ spya/ mabye n+tu ngh+rubye byebyeX dkar gyi ched/
chos 'bum snerno— ts+tshaṅge ṅgeṅge/
twe twe bye tram̐X zlordoX /gā bye kālha ༵gyuṭā
hūm̐ ༷ṭ+wāṃ na/ ༷/ py-izlos 'asmerngo medz+wa bye
lja dwot+t+waṃtwe ༷ṭ+wāṃ ///ḍi ṭ+wāṃXd/ / na~Xṭī
ṭaṃ/rdo/ ༷ skre da /༷ ṅgerdo /

dang / rdo shing / 'ul mi/ lha 'bri/ rdo bshags/ zhal dpon/ lag g.yog dang bcas pa rnams kyi mtshan tho zur gsal 'dus tshogs su snyan sgron zhus pa de rnams kyis gtsos 'das gson 'brel thogs dang bcas pa'i mi 'dod nyer 'tshe zhi zhing / tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang / mar gyur sems can thams cad kyis tshe rabs 'phreng bar bsags pa'i nyes ltung sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang zhing dag nas rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phangs rin po che bde blag myur du 'thob pa sogs gong du gsol ba btab pa'i re 'bras rnams de de bzhin du 'grub pa'i thugs smon skyabs 'jug brtse bas gzigs pa mkhyen/mkhyen/ mkhyen/ zhes gsol ba 'debs pa lags/’’bsngo zhu/zhwa ser bstan pa'i gsal byed dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gdong lnga'i mtshan can mchog gi zhabs kyi pad+mo'i drung du/sgo gsum rab gus se ra chos sding rje'i sgrub khang nyams gso'i do dam las byed thun mong nas rje'i sgrub khang rten dang brten par bcas pa nyams gso gsar rgyag gegs med lam lhong legs grub kyi gtang rag mtshon byed du tshogs chen rten mchog spyan sngar sna lnga'i chod sprin brgya tshar dang / dge 'dun 'dus tshogs su bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed/dgon pa'i sri zhu ba pho mo rnams la phyed 'gyed bcas dad gus spro gsum gyis phul ba lags na/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi rim pa rgya gang che skyabs 'jug brtse bas gzigs pa mkhyen/ mkhyen zhes gsol 'debs rten lha reg dang / sgor lnga bcas gus phyag gis phul/’’dbu mdzad lagasasu 'don bskulaskubs zhu/‘‘skyabs gnas dbu mdzad rin po cher/281

sgo gsum rab gus se ra chos sding rje'i sgrub khang nyams gso'i do dam las byed thun mong nas sgrub khang nyams gso gsar rgyag rten dang brten par bcas pa gegs med legs grub kyi gtang rag mtshon byed du gdan sa theg chen gling tshogs chen rten mchog spyan sngar sna lnga'i mchod sprin brgya tshar dang / 'dus tshogs su bsnyen bkur ma/nga 'gyed bcas 'bul lam zhus pa lags na/ zhal 'don gnas bcu dang / bstan 'bar ma sogs gsung bskul skyabs 'jug yod pa zhu rten lha reg dang / sgor gsum bcas gus pas phul/mi’4 ja ston sogs bzhugs mol chogs 'du khag la zhugs skabs spel ba'i gtam bshad dang / gong rim la snga rting du phul ba'i snyan zhu/(1)srid jus don 'khrol skor gyi snyan zhu/spyi lo 1981lo'i zla 10tshes 23nyin grong khyer lha sa 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs su srid jus don 'khyol gyi zhabs bskul dang / rgya gar rlung 'phrin las khungs nas phogs dngul zhu bsdad rnams rgya gar du bca' bzhugs krung go'i gzhung tshab chen mo brgyud bka' mol yong thabs zhus skor yi ge phul ba gsham gsal/‘‘se ra chos sding du sdod pa dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin nas bde sdug thung tsam zhu rgyur/ krung go rgyal khab nas sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi srid jus phyag bzhes bstar dang bstar bzhin gyi dril bsgrags 'dzam gling yongs su khyab pa gnang ba ltar ngos rang snga lo rgya gar nas bal yul brgyud rang yul du 'byor te srid jus don 'khyol yong ba'i re 'dun 282

lasrid gzhung nas thugs 'khur che bzhes gnang rgyur yid ches kyis snga lo re 'dun tshig tho shog lho don tshan gsum 'khod gcig 'bul lam zhus par don tshan dang po bu mo chung ba'i them tho bsgyur rgyu gcig pu'i yig cha gnang son de yang za 'bru'i yi ge ma thob par bsdad yod/ don tshan gnyis pa rang khyim khang pa zhol do po phyir slog skor snga 'phros khang pa'i shar brgyud rnams rtsis len byas 'thus gsungs kyang / da lta sdod mkhan nas spo shugs byed min zhes ka kor kho nar lus yod/ don tshan gsum pa phran rang zing 'khrugs nang med nges la brten mkhar dbang phyir slog zhus skor da lta gang yang ma byung ba bcas da bar lo gcig zla ba bzhi tsam song ba re sgug zhu mus kyi nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen bu phrug tshos phran bu re sprad pa de rnams za mkhas 'thung mkhas byas kyang goms gshis lang shor gyi sha mar nyo rin gcig pu yang ldeng min la brten rgya gar rlung 'phrin las khungs nas nga'i phogs 'phar gsog dngul zhu bsdad rnams rtsis len du ma bskyod thabs med lags kyang dgongs mnga' ltar snga 'khros rgya gar la 'gro rgyu nyen 'gan shin tu che ba'i gnas su gyar stabs/ rgya gar du bca' bzhugs krung go'i gzhung tshab chen mo brgyud rgya gar gzhung la bka' mol gyis gus pa'i phogs dngul bzhes thabs byung na nga'i dka' ngal sel bar phan thogs chen po yong ba 'dug na de don bka' mol gnang phyogs yod pa zhu rgyu dang / de mtshungs re 'dun don tshan gsum po'i re 'bras kyang 'phral du lag son yong ba'i thugs 'khur gzab bzhes gnang skyong zhu rgyu'i zhu shog tu/dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis 1981lo'i zla 10tshes 23la phul ’’zhes pa/ (lha sa grong khyer 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u krang zhu'i li lags brgyud phul/(2)1981lo'i zla 12tshes 19nyin grong khyer lha sa khreng kon chus kyi ja ston thog283

gong tshes nyin grong khyer lha sa khreng kon chus nas ja ston dang 'brel ba'i bzhugs mol tshogs 'dur yong dgos kyi brda lan 'byor ba bzhin bcar bas/ phyi rgyal nas phyir log gi lha sar sdod mi lnga dang / khreng kon chus kyi chus krang tshe ring phun tshogs lags dang / khreng kon chus 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u yi pu'u krang tshe ring sgrol ma lags nas gtso skyong gis byang phyogs don gcod dang / grong lhan 'thus mi bcas mnyam 'dzoms thog chus krang tshe ring phun tshogs lags nas deng dus krung dbyang gi mdzad phyogs bar skabs dang mi 'dra ba dngos thog bden 'tshol kyi phyag bzhes bstar lugs dang / grong khyer nang yar rgyas 'gro tshul sogs gsung bshad gnang / phyi rgyal nas yong ba'i nga tsho mi lnga po tshang mas bsam 'char lo rgyus mdor bsdus re zhus/ pu'u krang tshe ring sgrol ma lags nas gsung bshad gnang / khong gis gsung gsal/‘‘khyed rnam rgyal gces pa yin gshis srid gzhung gi mdzad phyogs gang cir dge skyon gsal bshad kyi legs skyes 'bul dgos ’’zhes gsungs pa ltar bsam 'char phul ba gsham gsal/‘‘rgya gar nas mes rgyal du phyir log yong nas se ra chos sding la sdod pa dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin nas dpyad gzhi legs skyes bsam 'char 'bul rgyur/ snga lo 1981lo'i zla 12tshes 19nyin grong khyer lha sa'i sne len las khungs nas bsdu bskong gnang ba'i phyi rgyal nas mes rgyal du phyir log yong ba'i gus tsho mi lnga dang / 'brel yod las khungs khag gi sku tshab bcas bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i skabs phan tshun mdza' brtse'i dgongs 'char lhug por gsung res dang 'brel sku tshab rnam pa'i gsung bshad kyi snying don du mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes rig ldan pa bcas kyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun la sman pa'i khyed tshos sems stobs che bskyed kyis legs skyes 'bul thub pa dgos rgyu'i 'bod bskul nan tan gnang byung bas/ phran lo na rgas pa dang /gzugs po rgyun gcong la brten lus po'i thog nas rgyal khab dang mi dmangs 284

la sri zhu legs skyes 'bul ma thub kyang / rgyal gces lhag bsam rnam dag gi mdzes zol med pa'i bsam 'char zhus na/ sngar gyi lo rgyus la'ang rgya bod mdza' mthun bde skyid gang legs byung yod pa dang / da cha'ang phu nu lta bu'i 'du shes bzung nas krung dbyang gis mdzub ston gnang ba'i mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes rig ldan pa bcas kyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed dgos pa'i byams brtse'i bka' slob bka' drin chen po gzi brjid can gyi dgongs don myur mgyogs byed pa'i dus tshod la slebs yod pa red/ des na rgyal khab su dang su yin yang mi dmangs kyis rgyal khab kyi bya ba la dga' mol dang yid ches yod pa zhig dgos pa de shin tu gal chen po red/ der brten gong gsal bka' slob don tshan gsum ldan gyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun de chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus thog nas legs bsgrub thub pa'i dge mtshan che bar mngon zhing / de yang bod mi rnams chos la dad pa ha cang chen po byed pa'i goms gshis yod stabs sngar lha sa'i cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo zhes 'char can bod zla dang po'i nang gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum gyis gtsos dge 'dun stong phrag nyi shu brgal bas lha sa gtsug lag khang du smon lam nyin nyer gcig ring tshugs kyi red/ de'i skabs sa thag ring po nas kyang smon lam mjal bar ched du yong nas mchod 'bul dang / bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed 'bul mkhan mang ba bcas kyi rten 'brel 'grigs pa lta bus mi tshang ma mthun po dang / zhing 'brog khul dkar chu lo legs byung thub pa mngon sum myong bas grub pa zhig yin gshis/ des na lha sa'i smon lam sngar bzhin ma byung rung / nyin bcu gnyis tsam tshugs na'ang 'grigs gshis/ de ltar phyag bzhes gnang thub pa byung na bod rigs mi dmangs rnams kyis dga' mos chen po byed rgyu ma zad/ rgyal khab kyi mtshan snyan gong mthor 'gro rgyu dang / spyi don la phan nus ha cang chen po yong rgyu dang / rgyal khab phyi nang bod rigs tshang ma dga' mgu yi rang gis mes po'i rgyal khab la bcos min gyi dga' zhen 285

chen po yong nges bcas kyi dge mtshan d+ngha'adug snyam pa lags na/ gus pa'i bsam 'char lhug zhu'i legs skyes 'di dag gong rim dbu khrid la spyan zhur 'bul gnang zhu rgyu dang / 'di dag dge mtshan du gzigs te phyag bzhes bstar rgyu dang / da dung dge skyon ji yod mno bsam zhib btang gis zol med rim zhus chog pa/ dge mtshan mchis min dgongs bzhes gnang skyong zhu rgyu'i lhag bsam zol med kyi bsam shog tu dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis 1982lo'i zla 1tshes 28la phul/’’(3)1982lo'i zla2tshes 18nyin phyir log bod rigs spun zla'i sne len khang gi ja ston thogabod rang skyong ljongs nas ched 'dzugs mdzad pa'i phyir log bod rigs spun zla'i sne len las khungs nas/ bod chu khyi gnam lo gsar tshes la bsu ba zhu ba'i ja ston tshogs 'dur/ 1982lo'i zla 2tshes 19nyin mgron 'bod gnang ba ltar bcar zhing / tshogs 'du'i sar gtam bshad byed dgos gsungs pa bzhin mdor bsdus zhus pa gsham gsal/‘‘dbu khrid rnam pa dang / blo mthun rnam pa lhan rgyas la zhu rgyur/ 'char la nye ba'i bod chu khyi gnam lo gsar tshes la bsu ba zhu ched sne len’las khungs nas ja ston tshogs 'du ched gnyer gyis mgron 'bod gnang ba bzhin ngas spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang chu khyi gnam lo gsar tshes la bsu ba zhu rgyu dang 'brel lhan rgyas tshang mar bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob pa nas bzung krung dbyang gis bod la 'dzugs skrun sogs gang ci yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i phyag bzhes rim par gnang mus de ltar yang / rkyen ngan bar chad kyi 1959lo lha sar zing 'khrugs langs pa dang / de rjes rgyal yongs khyon la ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje ’’zhes pa dang / ‘‘mi bzhi shog kha'i ’’dbang bsgyur gyis dus skabs bcas su tang gi srid jus la'ang 'gyur ba btang ste ming 286

'dogs sna tshogs kyis rgyal yongs khyab khongs tshang mar chab srid nyam chags chen pos mi dmangs smos ci/ mdzad rjes che ba'i krung dbyang gi dbu khrid dang / rim pa khag gi 'go khrid che chung dang / shes yon can sogs mchog dman gyi skye bo thams cad tshabs che'i sdug bsngal mnar gcod kyi duḥkha nyin mtshan mi 'khyol ba zhig myong dgos byung ba tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar 'dir zhu ma dgos/ 'on kyang de rjes tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs pa nas bzung sdug bsngal gyi mun pa de je dwangs su song ba'i thog la deng dus krung dbyang gi dbu khrid mdzad gtso rnam pas mkhas mdzangs rlabs chen gyi mdzad 'khur bskyangs pa la brten nas khyon yongs la bde skyid kyi 'go tshugs yod pa dang / lhag par du bod la dmigs bsal gyi gzigs skyong chen pos chos dad rang mos dang /zhing 'brog gnyis nas lo gsum gyi ring rgyal khab kyi dpya khral yang 'bul ma dgos pa'i byams gzigs bka' drin bla med du che bar brten mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas phyin te zhing 'brog khul du rang rang gi khang pa gsar rgyag dang / 'dzin chas dgos mkho gsar bsgrigs/ gyon chas gsar nyo bcas blo bag phebs po'i 'tsho ba skyel 'go tshugs 'dug de 'brel nga tsho phyi rgyal nas rang yul du phyir log yong mkhan tsho'ang 'byor gdong sne len dang 'brel rang gi 'jon thang la gzhigs pa'i las phogs sprod pa/ ngos rang lo rgas lus gcong gis las ka ma thub par dgongs pa zhus pa ma gtogs 'dod mos kyi las ka byas 'thus kyi bka' bzang thob pa/ rang khyim khang pa dang /'tsho ba'i bkod sgrig gi lag sne/ lo ltar lo gsar la dmigs bsal gyi zur gsos gsol ras bcas thugs brtse chen pos thugs 'khur che bzhes kyi bka' drin stsal bar thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / da cha nga tshos krung dbyang gi bka' slob dgongs don mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes rig ldan pa bcas 287

kyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun myur mgyogs byed thub par tshang mas 'bad brtson hur bskyed gnang skyong zhes re 'dun zhu rgyu ma zad/ da lta'i rgyal khab kyi srid jus la 'gyur ba med pa sra brtan yong ba dang / krung hwa mi rigs thams cad mthun sgril chen po dang / rgyal khab kyi dbu khrid rnam pa sku khams bzang zhing kun phan gyi las don khag thugs bzhed ltar 'grub pa/ bye brag bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mdzad gtso dbu khrid rnam pa dang / las byed blo mthun rnam pa sku khams bzang zhing mdza' brtse dam zab kyi las don yid bsam ltar lhun gyis 'grub pa bcas kyi smon 'dun zhu rgyu yin ’’zhes zhus/(4)1983lo'i zla 12tshes 5nyin bod rang skyong ljongs la snyan shog cig phulab/‘‘krung gung bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud dang / mi dmangs srid gzhung gi dbu khrid mdzad gtso rnam pa lhan rgyas mchog la/ snyan seng zhu rgyur/gus phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin spyi lo 1980lo phyi rgyal nas mes rgyal du phyir log gis lha sar gzhis chags gtan sdod byas par srid gzhung nas gzigs skyong gis 'dod mos las ka byas 'thus gsungs kyang gzugs po rgyun gcong la brten kha 'don byas te bsdad chog pa dang / 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen thad de sngon rgya gar gzhung gi rlung 'phrin las khungs nang las ka byas pa'i phogs dngul len rgyu yod pa de dag gis mi ldeng ba med zhus te se ra chos sding du chos dad rang mos la longs su spyad de sdod rgyu byung / snga lo gus pa lho kha khul gnas mjal la bskyod ring srid gzhung nas dmigs bsal gzigs bskyangs kyis gus par lha sa grong khyer srid gros u yon bsko gzhag bka' drin che 'dug kyang / kha 'don khas len mang bas las 'khur rtag bcar zhu thub thabs med rkyen phogs thob gsol ras zhus med/ ngos pha bu gnyis kyi 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen dmigs sgo rgya gar gzhung gi rlung 'phrin las khungs nas nga'i 288

phogs 'phar hin sgor stong phrag drug cu tsam zhu bsdad rnams len par gus rang rgya gar du 'gro rgyur zla ba drug ring dgongs 'khrol yong ba zhes snga lo ljongs phyi 'brel las khungs su snyan seng zhus te da cha chog mchan lag khyer thon nyer yod kyang / gus pas mes rgyal la dga' zhen gyis rang yul la phyir log thog tang dang srid gzhung gi srid jus bzang po dang / bod la 'dzugs skrun yar rgyas byung tshul/ chos dad rang mos sogs dngos yod gnas tshul bshad pa rlung 'phrin nang khyab bsgrags thengs kha shas byas par bod mi rmongs zhen can rnams ma dga' bar phran la mar khe se'i dge slong zhes ming btags pa dang / ‘‘kas khyod kha bde po zhe drag byed rgyu bzhag na dga' gi red/ sdug srog dang bral yong nga' ’’zer ba sogs snyad bsko kha brdung gtong mkhan yang kha shas byung ste srog mgo mi thon pa lta bu'i gnas gyar dang / rgya gar du yod pa'i yul gyar srid gzhung dang / bod mi tshos ‘‘phran la mi ngan khram pa rgyal tshong pa ’’zhes ming btags pa dang / lha sar phran bsad tshar lugs sogs dkrog gtam khyab spel dang / rang dbang gsar shog ces pa'i nang khyab bsgrags byas pa rgya bal khul khyab gdal byung 'dug stabs bde 'jags la nyen 'gan ha cang che bas rgya gar la 'gro rgyu rtsa ba nas 'grigs min zhes phru gu tshos kyang dgag cha byed pa dang / grong khyer 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs kyi dbu khrid blo mthun rnam pas kyang thugs brtse chen pos tang gi mdzad phyogs bka' slob lhug gsungs bcas la bsam gzhigs gis phogs dngul de skor ma 'ongs dus bstun snyan seng zhu rgyur bzhag ste da cha rgya gar la 'gro rgyu phyir 'then byas pa yin/ 'on kyang nga rang dang / bu mo skra bzang gnyis kyi 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen da bar phru gu tshos rogs phan gang yong byas kyang mi gnyis kyi 'tsho snon bu lon blangs pa mi dmangs shog sgor nyis stong brgal ba sprod dmigs med pa dang / rgya gar la'ang dga' nye khag la nyin sgor stong phrag 289

dgu lhag tsam sprod rgyur bsdad pa dang bcas dngul bun sprod dmigs rgya gar gyi dngul de rang las med gshis/ des na 1980lor ngas re 'dun zhus pa ltar phran zing 'khrugs nang med stabs srid jus don 'khyol gyis nga'i mkhar dngos phyir slog zhu 'os pa dang / gnang 'os pa zhig yin na'ang / mdzad dka' u tshugs zhu gi min/ zhu don snying po ni/ ngas mes rgyal la kha zhe med pa'i dga' zhen dang / tang gi srid jus la yid ches byas te mes rgyal gyi pang du log nas mdzes zol med pa'i khyab bsgrags dang / lus ngag yid gsum tang dang srid gzhung la 'bul mkhan rgyal gces pa dngos 'brel zhig la dgongs te dngul bun sprod thub pa'i don phan gyi rogs ram gnang skyong zhu rgyu dang gcig lhag par du gus pa'i bu mo skra bzang rang lo nyer bzhi la slebs pa skyes sbyangs kyi yon tan dman yang gzugs gzhi bde thang dang / las kar hur brtson che ba yod lags na rgyal khab kyi las khungs shig gi zhabs zhu 'khos dpag ma byan nam/ gad pa'am/ sgo srung gang rung zhig gi las ka'i khongs tshud pa'i skyabs 'jug gnang skyong zhu rgyu dang gnyis bcas gong gsol don tshan gnyis po don smin skyabs 'jug gis bka' gsal 'phral stsol thugs rje brtse gzigs zhu rgyu yin/dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis gus 'dud bcas 1983lo'i zla 12tshes 5la phul ’’zhes rgya bod gnyis kyi yig thog nas zhu'i pu'u krang brgyud phul/ (5)1984lo'i zla 2tshes 15nyin srid jus don 'khrol skor blar yang snyan shog phul ba/gong tshes nyin grong khyer lha sa'i srid gros kyi kru'u zhi sku gzhon rtsom sgyur tshan pa'i dbu khrid phun khang tshe ring phun tshogs mchog nas gsungs gsal/‘‘dge slong lags rang gi srid jus don 'khyol skor bsam gzhig legs btang gis bskyar du mdzad bde'i snyan shog cig bris 'bul zhu dgos ’riphebs par/290

‘‘phran gyi snyan zhu snga rjes phul te zhal bzhes bzang thob la zhabs bskul zhu mus yin/ da lta snyan zhu bskyar du 'bul gyi min ’rizhus par/ ‘‘de 'dra ma zer khyed rang rgyal gces mi sna yin gshis bsam shes rgyab skyor zhu rogs byas chog ’’gsungs pa bzhin bskyar snyan phul ba gsham gsal/‘‘1980lor phyi rgyal nas mes rgyal rang yul du log ste se ra chos sding du sdod pa'i dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin nas snyan seng zhu rgyur/ ngas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi mes rgyal la dga' zhen gyis rang yul du log par srid gzhung nas sne len gnang ba dang / rang ngos nas kyang tang gi srid jus bzang po'i gnas tshul drang bden bsam 'char gtam bshad gang yong rlung 'phrin nang rgyang bsring thengs gsum byas pa dang re 'dun lhug zhu byas kyang don phan gyi thugs 'khur thob ma byung / 1982lor lha sa grong khyer srid gros u yon gyi ming gnas stsal yang gzugs po rgyun gcong la brten las 'khur zhu ma thub par 'phrod bsten chu tshan sman bcos lo ltar byas stabs da cha gzugs khams cung zad bde ru phyin pa dang / rgyal gces sems shugs bskyed de srid gros u yon gyi las 'khur gtan 'jags bcar ma thub rung gang thub zhu rgyu'i sems shugs yod/ 'on kyang da phan 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen phru gu tshos sprad kyang 'tsho snon sogs la dngul bun che tsam chags te dka' ngal yod/ dka' ngal sel thabs su rang khyim zhol don po khang pa srid jus don 'khyol gyis phyir slog gsol ras stsal rgyu'i zhal bzhes 1981lor gnang ste snga 'khros shar rgyud khang pa rtsis len byas 'thus ’’zhes gsol ras gnang yang khang par sdod mkhan khyim tshang khag gnyis nas spo shugs ma byas par bsdad yod/ da cha tang krung dbyang gi yig cha gzhir bzung zing 'khrugs sogs la the gtogs gang yang med pa'i a ma dang / phru gu dgu la sgor ra shar nub kyi khang pa gang tshang thob thang yod nges kyang / mdzad bde'i ched zhol don po shar rgyud khang pa steng shod rnams srid jus don 'khyol gsol ras dang 'brel tsis len chog pa'i 291

bka' 'khrol yig cha 'phral myur gnang skyong zhu rgyu'i snyan shog tu/ dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis/ 1984lo'i zla 2tshes 15la phul ’’zhes pa'i snyan shog srid gros kru'u zhi sku gzhon phun khang brgyud gong tshes nyin phul bar rjes su de don zhal bzhes gtsang thob byung lugs gsungs kyang / khyim tshang khag gnyis ma spos par sdod mus so/(6)ljongs srid gros lo rgyus rig gnas khang la dpyad gzhi'i rtsom yig 'ga' zhig phul ba/ljongs srid gros lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha u lhan gyi bka' mngags bzhin 1984lor snga rting thog de snga'i bla phyag las khungs kyi lo rgyus gang dran mdor bsdus shig dang / gzhan yang nang don gong bkod ltar de sngon 1958lo lhun rtse khul du yangs can 'brog pa mi 40dang khal g.yag 2700skor tshwa 'bebs 'dren byed par 'gro skabs khams jag gis zing chas rkyen pas 'gag 'gyings byung bar thag gcod byed par bla phyag las khungs nas phran rang btang ba'i skor dang / 1954lo tā la'i bla ma mes rgyal nang du rgyal khab dbu brnyes nas lo drug 'khor ba'i rten 'brel mdzad sgor phebs pa'i skor/ 1956lo sbyar rag gling ga'i nang lha sa slob grwa 'bring ba thog mar btsugs pa'i skor bcas kyi rtsom yig bris te phul yod/(7)1985lo'i zla2tshes 16nyin ljongs sne len khang du lo gsar ja ston tshogs 'du'i thog‘‘dbu khrid rnam pa dang / blo mthun rnam pa lhan rgyas la zhu rgyur/ 'char nye'i shing byi gnam lo gsar tshes la bsu ba zhus te lhan rgyas tshang mar bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab chen po'i tang krung dbyang gi dbu khrid 'og bod rang skyong ljongs nas thugs 'khur che bzhes kyis phyi rgyal nas phyir log bod rigs spun zlar dmigs bsal gyi sne len khang ched 'dzugs kyis gzhis chags dang / gnyen 'phrad blta skor ba tshang mar sne 292

len gzab rgyas dang / lhag par nga tsho gzhis chags su sdod mkhan rnams la lo ltar lo gsar dgos mkho zur gsos gsol ras dang 'char can mgron 'bod gnang ba bcas la rnying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu/ nga tshor thugs 'khur che bzhes gnang ba tsam ma zad/ krung dbyang nas deng dus phyogs gang ci'i thad la srid jus bzang po dngos su phyag bzhes bstar bar brten spyi tshogs ring lugs la dga' zhen dang / mes rgyal la dga' zhen/ tang dang mi dmangs srid gzhung la dga' zhen/ deng rabs can bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun la legs skyes 'bul rgyu'i sems shugs/ lhag par du mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes rig ldan pa'i bod gsar 'dzugs skrun la sems thag gtsang bcad kyis rang gis nus pa gang yod 'don rgyu'i ngos 'dzin zhu gi yod/ mjug tu smon tshig zhu rgyur/ 'dzam gling zhi bde dang / krung hwa dar rgyas/ mi rigs thams cad mthun sgril sra brtan/ lhag par du bod rgya mi rigs mthun sgril dam zab thog phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod rigs spun zla rnams rang yul du myur du phebs thub pa'i smon 'dun zhu rgyu yin ’’zhes zhus/(8)bod rang skyong ljongs bzugs nas lo nyi shu 'khor ba'i rten 'brel mdzad sgor phul ba'i snyan tshigami mjed 'jig rten 'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i mi gzhir/brjid chags krung go rgyal khab zhing sa gshin/so nam mkhas mdzangs tang srid dmag dmangs bzhis/thabs jus 'bad pas bskrun pa'i 'bras bu bzang /nga drug mi rigs mang 'dus skye bo'i tshogs/zhum med dpa' ngar las la brtson pa dang /ya rabs bzang spyod bsam dngos dpal yon dar/mdza' mthun rgyal gces dar cha mthon por bsgrongs/293

rlabs chen spyi tshogs ring lugs dpal 'dzin pa'i/stong khun ma hā tsi na gung phran tang /dbu brnyes bgrang bya re lnga 'khor ba la/rab dga'i bkra shis me tog la brgyar 'thor/rab mdzes krung hwa spyi mthun rgyal khab 'dir/rab bzang tang srid dmag dmangs dga' skyid kyi/rab mthun mthun pa ched bzhi'i ngang tshul gyis/rab brtan gnam lo khri phrag gnas gyur cigagazhung lugs rig gnas thos bsam ma bgyis par/gya tshom rtsom 'bri bgyid pa bzhad gad gnas/'on kyang lhag bsam 'o mtsho gyen 'phyur gyis/gang bsam lhug brjod spyi brtol bskyed de phul/dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis 1985lo'i zla tshes la phul/’’(9)krung dbyang gsar 'god pa'i bka' don ltar rang gi lo rgyus mdor zhes/1985lo'i zla 3tshes 10nyin pe cin nas lha sar phebs pa'i krung dbyang gi gsar 'god tshogs chung phran sar ched phebs kyis khyod rang gi lo rgyus shod dgos gsungs pa ltar rang gi lo rgyus mdor bsdus zhus pa ste/‘‘phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi skye yul ni/ mal gro gung mkhar rdzong khongs sger phag mo lha sding pa'i mi ser grogs ra gsar zhes pa'i zhing pa yin/ pha mal gung rdzong gi las drung dbang 'dus tshe ring dang / ma grogs sprin sna ba'i bu mo sgrol 'dzoms gnyis kyi rigs myug tu spyi lo 1916rab byung bcu drug pa'i me 'brug lor skyes shing / ming la lha dbang tshe ring zhes btags 'dug rang lo brgyad la slebs dus phab nang du yi ge 'bri klog 294

bslab pa dang / rang lo bcu gcig la slebs skabs lha sar go bo khang ser zhes pa'i sger gyi slob grwa zhig tu slob sbyong dang / rang lo bcu bzhi la dpon khungs lha sding sras rim bzhi bsod nams tshe ring gi zhabs zhur rgya gar du phyin/rang lo bco lnga par grong drag dmag mi bsdu ba'i dmag bskul skabs mal gung rdzong khongs phag mo lha sding pa'i gtso drag ming 'khur gyi dmag bskul do dam rtse drung thub bstan theg mchog gi lasnga byar mnyam bskyod kyi dmag bskul las 'jug 'grib ba dang / lha sar phyir log gis lha sding pa'i zhabs zhu rang 'jags byas/ rang lo bco brgyad chu bya 1933lo bod kyi rdo shing spyi khyab shing bzo las tshan pa karma bsod nams lags kyi bu mo bsod nams dbyangs can gyi go mag tu dpon po lha sding pas ster 'dug pa ltar dpon po'i bka' bzhin chang sa brgyab/ bod ljongs sman rtsis khang du sum rtags sogs rig gnas slob sbyong byas/ lo der tā la'i bla ma sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa chen por yig tshad phul nas mi bab spyan zhur bcar zhing 'char phul phyag rtags dgongs don bla phyag las khungs kyi las bya zhwa'u li bsko gzhag stsal ba dang / rjes 'brel rtse phebs byams zhabs zhur tshud de tā la'i bla ma bcu bzhi pa mdo smad a mdo nas lha sar chibs bsgyur skabs phebs bsu'i khongs bcar bas nag chu brgal tsam bkra shis thang nas lha sar bar phebs byams gdan 'dren zhu mkhan khongs yod/ bla phyag las khungs kyi thugs mkho sgrub tu rgya gar la thengs kha shas phyin pa dang / gting skyes 'bras sgrub pa sogs phyogs 'gro mang po byed myong yod/ 1954lor tā la'i bla ma bcu bzhi pa mes rgyal pe cin du phebs skabs chibs zhabs phyag mdzod khongs drung tshab ming 'khur gyis zhabs zhur bcar/ mes rgyal nang rgya che'i lta skor du 'gro myong / 1956lo bod rang skyong ljongs slob 'bring dang po gsar btsugs nang bod yig dge rgan gyi ming 'khur gyis slob 'khrid bya rgyu dang / srid 'dzin khongs slob phrug tsho'i gdan 295

dang / nyal chas/ gyon gos sogs nyo sgrub byed sgo gzhung gron gang chung bsri tshags hur bskyed zhu mur tā la'i bla ma rgya gar du phebs rgyu'i chibs zhabasakhongs bod ljongs tshogs 'du nas bsko gzhag byas 'dug pa ltar bca ra/1958lo bla phyag las khungs nas mtsho sna 'bras sgrub pa bsko gzhag byas don 'gro dgos byung / lo der chu bzhi sgang drug gi dmag mis bkag nyar gyis lha sar phyir log byed ma thub/ 1959lo lha sar log yong skabs tā la'i bla ma ston 'khor lho khar 'byor ba stabs 'khel gyis bka' shag nas bka' drung bsko gzhag byas pa ltar las 'khur byas nas rgya gar du phyin pa yin/ rgya gar du 'byor nas zlos gar 'go 'dzin dang / shes rig drung che/ ldi li rlung 'phrin gyi bod skad rgyang bsring gi la sa byed sogs lo nyi shu tsam gyi ring las ka mang po byas/ 1976lo rgan yol byas te kha 'don byas nas bsdad/ 1978lo shes rig zlos gar gyi slob ston par zla ba drug tsam ring sdod dgos byung /1979lo rgya gar nas bal yul du gnas mjal la 'ongs/ bsnyen mtshams la sdod skabs lha sar yod pa'i bu 'bring ba lha sa slob 'bring dang po'i ang rtsis dge rgan bstan 'dzin phun tshogs dang / bu gsum pa rang skyong ljongs slob 'bring dang po'i bod yig dge rgan skal bzang rdo rje gnyis lha sa nas bal yul du pha thug 'phrad la 'byor nas bu gnyis kyis tang krung dbyang gi srid jus lhug gtong yang dag pa yin lugs dang / chos dad dang / 'gro 'ong rang mos sogs dngos yod gnas tshul drang bden zhib phra bshad par ngos rang sems 'gul thebs nas/ 1980lo'i zla 6nang bu gnyis dang mnyam du rang yul lha sar phyir log byas pa yin/ lha sar 'byor pa dang srid gzhung nas sne len dang 'brel 'phral sel sdod gnas se ra chos sding sgang gi rtse thog khang pa rnams gnang nas glog bzhu gsar du 'khrid 'dzugs dang / de rjes gus tsho'i sngar gyi sger khang zhol don po khang pa srid jus don 'khyol gyi phyir slog gsol ras 296

bka' drin che byung yang / khang par mang tshogs sdod mus rnams rim bzhin spo shugs byed 'jug rgyur snga 'khros shar brgyud khang pa steng shod rnams rtsis len byas 'thus gsungs pa bcas thugs 'khur che bzhes gnang ba dang /1982lo phran la lha sa grong khyer srid gros u yon bsko gzhag stsal/ bu phrug dgu yod khongs nas phru gu brgyad la tang dang srid gzhung gi gso skyong 'og tshar longs kyis tshang mar de sngon nas las phogs rim thob byung 'dug bu mo skra bzang thad 1981lor lho kha nas lha sar them tho bsgyur te 1984lo grong khyer srid gros kyi zur zhugs khongs 'os bab las phogs gnang ba sogs bzos sgo bdag rkyen gang legs thob pa bzhin/ krung dbyang gi mdzad phyogs sogs mthong thos myong ba gting zab byung nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dge mtshan dang / tang krung dbyang gi srid jus rnams dngos 'brel yang dag pa yin par yid ches kyis rgya gar rlung 'phrin las khungs nas phran gyi phogs 'phar gsog 'jog dngul sgor drug khri tsam len rgyur bsdad kyang rgyal gces sems shugs chen pos rang yul la gtan sdod bya rgyur khas len zhus pa yin/ 1984lo srid gros grong khyer skabs bzhi pa'i tshogs 'du thengs gnyis par u yon mang mos kyis rgyun las u yon du 'dems bsko gnas spar dang 'brel go bab kyi phogs thob kyang bstsal te tshogs 'du sogs gal che'i rigs dang rnam kun res gza' zla ba'i nyin 'char can snga dro'i ring srid gros su las bcar zhu rgyu ma gtogs rgyun gtan chos dad rang mos kyi kha 'don byas nas bsdad chog pa'i gnang ba thob ste bde skyid kyi ngang gnas pa 'dis tang gi srid jus yang dag pa yin par ra sprod lta bu zhig tu gyur yod pa bcas kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus lags so ’rizhes zhus pa sgra sdud 'khor lo'i nang phab 'jug gnang song /‘‘de ring 'di gar rgyal sa pe cin nas bod la ched phebs gsar 'gyur 'god las pa blo mthun rnam pas phran dge slongasmoblo bzang bstan 'dzin la 297

mthong thos bsam tshul mdor bsdus shig gtam bshad byed dgos gsung pa bzhin sgro bkur spang pa'i gang dran mdor bsdus zhu gi yin/'dzam bu gling gi mi thams cad bde skyid 'dod mkhan sha stag yin kyang bde skyid sgrub pa'i las ka byed thabs sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kho nar gyur nas dngos gnas kyi bde skyid thob khag po red/ bde skyid de yang gnyis yod pa red/tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang / tshe phyi ma'i bde skyid bcas gnyis red/ 'dzam gling 'dir mi mang che ba tshe 'di'i bde skyid kyi ched du dpal 'byor yar rgyas gong 'phel gtong rgyu kho nar gal chen po byed kyi yod pa red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dar khyab yod sar mang che ba tshe 'di phyi gnyis ka'i bde skyid 'dod mkhan yin pa red/ bod 'dir yang mi mang che ba tshe 'di'i bde skyid 'dod pa ma zad tshe phyi ma'i bde skyid de bas kyang gtso che ba byed pa'i chos kyi goms gshis de gna' snga mo zhig nas yod pa red/ bar skabs tang krung dbyang nas bod la bde skyid bskrun ched bcings 'grol dmag dpung dang bcas bsgyur bcos yar rgyas 'byung phyir bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i dgongs bzhes yod kyang 1959lo lha sar zing 'khrugs byung ba dang / de rjes ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje ’’zer ba dang / ‘‘mi bzhi shog kha'i ’’byed las kyis bod tsam ma zad krung go rgyal yongs la bde skyid yong rgyu'i tshab la sngar ma grags pa'i sdug bsngal tshabs chen myong dgos pa byung ba dang / gzhung sger thams cad nyam rgud gyong gun shin tu chen po byung ba red/ 'on kyang skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs pa nas bzung krung dbyang gi mdzad jus dang / slob ston bzang po la brten nas khyon yongs la bde skyid kyi 'go tshugs pa dang / de rjes krung dbyang gi dbu khrid hu'u ya'o pang phyag rogs dang bcas bod la phebs te gzigs skor bka' slob dang / srid jus lhug gtong dang bsgyur bcos mdzad pa'i 'bras 298

bu bzang po mngon du gyur te rim bzhin rgyal yongs dang 'dra ba'i bod ljongs su gang ci yar rgyas chen po byung ba dang / lhag par bod kyi zhing 'brog la khral rigs rtsa chag gnang ba dang / chos dad lhug gtong / 'gro 'ong rang mos sogs byung ba des nga tsho phyi rgyal du yul gyar bod mi rnams kyang rang yul la phyir log bya rgyu'i sems 'gul thebs pa ltar nga rang yang 1980lo phyir log byas pa dang / de rjes phyir log byed mkhan yang lo re bzhin mang du 'gro bzhin pa red/ deng skabs tang krung dbyang gi srid jus klong yangs brtan snyings bzang po yin par yid ches byung ba dper na/ zhang kang la cha mtshon na rgyal khab gcig la lam lugs gnyis phyag bzhes bstar ba des zhang kang bde blag ngang rang rgyal la phyir log byung thub pa red/ de 'brel tā la'i bla ma dang / rjes 'brangs phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod rigs spun zla mi dmangs rnams la'ang krung dbyang nas mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba gnang dang gnang bzhin pa 'dis mthun sgril yong rgyur re gzhi chen po zhig byung yod la da dung yag tu 'gro ba'i re ba yod/ pha mas bu la brtse ba ltar tang krung dbyang nas bod la kha zhe med pa'i thugs 'khur gzigs bskyangs chen po gnang ba la brten nas mi dmangs phal cher phyug 'gyur gyi lam la bskyod de 'gan gtsang len pa dang /zhor las byed pa/ tshong gnyer sogs gang 'dod ci dgar spyad chog pa des tshe 'di'i bde skyid dpal 'byor nyin re bzhin gong 'phel 'gro dang 'gro bzhin pa kun mig sngar mthong thub pa 'di red/ de bzhin tshe phyi ma'i bde skyid kyi rtsa ba chos dad rang mos lhug gtong gnang yod pa ltar lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang / rtse pho brang chen po po ta la/ nor gling pho brang / gzhan yang chos kyi bsti gnas dbus gtsang gi gdan sa chen po bzhin la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang khag dang / dgon sde mang po nyams gso gsar rgyag dang 'brel chos byed dge 'dun pa'ang gang 'tshams slar gso gsar 'dzugs kyis chos spyod kyi bya 299

ba dpe cha slob khrid dang / 'chad rtsod kyi srol rgyun tshugs shing / chos sgo phye nas mang tshogs kyis mchod 'bul dang / bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed 'bul ba sogs ci dgar byas chog pa byung yod pa dang / de 'brel bod kyi rig gnas slob sbyong gong 'phel byung ba sngar med pa'i bod ljongs slob grwa richen mo dang /slob grwa 'bring ba/ slob grwa chung ba bcas slob grwa khag mang po btsugs nas de'i nang slob phrug khri khrag la slob sbyong yod pa dang / gzhan yang 'phrod bsten sman khang dang / 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren/ bzo grwa/ gter kha khaga'adzugs skrun khag sogs sna mang 'di dang 'di zhes brjod kyis mi lang pa'i nang tshan mdor bsdus tsam zhu na/ 'di lo krung dbyang nas gron dngul dang /las mi mkhas can zhing chen khag nas gtong gnang gis bod la gtso gnad 'dzugs skrun khag bzhi bcu zhe gsum gnang gtan 'khel khongs nas bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo dang / mi dmangs sman khang / sman rtsis khang / mgron khang / za khang / lus rtsal khang / mang tshogs sgyu rtsal khang / glog brnyan khang la sogs gzhi rgya che ba'i khang chen khag nyi shu tsam nye char legs grub zin dang zin nyer yod pa de rnams grong khyer lha sa'i mdzes rgyan du gyur par gzu gnas skye bo mtha' dag dga' ba skyes nas bsngags brjod byed kyi yod pa red/de mtshungs lha sa grong khyer nang gi sa 'og chu 'gro mkhregs sa'i mdong mo che chung dra ba lta bu dang / srang lam khag la rdo gcal spus legs bting ba/ chu ka la btsugs pa/ glog bzhu kha snon btsugs 'then/ gtsang chu'i chu rags sra brtan dkyus ring / lcags po ri steng gzugs mthong brnyan 'phrin gyi khang chen dang lcags kyi ka ring btsugs te rang skyong ljongs dang / lha sa grong khyer so so nas brnyan 'phrin dus rtag tu legs gtong byed pa/ nag chu khul rlung shugs kyi glog khang btsugs nas mang tshogs la glog thab dang bzhu mar bed spyodakhyed pa/ lho kha gnam gru 'bab tshugs khang la mgron khang dang / lha sa 300

bar gyi 'khor lam snum nag spus legs rgya khyon kha zhengs che ba bting ba/ de sngon nas btsugs zin pa'i ngo mtshar che ba zhig la gor mo nas lha sa bar le dbar stong phrag sar sa 'og tu mkhregs sa'i lcags mdong yur bu'i nang 'khor snum drangs te bed spyod byas dang byed bzhin pa/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi khyams ra'i sgo 'phyor 'og jo bo dbu skra'i nub phyogs su rgya khyon che bar rgyardo gcal bsgrigs bkod mdzes kyi chu rdzing dang / me tog rwa ba/ shing sna/glog bzhu lnga tshom bsgrigs pa'i ka ba khag lho byang g.yas g.yon khang pa rdo brtsigs spus dag bod bzo bkod legs bstar bsgrigs/ lha sa grong khyer nang gi lam chen shar lho nub byang khag tshang ma'i g.yas g.yon du thog brtsegs can gyi khang pa gsar pa rgya khyon che ba brgyab dang rgyag bzhin pa sogs phyogs gang sar yar rgyas chen po byung yod pa dang / nga tsho phyi rgyal nas mes rgyal rang yul du phyir log yong mkhan tshor yang srid gzhung nas sne len khang las khungs ched 'dzugs dang / 'os babs bkod sgrig gang yong gnang ba ma zad/gnyen 'phrad blta skor ba tshor yang mthun 'gyur gang legs gnang gi yod pa dang / lhag par krung dbyang nas khyon yongs la srid jus lhug gtong dang /chab srid/ rig gnas/ chos dad/ dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun sogs phyogs gang sa ci'i thad la yar rgyas gong 'phel gyi dge mtshan rnams la dga' mgu yi rangs kyis snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang bcas bod rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes nas lo nyi shu 'khor ba'i mdzad sgor bkra shis bde legs kyi bsu ba zhu rgyu yin/ mtha' don smon tshig zhu rgyur/ 'dzam gling zhi bde yong ba dang / rgyal khab dang / mi dmangs spyi mthun la dgongs bzhes thugs 'khur phyag bzhes mdzad po rim pa khag gi tang srid dbu khrid khag dang /las byed blo mthun 'thab phyogs gang na su bzhugs rnams sku tshe brtan pa dang /las don phyogs las rnam rgyal yong ba/ tā la'i bla ma dang / phyi rgyal du yod 301

pa'i bod rigs spun zla rnams gang mgyogs rang yul mes rgyal du phyir log thub pa dang / mi rigs thams cad mthun sgril sra brtan yong ba/ krung hwa dar rgyas phun sum tshogs pa yong ba bcas kyi smon 'dun zhu rgyu yin/ phyi rgyal nas 1980lor bod du phyir log gis lha sa grong khyer khongs se ra chos sding ri khrod du chos dad rang mos gyi 'tsho ba bde skyid ngang skyel bzhin panyi dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis 1985lo'i zla 7tshes 14la ’’zhes zhus/(10)1986lo 'ol dga' chu tshan blar gso byas pa/phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya gar nas bal yul brgyud bod du yong khar rgya gar sman khang nas khog pa bshags bcos byas te bod la 'byor dus seng drag med stabs lha sar 'byor nas stod lung dang / 'bri gung / gro mo bcas so sor chu tshan lo bstud de brgyab par phan skyes yag po byung na'ang /1985lo mkhal ma cung zad nad mnar gyi sdod mur rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes te lo nyi shu 'khor ba'i rten 'brel la krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa spyi zla dgu pa'i nang lha sar phebs skabs tshogs gtso krung dbyang dbu khrid hu'u chi lis gtso skyong mdzad pa'i tshogs pa'i mdzad zhabs tshogs mir grong khyer lha sa'i srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa cha pa bsod nams sgrol ma lags dang /rgyun las u yon gus dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin bcar dgos brda tho phebs don bzhin dgongs pa zhu ma nus par dang len gyis bcar zhing / rnam kun rang shag tu dro bcos kho na byas te bsdad pa dang / mdzad sgo'i nyin nyi shu rtsa brgyad ring gang sar mdzad zhabs su bcar dgos byung bar grang 'khyags kyi rkyen pas mkhal nad khar/ rkang pa nad mnar lci lod du gyur par brten slar yang chu tshan zhig brgyab na phan thogs yong res mo brtag byas par 'ol dga' chu tshan bzang babs kyang chu tshan de ni ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje ’’zhes pa'i skabs gtor bshigs kyis bed spyod byed sa rtsa ba nas med pa red 'dug 302

pa ngos rang 1982lo lho gnas dang / chos 'khor rgyal gyi mtsho mjal du bskyod skabs dngos su mthong bas nyams gso mi byed mthu med kyis lha sa nas ar 'dam mkhregs sa do po kha shas nyos 'khyer gyis grong khyer srid gros gzhung las thing nas lho kha kron chus la ngo sprod yi ge zhus te 1986lo'i zla 4tshes 18nyin lha sa nas thon/ rtsed thang du 'byor ba dang lho kha sa gnas srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa blo bzang phun tshogs lags nas rogs ram mdzad de lho kha kron chus nas zangs ri rdzong la ngo sprod yi ge zhus gnang ltar zangs rir phun tshogs hru'u ci ngo mjal gyis bka' mol zhus par zangs ri rdzong nas 'ol dga' chus kyi las byed skal bzang lags dang / shang gi 'go khrid thun mong la yi ge gnang bakhyer te 'ol dgar khong tsho dang gros mol gyis chus las skal bzang lags nas 'go khrid de las mi nyi shu tham pa nyin gcig 'dag shangs 'go btsugs kyang de'i sang nyin las mi bzhi ma gtogs 'byor ma byung / khong tsho gzhan dag ma yong ba gang red dam zhes bshad par nga tshos shes ma byung zer/ 'o na skal bzang lags 'dir phebs rogs gnang zhes zhu bar mi gcig btang bas skal bzang lags mdang nub bo stod chus la log phebs song zer/ a ya mtshan khyod tshor gla cha sprod len skor mngags cha gnang byung ngam lab par nga tsho shang nas 'gro dgos gsungs te bcar ba las gla cha yod pa ma red zer/yul srol gla cha nyin re mi rer ji tsam red dam zhes dris par/ yul mi phan tshun rogs res la 'gro dus nyin re gla cha ma'o tse brgyad re red zer/ 'o na ngas nyin re sgor gcig dang sgor zur lnga re sprad chog lab par dga' mos chen pos thugs rje che nga tsho mi bzhi po'i nang mi gzhan dag dang bcas las kar bcar chog pa zhes so so'i nang mi spun mched 'khrid de mi bcu gcig 'byor/de tsho'i nang phru gu na chung kha shas 'dug pa 'di tshor las ka bskul na rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims dang 'gal lugs brjod par/ khong tshos brjod gsal phru gu 'di 303

tsho rnam kun rgan pa nang bzhin gyi las ka byed thub kyi yod pas thugs rjes gzigs sku mkhyen zhes nan brjod ltar nyar dgos byung / khong tshos bshad pa bzhin phru gu de tsho rgan pa kha shas las lhag pa'i las shugs che la hur brtson che ba 'dug de'i sang nyin nas mi grangs mang po 'phar te mang ba'i skabs mi grangs sum cu so grangs yong ba nas nyin nyi shu rtsa gnyis ring chu tshan khag bzhi 'dag shangs dang bzo bcos byas/ lhag par gro lo kha dang / skyog gcus gnyis kyi chu yur bzo rgyu dang rdo brtsigs rgyag rgyu/ rdo gcal bting ste rmig 'dag ar 'dam byugs rgyu/ gro lo kha'i lcags ri nyams gso gsar rgyag dang 'brel sgo gsar bzo sogs kyi rgyu cha'i rin dang / rdo bzo shing bzo dmangs 'ul bcas kyi gla cha khyon bsdoms dngul rkyang sgor chig stong lnga brgya lnga bcu nga lnga dang / las mi mi grangs drug cu skor la las mjug 'gril mtshams legs skyes dga' ston kha lag sha 'bras dang / kha tog ja chang gya nom bcas drangs te khyod rnams kyis las ka hur dag byas par thugs rje che zhus pa dang 'brel deng skabs tang krung dbyang gi srid jus bzang po rnams ngo sprod byas thog tshang mas sgrig khrims la srung brtsi dang mthun sgril dam zab kyi sgo nas bsam pa'i dpal yon dang / dngos po'i dpal yon dar ba'i thabs la 'bad brtson cher bskyed kyis phyug 'gyur gyi las thabs hur bskyed byed dgos pa sogs kyi bskul lcag slob ston gang shes byas par tshang ma dga' mos chen pos sems 'gul thebs pa byung song ba dang / zangs ri rdzong la chu tshan nyams gso legs bsgrubs zin pas rdzong dpon hru'u ci gzigs skor rtsis bzhes su phebs gnang yod pa zhes pa'i yi ge phul bar kru'u ren phun tshogs dbang 'dus lags 'byor te hru'u ci da res phebs thub min la brten nga rang btang gnang byung gsungs te chu tshan khag la blta zhib gnang nas dga' tshor chen pos thugs rje che/ khyed kyis da res 'gro gron 'dzems med btang gnang 304

ba ma zad/ ri sku gzugs thang thang med pa dang / dgung lo mtho po yin na'i nyin mang sku ngal bskyon pa'i gyeb— 'obras ha cing chen spyobyutre zhegeX gyuXnedza sngonaphyage bris 'byor pa dang / nga tsho'i rdzong gi 'go khrid tshang ma dganya —māgu yi ’rengase kyis da res nga tshor bskul lcag chen po thebs byung / khyed k+shis nga tshor gsung 'os gang yod gsung rogs zhu—sa gar+shasungs kyi 'dug ces rdine snagene/ ci phran gyisda 'di khul mar spus dag tshod mkha—na rnyed min lwa nyo khudas beganutre thubasde ci.e r+yad zhus par/ de don nges pyane du ghong —rgyu zhes rdzongatsho gi —'brohūṃ paṃshel+lī mā gezhodwa zerwa baspyi tshogs rnying pa'i skasdeg kyi kurne glija 'brog pā'i 'aspyo9 p+ta k+shilnge sdedzargotsho kha sde ge btang gnang song bas de'i dzeganatres nyin rang rgyal myatrenā rgestawa rger+shasgo rgya 6mū drug bskyal 'byor byungaci —ban khya ma rīn rdzong nasnye sgor —sdezhiṇ+ḍa mro gnang ldamakā lta8 gnang na 'thus rgyu— zeru yad / rnye sa'i yul —thang sgor ngug re yadaci pār dāga' po byung song / rgyal mtshan gyis khyed male gro ru thog chu tshan sa 5lhebasga— nene —nga tsho'i sdod yul la dgong zhag 'phel rgyur nges par du phebs rogs/ phebs bsu'i chibs pa'ang nga tshos btang chog zer bar 'gro rgyu 'khel na yi ge gtong rgyu byas/gro lo kha dang / skyog gcus gnyis la lcags gdong nang chu drangs te sku gzugs 'khru sa'i rdzing chung re gsar bzo byas pa bcas mjug gtsang byung rjes ngos rang chu tshan brgyab nas sdod skabase zangs ri rdzong gi phun tshogs hru'u ci lags 'ol dgar phran sar phebs te dgyes tshor chen pos thugs rje che/ da res khyed kyis nga tshor rogs ram dang / slob gso bskul lcag yag po byung /khyed kyis gsung don gro lo khar mgron khang dang / bsrung bya ba sdod khang bcas nga tshos nges par du gsar rgyag byed kyi yin/ khyed kyis nga tshor gsung 'os lhug gsung gnang dgos gsungs byung bas rtsed thang bar 'grul 'khor zhig gtong thabs bde na gtong rogs zhus par nges par btang chog gsungs te btang gnang byung /305

tsho rī 〈11—) 1986 lo sdong khyeraske mi sakhri dbu khrid hru'u ci gsar pa grong khyer srid gros kyi kru'u zhitsā mthumu chos rgya4 lags kyi bka' ngo smog med bsam shog jagikhubajib/ — — — ‘‘lha sa khrongu khyesgre u yonacho lhan khang gi r+yā'u ci grong khyer srid gros kyi kru'u zhi blo mthun chos rgyalwa mchog lha saskre gong khyer gīto derwabu khride gsar par phebs pa der bcos min —gyi dga' gus chen gosardo —bukra shis rīsta4de legs zhu rgyu dang / sku nyid k+shis nye sngon ngo sprod rjogās 'uduldi skubs gesud ba—shad gnang ba dang / lhag par nye char grong khyen srid grosga tsho—gas 'du'o treme sten nyin gus par dmigs bsal gyi zugasnga burtse chen sngose zur du gasnyenge modza dzasdod bskul gnang ba der gus rang dgake sdo dprag mede stobru— rgyung bske thugasdawa rjetsho wakai/ khyed kyis bongs ba gser gzigasga k+shi re —'uṅkun gsungs me der rje lhags pa'i bsam gros zhu nus dben rung / gang bsam zole ——med’—spre 'edod chen dzil rmyeng / des na ngas gsham du dorne tshan lnga 〉zhu rgyu yi na/ — — — dang po/ ma/nga tshogame kyi 'go khrid gnang rgyu de gzi brjid che la sgo gsum dka' ngal rnyog 'dzing che ba zhig red/ 'on kyang rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims dang /mdzad phyogs srid jus sogs gzhir bzung ste drang bden gyi sgo nas phyogs gang sar zhib 'jug nan tan dang 'brel las don khag blo khog chen pos nar 'gyangs med par 'phral 'phral thag gcod gnang rgyu de gtso gnad gcig red/gnyis pa/ sger don sgrub mkhan kha shas nas ngo shes brgyud pa sogs thabs shes rnam pa sna tshogs kyis ltag sgo skor mkhan mang po yong srid pas de tshor dbu ma 'khor ba byas nas gtam bshad mkhas pos gzhung bsrang gi phan grogs gnang gal che ba/ —gsum pa/ rang nyid tang yon zhig yin pas na tang srol rnams lag bstar gnang rgyu smos ci/ sger sems spang nas rgyal khab dang mi dmangasakyi spyi 306

don kho na bsgrub thub pa zhig dang / de min sger don zhor dang / spyi don gtso bo gnang thub pa zhig nges par du thugs gzab gnang dgos pa/bzhi pa/ mi rigs khag mthun sgril chen pos krung hwa dar rgyas yong thabs dang / yang dgos bod ljongs kyi las don spyi dang lhag par rang nyid kyi bgo skal lha sa grong khyer gyi phyogs gang ci yar rgyas gtong rgyu bcas la sgo gsum yod dgu rtsal sprugs gnang dgos pa/lnga pa/ skabs babs 'phral sel gyi las don gal 'gangs che shos ni grong khyer gyi gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten je zhan bod kyi mtshan shas byed pa de dag 'phral mar legs bcos yar rgyas gtong thabs gnang rgyu dang / phugs don gyi gtso gnad slob gso'i las don la shugs snon gyis mi rigs rang nyid kyi shes ldan mi sna gso skyong dang / shes yon bed spyod rgya cher btang ste shes ldan de tshor mthong chen las gnas dang phogs thob gang legs gnang thub na dpal yon gnyis dar rgyur nus shugs thon pa yong nges snyam pa bcas glog la mun pa'i gsal 'debs lta bu'i dpyad gzhi'i bsam shog tu/se ra chos sding sgang du sdod pa na rgas rmongs rgan dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis 1986lo'i zla 10tshes 28nyin la phul ’’zhes zhus/(12)1986lo'i zla 12tshes 18nyin bod me yos lo gsar gyi ja ston tshogs 'du'i thog‘‘ring min 'char la nye ba'i bod me yos gnam lo gsar tshes la bkra shis bde legs kyi bsu ba zhu ched du de ring lha sa grong khyer srid gros kyi bkra shis pa'i ja ston gyi tshogs 'dur phebs pa'i dbu khrid rnam pa dang / blo mthun rnam pa lhan rgyas la bcos min gyi dga' gus chen pos gnam lo gsar bzhad la bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu/ rang re'i rgyal khab ni lo stong phrag mang po'i sngon rol nas 'dzam gling nang stong khun rgyal khab bam/ ma hā tsi na'i rgyal khab ces stobs 'byor ldan la snyan grags che ba'i rgyal khab chen po zhig 307

red/ chab srid skyong phyogs la dar rgud mang po zhig byung yod pa zhib cha rgyal rabs yig tshang khag nang gsal 'khod ltar dang / bar skabs 1949lor krung go gung khran tang gis 'go khrid pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes te blo mthun ma'o tse tung sogs mes po dam pa rnams kyis dka' spyad 'bad brtson che bskyed gnang ba'i 'bras bur krung hwa mi rigs yongs rdzogs chig bsgril 'go tshugs pa dang / bod ljongs su'ang 1951lor ‘‘gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun bzhag ste zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob nas chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ shes rig 'dzugs skrun sogs gang sa nas yar rgyas 'gro dang 'gro mus su gegs dbang bar chad bzlog med kyis 1959lo lha sar ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs rkyen tā la'i bla ma'ang phyi rgyal du bros byol la phebs dgos byung ba dang / de rjes ngo log zing 'khrug lhing 'jags byung yang lo bcu'i zang zing gi gegs chag dang / ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje ’’zhes pa bcas rkyen ngan ru 'dzings kyis krung go'i rgyal yongs la bde ba'i go skabs bral te gzhung sger mi dmangs kun la dka' ngal dang / gyong gun tshabs che phog nas nyams rgud chen por gyur pa tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar dang / 'on kyang tang krung dbyang gi dbu khrid rnam pas dkyel che'i dgongs bzhes bla med kyis skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs rjes srid jus lhug gtong dang /chab srid/ dpal 'byor/ mi rigs chos dad rang mos sogs kyi srid jus yang dag pa la brten nas rgyal yongs khyon la phyogs yongs gang sa ci thad nas dbyar mtsho rgyas pa ltar gong 'phel byung ba bzhin bod ljongs su yang yar rgyas gong 'phel dang / srid jus lhug gtong / 'gro 'ong rang mos sogs byung ba de skor rlung 'phrin nang khyab bsgrags gnang ba phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin bal yul du gnas bskor bsnyen sgrub tu sdod skabs go thos byung ba dang/308

lha sa nas bal yul la phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed pa dngos su mthong ba bcas la brten rang nyid mi lo nyi sha lhag tsam phyi rgyal mi yul la gyar nas bza' zla bu phrug rnams bod du lus pa thug 'phrad bya rgyu skom pa chu 'dod ltar yod mur/phran gyi bu 'bring gzhon gnyis pha rgan thug 'phrad du bal yul la 'byor nas zhib phra'i gnas tshul gsal bshad byung ba blo bder gyur nas bal yul du bzhugs pa'i krung go'i gzhung tshab khang la bcar te bod du gnyen 'phrad la 'gro rgyu'i lag 'khyer zhus stsal byung ba bzhin 1980lo'i zla 6tshes 18nyin bal yul nas thon te gram 'gag sgo brgyud lha sar tshes 22nyin 'byor par srid gzhung nas sne len gnang ba dang / bu phrug dang / spun nye rim 'phrad dga' 'dzoms thog gtsug lag khang dang / rtse pho brang po ta la/ se 'bras gnyis bcas la mchod mjal gsol 'debs dang / khrus gsol rab gnas sogs zhu rgyu byung ste skal bzang dga' spro dpag med thob/ srid gzhung nas thugs 'khur che bzhes kyis 'dod mos kyi las ka byas 'thus gsungs byung yang dgongs zhu byas te se ra chos sding sgang du kha 'don dge sbyor la bsdad 'thus byung / 1982lo lha sa grong khyer srid gros u yon bsko gzhag gnang yang las bcar ma thub/ 1984lo srid gros (grong khyer )u yon mang mos kyis rgyun las u yon du 'os 'dems bsko gzhag bka' drin che byung bar rtag bcar zhu khom med kyang gal che'i tshogs 'du dang / res gza' zla ba nam shar la snga dro'i ring bcar rgyu'i khas len zhus te da bar las bcar zhu mus yin/ nga tsho'i grong khyer srid gros kyi dbu khrid rnam pa dang / las byed tshang mas mthun sgril dam zab yod pa ma zad/ rgyal gces bdag po'i ngang tshul bzung nas tang krung dbyang dang / rang skyong ljongs/ grong khyer bcas kyi gong rim gyi bka' bzhin las don tshags tshud 'bad sgrub byung bar gong rim nas gdeng 'jog mthong chen gnang gi yod pas/ slad phyin phyar ba gru 'degs kyis nus 309

shugs gang yod bton te sngar las lhag pa'i legs skyes 'bul rgyu yin/ krung dbyang nas bod la 'dzugs skrun sogs lo rim bstud kyis gnang yod pa brjod kyis mi lang pa mthong gsal khar/ na ning gtso gnad rnam grangs bzhi bcu zhe gsum gzhi rgya che la spus ka dag pa lha sa grong khyer dang / kron chus khag bcas la gsar skrun gnang ste kun yid 'phrog pa byung yod pa dang / gzhan yang krung dbyang nas yig cha snga rjes stsal ba'i dgongs don srid jus lhug gtong dang 'brel ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje ’’zhes pa rtsis med bzos pa ma zad/g.yon thal bsam skyon yang gtsang sel byas shing / gral rim gyi 'thab rtsod med pa bzos nas mthun sgril chen po byung ba dang / sngar gyi nor 'dzol byung rigs la dag sel dang / blu nyo/ srid jus don 'khyol/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur slar gso/ chos dad rang mos la srung brtsi/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gzhung dang / skad yig la mthong chen bed spyod byed dgos pa/ zhing 'brog gnyis la khral rigs rtsa chag dang / thon skyed 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs dar spel/ tshong rwa 'khrugs shing nyer mkho dang / bza' bca' 'bel 'bel lhug lhug yod pa/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang / rwa mo che/ rtse pho brang po ta la/ nor gling pho brang yas mas/ gdan sa chen po khag gis gtsos dgon khag mang po bcas nyams gso gsar bskrun dang / sku gsung thugs rten/mchod chas srid gzhung nas gsol ras/ dge 'dun gsar 'dzugs kyis chos spyod bshad sgrub 'phel thabs gnang ba/ chos dad rang mos kyi chos sgo lhug por phye nas mi dmangs rnams phyag mchod bsnyen bkur ci gar spyad chog pa/ lhag par du blo stobs chen pos bsgyur bcos kyis bod rigs na gzhon shes ldan dag 'go khrid la gnas spar dang / phyi phyogs la sgo dbye ste phyi rgyal gyi mi sna khag yul skor spro 'cham pa lo re bzhin mang du phyin pa dang / lha sa'i gsol mgron khang dang / gangs ljongs mgron khang sogs gzhung sger mnyam 310

gsum gyi mgron khang khag gnyer 'dzugs kyis gzhung sger yong 'bab byung nas phyug 'gyur gyi lam gsar gtod bcas la brten nas mi dmangs phal che ba lto gos 'dzoms shing / nyer mkho 'dzin chas spros rgyas dang dod byed pa sogs dus skabs bzang po'i bde skyid kyi 'go tshugs yod pa dang / phyi rgyal la yod pa'i bod rigs spun zla'i khongs nas rang rgyal du tshur log rnams la sne len gang gzab dang 'brel sdod khang sogs gang ci 'os babs bkod sgrig dang / shes yon 'jon thang la dpags pa'i las phogs gnang ba/ lo ltar 'char can lo gsar gyi dgos mkho gsol ras sogs gzigs bskyangs bla med dang / gnyen 'phrad du yong mkhan tshor yang gang ci'i mthun 'gyur blta rtogs gnang gi yod pa sogs krung dbyang gi yang dag pa'i mdzad jus bzang po de rnams dngos 'brel dga' ba skye 'os pa zhig red/ nga tshos bka' drin snying bcangs kyi sgo nas me yos gnam lo gsar bzhad 'di'i nang tang krung dbyang gi mdzad phyogs gzhir bzung rtsa don bzhi rgyun 'khyongs dang / phyi phyogs su sgo dbye ba/ nang khul dar rgyas/ bsgyur bcos sogs dang len gyis nus shugs gang yod bton nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed ched grub 'bras sngar bas che ba yong rgyur 'bad brtson dang / legs skyes 'bul dgos/ mjug tu smon tshig zhu rgyur/ 'dzam gling zhi bde yong ba dang / rgyal khab dang mi dmangs spyi don la thugs 'khur phyag bzhes mdzad po rim pa khag gi tang srid dbu khrid khag dang / las byed blo mthun 'thab phyogs gang na su bzhugs rnams sku tshe brtan pa dang las don phyogs las rnam rgyal yong ba/ phyi rgyal du yod pa'i tā la'i bla ma dang / bod rigs spun zla rnams gang mgyogs rang yul mes rgyal du phyir log phebs thub pa dang / mi rigs thams cad mthun sgril sra brtan yong ba/ krung hwa dar rgyas phun sum tshogs po yong ba bcas kyi smon 'dun zhu rgyu yin/ bkra shis bde legs ri’zhes 311

grong khyer srid gros kyi lo gsar ja ston tshogs 'dur snyan sgron zhus/(13)1987lo'i zla2tshes25nyin bod ljongs mi dmangs kun༅ba rlung 'phrinaspus khungs kyi bka' don bzhin phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod rigs spun zlar lo gsar la bkra shis bde legs kyi gtam bshad byas pa/‘‘phyi rgyal du bzhugs pa'i bod rigs spun zla rnams la lo gsar gyi bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu yin/ da lam skal pa bzang po'i shis brjod zhu ba'i go skabs 'di'i thog gus rang bod du phyir log 'byor nas lo ngo bdun tsam song ring gi mthong thos myong gsum sgro bskur med par mdor bsdus shig zhu rgyur/1979lo tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs rjes srid jus lhug gtong dang / chab srid/ mi rigs/ dpal 'byor/ chos dad rang mos sogs srid jus yang dag pa la brten nas rgyal yongs khyon la phyogs gang sa ci thad nas dbyar mtsho rgyas pa ltar gong 'phel byung ba bzhin bod ljongs su'ang yar rgyas gong 'phel dang /srid jus lhug gtong / 'gro 'ong rang mos sogs byung ba dang / de skor rlung 'phrin nang khyab bsgrags gnang ba gus rang bal yul du gnas bskor bsnyen sgrub tu sdod skabs go thos byung ba dang / lha sa nas/ bal yul la phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa dngos su mthong ba bcas la brten rang nyid mi lo nyi shu lhag tsam phyi rgyal mi yul la gyar nas bza' zla bu phrug rnams bod du lus pa thugs 'phrad bya rgyu skom pa chu 'dod ltar yod mur/ phran gyi bu 'bring ba gnyis pha rgan thug 'phrad du bal yul la 'byor nas zhib phra'i gnas tshul gsal bshad byung ba blo bder gyur nas bal yul du bzhugs pa'i krung go'i gzhung tshab khang la bcar te bod du gnyen 'phrad la 'gro rgyu'i lag 'khyer zhus stsal byung ba bzhin/ 1980lo'i zla 6tshes 18nyin bal yul nas thon te gram 'gag sgo brgyud lha sar tshes 22nyin 'byor par srid gzhung nas sne len gnang ba dang /bu phrug spun nye dga' 'dzoms thog gtsug lag khang dang / rtse pho brang po ta la/312

se 'bras gnyis bcas la mchod mjal gsol 'debs dang / khrus gsol rab gnas sogs zhu rgyu byung ste skal bzang dga' spro dpag med thob/ srid gzhung nas thugs 'khur che bzhes kyis 'dod mos kyi las ka byas 'thus gsungs byung yang dgongs zhu byas te se ra chos sding sgang du kha 'don dge sbyor la bsdad 'thus byung / 1982lo lha sa grong khyer srid gros kyi u yon du bsko gzhag gnang yang las bcar zhu ma thub/ 1984lor grong khyer srid gros u yon mang mos kyis rgyun las u yon la 'dems thon bsko gzhag gnang ba rtag bcar zhu khom med kyang gal che'i tshogs 'du dang / res gza' zla ba nam shar la snga dro'i ring bcar rgyu'i khas len zhus te da bar las bcar zhu mus yin/ nga tsho'i grong khyer srid gros kyi dbu khrid rnam pa dang / las byed tshang ma mthun sgril dam zab yod pa ma zad/ rgyal gces bdag po'i ngang tshul bzung nas tang krung dbyang dang / rang skyong ljongs/ grong khyer bcas kyi gong rim gyi bka' bzhin las don tshags tshud 'bad sgrub byung bar gong rim nas gdeng 'jog mthong chen gnang gi yod pas slad phyin phyar ba gru 'degs kyis nus shugs gang yod bton te sngar bas lhag pa'i legs skyes 'bul rgyu yin/krung dbyang nas bod la 'dzugs skrun sogs lo rim bstud kyis gnang gi yod pa brjod kyis mi lang ba'i thog na ni gtso gnad rnam grangs bzhi bcu zhe gsum gzhi rgya che la spus ka dag pa lha sa grong khyer dang / kron chus khag bcas la gsar skrun gnang ste kun yid 'phrog pa byung yod pa dang / gzhan yang krung dbyang nas yig cha snga rjes stsal ba'i dgongs don srid jus lhug gtong dang / ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje ’’zhes pa rtsis med bzos pa ma zad/ g.yon thal bsam skyon gtsang sel dang / gral rim 'thab rtsod med pa bzos nas mthun sgril chen po byung ba dang / sngar gyi nor 'dzol byung rigs dag sel dang / blu nyo/ srid jus don 'khyol/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur slar gso/313

chos dad rang mos la srung brtsi/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gzhung dang /skad yig la mthong chen bed spyod byed dgos pa/ zhing 'brog gnyis la khral rigs rtsa chag dang / thon skyed 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs dar spel/ tshong rwa 'khrug shing nyer mkho dang / bza' bca' 'bel 'bel lhug lhug yod pa/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang / ra mo che/ rtse pho brang po ta la/ nor gling pho brang yas mas/ gdan sa chen po khag gi gtsos dgon khag mang po nyams gso gsar skrun dang / sku gsung thugs rten dang mchod chas srid gzhung nas gsol ras dge 'dun gsar 'jug gis chos spyod bshad sgrub 'phel thabs gnang ba/ chos dad rang mos kyi chos sgo lhug por phye nas mi dmangs rnams phyag mchod bsnyen bkur ci dgar spyod chog pa/ lhag par du blo stobs chen pos bsgyur bcos kyis bod rigs na gzhon shes ldan dag 'go khrid la gnas spar dang / phyi phyogs la sgo dbye ste phyi rgyal gyi mi sna khag yul skor spro 'cham la yong mkhan lo re bzhin mang du phyin pa dang / lha sa'i mgron khang chen mo dang /gangs ljongs mgron khang sogs gzhung sger mnyam gsum gyi mgron khang khag gnyer 'dzugs kyis gzhung sger yongs la yong 'bab byung nas phyug 'gyur gyi lam gsar gtod bcas la brten nas phal che ba lto gos 'dzoms shing / nyer mkho 'dzin chas spros rgyas dang dod byed pa sogs dus skabs bzang po'i bde skyid kyi 'go tshugs yod pa dang / phyi rgyal la yod pa'i bod rigs spun zla'i khongs nas rang rgyal du tshur log rnams la sne len gang gzab dang 'brel sdod khang sogs gang ci 'os babs bkod sgrig dang / shes yon 'jon thang la dpag pa'i las phogs gnang ba/ lo ltar 'char can lo gsar gyi dgos mkho gsol ras sogs gzigs bskyangs/ gnyen 'phrad du phebs mkhan tshor yang gang ci'i mthun 'gyur lta rtog gnang gi yod pa sogs krung dbyang gi yang dag pa'i mdzad jus bzang po de rnams dga' ba skye 'os pa zhig dngos 'brel yin/314

phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod rigs spun zlar 'dzin pa'i srid jus la 'gyur ba med pa gnang mus/ krung dbyang nas dga' bsu zhu gnang mdzad mus ltar tā la'i bla ma dang / phyi rgyal du bzhugs pa'i bod rigs spun zla rnams kyang snga tsam rang yul mes rgyal du tshur log phebs rgyu'i dgongs bzhes gnang skyong zhu rgyu bcas mjug tu bkra shis bde legs/ 1987lo'i zla 2tshes 25la mi’zhes bod ljongs mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi gsar 'god pa bzang po lags nas u tshugs kyis sgra 'dzugs byas song yang rgyang bsring byas yod pa thos ma byung /(14)1987lo'i zla 10tshes 15nyin sne len khang du bzhegs mol tshogs 'du'i thogaphyi rgyal nas bod rigs spun zla tshur log la ched btsugs ljongs sne len khang du tshur log gtan sdod byed mi rnams la brda tho phebs don bzhin/ gong tshes nyin de mo bla brang sne len khang (phyir log bod rigs spun zla'i sne len khang )du bzhugs mol tshogs 'du bskong tshogs kyis ljongs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs kyi dbu khrid kreng g.ying pu'u krang gis gtso skyong gnang ba'i gsung bshad kyi snying don krung dbyang gi mdzad phyogs dang / da lam lha sa'i zing char mthong tshul bsam 'char gsal bshad byed dgos gsungs pa bzhin phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis tshogs 'du de'i thog gtam bshad bgyis pa gsham gsal/‘‘deng skabs bod ljongs su chab srid kyi las don spyi dang / lhag par chos dad rang mos srid jus dang / mi rigs srid jus/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur srid jus bcas la tang krung dbyang nas mthong chen dang / gces skyong gnang gi yod pa dang / gzhan yang phyi phyogs su sgo dbye ba dang / nang khul dar rgyas/ mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes rig ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed phyir rim pa khag gi dbu khrid dang /315

'thab phyogs gcig 'gyur/ las byed pa/ bzo pa/ zhing 'brog mang tshogs bcas ser skya tshang mas rgyal khab kyi bka' slob lam ston gzhir bzung ste rang rang gi las 'khur la 'bad brtson cher bskyed byas nas lo ngo bdun brgyad tsam song ring phyogs gang ci yar rgyas phun sum tshogs po byung yod pa dang /lhag par zhing 'brog mi dmangs la khral rigs rtsa chag dang 'gan gtsang lam lugs khyab gdal gtong gnang mdzad pas bde skyid mngon gsal dod po byung ba dper na/ dud tshang mi nyung ba zhig gis khang pa gsar rgyag dang /nyams gso byas te bzo bkod yag la sge'u khung shel khra dkar gsal dod po dang / nang du gdan lcog dang / cha sgam/ mchod gshoms/ sku gsung thugs rten/ gzhan yang gnad che'i dgos mkho 'dzin chas sogs mkho dgu'i yo byad dngos gtsang grwa rgyas dang / pho mo'i gyon chas la dang bstod che ba/ sha mar sogs bza' btung longs spyod la sems khral med pa/ mchod 'bul dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen 'gyed rten 'brel dang / 'das mchod sogs yul goms gshis lugs kyi rang khyim du dge 'dun gdan zhus kyis chos phyogs byed sgo rang 'dod ltar byas chog pa/ blo bde bag phebs dang /zhor las dang / tshong las byed thub mkhan tsho ni de bas kyang gra 'grig phun sum tshogs shing phyug po'i lam la snyegs mkhan yang byung yod pa red/ sngar 'brog pa'i sdod mal sbra gur kho na yin rung / deng skabs 'brog khul la'ang khang pa mang po brgyab nas bza' 'bru zhing pa las lhag pa gsog nyar byed mkhan yang mang po yod pa red/ de bzhin sngar gyi tshong 'dus khag bskyar gso byas nas tshong rwa 'khrug pos yul zog sna mang brje tshong tsam ma zad/ rgyal nang spun zla'i zhing chen dang / phyi rgyal gyi dngos zog mang po nyo tshong 'bel 'bel lhug lhug yod pa/ grong khyer dang / grong rdal khag la rgyal khab nas gron dngul 'bor chen btang nas las khungs khag mang gi khang pa dang / slob 316

grwa che 'bring chung gsum/ dngul khang che 'bring chung gsum/ sbrag tar khang /bu gso khang / rgas gso khang / sman khang khag mang / lhag par du 1985lo gtso gnad kyi las grwa khag bzhi bcu zhe gsum gsar skrun gnang ba lha sa mgron khang dang / zlos gar khang chen/ lus rtsal khang chen/ mi dmangs sgyu rtsal khang / sman rtsis khang gi nad khang / bod ljongs sman khang chen mo/ bod ljongs mgron khang / de bzhin gzhis ka rtse dang / lho kha rtsed thang / nag chu/chab mdo/ nying khri/ stod mnga' ris bcas kron chus khag so sor yang khang chen mang po gsar bskrun byas yod pa de tsho spyir btang ma yin pa spun zla'i zhing chen khag nas lag rtsal mkhas can dang / rgyal khab nas dgos mkho rgyu cha spus dag mkho 'don gnang ba bcas khang pa rnams bzo legs bkod gtsang dang rgyal nang gi legs gras khongs su tshud pa de rnams kun gyi mig lam du dngos su mthong rgyu yod pa dang / khang pa so so'i nang gi sgrig chas cha lag tshang la spus ka dag pa/ de 'brel 'grim 'grul lam bzo la mtshon na mtsho bod lam chen dkyus ring de lta bu la zheng che'i 'khor lam snum nag bting ba dang / lha sa nas lho kha gong dkar gnam gru 'bab thang bar dang lha sa grong khyer gyi lam chen khag mang por snum nag bting ba/ lam gyi g.yas g.yon du ljon shing bstar bsgrigs kyi bkod pa mdzes pa/ grong khyer nang gi srang lam khag la rgya rdo gru bzhi ma che ba'i rdo gcal bsgrigs pa dang / sa 'og chu 'gro mkhregs sa'i lcags mdong ha cang sbom po bsgrigs sbyor ‘‘spyi le ’’kha shas sar btsugs nas chu snyigs shar bskyod thub pa/ ha las ngo mtshar che ba zhig la gor mo nas lha sa bar sa 'og lcags mdong nang 'khor snum drangs yod pa/grongakhyer nang chu ka la 'dzugs 'khrid dang khyim tshang tshang mar glog bzhu chad med spar rgyu yod pa/ las phogs yong khungs med rigs la skyob gso gnang ba/bu phrug rnams slob grwar btang ste shes yon gong mthor gtong ba/ tshong rigs 317

khag nas tshong khral phul phyin tshong thabs ci dgar byas chog pa/ phyi rgyal nas tshur log bod rigs spun zlar sne len khang ched 'dzugs gnang ste sne len gang gzab dang / sdod khang lag sne gsol ras/ lo ltar lo gsar la dgos mkho zur gsos dang / mgron 'bod/ rang rang 'jon thang la gzhigs pa'i las phogs gnang ba/ nga rang la cha bzhag na shes yon dman rung / grong khyer srid gros kyi rgyun las u yon bsko gzhag dang gzigs bskyangs thob pa las ka mi 'pher ba khag la'ang 'os babs bkod sgrig gnyen 'phrad dang / blta skor ba rnams la'ang mthun 'gyur sne len gang gzab gnang gi yod pa/ chos dad rang mos la srung skyob kyis rgyal khab nas gron dngul btang ste dbus gtsang gdan sa chen po bzhi dang / rgyud grwa stod smad/ sa skya dgon pa/ smin grol gling / mtshur phu/ chab mdo dgon sogs dbus gtsang mdo khams gang sar dgon sde khag mang nyams gso dang 'brel dge 'dun pa slar gso dang /grwa gsar chos zhugs sogs chos spyod bshad sgrub thos bsam gyi nyams len sngar gyi srol rgyun mi nyams gong 'phel du 'gro ba/ lo mang tshogs ma thub par lus pa lha ldan smon lam chen mo'ang gzhes ning lo nas dbu 'dzugs kyis lo ltar 'tshogs te dge bshes lha ram pa'i dam bca' sogs cho 'phrul zla ba'i mdzad sgo khag slar gso thub yod/ las byed pa dang / las bzo pa bzo pa rnams la rgyun phogs 'dod blo khengs nges yod pa dang / zhabs lo dang / lo na slebs mtshams las bshol rgan yol byas rigs phogs thob sgang tshang dang /brgya cha brgyad cu nas ma chag pa yod thog sdod khang gi thob cha'i dngul 'bab sgor chig khri nas dma' mthar sgor drug stong re gnang gi yod pa sogs bar skabs ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje ’’dang / lo bcu'i zang zing skabs dang mi 'dra ba skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs rjes tang krung dbyang dang / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi mdzad jus 318

yang dag pa rnams krung go rgyal yongs la khyab gdal dang / lhag par bod ljongs su dmigs bsal thugs 'khur che bzhes kyis rgyal sa pe cin du rang skyong ljongs kyi dbu khrid khag tshogs 'du bskong tshogs thengs gnyis (bod kyi las don skor gyi bzhugs mol tshogs 'du thengs dang gnyis )gnang thog srid jus lhug gtong gang legs kyi yig cha snga rjes gnang ba nang gsal nas bka' dgongs lag len gang thub bstar ba'i 'bras bur gong du smos pa'i yar rgyas de rnams byung ba red/ da dung rang re'i bod rang skyong ljongs nas krung dbyang gi bka' dgongs cha tshang bsgrub rgyu'i nus pa mi ldeng ba dang / sgrub ma thub pa'i las don kha shas nar lus su gyur pa'i stabs kyis shugs ma thub kyi gnod skyon phran bu yong gi yod pa las/ tang krung dbyang gis deng skabs bod la byams brtse'i lam ston dang / rgyab skyor thugs 'khur kha zhe med pa gnang gi yod pa nga la yid ches yod la/ don dngos kyi yar rgyas 'gro mus dang / bod mi dmangs rnams bde skyid kyi lam la kha phyogs nas 'gro dang 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs 'dir nye char grwa btsun na gzhon nyung shas shig nas sne khrid de spyi zla 9tshes 27nyin dang / zla 10tshes 1bcas la glo bur du (lha sar ) zing cha bslangs te ‘‘bod rang btsan ’’yin zhes skad 'bod khrom skor byas pas ma tshad khrims 'gal gyi bar skor don gcod khang le lag mer bsregs btang ba dang /bde 'jags las byed par rdo gzhus rmas skyon tshabs che dang / rlangs 'khor mer bsregalhas btang ba/ zing bslangs kyi rkyen pas mi drug tsam bsad 'das bcas sngar byung ma myong ba'i mthun sgril gtor bshigs dang / zing cha tshabs chen byung ba go thos la nga rang yang ha cang blo pham chen po byung / phyin chad zang zing de rigs mi 'byung ba'i thabs shes gnang gal che bar brten 'brel yod las khungs khag dang / lhag par gong rim gyi dbu khrid rnam pas dgongs pa zab bzhes gnang skyong yod pa dang / mi dmangs ser skya tshang mas mthun sgril 319

la gtor bshigs dang / mi dmangs kyi bde skyid bcas la gnod gzhi'i rigs mi 'byung ba'i thabs shes gang gzab gnang dgos pa ma zad/ nga tshos krung hwa dar rgyas phun sum tshogs po yong ba dang / mes rgyal gcig gyur/ mi rigs mthun sgril gyis can bzhi 'dzugs skrun la 'bad brtson dang / lhag par du mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes rig ldan pa bcas kyi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun la rang gzhan tshang mas legs skyes sngar las lhag par 'bul rgyu'i re 'dun dang 'bod bskul/ smon 'dun bcas zhu rgyu yin ’’zhes zhus/(15)1988lo'i zla 11tshes29nyin rang gi 'brel yod lo rgyus re'u mig 'bri 'bul zhus pa/lha sa grong khyer 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs nas phran blo bstan gyi lo rgyus shog lho 'bul dgos gsungs pa ltar lo rgyus 'god shog re'u mig nang 'god 'bul zhus pa phran dang / bu phrug pho mo dgu'i las gnas dang phogs rim sogs zhib 'khod phul ba dang / yang srid gros (grong khyer rgyun las khongs mi'i lo rgyus 'bul dgos zhes gsungs pa ltar phul gsham gsal/)320
— /༵shāṭāṭ+wāṃ byeshā /ṭ+wāṃ sbyapa dītrī / ḍi rdoḍi sbyaspya ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ/༵na/ ṭādaste/

—— ——— — da — — — — —skye yul mal gung lha sding / pha mal gung rdzong gi las drung dbang lhadu~X tshe ring dang /rum sgrol 'dzoms gnyidze+e s+t+ra buphrukālngaṭ+wāṃdapa'i rgan ༵sna byeṭā /khangachu ༵ slodī' sbyo spya dī/ /nasad ṭ+wāṃ sna khupyi ṭ+wāṃ trī d+ngha tre/ 'i~X yo ṅgi py-i~X /gnyis byas/ de rjes rdo shing spyi khyab shing bzo las tshan karma bsod namasat+t+waṃ bu /sa ma/ dropar dpon khuzlos nas bak+tor/ bla phyag las t+nad+nghasdu tā ṭ+wāṃdī twe ṭ+wāṃ~X dīkā sna ṭ+wāṃgaphyo r+shadī dī ༵ bya~Xng/ bye~Xṭ+wāṃ /byama~X sna sdodī /thengs kha shas dang / mes rgyal nang 1954lor blta skor du 'gro myong /bod ljongs slob 'bring gi dge rgan byed mur 1958lor de snga sa gnas srid gzhung rnying pas mtsho sna 'bras khang gzhung 'dzin mi 'gror btang ste/1959lor lho kha lhun rtser yod/ lo der rgya gar du phyin nas yul gyar gzhung gi bka' drung dang / shes rig drung che/ zlos gar 'go 'dzin/ldi li rlung 'phrin las ka sogs lo 22ring las ka byas/ 1979lor bal yul du gnas mjal bsnyen sgrub byas/ 1980lor rang yul du log nas 1982lor lha sa grong khyer srid gros u yon du bskos/ 1984lor grong khyer srid gros rgyun las u yon bsko gzhag stsal ba bcas so/

skre ṭaṃ shelnge skre khroskrelnge khroskre da skre ༷ sdak+ṣiṃ ne+e / ༷tswa t+t+waṃ tweṭaṃ ṭ+wāṃt+t+waṃ ṭ+wāṃ / twebye twerdosdusna/spya ༵/ra trīlda tā~X/lhu/ r+sha / tram̐ k+ta tram̐ne+e zlo snaṭ+wāṃ~X ṭ+wāṃsbya trī sbyi gatram̐/ba byad ༷ṭ+wāṃ/ga rgi byetwe /tswaX/ ༷/ py-irdo ༷rdoX byesna/ ༷ ༷ ṭ+wāṃ cho ṭī ༷༷༷༷༷༷ ༷ ༷ ṭ+wāṃ / twe ༷༷ byedī/

(16)1988lo'i zla 12pa'i nang lha sar zing cha byung skor gong rim dbu khrid 'ga' zhig gi bka' 'brel bsam shog phul ba/gong zla'i nang ljongs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs kyi sku tshab pa sangs lags dang / phyir log bod rigs spun zla'i sne len las khungs kyi sku tshab 'jam dpal lags dang mtshams gcod lags bcas phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi sar ched phebs kyis nye char 1988lo'i zla 12tshes 12nyin lha sar zing cha byung ba der khyed rang gi bsam tshul dang mthong tshul ji yod gsal brjod dgos lugs gsung par gnas lugs gsal zhu dang 'brel zhen bskul bsam shog cig phul ba gsham gsal/‘‘ljongs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs dang / phyir log bod rigs spun zla'i sne len las khungs bcas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas mchog la/khyed lhan rgyas kyi bka' mngags ltar nye char sku tshab las byed blo mthun gsum phran sar ched phebs kyis gsung gsal/ da lam 1988lo'i zla 12tshes 12nyin lha sar zing cha byung ba der khyed rang la bsam tshul dang mthong tshul ji yod dri brtsad gnang byung bar/ rang nyid kha 'don byas nas sdod mus la brten gnas tshul mig mthong ma byung rung / nye char lha sar zing cha byung ste grwa pa gcig srog skyon byung lugs rna bas thos pa tsam las zhib cha shes ma byung /mthun sgril kha bral gtong ba'i bya las de tshang mar phan pa med pa'i gnod skyon che shos shig yin par ngas dus gtan du ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ da res zing cha de nyen rtogs pas lam seng 'gog srung zhod 'jags gang legs btang thub na'ang / bden gtam mam dkrog gtam gang yin ma shes/ grwa pa shi ba'i khrag gi steng du kha btags dang / dngul mang po spungs bzhag yod lugs thos pa dngos 'brel yin tshe cung nyen khar brten don de gong rim nas mkhyen rtogs gnang gal che zhing / ljongs gong rim nas dus gtan du las don che phra mtha' dag la brtag dpyad rgyun bsring lhod g.yeng ma song ba gnang 324
