skyong zhu rgyu'i zhen bskul bsam shog tu/ dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis 1988lo'i zla 12tshes 24la phul ’rizhes pa gong gsal las byed rnam pa gsum brgyud phul/(17) 1989lo'i gli 9ches 8nyin srid jus don 'khrol skor zhabs bskul snyan shogasbul ba/‘‘bod rang skyong ljongs srid jus don 'khyol gyi phyag las mdzad gtso lhan rgyas mchog la snyan seng zhu rgyur/ gus phran se ra chos sding du sdod pa'i dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin 1980lor phyi rgyal rgya gar nas bal yul brgyud rang yul lha sar gnyen 'phrad du yong bar srid gzhung nas sne shan bsod stobs lags dang / g.yu sgron lags ched 'dzugs kyis sno len gzab rgyas thog dgyes brtse'i mtshams 'dri dang 'brel/ ‘‘khyed kyi bu phrug tshang ma bod du yod par brten khyed rang rang yul lha sar gtan sdod gzhis chags su bsdad na gang legs yong rgyu dang / srid gzhung nas kyang gang cir lta rtog thugs 'khur che bzhes gnang rgyu ’’zhes mdza' brtse'i bka' slob gnang bar dga' mos byung yang / ‘‘snga 'phros rgya gar du thengs gcig ma log thabs med yin/gang lags she na/ gus pas rgya gar rlung 'phrin khang du las ka byas pa'i phogs 'phar gsog 'jog byas pa sgor drug khri tsam len rgyur bsdad pa de dag blangs te nges par du bod la phyir log bcar chog pa ri’zhes par/ ‘phogs dngul len rgyu'i thad gzhung 'brel gyi rgya gar gzhung la bka' mol zhus na 'grigs lugs migasungs par brten bod du gzhis chags gtan sdod bya rgyur thag bcad/ bod du 'gyur ba byung nas yar rgyas phyin pa'i skor sogs rlung 'phrin nang rgyang bsring thengs 'ga' shas byas par gzhis byes bod mi phal che ba'i blo la ma babs par phran la ‘mgo gnyis ma ’dang / mgo btags pa ’zer ba dang / ‘mar khe si'i dge slong mizer ba sogs ming 'dogs sna tshogs kyis khong khro byed pa dang / rgya gar du yod pa'i bod rigs nas kyang ‘dge 325

slong smyang ma mgo ’dang / ‘mi rigs kyi zhabs 'dren/ rgyal tshong pa ’zer ba sogs kyi mi ngan yin lugs gsar 'gyur 'grems spel byas pa sogs srog mgo mi thon pa'i gnas su gyar ba'i dka' ngal gnas tshul mang po zhig byung yang bzod sgom ma byed thabs med du gyur/ gnas tshul de tsho 'brel yod tshang mas shes gsal dang / srid gzhung nas kyang sne shan gnyis brgyud gsungs gsal/ 6khyed kyi re 'dun ji yod gsungs na thugs 'khur bzhes rgyu mizhes bka' bzang phebs par brten rang nyid kyi snga phyi'i lo rgyus sbas gsang med pa drang bden gsal zhu dang / 1958lo gus pa dpal lha'i gzan rtags nas thon te mtsho sna 'bras khang gzhung 'dzin mi 'gror gtong gnang ltar thon bskyod kyis 1959lo zing 'khrugs skabs lha sar bsdad med pa ma zad/ snga phyir zing 'khrugs nang the gtogs gang yang med la lha sar yod pa'i phru gu'i a ma dang / bu phrug rnams kyang zing 'khrugs nang rtsa ba nas the gtogs med pa dngos ra gsal 'phrod la brten gus tsho'i de snga'i rang bdag sger khang zhol don po khang pa dang / mkhar dngos tshang ma bar skabs srid jus nor 'khrul gyi gzhung bzhes byas pa rnams srid jus don 'khyol gyis phyir slog gsol ras yong ba zhes gong gsal sne shan gnyis brgyud ngag zhu dang / yig thog snyan zhu phul bar/ gong rim la snyan seng gis rim bzhin dgongs bzhes yong rgyu dang /khang pa'i thad don smin yong 'gro yang mi dmangs sdod khang mi ldeng ba'i dka' ngal che bas snga 'khros don po'i shar rgyud rtsis len byas 'thus dang / mi dmangs sdod khang gsar rgyag byed mus la tshar rim bzhin khyod kyi khang pa nas spo shugs byed 'jug rgyu zhes 1981lo bka' phebs pa bzhin gus pas rlung 'phrin rgyang bsring nang tang krung dbyang nas bod la 'dzugs skrun sogs gang legs gnang ba'i gnas tshul dngos yod dang / tang gi srid jus yang dag pa yin pa/ rang nyid sger la cha mtshon na sngar gyi rang bdag sger khang cha tshang 326

phyir slog gsol ras bka' drin che byung zhes rlung 'phrin nang snga rjes gsal bsgrags byas pa dang / bu phrug pho mo dgu yod khongs nas bu mo gcig ma gtogs de byings srid gzhung nas gso skyong gnang ste rang rang la phogs thob nas 'tsho bar dka' ngal med pa/ bdag dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin shes yon dman yang rgyal khab kyi gces nor gsum gyi gral khongs grong khyer lha sa'i srid gros kyi u yon dang / rgyun las u yon bsko gzhag gis gdeng 'jog gang legs gnang ba ltar rang ngos nas kyang rgyal gces lhag bsam bzang po'i sri zhu bsgrubs pa/ chos dad rang mos la longs su spyad de rnam kun kha 'don dge sbyor byas nas bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba skyel bzhin pa sogs rlung 'phrin nang dril bsgrags dang / mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes rig ldan pa'i bod gsar 'dzugs skrun gyi bya gzhag la shugs gnon yod rgu rtsal sprugs zhu bzhin pa bcas kyi dngos yod gnas tshul la gzhigs na srid jus don 'khyol 'phral mar gnang 'os che yang / nyam chung tshul mthun du sdod mkhan la snang chung mdzad pa ni ga la srid/ phyag las mdzad rgya'i dbab gis rim 'gyangs gyur pa yin shag gang ltar khang pa'i bdag thob kyi yig cha'ang rjes su gzhan dag dang chabs cig thon rgyu gsungs te da bar lo dgu tsam ring zhabs bskul lo bstud de ngang sgug zhus kyang don son ma byung bas da cha srid jus don 'khyol gyi skor 'di zla dgu pa nas mjug bsdoms gnang gi yod lugs go thos byung bas/ des na zhu don snying po gus pas rgya gar la yod pa'i dngul 'bor de tsam blos btang gis rgyal gces lhag bsam gyi sri zhu bsgrubs pa sogs gong du zhus pa'i don gnas rnams la dgongs pa che bzhes kyis bka' 'khrol zin pa'i gus tsho'i sger khang zhol don po'i sa khang cha tshang rtsis len 'phral du byas chog pa zhig dang / sa khang bdag thob kyi gtan tshigs lag 'khyer 'phral stsol yong ba/ de 'brel dngos tho zur phul nang gsal rnams la 327

rgyal khab kyi yig cha'i dgongs don rin dngul gsol ras gnang skyong yod pa bcas rgyal gces mi sna lus ngag yid gsum 'bul mkhan la dgongs bzhes kyis don smin 'phral myur gsol ras brtse gzigs zhu rgyu'i snyan shog tu/ dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis gus btud bcas/ 1989lo'i zla 9tshes 8la phul ’’zhes pa'i snyan zhu rgya yig bod yig gnyis ka dang / mkhar dbang dngos tho rgya yig bod yig phru gu pho mo mi dgu'i lo rgyus rgya yig bcas lha sa grong khyer 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs brgyud 'bul lam zhus yod pa thugs zhib kyis dngos po rnams la rin bsgyur byas na dma' mthar yang krung sgor khri brgya phrag brgal nges lags na dgongs bzhes thugs rje mi chung ba skyabs 'jug mkhyen/ mkhyen/ mkhyen/ zhes zhus/(18)zangs ri rdzong la yi gezhag phul ba/‘‘mkhyen rlabs mtshungs med zangs ri rdzong tang srid dbu khrid lhan rgyas mchog gi sku drung du/ stabs 'bul/ ji ltar dgongs par mnga' gsal bzhin 'ol dga' zhol gyi chu tshan rnams nad bcos la phan nus che ba'i grags can la brten spyi phan gyi ched du gzhes ning / (1986)lo phran gyis chu tshan khag bzhi nyams gso dang / lhag par gro lo phar chu tshan tsha grang gnyis ka'i chu yur shangs nas rdo gcal dang / rtsig pa nyams gso/ thog mar gzugs po 'khru bsha' byed pa gsar bzo mkhregs sa'i rmig 'dag byug nas rdo brtsigs lcags ri bskong ste gang byung 'gro bskyod mi 'byung ched lcags sgo ru bzhi me long rang 'grigs la mdzo sna kri lcags gsar pa bsgar te sgo lcags brgyab rgyu yod pa bcas 'khos dpag 'gro gron 'dzems med btang nas dngos gtsang gang legs gsar bskrun byas pa der rdzong dbu khrid lhan rgyas nas dga' bsu gnang ba ma zad ring min mgron khang gcig dang / thab tshang / chu srung sdod khang bcas khang mig gsum zangs ri rdzong nas gsar rgyag gnang rgyu'i ngo mjal zhal bzhes thob kyang khyed lhan rgyas phyag las mdzad brel che rkyen gyis 328

phyag bzhes bstar rgyu ma byung mur/ da cha go thos su chu tshan gyi sgo yang rku 'khyer dang / lcags ri gzhig ral sogs nyams chags gyur yod tshod 'dug pas thugs 'khur che bzhes kyis nyams gso gsar rgyag 'phral du gnang skyong zhu rgyu dang / gus dang rogs pa bcas spyi zla gnyis pa'i nang chu tshan sman bcos su yong rgyu lags pas de skabs sdod khang sogs bsdad chog yong ba'i skyabs 'jug ci nas yod pa zhu/se ra chos sding sgang nas dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis/1989lo'i zla 1tshes 11la phul/mi’(19)1989lo'i bla 2ches 29nyin grong khyer grid gros kyi brda phebs don bzhin bod yig gi yig gzugs 'ga' zhigashāsaspra/grong khyer srid gros u yon rnams kyi bod yig 'grems ston byed ched tshang mas yig tshad bris 'bul zhu dgos phebs pa bzhin phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis 'bru rtsa dang / tshugs thung / tshugs chung / tshugs ma 'khyug 'khyug yig bcas so so nas sho lo ka re bris 'bul zhus pa'i tshig gzhir/‘‘spyi tshogs ring lugs rlabs chen nyi ma'i 'od/mi nub 'dzam gling dpal du rtag 'char bas/srid zhi'i rgud tshogs rmongs mun rab bsal nas/kun phan zhi bde'i snang bas khyab par smon ’mizhes dang / ‘‘bdag ni sems can thams cad la/ yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i/ don mchog sgrub pa'i bsam pa yis/ rtag tu gces par 'dzin par shog mimices sogs glang thang tshigs brgyad ma bkod bris kyis phul yang / de rjes grong khyer srid gros nas gsung gsal/ rang skyong ljongs kyi bka' dgongs ljongagayongs nas bod yig yig tshad 'bul dgos la yig tshad bris 'bul dgos phebs pa 329

ltar tshugs thung sho lo ka gcig phul ba'i tshig gzhir/‘‘legs bshad dbyangs snyan sgrog pa'i khu byug de/legs skyes lus 'degs bskyod pa'i gar dang bcas/legs tshogs sgo brgya phye ba'i mdun sa cher/legs byas rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i ched du dengs/zhes pa'i tshigs bcad yig gzungs spyan zhu'i ched/ rim gong bka' dgongs sa bcad ma stong tsam/ dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis lag bris su rab rgyal sa sbrul zla 3tshes 8dge bar phul ’’zhes gong gsal yig tshad bkram ston la gzigs phebs khongs bod rigs gzhon nu 'ga' zhig gis sho lo ka dang po'i tshig gzhir yid ma rangs pa lta bu dang / glang thang tshig brgyad ma tshig don phun gsum tshogs pa 'dug ces dga' mos byed lugs go thos byung /(20)chu tshan khag 'ga' zhig gi gnas yul dang phan yon skoracwas pa/‘‘ngos dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin nad gcong la brten stod lung dang / mal gro gung dkar/ lho kha zangs ri bcas khag bzhi'i chu tshan la sman bcos su bskyod pa yin gshis/ sa khul so so'i gnas tshul mthong thos rnams yig lam du bkod na ma 'ongs sman bcos la phebs mkhan tsho'i rang gi nad babs dang mthun pa'i spang blang mdzad rgyur phan khyad yong ched rim par 'god pa la/(ka)stod lung bde chen rdzong khongs stod 'tsho chu bzang chu tshan ni/lha sa grong khyer gyi nub byang phyogs su lam thag spyi le lnga bcu skor gyi sa chu bzang ri steng du yod cing / rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad spyi khre bzhi stong brgal ba yod tshod dang / chu tshan gyi lo rgyus yig cha ma rnyed pas rgan rabs kyi ngag rgyun du 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po sa gnas der zhabs bcags mdzad skabs pho rog gcig gis lung bstan pa lta bu'i tshul gyis chu tshan de sngog 330

'don gnang ste rje rang nyid chab bzhes mdzad lugs dang / nad rigs kun 'joms kyi sman chu nus ldan yin par grags/ rtsa ba'i chu tshan gyi chu de ar 'dam lta bu'i brag phug gi nang nas thon shugs chung bas rdzing bu gang bar dus yun chu tshod gsum tsam 'gor gyi 'dug brag phug de'i nang sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rang byon dang / nub byang phyogs su rje tsong kha pa chen po'i sku stod dang / dbu'i dpar rjes brag ldebs su 'dag par sa ts+tsha dpar 'debs byas pa lta bu da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod pa dang / de min pho rog gi rang byon dang /chudze+eng chus khengs pa brag steng nas 'og rdzing du babs pa'i g.yas g.yon du glang chen kha sprod kyi rang byon gzugs brnyan yod pa rnams ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i ’miskabs gtor bshig song 'dug chu rdzing lte ba'i brag phug 'khor rgya smi gru bzhi ma brgyad tsam dang / chu'i gting tshad kung khre gang tsam khengs mtshams lho nub phyogs brag steng nas sku gzugs 'khru sa'i 'og rdzing nang babs pa dang / 'og rdzing de'i shar lho'i phyogs su drod tshad cung zad dma' ba'i chu rdzing rgya khyon smi gru bzhi ma drug tsam dang chu'i gting tshad skar ma bzhi bcu tsam gang ba dang bug pa zhig brgyud 'og rdzing nang babs pa bcas rdzing gnyis kyi rtsa ba'i chu rtsa gcig gyur yin tshod 'dug kha char 'bab skabs chu'i kha dog skya bor 'gyur 'gro ba las spyir na dwangs shing gsal ba/ btung na rnam kun spyir btang gi 'thung chu dang mi 'dra ba dri cung zad yod pa zhig 'dug rgan rabs kyi ngag rgyun la chu tshan 'di ni rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i nad rigs spyi 'joms kyi chu sman byin rlabs can zhig yin tshul tsam las lo rgyus dkar chag sogs mig ston bya rgyu mi 'dug kyang /1976lo bod ljongs sa gshis cus kyis zhib 'jug byas pa'i yi ge zhig chu tshan khar lcags shog thog bris pa sbyar 'grems nang 'khod gsal/ chu tshan nang rdzas 'gyur gyi rgyu sna mang po yod pa dang / tsha tshad ldan la rin chen bcud nus 331

yod pas 'thung ba dang / brgal na dbang rtsa nyams gso datsā pho rgyu gnyis kyi nus pa che ru 'gro ba/ 'ju byed dang phyir gtong nus pa snyoms pa/gzugs gzhi yongs kyi rtsa rgyud sgrig 'jug sogs kyi nus pa thon pa bcas kyis gzugs stobs bskyed thog khrag rtsa rgyugs pa dang / glo nad 'don pa/ gnyan tshad gcog pa/ dregs med pa bzo ba/ 'bam grum dang / lpags nad/ pho ba'i nad sogs la mngon gsal chen po'i nus pa yod pa ma zad khrag shed mtho ba'i nad khag la'ang nus pa nges can yod ces 'khod 'dug pa ltar ngos rang gi mkhal nad dang / rkang nad la phan nus gang legs byung / ston dpyid gnyis la phyogs gang sa nas gur dang gdan thab chas sogs khyer te chu tshan rgyag tu yong mkhan mang ba dang / phyis su sdod khang gsar rgyag gis khang gla dang / gdan gla sprod len byed pa las/ chu gla sne sel tsam las sprod ma dgos pa dang / stod lung chu bzang chu tshan 'dir deng dus sdod khang khang mig nyer brgyad nang mi grangs brgya tsam nyal sdod byed sa yod kyang / lcags kyi nyal khri bco brgyad dang / 'bol gdan cha sum cu tsam las med pa ma zad/ lcog tse'ang khang pa bzhi'i nang yod pa las de byings nang lcog tse med/ phran blo bstan lo mang chu tshan la 'gro rim bzhin chu gnyer dang / shang gi 'go khrid la lhag bsam zol med zhen bskul gyis khang pa'i nang gdan lcog ldeng nges dang /nyal chas sogs cha tshang gra sgrig za khang zhig btsugs na chu tshan du yong mkhan mang du 'gro ba dang / 'grul par phan pa ma zad shang la'ang yong 'bab che ru 'gro lugs 'bod bskul lo ltar byas rung / de lta'i 'gro gron gzhung nas gsol ras ma gnang na nga tshor dngul med lugs dang / gzhung la zhus kyang gnang mkhan med pas bya thabs bral lugs zer/ 'o na bogs mar btang na yar rgyas cha tshang gtong rgyur khas len byed mi 'dug gshis/ khyed tshor da lta'i yong 'bab las 'phar ba sprod mkhan yod lugs brjod na'ang bogs mar 332

gtong gi min zer te sems sbug dog pos sri zhu je zhan ngang gnas mus red/(kha)gro mo rdzong phag ri kham bu chu tshan zhes pa phag ri grong rdal gyi nub phyogs ri bo'i la zhig brgal na thag nyer yod rung / dgun dpyid kha bas la lam 'gag dus gro mo shar gsing mar bskyod de shar gsing ma'i nub brgyud nas byang gi phu chu gyen 'ded kyis 'gro dgos/ shar gsing ma nas kham bu chu tshan bar rgyang thag spyi le nyi shu tsam med dam snyam pa dang / nags ri rdzogs mtshams nas spa ma ba lu tha thor skyes pa'i spang ri dang / rdza ri 'dres ma lta bu'i ri gsham/ gam pa dang ka la'i chu bo nub byang nas shar lhor rgyu ba'i chu 'gram der chu tshan thon khungs khag nyi shu skor yod kyang ming can chu tshan khag bcu gnyis la chu skyor rdzing bu skong yod med sna tshogs 'dug nga tsho 1983lo chu tshan du bskyod skabs chu tshan bdag gnyer rgan mo lo brgyad cu gya lngar slebs pa las kar do snang che ba zhig 'dug pa khong la chu tshan gyi lo rgyus yig cha 'dri brtsad bgyis par/ lo rgyus yig rnying shog lho 'thor gyar ral rdol can yig 'bru gsal la mi gsal zhig mig ston byung bar cha tshang min yang / rgan mo'i ngag lam nas brjod gsal/ kham phu'i brag phug tu o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas sgrub pa mdzad nas bzhugs skabs gzhon nu ma bcu gnyis lhags 'byor gyis mjal kha dgos lugs zer ba bzhin mjal kha gnang / khyod tsho gar 'gro zhes bka' 'dri gnang bar khong tshos nga tsho byang sham bha lar 'gro mi yin zhus par/gu ru rin po ches khyed rnams 'dir bsdad na 'gro don che zhes bka' stsal bas gzhon nu ma de rnams bstan ma bcu gnyis yin gshis sdod rgyu'i khas len zhus pa ltar ming can chu tshan bcu gnyis gnyer du gtad lugs zer zhing / kham phu chu tshan ni rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad spyi khre lnga stong brgal ba yod tshod dang /chu gnyer rgan mo'i lag tu yod pa'i yig rnying ral rdol can kham phu chu tshan gyi chu yig ces pa de'i nang / ‘‘thog mar yul 'di'i lha klu gzhis bdag dang /333

rdzing bu so so gnyer du gtad pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis rnams bsangs gsol gyis mchod par byas/ khyad par o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la dad gus drag pos gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'jug nas rang gzhan gyi nad rigs dang / sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs thob par bya snyam pa'i kun slong bcos te rim bzhin khrus rdzing khag la chab ma 'khrugs mi rnyog par zhugs par bya/ de yang o rgyan gyis/ sems can sgyu lus nad kyis 'jigs pas mnar/ de dus nga la gsol ba rtse gcig thob/ o rgyan sman gyi lha dang dbyer med pas/ las zad min rnams sel bar the tshom med/ ces pa ltar yid ches dang / nad dang sdig sgrib zhi ba'i mos pa gyis shig ’’ces 'khod 'dug(1)lha mo rdzing zhes bya ba rdo rje kun bzang mar gnyer du gtad pa'i rdzing bu 'dir dang thog bsangs dang gsol ba btab ste der khrus la zhugs dgos/'di'i phan yon ni las ngan sdig sgrib dang / mi gtsang ba'i dri ma thams cad sbyang zhing / khyad par bad rlung mgo 'khor dang / khrag mkhris/ chu ser gsar rnying kun sel ba/ gzhan yang nad rigs phal cher sel ba'i nus pa yod/(2)bya rgod rdzing zhes bya ba 'dir sngon gyi dus su bya rgod cig gshog pa chag ste stes dbang gis rdzing bu der lhungs pa chab kyi nus pas 'phral du gsos shing bde bar 'phur bas bya rgod rdzing zhes grags/ chu'i rgyu mo cong las grub pa'i phan yon ni/ mgo nad dang / rus chag rireg dug rkang 'bam/ rmu chu'i 'jug rma dang shu ba/ stod gzer/ stod skod/ khyad par dkar nag khra gsum sel zhes grags/ 'di ni rdo rje dpal la gnyer du gtad/(3)dpon rdzing ya ma rdzing gi chab rgyu ni/ dzing byang ma mu zi dkar po dang / rdzing lho ma mu zi nag po las grub cing / phan yon ni/ khrag sing ya ma dkar nag 'joms/ de yang lho mas slang zhing byang mas drag mkhris pa dang 334

klad nas sel/ 'on kyang lo rgan mkhal sked na ba dang / grang ba dang / grum bus mnar ba rnams zhugs na mi 'grigs spang par bya/ byang rdzing gnyer kha rdo rje spyan gcig dang / lho rdzing rdo rje g.yab ma kun la gtad/(4)brag skyes rdzing gi chab rgyu mu zi dang ni cong zhi gnyis las grub/phan yon ni chu ser dang ni skya bab dang / mig nad mgo nad rna nad dang /stod nad snying nad sel bar byed/ khyad par khrag mkhris nad dag sel/ snga dro gzhan dang / dgong dro rdzing 'dir zhugs/ 'di yi gnyer kha rdo rje drag la gtad/(5)thang rdzing a rgan zhes bya ba'i chab rgyu rdo rgyud cong zhi gnyis las grub/phan yon dregs dang grum bu mdze nad dang / rkang 'bam dug g.ya' tshad ro la sogs dang / mkhal sked nad gram sogs la shin tu mngags/ skrang sbos za gcong sogs la 'dzems par gces/ 'di yi gnyer kha rdo rje kun drag yin/(6)dus kun rdzing ngam/ slob dpon pad+ma zhes sam/ deng dus a phrug rdzing zer ba'i chab rgyu gcung gzhi pho la ma ni cung zad 'dres pa'i phan yon ni/grang ba dkar 'dzags dmar 'dzags dang / pho ba 'bam grum dkar nag dang / mkhal grang dpyi mig gzer nad dang / bad kan sogs la phan zhes gsungs/ 'di yi gnyer kha sman srung zhwa dpon chen por gtad/(7)gser nya rdzing ngam gser ka rdzing zhes pa'i phan yon ni/ bad kan ser rlung nad/ 'bam grum chu ser tshigs nad dang / mkhal grang chu snyil grum bu'i rigs la phan/ mig la cung zad gnod pas 'dzems par bya/ 'di yi gnyer kha grags chen rdo rje bgegs cor la gtad/(8)dong sbug rdzing ngam bad khrag rdzing zhes bya ba'i chab rgyu ni/ ma ni gcong dang mo gcong dang / mu zi cung zad 'dres pa yis/ phan yon glo nad mchin mtsher dang / pho ba'i nad dang bad kan dag skya ser gsar rnying thams cad dang / 'dus nad rmug ser sel la mchog dug nad la yang phan 335

pa yin/ 'di yi sman srung gnyer kha ni/ mkha' lding rdo rje lha mor gtad/(9)bla ma rdzing gi chab rgyu mo gcong dang mu zi nag po las grub pa'i phan yon ni/ chu ser bad kan skya bo dang / mgo nad thams cad la phan no/ dzing bu 'di yi gnyer kha ni/ rdo rje sman gcig ma la gtad/(10)brag rgyab rtsa dkar dzing gi chab rgyu gcong zi pho la mu zi ljang khu cung zad 'dres pa'i phan yon ni/ bad kan dang ni mkhris pa dang / pho rgyu chu ser rigs la phan/ khyad par rtsa grib dang / rtsa dkar nag drang srong chu nad la yang e ma ho/ 'di la phu rgyal/ byang sems babs pa'i gang zag la dngos grub sna re yod ces ye shes mdzad/ rdzing 'di'i bdag po rdo rje zur legs yin/(11)brdzi po dzing gi phan yon ni/ pho skran grang skrang skrang pa dang / me dros gsos shing mkhal nad grang nad dang / 'bam grum dkar nag sbos skrang dug nad dang / khyad par se dug nad la mchog tu phan/ khrag tshad maphris nad can rnams 'dzems par gyis/ 'di yi bdag po'ang rdo rje zur legs yin/(12)nub rdzing chab kyi rgyu ni gcong gzhi pho mor grub cing phan yon ni/dregs dang grum bu rkang 'bam dang / grang khrag chu ser thur 'bab dang / chu ser tshig sgril rma 'bras dang / 'di ni sman chu kun gyi rgyal po yin/ nad gzhi langs nas bdun rer 'di la zhugs/ 'on kyang bad rlung dros khrag rgyas pa dang / mkhris pa can la phog pas 'dzems par gyis/ bdag po gnyan pas thab zhob sogs la 'dzems/ nad thog sman chu 'bad pas yun ring mthud/rang rang lus gzugs 'khrus la dag par bsten/ sman chu gsol zhing zil rlung ma shor bar/ bal gdan sogs kyis sgril ba gnad du che/ chu zhag thims rjes mar dkar dwangs mas byugs zhes dang / thag ring nas yong ba'i nad pas thog mar ngal gso byas nas nad khrag dang zung khrag gnyis phye ba gal 336

che zhing / de nas rim gyis 'jug ces mkhas pas gsungs/ 'di nyid tshul ldan spyod gyur na/ nad dag 'joms shing lus khams bde/ rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrubs bya'i phyir/ dam pa'i chos la spyod par bya/ sdig spong dge sgrub nan tan bya/ tshe lhag don dang ldan par mdzod/ chu zhag thims mtshams yul lha gzhis bdag la gtang rag gsol mchod gang legs sogs byed sgo ma 'phyug pa dgos pa lags so/(ga)mal gro gung dkar rdzong khongs 'bri gung gter sgrom chu tshan ni/ lha sa nas shar phyogs su spyi le brgyad cu trem gyi sa reb phu gter sgrom dgon pa'i mdun 'og tu yod/ rgyab ri glang chen gzugs brnyan gyi sna mchu 'dra ba'i 'og gram hrug gi dkyil nas chu lbu ba chil chil khag mang po nas thon pa'i chu tshan sbug ma rdo brtsigs sgor mo dpangs la kung khre gsum tsam dang / chu'i gting tshad skar ma lnga bcu trem/ rgya khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma nyi shu skor yod pa dang / chu rdzing mdo ma rag skyor rgya khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma sum cu tsam gyi nang gi nub phyogs nas chu lbu ba chil chil du thon zhing / rdzing sbug ma'i chu 'dres pa dang bcas chu chen rgyugs chu dwangs gtsang gting tshad skar ma drug cu tsam yod pa drod tshad che chung 'dod mthun gyi 'dzul sdod chog pa yod/ deng skabs rdzing sbug mar bu rnams dang / mdo mar bu mo rnams chu zhugs byed/ chu tshan la phebs mkhan tsho bzhugs yul khang mig che chung lnga 'dug pa'i nang sa khri dang / shing gi nyal khri bsdoms mi grangs nyi shu skor shong pa 'dug ste rtsa 'bol las gtsang gdan sogs gang yang med la/ lcogs tse'ang re zung las med pa de skabs cha rkyen zhan/ mi res nyin re gla cha sgor gnyis re sprod dgos/ 'bri gung gter sgrom kyi lo rgyus dang / sngar gyi gnas yig chu tshan gyi phan nus sogs zhib phra 'khod pa zhig de sngon yod lugs 'dug kyang ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i ’miskabs gtor brlag tu song stabs gter sgrom dgon pa'i dge slong bgres po chos 'phel dang / chags chen 'phel dar gnyis nas lo rgyus gsal bshad 337

dang / phyogs sgrig mkhan chos rje bzang po bcas nas kun la phan res lhag bsam bzang pos rab lo 956chu khyi (1982)lo'i zla 6tshes 10nyin gsar du brtsams bsgrigs byas pa gsham gsal/‘‘chu tshan chags yul ni/ lo stong phrag gi lo rgyus yod pa'i gnas ri khyad par can zhig yin pa'i bshad srol yod pa de dag bod ljongs lha sa grong khyer/mal gro gung dkar rdzong rmam pa chus/ gter sgrom shang khongs su gnas yod/de lho 'dzam bu gling du mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas chen bdun yod pa'i nang tshan gos kyi gong ba lta bu las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum 'du ba'i gnas gzhu stod gter sgrom brag dkar du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi lo bdun zla bdun zhag bdun sgrub pa mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro gsang ba mchog sgrub kyi phug pa zhes bya ba rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad spyi khre lnga stong tsam yod pa ngo mtshar can gyi gnas mchog yul ljongs mdzes sdug ldan pa (brag )bya sgro dkar po nam mkhar 'phyo ba dang mtshungs/ sngar gyi gnas yig tu bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan bsam yas su bzhugs skabs slob dpon gyis rdzu 'phrul gyi rta sngon po chibs nas byang phyogs su reb tsam gyis chibs rgyugs mdzad de mkha' 'gro gsang ba 'dus pa'i tshogs khang du phebs skabs mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bsu bar byon nas mar thud rtsig pa rdo yi rang byon da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ slob dpon gyis sgrub phug der yun ring bzhugs nas 'gro ba'i don du chos gter dang / nor gter/ brag gter/ sa gter/ chu gter sogs khyad du 'phags pa'i nor gter du mdzad pa rnams gong ma'i bka' brgyud gdan rabs rim byon gyis khag gcig gter nas bzhes pa'i gter khung dang rang byon gter dngos rnams gnas rir phebs skabs rim bzhin mjal rgyu yod/ lhag par chu gter gyi gtso bo chu tshan 'di nyid thog mar gsang sngags bde chen pho brang (gter sgrom dgon pa )tshogs khang mdun du dug mtsho chen po zhig chags nas gza' dang / srin po/ klu bdud bcas kyis chu 'di 'gro thabs med pa'i rmu 338

gsum brag gis sgo brgyab pa ltar bkag de yi rgyab tu gza' bdud phug pa zhesakhya ba der gza' bdud rnams kyi 'du ra yin pas slob dpon gyi thugs dgongs la de mur bzhag na yul rnams dug mtshos 'jig par nyen pas/ a phyir bka' gnang bas a phyis brag de me long gis 'khred bshag gnang bas/slob dpon gyi dgongs par thabs de 'gor che bas khong nyid bdud 'dul phug pa nas gu ru bdud 'dul drag po'i skur bzhengs nas rdo rje 'phangs te brag brdol ba'i khungs po dang / rdo rje'i rjes dang / me long gis brag bshag pa'i shul bcas da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ de nas bzung ngo mtshar can gyi chu tshan chags/ mdun ri 'bras dkar spungs pa lta bu dang / rgyab tu brag ri dar dkar 'phyar dang 'dra/ nam mkha' mthing sangs g.yu 'od 'bar ba'i klong / khyad par mu le'i mthing khrag gter sgrom gnas/ che bzhi chen po a phyi rna nam bza'/ nad gdon gdug pa 'dul ba'i chu tshan chags/ g.yon ri om kog bha la sgrub phug nang / bha lha'i dge gnyen zhes kyang bya ba yod/ de nas yan lag brgyad ldan chu mig yod/ de yi phan nus chu tshan 'di ru khyab/rgyab ri glang chen 'dra ba'i rang byon la/ de steng nor bu me 'bar btsugs pa 'dra/ khyad par slob dpon bdud 'dul sgrub phug na/ khyad 'phags khri dang rdor dril rang byon yod/ de yi glang sna'i 'og tu chu tshan chags/ g.yas ri'i ngos su ha ra'i sku mkhar dang / rlung ri rdzong du ha ra'i phug pa chags/ de yi steng du rgyang grags dam can chu/ khyad par chos ldan bzang mo'i sgrub khang yod/byin rlabs char rgyun chu tshan 'di ru khyab/ 'brong ngur chu nas byang sems dkar po 'bab/ chu tshan nas kyang byang sems dmar po 'bab/ de gnyis yar ngo'i zla ba'i tshes bzang la/ dus gcig sbyor ba dngos su mthong rgyu yod/phyogs bzhir gnas bzhi 'dzoms pa'i chu tshan 'di/ lhag par lo rgyus thog nas bshad pa na/ bod ljongs yongs la chu tshan mang mod kyang / chu tshan 'di 339

nyid tsha grang snyoms pa dang / shin tu dwangs gtsang dri med gting tshad snyoms/sdig sgrib dag nas dus nad bcos par byed/ slob dpon zhal bzhugs skabs kyi gsung rab la/ nga ni lho nub srin po'i yul du 'gro/ chu tshan 'di ni nga yi tshab tu bzhag byin gyis brlabs pas nga dang khyad par med/ nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi la yang phan/ chu tshan nang du sman rdo rtsa chen yod/rang lus na tsha gang yod de ru sbyor/ zhes so/ phyogs sgrig pa yi sdud pa'i snying po ni/ gter sgrom reb dang gter sgrom gnas/ mdzes sdug yid 'ong yul ljongs 'dir/ ri mtho g.yang gzar sman rdos khyab/ cong zhi pho mos shel dkar mdog shing sna 'dzoms shing mkha' rlung bzang / yul mi rnams kyi dka' sdug sel/ yan lag brgyad ldan chu mig yod/ nad rigs kun la mchog tu phan/ 'di yi khyad chos mngon gsal can/ bya sna 'dzoms shing sa mchog 'dir/ dbyar rgyal glu len thog ma'i gnas/ snyan po'i rol gyis mi rnams dga'/ mi tshe ring ba'i khyad chos yod/ e ma gnas 'di ngo mtshar che/(21)chu tshan 'di'i grub cha dang / phan nus skor/rang ljongs su chu tshan mang po yod cing / drod che ba'i gter dngos sna tshogs la brten nas rang byung chu tshan chags pa dang / gter dngos sman rdzas la brten nas mu zi dang / cong zhi/ brag zhun/ rdo zho/ brag tshur sogs 'dres nas chu tshan so so'i nus pa mi 'dra ba dang / dri dang / mdog ro/nus pa mi 'dra ba yang yod/ lhag par gter sgrom rang byung chu tshan 'di ni phal cher rdo sol cong zhi mu zi bcas 'dus pa'i chu tshan zhig 'dra bas dri med dwangs shing ja chang la bsres kyang ro mi 'gyur/ de yi gtso bcos ni/ pho ba rmug po tshad rnying dang / chu ser grang ba'i nad rnams sel/ dreg grum rtsa dkar pags nad bcas la yang phan/ chu tshan rgyag pa'i dus tshod ni/ bod zla gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa dang / bdun pa brgyad pa dgu pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni dbyar char dang po ma gtogs pa/ mkha' las babs pa'i chu mchog 340

yin/ri’ ma dros mtsho las babs pa'i chu/ yan lag brgyad kyi yon tan tshang /ston zla 'bring po'i yar ngo la/ chu dug thams cad sa la thim/ yan lag brgyad ldan yon tan gyis/ cha shas chu rnams kun la khyab/ dus der skyes bu rtsal ldan gyis/ chu zhugs 'du ba spyi snyoms ni/ lu ma 'khyil chu rul pa min/shugs drag brdabs pa'i 'bab chur bya/(22)chu tshanasbyi'i phan yon skor/dug dang tshad rnying dgyer ba 'don pa dang / dreg grum 'bam 'jug re 'khums bshig par byed/ 'bras dang sur gyi rnag dang chu ser skem/ skem po rgyas shing sbom po bri ba dang / dgye bo dgug cing sgur po 'drong bar byed/chu tshan rgyag skabs gzab nan byed dgos pa ni/ khrag shed mtho dang snying nad can/ tsha ba rgyas pa'i nad rigs can/ sbrum ma bcas kyis spangs dang nyung zhugs bya/ chu tshan rgyag skabs dang thog mgo nas snying khar chu bcag rim pas bya/ nad yod gnas der bkru zhing phur mnyed dang / lhag par khog par skran yod na chu tshan gyi chu dal pos thung zhing pho bar bskor/ gzhan yang rlung bcos rlung gnon bya thabs dang / zas goms spyod lam nad khams bstun te bya/ chu las thon ma nyid du drod la nyal/ phan nus mngon gsal ma byung bar du bsten/ chu nang zhugs yun thog mar thung tsam dang / bar du ring tsam mtha' mar thung tsam gyis/ de bzhin thog mar thengs grangs nyung ba dang / bar du cung mang mjug tu nyung du btang / spyir btang chu tshan rgyag stangs ngag rgyun bzhin/ nas 'bru lta bu dgos pa gdams ngag yin/ dpyid dus bdun gnyis ston dus bdun khrag gsum/ tshul bzhin brgyab ste lus stobs rgyas pa'i thabs/ zas spyod gang gzab bstan la rab brtson na/ gong gsal nad rigs 'joms pa gdon mi za/ gzhan yang las brel khom pa med rnams kyang / nyin grangs gsum nas bdun bar zhugs na yang / de dang 341

mthun pa'i phan nus yong ba las/ phan pa med pa ma yin thugs bder mdzod/gong gsal gnas yig dang / chu tshan gyi phan nus mdor bsdus phyogs sgrig bgyis pa'i nang nga tsho'i yon tshad shin tu dma' ba'i rkyen gyis yig don gnyis kar don 'khrul yod nges pas rgya che'i blo mthun rnam pas lhag bsam rnam dag gis rogs ram gnang rgyur snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/lo rgyus gsal bshad mkhan dge slong chos 'phel dang / chags chen 'phel dar/ phyogs sgrig mkhan chos rje bzang po bcas thun mong nas 1982lo'i zla 6tshes 10la/(nga /) deng sang zangs ri rdzong khongs 'ol dga' chu tshan ni lho kha rtsed thang grong rdal nas byang shar phyogs su spyi le bdun cu don gnyis tsam gyi sar yod pa dang / rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad spyi khre bzhi stong nyis brgya tsam yod/der chu tshan khag lnga yod pa'i gnas yul ni/(1)sman chu chu tshan zhes pa sngon ma'i 'ol dga' rdzing gi nub byang ri chen gyi zhabs 'og tu gnas yod pas nyi ma bzhud snga ba dang / rdzing phyi'i 'bab chu'i ri 'gram du rgyugs pa 'dres pa lta bu las rdzing bu zur du mi mngon pa zhig 'dug pa chu de ya mar phan zhes ngag rgyun 'dug(2)'phags pa chu tshan (pha kha'ang zer )zhes pa sman chu dang nye ba'i byang shar phyogs der brag ri dkar gong lta bu zhig gi 'og nas chu kha shar lhor bltas nas thon gyin 'dug pa chu'i rgyugs tshad chung ngu zhig las mi 'dugardzing gi rgya khyon smi gru bzhi ma bcu drug tsam dang / gting tshad skar ma sum cu tsam yod/ chu tshan de mkhal ma'i nad la phan pa che ba yod 'dug rung / 'ol dga'ardzong zhol dang khad nye bas yul mi tshos nyin mo nyal gos gdan sogs btsog pa sna tshogs 'khru ba dang / ko ba sbong ba/ dgong dro pho mo rgan gzhon tshang ma chu ras med par dmar hreng mar sdebs 'dzul mnyam por chu zhugs byed srol tha chad ya nga ba zhig 'dug pa sems kyis mi bzod par shang krang ngo 342

'phrad kyis de ltar mi 'byung ba mang tshogs la slob gso btang ste chu tshan gtsang ma byung na 'grul pa mang du phyin nas yul gyi thon khungs la rin dngul 'bab rgyu dang / rang gzhan thams cad kyi 'phrod bsten la phan pa bcas dge mtshan che zhes 'bod bskul byas par shang krang nas brjod gsal sngar nas de rang lang shor gyis bkag 'gog mi thub ces 'khur len mi byed pa bzang ngan mi shes stabs ngos rang gis mi grangs bcu skor glas te nyin shas ring rdzing bu rgya cher btang ste rdo chen gyi bar bcad brgyab/ rmig 'dag ar 'dam byugardzing mdo spug gnyis bzos/ rdzing sbug ma sman bcos 'phrod bsten bya yul gtsang ma bzos nas nub gcig mtshan gang chu bsags/ sang zhogs snga bar langs te chu zhugs la 'gro skabs mdang nub mtshan mo de rang la nyal gdan sogs 'khrus pa'i dreg zhag zhag 'khyil 'khyil gyi btsog pa btsog rkyang bzos 'dug pa 'go dmangs tshang mas sgrig khrims 'khur shes rtsa ba nas med pa yi mug skye ba'i gnas so/) (3)spang kha chu tshan zhes pa 'phags pa chu tshan nas mal le gcig trem gyi sar byang shar ri ma 'dab tu khor yug gi sa cha phal cher spang sa yin la sa'i mdog sngo nag dang chu tshan gyi chu thon sa nas rdzing gi bar spyi khre bdun tsam yod cing / rdzing gi rgya khyon smi gru bzhi ma bzhi bcu zhe lnga tsam dang / chu'i gting tshad skar ma bzhi bcu tsam yod/ chu'i gting du 'dag rnyog sngo nag ha cang mang po zhig 'dug(4)skyogs gcus chu tshan (skya chung yang zer )zhes pa spang kha dang ri rgyud gcig pa'i byang shar ri ldebs su yod/ chu tshan de rje tsong kha pa chen pos chab skyogs kyis gcus nas gsar du bton gnang mdzad pas skyogs gcus zhes grags/ gnas yul spang kha chu tshan 'dra po yod kyang chu tshan de brag gi gseb nas kha lhor bltas te thon gyi 'dug brag rdo de'i khor yug la spang 343

rtsa'am na thang gi rtsa ring po skyes yod la khur mang dang / g.yang mo thang gi me tog ser po tha thor du bzhad 'dug rdzing gi rgya khyon smi gru bzhi ma drug tsam rdo brtsigs dang / mthil du rdo g.yam gcal bsgrigs/ chu'i gting tshad spyi khre gang tsam nas lcags mdong nang brgyud 'og ma'i 'khru shal rdzing chung nang bab pa bcas/(5)gro lo kha'i chu tshan zhes pa 'ol dga' rdzong gi shar byang rdzing phyi'i chu bo lho phyogs su rgyu ba'i shar ngos su gro lo thang zhes pa'i na thang yangs shing rgya che ba de'i byang dbus su gnas yod pa dang / na thang 'dres mtshams kyi rdo hrug gi seng dbar nas chu 'bur 'bur du yar tshad 'phags te 'khol bzhin thon gyin 'dug chu tshan de tā la sku 'phreng rim byon rnams khrus gsol gyi chu rdzing yin pas sngar skye bo gzhan sus kyang der chu tshan rgyag gi med pa red/ bar skabs lo bcu'i zang zing nang chu khol der phag pa sogs bsad de sha dang /sgo nga tshod sa byas pa dang ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i ’’skabs gzim chung le lag sogs thog bshus brgyab ste shing rdo rku 'khyer dang / chu rdzing nang sa ro rdo ro rgyangs te bed spyod byed sa med pa bzos yod pa red/ 1986lor phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis 'gro gron btang ste chu tshan khag bzhi 'dag shangs nyams gso byas pa dang / lhag par gro lo kha'i chu rdzing gi mthil du sngar rdo g.yam gcal du bsgrigs yod pa nyams gso dang / rdo brtsigs nyams gsos kyis ar 'dam rmig 'dag byugs shing / rdzing gi chu nas lcags mdong nang drangs te nub phyogs su sku gzugs 'khru shal gnang sa rdzing chung gsar du bzos/ lcags ri rdo brtsigs nyams bzo dang / gzim sgo gsar du bzos te sgo lcags rgyag rgyu yod pa dang / chu tshan gyi tsha drod gcog byed byang shar mtshams kyi rdzing phyi'i gtsang chu nas chu tshan gyi rdzing nang 'dren rgyu'i chu yur 'dag bshangs byas pa bcas chu tshan de khams gtsang dwang ba 'dren pa byung yod par zangs ri rdzong gi dbu khrid tshos dga' bsu bsngags brjod gnang ba 344

dang / phran blo bstan nas zhen bskul zhus pa ltar gro lo kha'i chu tshan du phebs mkhan tsho bzhugs sa'i khang pa dang / thab tshang / srung bya ba sdod khang bcas zangs ri rdzong nas gsar rgyag gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes kyang thob/ chu tshan gyi rgya khyon ni spyi le gru bzhi ma nyi shu lhag tsam gyi dkyil du sngar gyi rdo btsugs gru bzhi ma skar ma bzhi bcu tsam 'bur thon dang / dpangs la spyi khre gnyis tsam yod par chu'i gting tshad spyi khre gcig tsam nas lcags mdong nang 'khru shal rdzing chung du babs pa/ gro lo kha'i chu tshan yod sa'i sa gnas de gzhan dang mi 'dra ba na thang sa gzhi snyoms la rna'u gsing spang gshongs yangs shing rgya che ba dang /lho phyogs nas gangs ri mtho ba 'o de gung rgyal gyi pho brang gangs ri'i khor yug gi dbu rtse rnams mthong ba/ de'i byang mdun du chos lung dgon gyi rgyab ri rtse mo rdza ri dang / bar du nags ri/ ri gsham spang ri bcas byed pos bskrun pa lta bu dang / gro lo thang gi nub phyogs rdzing phyi'i gtsang tshu dwangs gtsang byang nas lho ru rgyu ba/ byang shar sa thag ring po na yod pa'i gangs ri'i rtse mo mthong ba/ shar phyogs nyi ma gling gi ri bo maṇ+ḍal gyi tsho ma bu lta bu dang / shar lho phyogs kyi ri bo gangs ri'i rtse mo mig lam du mngon pa sogs yul ljongs lta na sdug pa'i mdzes chos mang po zhig yod pa dang / na thang gi lhor ri chung steng du yod pa'i 'ol dga'i mkhar rdzong rnying pa'i gyang gog gi rgyab mdun du grong khyim them dud brgya skor gnas sdod byed pa/ 'ol dga'i ri bo khag nas rtsa che'i sman rigs sman rtsa dang / spa shug ba lu/ bsangs dga' ldan 'khan pa/'khan dkar/ spen ma/ gla 'tsher/ glang ma/ dmar rtsi/ 'jab phyags/dkar 'dag sogs thon khungs bzang ba/ 'ol dga'i yul du chu rigs gsum mgon po yod zer ba 'di ltar/ shar phyogs yar lha sham po'i gangs ri las 'bab pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi chu bo zhes pa dkar po 'o ma mdog dang /byang phyogs rdzing phyi'i gtsang chu khrus chab mdog 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi chu bo 345

zhes pa/ nub byang sle lung gi phu chu mdog sngo nag phyag na rdo rje'i chu bo zhes pa bcas chu rigs gsum mgon po bo stod sa char gcig tu 'dus pa'i gtsang chu de gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i chu shugs ngo mtshar che bar brten dus phyis lab kyi kha spros yar rgyab gtsang po'i byang phyogs su lho kha'i glog khang chen mo brgyab ste lo shas song ba dang / slar yang 1986lo lab nas bo stod la ma slebs tsam der glog khang gsar pa che ba zhig gsar rgyag byas yod pa red/ dbyar dus su bo stod khul gyi chu bo rigs gsum mgon po 'dus mtshams nas bzungs phyogs gyen 'ded kyis bskyod skabs ri klung thams cad snum bag ldan zhing /g.yas g.yon gang sar nyin mtshan kun tu sman bsangs kyi dri bsung mngar sing ldan pa dang / yid la dga' bde 'phel ba/ skye bo kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog pa zhig yod pa de ni 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po dang 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad yab sras rnams kyis khul de'i yas mas rnams su dgon sde ri khrod mang po gsar bzhengs kyis sgrub pa rnam dag mdzad pa dang / bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mang po mngon sum zhal gzigs gsung thos byung tshul sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad pa'i gnas yul gyi byin rlabs yin pa gor ma chag gro lo kha'i chu tshan gyi chu de nas drod ldan chu rkyal rgyag sa'i rdzing chen zhig bzos na bzo bder yod pas phyi rgyal nas yul skor spro 'cham la phebs mkhan tsho spro skyid gtong yul yong ba dang / chu tshan la phebs mkhan dang bcas par mgron khang gsar rgyag byas pa yin na 'ol dga' yul lung gi thon khungs mar phyur dang / spu bal/ sman rtsa sogs dang / mdor na zho 'o ma/sgo nga / me shing sogs tshong sgo phye nas sngar ma grags pa'i dngul gyi yong 'bab gang legs yong rgyu smos med khar/ lha sa sogs la 'grim 'grul stabs bde'i gnas mjal dang / mkho sgrub tshong thabs bcas phyug 'gyur gyi lam chen gsar gtod bde blag ngang thub pa'i cha rkyen shin tu 'dzoms rung 'khur 346

bsam bskyed mkhan ma byung ba ha cang phangs par brten zangs ri rdzong gi 'go khrid rnam par phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis de skor 'grel bshad zhen bskul zhus par dga' mos chen pos de 'dra byed thub na gang legs yong nges lags kyang nga tshor gron dngul gtong dmigs med pas de lta bu 'byung thabs dka' lugs kyi 'bad brtson thub min gsungs so/ 347

bcu gcig dus rabs 'di'i nangasgil gyi nyo thang ji byas skor gyi gnas tshulasador bsdus shigabadag dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi mi tshe'i ring gi lo rgyus mthong thos myong gsum gyi gnas tshul gong 'khod rnams kyi thog da dung kha bskong 'god rgyu mang po zhib bsdad 'dug rung / da cha na tshod rgas pa'i dka' ngal dang / mi tshe'i lo rgyus mjug sdom bya rgyu'i dus tshod 'gyangs gzhir brten zhib 'god bya mtshams 'dir bzhag 'on kyang dus rabs 'di'i nang yul gyi 'tsho ba'i nyo thang ji byas skor 'god gal che bar bsams mdor bsdus shig 'god par bya ste/ de'ang bdag byis pa'i dus su tā la'i bla ma sku 'phreng bcu gsum pas bod kyi srid skyong ba'i dus skabs 'khel 'dugabod kyi yul goms 'tsho ba'i nang gi gtso che shos 'bru mar gnyis yin gshis/ 1920nang ngos kyi pha mes kyi skyes yul mal gro gung dkar rdzong zhol du 'bru ru'i khal rer rin dngul srang gang zho do re dang / chang kha ldir gang (a'u h+phang tsam )la rin dngul kha gang zhes skar phyed gsum byed pa dran gyi 'dug de dus lha sar 'bru ru'i khal rer rin dngul srang gang zho lnga re yin tshod 'dug mar lha srang gi 'degs khal rer rin 'bru ru'i khal gnyis re rgya khyab tu byed pas dngul la phab na mar 'degs khal rer rin dngul srang do zho lnga dang srang gsum yas mas dang / ja 'bru dang sbag chung rer rin dngul srang med zho gsum/ ja ril rer rin dngul srang med zho gang / 'bri be'u skye rgyu yod pa rer rin 'bru ru'i khal bco lnga re dang / dngul byas na dngul srang 348

bco brgyad tsam/ rmon g.yag dang / bsha' g.yag legs pa rer rin dngul srang nyi shu rtsa bzhi rtsa lnga re/ lug rer rin dngul srang gang zho lnga dang / ra rer rin dngul srang gang zho do/ pho rta 'gros mar rdo tshad gnyis sprad pa zhes ha las las byed pa dngul srang brgya tham pa red/ bzhon drel legs pa rer rin dngul srang drug cu bdun cu tsam re/ kong po'i khal drel rer rin dngul srang sum cu bzhi bcu tsam re sprod len gyi nyo tshong byed kyi 'dug me stag 1926lo phran lha sa'i slob grwar 'gro skabs lha sar rngan pa nyo dus dngul kha gang la bag leb che chung 'bring tshad gnyis re dang / sha mog mog cung chung ba gsum rer rin dngul kha gang / rgya sran ma brngod ma kha gang la bre gang tsam yod pas slob phrug mang che bas rgya sran ma nyos yong / lug sha khog rer rin dngul srang do re byed cing / bka' blon sogs dpon rigs kyi sku mdun du bcar skabs 'bul mtshan lug sha khog re nges par du 'bul dgos/ sha ngo 'bul 'khyer rgyu med na mgron zhabs la dngul srang med zho bdun skar lnga re phul nas sha khog gcig spyan bstar zhu tsam byas na 'thus yong / de rjes krums dod ces dngul srang gang shog chag dang / kha btags re 'bul srol chags/ gzhung zhabs ser skya phyogs thon nam yin la rtse dang / nor gling gang yin gyi gzim chung 'gag tu drung ja tshogs pa'i dus su thon phyag mjal khar bcar dgos thon gnang zhes gnang char dngul srang med zho bdun skar lnga yod pa'i shog chag la cha'i rtags tham dmar po brgyab pa zhig gsol ras gnangasrol 'dug pa tshod dpag byas na sngar lug sha khog re gsol ras med dam snyam/ lcags rta 1930lo lha sar 'bru ru'i khal rer rin dngul srang gsum re byed skabs skabs der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bkar khang khag nas 'bru 'bor che ba lha sar dbor 'dren gyis mi ru rnying pa'i nang nas mang tshogs la 'bru ru'i khal rer rin dngul srang do re byas te spus tshong byas stabs 349

sger gyi 'bru tshong mkhan tshos kyang 'bru spus dag ru'i khal rer dngul srang do re byas te btsongs song yang / gzhung 'bru tshong mtshams bzhag pa dang de ma thag tu rin gong 'phar te ring por ma song bar 'bru ru'i khal rer rin dngul srang bzhi dang zho lnga byas song / mar la yang lha srang gi 'degs nyag lnga rer rin dngul srang gang re byed mur bzhi srang dang / gsum srang / do srang / mthar nyag srang byas te mar 'degs khal rer rin dngul srang nyi shu tham pa re dang /ja sbag chung rer rin dngul srang gang zho lnga re/ ja ril rer rin dngul srang med zho lnga re/ zi ling pho rta 'gros ma legs pa rer rin dngul ṭam rdo drug bdun tsam re/ bzhon drel legs pa rer rin ṭam rdo lnga nas drug bar/khal drel rer rin ṭam rdo gsum nas bzhi bar bcas byas te nyo tshong byed kyi 'dug rta drel nyo tshong gi dus tshod bzang shos ni/ bod zla brgyad pa'i tshes shar la zi ling gi tshong pa lha sar 'byor dus tshong pa mang che bas rta drel tshong gnyer byed pa yin pas de dus rta drel spus dag mang po 'dems sgrug gis nyo rgyu yod/ de'i dus su 'khor lo'i rigs dar khyab med par brten rta drel la mthong chen byed kyi yod pa red/chu sprel 1932lo tā la'i bla ma'i zhal gdams zhes pa'i nang ‘‘chu glang nas bzung bod ljongs 'di nyid bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la ci dgar longs su spyod rgyu byung ba phra zhib yig lam dang / lha sde mi sde spyi'i blor nges gsal ’’zhes gsungs yod pa dang / chu bya 1933lo'i zla 10tshes 30nyin tā la'i bla ma sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa dgongs pa chos dbyings su thims tshul bstan rjes bod ljongs tshogs 'du chen mos rgyal tshab 'os dmigs bla chen khag gsum 'phags pa lo ke shwa re'i spyan sngar gzan rtags phul te rwa sgreng rin po che rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ rwa sgreng rgyal thog skabs nyo thang rim 'phar gyis bar skabs shig la 'bru ru'i khal rer rin dngul srang brgyad re dang /350

ja sbag chung rer rin dngul srang do re byed skabs lha sar rku ma mang ba sa rib ma rib nas khang pa'i sge'u nang shing skas btsugs te rkun ma mang po shor bar rkun ma 'dug go zhes skad 'bod byed skabs rkun ma bas zhed snang mi byed par/‘‘ā/ rku ma ma rku rang rku red/ 'bru la srang brgyad byed kyi mi 'dug gam ’’zhes skad chen pos lan slog lugs go thos byung / de'i skabs bka' shag gi rgyal sgo'i ldebs su yig bskur sbyar ba'i nang / ‘‘'bru la srang brgyad byed kyi 'dug rgyal po lags/ ja la srang do byed kyi 'dug srid blon lags/ snyoms chung mu ges shi ba 'dug go bka' shag lhan rgyas lags ’’zhes pa'i yig chen sbyar 'grems byas pa byung song bar der brtsad gcod byed pa dang / nyes chad gtong ba sogs byed srol mi 'dugade nas chu lug (1943)bar 'bru ru'i khal rer rin dngul srang bcu gcig nas bcu gnyis tsam re dang / mar 'degs khal rer rin dngul srang sum cu nas sum cu so lnga skor/ ja sbag chung rer rin dngul srang gsum nas bzhi bar/ ja ril rer rin dngul srang gang nas srang gang zho lnga bar/ pho rta 'gros ma rer rin ṭam rdo bco lnga nas nyi shu bar/ zing rta 'gros ma legs par ṭam rdo bzhi bcu nas lnga bcu bar/ bzhon drel legs par rin ṭam rdo sum cu nas bzhi bcu bar/ khal drel rer rin ṭam rdo bco lnga nas nyi shu bar bcas sprod len byed/shing sprel (1944)lo rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po ches lo gsum ring rgyal tshab dgongs pa nan zhu mdzad de yongs 'dzin stag brag rin po cher paṇ+ḍi ta'i mtshan gsol dang bcas rgyal tshab tu bsko gzhag mdzad/ lo gsum 'khor mtshams stag brag rin po ches rgyal tshab dgongs zhu ma gnang rkyen rwa stag gnyis kyi dbar dam sel 'gal zla'i zing cha chen po langs te mthar rwa sgreng rin po che khrims mun du bcug rtse shar chen lcog gi btson khang nang snyun bzhes kyis zhing gzhan la gshegs par gnas tshul 'dra min lab gleng mang po 351

byung zhing / spyi tshogs brtan lhing ma byung stabs nyo thang yang ha cang 'phar te 'bru ru'i khal rer rin ṭam rdo gsum nas bzhi bar dang / mar khal rer rin ṭam rdo drug nas bdun bar ja sbag chung rer rin dngul srang bzhi nas lnga bar/ zing rta 'gros mar ṭam rdo lnga bcu drug cu nas ṭam rdo drug brgya bdun brgya bar dang / bzhon drel legs pa rer rin ṭam rdo brgyad cu dgu bcu nas ṭam rdo lnga brgya drug brgya bar/ khal drel rin ṭam rdo bzhi bcu lnga bcu nas ṭam rdo brgya dang lnga bcu dang brgya dang drug cu bar bcas ha cang gi nyo thang 'phar ba dang / spyi tshogs nang blo bag ma phebs pa byung yod/1959lo'i zla 3nang lha sar ngo log zing 'khrug langs rjes nyo thang sogs kyiganas tshul go thos tsam las dngos su ma mthong bar brten 'dir 'bri ma thub kyang 1980lo skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs tshun krung dbyang gi mdzad jus bzang po lag bstar 'og rgyal yongs su yar rgyas kyi 'go tshugs pa dang / srid jus lhug gtong gnang ba bzhin gus blo bstan yang 1980lor phyi rgyal nas rang yul lha sar 'byor skabs bod rang skyong ljongs su hru'u ci dbyin h+pha thang gis gtso 'gan dbu khrid gnang gi 'dug skabs der yar rgyas gtong 'go tshugs pa tsam las lo bcu'i zang zing gi shugs rkyen ngan pa'i dbang gis lha sar phyogs gang ci'i thad la tha zhan tsam dang dgos mkho nyo sa med pa/ kung si nas ras kha gang tsam nyos na'ang ‘‘pu phe'o ’’zhes pa'i ras 'dzin med na mi thob pa dang /mdor na bag leb sgor sgor gcig nyo dgos na'ang ‘‘leng phe'o ’’zhes pa'i 'bru 'dzin dgos pa sogs ha cang dka' rnyog che zhing / ser skya mi dmangs kyi gyon gos zhwa lham sogs thabs skyo tsam gnas 'dug rung / ngos rang gi phru gu tshos brjod gsal ‘‘da phyin chad yag po yong gi red/ gang lags she na deng dus krung dbyang gi mdzad phyogs dngos 'brel gyi gang legs yod gshis rim 352

bzhin yar rgyas 'gro rgyur blos 'gel byas chog gi red ’’ces blo bag phebs mdog byed kyi 'dug bu mo 'bring ba bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par las khungs kyi yig sgyur tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms dang / bu 'bring ba lha sa grong khyer slob 'bring dang po'i ang rtsis dge rgan bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ bu gzhon pa ljongs lha sa slob 'bring dge rgan skal bzang rdo rje bcas kyi las ka lha sar yod par brten khong tshos phran la 'tsho ba'i bkod sgrig gang legs byas pa ma zad bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms nas gros 'go bton te pā lags su 'dzin dngos thab chas nyo dmigs su phru gu re nas dngul sgor bdun cu re lam seng 'phral 'bul thog zla re'i 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen blos bcad gang thub kyis zla re bzhin 'bul dgos zhes 'bod bskul byas pa dang / bu mo tshe g.yang rang nyid nas dngul sgor bdun cu dang gla spu'i 'bol gdan cha gcig grum ze'i gdan khred shol gcig thab chas dgos mkho tsag tsig zla re sgor bzhi bcu zhe lnga re bcas sprad byung yang / bu mor phru gu yod pa dang bu rdzi gso skyong byed dgos pas zla re'i dngul de tsam ma dgos lab ste zla re sgor sum cu re blangs/de bzhin bu bstan 'dzin phun tshogs dang / skal bzang rdo rje gnyis so so nas kyang gdan lcog thab chas dang / dngul sgor bdun bcu re/ zla re dngul sgor sum cu re bcas sprad byung bar bu bstan 'dzin phun tshogs la phru gu gsumayod stabs zla re'i dngul rtsa ba nas mi dgos lab kyang u tshugs kyis sprad pa zla shas mtshams mi len pa'i mna' bskyal/ 'on kyang rnam kun pha'i las ka tsag tsig dang / gos 'khru/ skra bzhar sogs 'phyugs med dang len rgyun 'khyongs byed cing / de rjes phru gu gzhan dag tshos kyang dngul sgor bdun cu re dang / zla re blos bcad kyi sgor nyi shu sum cu re sprad byung yang phal che bar yong 'bab de tsam mi 'dug stabs zla re'i dngul 'bab sprod ma dgos lab ste ma blangs/353

1982lo bu mo rgan pa bde skyid chos sgron rgya nag zhan yang slob grwa'i dge rgan nas bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan du las bsgyur gyis lha sar 'byor zhing / phran la lag sne'i dngul dang dgos mkho treg tsig mang po dang /zla re sgor bzhi bcu zhe lnga re sprad byung ba de 'dra mi dgos sgor sum cu res 'grigs lugs bshad kyang / bu mos brjod gsal gus mos skyes ma dam pa der sa khad 'gyangs stabs zhabs zhu bka' drin gsol rgyu ma byung bar blo 'gyod chen po yod/ da cha pha khyed kyi bka' drin gso ched bzhes rogs zhes u nan che bas len dgos byung / bu phrug pho mo dgu po ya rabs tshul mthun zhe gcig las ma rabs rtsing spyod byed mkhan gcig kyang med pa ma zad/ khong tsho rgyal gces lhag bsam yang mi dman tsam yod pas blo ba bde zhing / phru gu tshos bshad pa ltar ring por mi thogs par krung dbyang gi srid jus yig cha dang bka' dgongs rnams rim bzhin lag bstar byung nas bod kyi dka' ngal rim sel gyis lo re nas lo re bzhin yar rgyas gong 'phel myur mgyogs byung ba dang / lhag par du 1983nas bzung lo gsum gyi nang krung dbyang gi bka' bzhin bod du dza drag chen pos ar las rgya che dang / lam bzo sogs 'dzugs skrun rgya che spus dag mang po dang / gang ci'i srid jus lhug gtong gis phyi phyogs sgo dbye/ nang khul tshong 'thab dang / 'grim 'grul bde ru phyin pa/ 'gan gtsang lam lugs btsugs pa sogs kyis nyo tshong 'khrugs la bza' bca'i rigs dang / nye mkho sne 'dzoms 'bel lhug gi dga' ba skye 'os pa'i yar rgyas gong 'phel chen po byung ba dang / 1985lo bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob nas lo nyi shu 'khor ba'i dus dran rten 'brel mdzad sgor krung dbyang gi sku tshab hru'u chi lis tshogs gtso mdzad pa'i krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa dang / kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che (sku phreng bcu pa )sku 'khor bcas rgyal sa pe cin nas mkha' lam thog lho kha gnam gru 'bab thang brgyud lha sar 354

phebs te nor gling byang shar lha sa mgron khang chen mor zhabs sor 'khod/ lha sar dus bab brtan lhing yod pas mdzad sgo khag gra rten legs 'grigs byung ba dang / skabs der bod rang skyong ljongs kyi dbu khrid gtso bo gsar pa wu'u cing hwa bsko gzhag ngo sprod gnang ste mdzad 'khur bzhes shing / blo mthun wu'u cing hwa ni sku stobs che la mi babs rdzig cing / mkhyen yon gnyis ldan/ las don khag bab lhing brtan gsum yod pa dang / lhag par du bod kyi yul goms gshis lugs dang / mi rigs mthun sgril/ chos dad rang mos sogs la brtsi 'jog da nga lag len bstar te 1986lo lha ldan smon lam chen mo bskyar gso tshogs thub pa ma zad/ bco lnga mchod pa'ang sngar gyi mtho tshad ltar bzhengs shing / mchod 'bul dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur gsol ja bzhes thug dang gsol zhib/ sku 'gyed/ dge bshes lha ram pa'i dam bca'/byams pa gdan 'dren sogs chos phyogs kyi mdzad sgo gang legs byung bar bod mi ser skya yongs kyis spyi mos gus bkur dang / mes rgyal la dga' zhen byed pa bcas gang legs su yod kyang phyi rgyal kha bral ring lugs pas dkrugs shing gis rkyen pas lnga lo 1987nas bzung lha sar na gzhon grwa pa dang /btsun ma mi dmangs nyung shas bcas nas snga rjes su ‘‘bod rang btsan ’’yin zhes pa'i skad 'bod khrom bskor byas pa dang / ya med khrims 'gal gyis gzhung khang dang rlangs 'khor mer bsregs btang bas ma tshad bde srung dmag mir rdo gzhus rma rmas dang / dmag mi gcig g.yang bskyur gyis bsad pa sogs shin tu ma rung ba'i bya spyod spel ba dang / de bzhin rgyal sa pe cin du slob phrug gis zing cha bslangs pa'i shugs rkyen bod du thebs nas lha sa'i slob grwa khag gi nang nas kyang khrom bskor skad 'bod byas pa sogs la gzur gnas kyi skye bo rnams ci drag snyam pa'i blo g.yeng chen po byung song yang / rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs dang / rang ljongs dbu khrid rnam pa'i srid jus la brten nas 355

zing cha de tsho 'phral myur bde blag ngang 'gog gnon thub ste deng gi dus su brtan lhing gang legs su yod pa dang / phran dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin yang phyi rgyal nas rang yul lha sar log nas da bar (19kro)lo bcu hril po 'khor zhing / 1983bar se ra chos sding sgang du bsdad de bu phrug tshos gang thub kyis 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen sbyar nas kha 'don dge sbyor gang legs byung ba dang / 1984nas bzung lha sa grong khyer srid gros su bcar thag nye khyad dang bcas bod ljongs slob grwa chen mor bu mo bde chos kyi las shag tu bsdad de bu mo bde chos lags nas 'tsho ba'i sri zhu gang ci 'jungs pa med pa tshags tshud gtsang sbra dang dod dang ldan pa rgyun 'khyongs yid dang mthun pa bsgrubs par brten rgyal khab nas rtsa ba'i phogs dngul dang / gong 'khod phru gu tsho'i zla re'i mthun rkyen sprad pa'i dngul 'bab bcas kyis rgyun ldan gyi mchod gtor dang / mchod me/ dus bzang khag dang zla ba yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i gsol tshogs sogs kyi mchod 'bul dang sbyin gtong bcas gang thub byas te 'di phyi gnyis dge'i bya bas dga' skyid kyi dus 'da' zhing / 1987lo sngar gyi dam bca' yod pa ltar yi dam lhag lha'i bsnyen mtshams la lo gsum zla gsum bsdad 'thus dgongs zhu phul bar chos dad rang mos la dgongs bzhes bla med kyis bka' 'khrol byung ba bzhin se ra chos sding sgang du bsnyen mtshams su sdod skabs bsod dman la bar chad sdang ba'i dpe ltar skabs der grwa btsun gyis zing cha bslangs stabs chos sding sgang du grwa btsun gab yib yod med bsngogs bsher du lcags zhwa gyon dmag 'byor te sgo gsum mtshams ral gyis bod ljongs slob grwa chen mor phyir log byed dgos byung / de rjes rgyal khab kyi bka' 'brel lha sar bkag rgya bsdams pa nas bzung zing cha lhing 'jags byung yod/deng dus (1990)lha sa'i nyo thang ni 'bru ru'i khal rer rin mi dmangs 356

srang 45) lo gsum kham bu rgya ma rer rin sgor 1 50(dngul srang 18 5)mngar kham skam po rgya ma rer rin sgor 6 00(dngul srang 90) shing tog a mra rgya ma rer rin sgor 3(dngul srang 45) chi pi kha rgya ma rer rin sgor 1 00(dngul srang 15) li rgya ma rer rin sgor 2 00(dngul srang 30) bye ma ka ra rgya ma rer rin sgore 1 80(dngul srang 27) ja spa ti rgya ma rer rin sgor 12 00(dngul srang 180) zho shel dam gang la sgor 1 00(dngul srang 15) 'o ma shel dam rer sgor 1 00(dngul srang 15) phyur zhib bre byi ril snod glang gog lan par rer rin sgor 2 00(dngul srang 30)sman rtsis khang gi spos ang dang brgya bam rer sgor 40 00(dngul srang 600) ang gnyis spos chag rer sgor 5 00(dngul srang 75) sman grol gling gi spos legs chag thung rer sgor 18 00(dngul srang 270) ang gnyisapa spos chag rer sgor 12 00(dngul srang 180) gla rtsi sgor ljid gcig la sgor 300(dngul srang 4500) zhal gser sgor ljid la sgor 1200(dngul srang 18000) kha che sha ka ma rgya ma re la sgor 500(ṭam rdo 150)me tog rtsam pa ka gang bu che ba rer sgor 7 00(dngul srang 105) rtsa ku sha chag pa rer rin sgor 5(dngul srang 75) bal gyi grum ze'i kha gdan spus legs cha rer rin sgor 1100(ṭam rdo 450) rtsa 'bol cha rer rin sgor 45(dngul srang 675) shing gi gdan khri cha rer sgor 100(ṭam rdo 30) snam bu sha'am pho phyu ldeng ba sbubs rer rin sgor 1000(ṭam rdo 300) snam bu spu phrug spus legs gyon ldeng la rin sgor 400—500(ṭam rdo 120—150)cha sgom spus legs cha rer sgor 600(ṭam rdo 180) mchod gshom brkos ma legs par sgor 5000(ṭam rdo 1500) rgya lcog legs par sgor 150(ṭam rdo 45) rgya lcog nar mo che ba rer rin sgor 250(ṭam rdo 75) ja mdong rag shan mar sgor 120(ṭam rdo 36) gzugs mthong brnyan 'phrin che ba 358

rer rin sgor 5000(ṭam rdo 1500) sgra phab sgra bsdus gcig 'thus legasapar rin sgor 2000(ṭam rdo 600) sgra sdud 'khor lo legs par rin sgor 100(ṭam rdo 30) shing gdung ma bzhi gzhogs spus legs ring shos rer rin sgor 100(ṭam rdo 30) gdung dkyus rer sgor 35re/ lcam rgyugs legs pa rer rin sgor 15re/ spang leb mthug legs ring ba rer sgor 30re/ spang leb zheng che sgo spang mthug par sgor 40re srab pa rer sgor 30re/ ar 'dam mkhregs legs do po rer rin sgor 45re/ ang gnyis pa do rer rin sgor 25re/ lcags gdung ring legs rer rin sgor 500re/ rtsigs rdo rer sgor 0 80 mkhregs sa'i sa phag rer rin sgor re/khang pa gsar rgyag bogs ma byas na bod khang spus dag ang dang gi rgyu cha yongs rdzogs bogs len nas btang ste zhal ba tshon rtsi khra shel sogs bsdad chog bzos na smi gru bzhi ma rer rin sgor nyis brgya lnga bcu nas sgor nyi brgya nyis shu bar sprod len byed srol/ de 'brel phyi rgyal dang / mes rgyal nang khul nas thon pa'i gyon chas sogs mkho dngos sna tshogs mang po dang / bod rang du bzos pa'i dngos zog sne 'dzoms bcas nyo bde ba/ 'grim 'grul 'khor lo mang ba/ lhag par lha sa grong khyer nang gzhung sger gnyis ka'i spyi spyod rlangs 'khor mang du phyin pa dang / dus phyis 'khor gsum rkang 'khor gla pa mang bas 'grul bzhud stabs bde yod pa/ bzo pa las byed par rgan yol las gshol phogs thob gang legs yod thog sdod khang gi dmigs thebs dngul sgor chig khri nas drug stong bar go babs la gzhigs pa'i gsol ras yod stabs las yol khag gi sdod khang gsar rgyag byed mi mang ba/ lha sa grong khyer gyi phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du khang pa gsar pa mang po brgyab pa'i khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su rtse pho brang chen po po ta la gzi byin 'bar bar yod pas grong khyer rgya khyon che la bkod mdzes yid 'ong lta na sdug pa skye bo 359

thams cad dga' ba skye 'os pa zhig tu gyur yod pa red/ gzhan yang krung dbyang gis bod la dmigs bsal gyi thugs brtse chen pos zhing 'brog gnyis nas dpya khral sne sel tsam yang 'bul ma dgos pa chag yang stsal ba 'gyur ba med par gnas mus dang / mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad yig la mthong chen gnang bar rang ljongs nas lag len bstar ma thub pa ma gtogs krung dbyang gi bka' drin chen pos mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad yig bed spyod lag len bstar chog pa rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims nang du bkod gnang yod pa dang / bod ljongs su mi rigs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i mthong chen dang gzigs bskyangs gnang dang gnang mus ma zad slad phyin yang gang cir byams brtse'i gzigs bskyangs gnang rgyur blos 'gel chog pa zhig red snyam gyi 'dug la/ rgya bod zhi mthun brtan lhing yong ba'i smon 'dun zhu rgyu ma zad/ mi rigs thams cad mthun sgril yong ba/ 'dzam gling zhi bde yong ba/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral nas bde ba dam pa dang ldan pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i smon 'dun zhu bzhin pa lags so/mjug byang / shes rmongs bdag 'dra'i lo rgyus yig lam du/ bkod pa'i ngal ba don gyi snying pos dben/ 'on te rang ljongs dbu khrid mchog gi bkas/ yang yang nan bskul che rkyen 'bad brtson zhus/ bdag ni blo dman sbyangs pa chung ba dang / thos nyung skyes sbyangs yon tan shin tu dman/ sngon chad rtsom 'bri'i nyams myong ma mchis kyang / bka' gnang gyen bzlog ma nus spyi brtol bskyed/ rang gi mi tshe 'di yi dus ring la/ bzang ngan mthong thos myong gsum gang yin dang / gzhis byes bod kyi lo rgyus mdzad sgo sogs/ sgro bkur spangs te drang bden bkod lags kyang / ma shes nor 'khrul ci yang yong nges pas/ mkhyen ldan rnams kyis yo bsrang kha bskong mdzod/ 'di yis rngo thogs don phan ma mchis rung / lo rgyus dpyad gzhir sman phyir sems 360

'khur bskyed/ de yang rang lo drug cu re dgu pa/ spyi lo 1983zla 3tshes 15bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu phag zla 2tshes 1bzang por 'go brtsams shing / khas len kha 'don tshig khral tsam bgyis te bar seng nam byung lhod med rtsom bris kyis slad ma'i mjug bsdoms rang lo don lnga pa spyi lo 1990lo zla 7tshes 6rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags rta zla 5tshes 14bzang por rdzogs par bgyis pa'i dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi mi tshe'i lo rgyus 'di dag rang nyid kyis sug bris bgyis pa lags so//361
